10.desc: Play the world's number 1 online action game. Engage in an incredibly realistic brand of terrorist warfare in this wildly popular team-based game. Ally with teammates to complete strategic missions. Take out enemy sites. Rescue hostages. Your role affects your team's success. Your team's success affects your role.
10.name: Counter-Strike

100.desc: With its extensive Tour of Duty campaign, a near-limitless number of skirmish modes, updates and new content for Counter-Strike's award-winning multiplayer game play, plus over 12 bonus single player missions, Counter-Strike: Condition Zero is a tremendous offering of single and multiplayer content.

10090.desc: Call of Duty is back, redefining war like you've never experienced before. Building on the Call of Duty 4®: Modern Warfare engine, Call of Duty: World at War immerses players into the most gritty and chaotic WWII combat ever experienced.
10090.name: Call of Duty: World at War

10180.desc: The most-anticipated game of the year and the sequel to the best-selling first-person action game of all time, Modern Warfare 2 continues the gripping and heart-racing action as players face off against a new threat dedicated to bringing the world to the brink of collapse.

1030300.desc: Discover a vast, haunted kingdom in Hollow Knight: Silksong! Explore, fight and survive as you ascend to the peak of a land ruled by silk and song.

1046930.desc: Hire a crew and destroy your rivals in this new strategy battler set in the world of Dota. Introducing Season One: Explore White Spire and earn rewards on the Battle Pass. Pick from several different game modes, play on your own or with friends, and take advantage of crossplay on PC and mobile.
1046930.name: Dota Underlords

10500.desc: Command the seas, control the land, forge a new nation, and conquer the globe.

105600.desc: Dig, fight, explore, build! Nothing is impossible in this action-packed adventure game. Four Pack also available!
105600.name: Terraria

1063730.desc: Experience a thrilling action RPG set on the supernatural island of Aeternum. Forge your destiny on an adventure filled with danger and opportunity.

10680.desc: Survive, hunt and prey in the deadly jungles and swamps in distinctly new and thrilling first person gameplay.
10680.name: Aliens vs. Predator™

107410.desc: Experience true combat gameplay in a massive military sandbox. Deploy with a wide variety of single- and multiplayer content, a massive arsenal of modern weapons and vehicles, and limitless opportunities for content creation. Authentic, diverse, open - Arma 3 sends you to war.
107410.name: Arma 3

1077310.desc: You’re a cat, and the whole house is yours. Bring up to 7 friends: knock plates off the table, play cat football in the garden, swim in the pool, or curl up together in a sunbeam. No timers, no fail states. Just a warm place to be.
1077310.name: Whiskers of Yesterday

1085660.desc: Explore the mysteries of Sol and experience exhilirating first-person shooter combat in Destiny 2. Unlock powerful abilities and collect unique gear across story missions, co-op, and PvP modes.
1085660.name: Destiny 2

A hardcore RPG skillset, a vast map, massively customisable sandbox and a cute tutorial raccoon await the unwary. So how will you die? All it takes is a bite..

1086940.desc: Baldur’s Gate 3 is a story-rich, party-based RPG set in the universe of Dungeons & Dragons, where your choices shape a tale of fellowship and betrayal, survival and sacrifice, and the lure of absolute power.
1086940.name: Baldur's Gate 3

1089350.desc: NOTE: All multiplayer servers for NBA 2K20 will be shutdown as of 12/31/2021. After that time, all game functions requiring online servers will no longer function.
1089350.name: NBA 2K20

1091500.desc: Cyberpunk 2077 is an open-world, action-adventure RPG set in the dark future of Night City — a dangerous megalopolis obsessed with power, glamor, and ceaseless body modification.
1091500.name: Cyberpunk 2077

109600.desc: Neverwinter is a free, action MMORPG based on the acclaimed Dungeons & Dragons fantasy roleplaying game. Epic stories, action combat and classic roleplaying await those heroes courageous enough to enter the fantastic world of Neverwinter!

1097150.desc: Fall Guys is a free, cross-platform massively multiplayer party royale game. Clumsily compete in absurd obstacle courses with friends or build your very own chaotic course to share with the community.
1097150.name: Fall Guys

1103140.name: Reverie

1116170.desc: Brutal fast-paced isometric Co-op Loot Shooter in Cyberpunk world. Equipment-based combos. Exotic Weapons and Armor. Easy to start, hard to master. Play solo or with friends.
1116170.name: CyberCorp

1118300.desc: A fantasy yuri visual novel in which a noblewoman uncovers her father's evil plot and, along with her lowborn friends, takes to the seas to flee from high society. Her plan to right her family's wrongs and return home are disrupted by the untimely arrival of an enigmatic and flirtatious pirate.
1118300.name: The Sea is Our Stage

1123990.desc: At 5:00 PM, she always dies. No matter how many times time rewinds, her death repeats. Relive the same day, uncover the truth, and defy her fate in this time-loop psychological horror adventure.
1123990.name: Ake no Yosuga - Twilight Loop

113400.desc: The world’s first and premier Action MMO Third Person Shooter allows you to choose between two sides of the law. Play as Enforcer or Criminal, customize your gear for the task at hand and hit the streets and play how you want in a city filled with more action this side of a Hollywood blockbuster.
113400.name: APB Reloaded

1142710.desc: The cataclysmic conclusion to the Total War: WARHAMMER trilogy is here. Rally your forces and step into the Realm of Chaos, a dimension of mind-bending horror where the very fate of the world will be decided. Will you conquer your Daemons… or command them?
1142710.name: Total War: WARHAMMER III

1144200.desc: Ready or Not is an intense, tactical, first-person shooter that depicts a modern-day world in which SWAT police units are called to defuse hostile and confronting situations.
1144200.name: Ready or Not

1145360.desc: Defy the god of the dead as you hack and slash out of the Underworld in this rogue-like dungeon crawler from the creators of Bastion, Transistor, and Pyre.

1158310.desc: Love, fight, scheme, and claim greatness. Determine your noble house’s legacy in the sprawling grand strategy of Crusader Kings III. Death is only the beginning as you guide your dynasty’s bloodline in the rich and larger-than-life simulation of the Middle Ages.
1158310.name: Crusader Kings III

1162860.desc: Burglarize hideous farmhouses in the middle of nowhere and get outta dodge. You have moments before the cops arrive to rob a procedurally-generated house that you've never seen before. If you're caught, residents will call the police even sooner... or take the law into their own hands.
1162860.name: Keepsake County

1172470.desc: Apex Legends is the award-winning, free-to-play Hero Shooter from Respawn Entertainment. Master an ever-growing roster of legendary characters with powerful abilities, and experience strategic squad play and innovative gameplay in the next evolution of Hero Shooter and Battle Royale.
1172470.name: Apex Legends™

1172620.desc: Sea of Thieves is a smash-hit pirate adventure game, offering the quintessential pirate experience of plundering lost treasures, intense battles, vanquishing sea monsters and more. Dive in with this revised edition of the game, which includes access to digital bonus media.
1172620.name: Sea of Thieves: 2026 Edition

1174180.desc: Arthur Morgan and the Van der Linde Gang are outlaws on the run. With federal agents and bounty hunters massing on their heels, the gang must rob, steal, and fight their way across the rugged heartland in order to survive.
1174180.name: Red Dead Redemption 2

1200.desc: Fight in the theatre of war that changed the world forever. Battle alongside your compatriots on some of the most inhospitable environments of the Eastern Front in Red Orchestra: Ostfront 41-45. Red Orchestra places you in the most realistic WWII first-person multi-player combat to date on the PC, allowing the player to fight through...
1200.name: Red Orchestra: Ostfront 41-45

1202520.desc: Fallout 1st is a premium membership that enhances the Fallout 76 experience. Members receive access to Private Adventure and Custom Worlds, exclusive utility and cosmetic items, 1650 Atoms per month, plus other bonuses. Become a member and reclaim the wasteland today!
1202520.name: Fallout 1st

1203220.desc: Dive into the legends of the Far East in NARAKA: BLADEPOINT; team up with friends in fast-paced melee fights for a Battle Royale experience unlike any other. Find your playstyle with a varied cast of heroes with unique skills. More than 40 million players have already joined the fray, play free now!
1203220.name: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT

1203620.desc: Enshrouded is a solo and co-op survival action RPG where your freedom and creativity come first. Conquer the Shroud, a corrupting fog devouring the kingdom of Embervale: explore a handcrafted world full of secrets, forge your hero your way, and build anything, anywhere in a fully terraformable land.
1203620.name: Enshrouded

1209970.desc: Blind Descent is an open-world survival adventure into the mysteries of the Martian depths. Play solo or with friends in 4-player co-op as you search for the missing team. Adapt to survive by building custom tools, upgrading your base, and/or mutating in this bizarre alien world.
1209970.name: Blind Descent

1211600.desc: A great catastrophe has struck. While on a mission, your aircraft crashes and you are trapped in the Zed Zone. Zombies and monsters are everywhere. To escape, gather materials, upgrade your skills, build shelters, and defeat zombie hordes and mysterious mechs as you chase a glimmer of hope.
1211600.name: ZED ZONE

12140.desc: Max Payne is a man with nothing to lose in the violent, cold urban night. A fugitive undercover cop framed for murder, hunted by cops and the mob, Max is a man with his back against the wall, fighting a battle he cannot hope to win. Prepare for pain…
12140.name: Max Payne

12150.desc: Max Payne 2: The Fall of Max Payne is a violent, film-noir love story. Dark, tragic and intense, the in-depth story is a thrill-ride of shocking twists and revelations. Love hurts.
12150.name: Max Payne 2: The Fall of Max Payne

12200.desc: Bully tells the story of mischievous 15-year-old Jimmy Hopkins as he goes through the hilarity and awkwardness of adolescence. Beat the jocks at dodge ball, play pranks on the preppies, save the nerds, kiss the girl and navigate the social hierarchy in the worst school around.
12200.name: Bully: Scholarship Edition

12210.desc: Niko Bellic, Johnny Klebitz and Luis Lopez all have one thing in common - they live in the worst city in America. Liberty City worships money and status, and is heaven for those who have them and a living nightmare for those who don't.
12210.name: Grand Theft Auto IV: The Complete Edition

1222670.desc: Play with life and discover the possibilities. Unleash your imagination and create a world of Sims that’s wholly unique. Explore and customize every detail from Sims to homes–and much more.
1222670.name: The Sims™ 4

1228610.desc: What do you get if you combine an FPS, Parkour, Slowmo & ... Milk? KARLSON. The milk-infused man will stop at nothing to locate and drink his favorite beverage.

1229490.desc: ULTRAKILL is a fast-paced ultra-violent retro FPS that combines the skill-based style scoring of character action games with the unadulterated carnage inspired by the best shooters of the '90s. 1229490.name: ULTRAKILL

1238810.desc: This is the ultimate Battlefield V experience. Enter mankind’s greatest conflict with the complete arsenal of weapons, vehicles, and gadgets plus the best customization content of Year 1 and 2.

1238840.name: Battlefield™ 1

1240440.desc: From one of gaming's most iconic sagas, Halo is bigger than ever. Featuring an expansive open-world campaign and a dynamic free to play multiplayer experience.
1240440.name: Halo Infinite

1245620.desc: THE CRITICALLY ACCLAIMED FANTASY ACTION RPG. Rise, Tarnished, and be guided by grace to brandish the power of the Elden Ring and become an Elden Lord in the Lands Between.
1245620.name: ELDEN RING

1250.desc: 6-player co-op survival horror at its finest! Free updates, free special events and a ridiculous amount of fun!

1257610.desc: Welcome Architects! Design and develop your own personalized penitentiary in Prison Architect 2. The classic prison-builder has broken out into 3D, and it’s up to you to contain it!
1257610.name: Prison Architect 2

1272080.name: PAYDAY 3

1280190.desc: Conquer a vast procedurally generated star system in Falling Frontier, a sci-fi RTS where intel and logistics are decisive factors. Design ships and raid enemy supply lines, lay minefields and construct recon stations, and ambush enemy forces within asteroid fields and nebulae.
1280190.name: Falling Frontier

1281930.desc: Dig, Fight, and Build your way through the world of player-created mods on Terraria with tModLoader - this DLC makes modding Terraria a reality!

1286830.name: STAR WARS™: The Old Republic™

1289670.desc: Unlock a world of thrill. Get unlimited access to a collection of EA’s top titles, trials of select new games, & member discounts and rewards*.

1320170.desc: Guard the beach, react fast, and save lives using quad bikes, jet skis, and drones. Patrol the bay, help those in need, and uncover a hidden criminal intrigue beneath the waves.

1332010.desc: Lost, alone and separated from family, a stray cat must untangle an ancient mystery to escape a long-forgotten cybercity and find their way home.

1366800.desc: Improve your aim and accuracy in every shooter you play. Crosshair X overlays a custom crosshair on top of any game, even games that do not include one. Choose from thousands of community designs or build your own with the designer.

While other games claim to be next-gen with impressive graphics and physics, Assassin's Creed merges technology, game design, theme and emotions into a world where you instigate chaos and become a vulnerable, yet powerful, agent of...
15100.name: Assassin's Creed™: Director's Cut Edition

1517290.desc: Battlefield™ 2042 is a first-person shooter that marks the return to the iconic all-out warfare of the franchise.
1517290.name: Battlefield™ 2042

1520340.desc: Astario is a universe in which you can build functional ships and orbital stations with automated factories. Collect materials, craft new blocks, and expand into the universe. 1536500.desc: Explore the heart of Russia, Moscow, and beyond. Feel the spirit of Russian history driving through centuries-old cities. Get lost in the sea of trees and open plains.
1536500.name: Euro Truck Simulator 2 - Heart of Russia

1550920.desc: Slime Alchemy is a relaxing puzzle game where you must place pieces in specific locations on a hexagonal grid.
1550920.name: Slime Alchemy

1551360.desc: Explore the vibrant open world landscapes of Mexico with limitless, fun driving action in the world’s greatest cars.
1551360.name: Forza Horizon 5

1553240.name: Immerse Gaming | HIVE

15620.name: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War II - Anniversary Edition (Classic)

1574750.desc: Classic Retro STG Is Back! Pick from distinctive fighters, earn permanent upgrades between battles, and brace for bosses that'll drive you up the wall. Grab a friend and sit side by side at the screen, just like old times — or go solo (it's harder).
1574750.name: Super Retro Fighter

1579420.name: Guardians of the Wild Sky

1599340.desc: Embark on an odyssey for the Lost Ark in a vast, vibrant world: explore new lands, seek out lost treasures, and test yourself in thrilling action combat in this action-packed free-to-play RPG.

1623730.desc: Fight, farm, build and work alongside mysterious creatures called "Pals" in this completely new multiplayer, open world survival and crafting game!
1623730.name: Palworld

1652580.desc: Imperial Grace is a visual novel about romance, medieval intrigue, and political strategy. Will you rule with your head, or your heart?
1652580.name: Imperial Grace

1657360.desc: Over 8 hours of soundtrack, and 14 wallpapers.

1665460.desc: Step up and experience the exhilarating soccer game that has now surpassed 1 billion downloads! Play eFootball™ with users around the world!
1665460.name: eFootball™

1667040.name: Under a Rock

1675200.desc: Your games, everywhere Powerful, portable PC gaming, designed for comfort and a console-like user experience
1675200.name: Steam Deck

1677110.desc: Experience a relaxing open-world farming game where your mech does the heavy lifting. Build your ideal farm and automate the upkeep. Tune your mech to clear entire forests and plow vast fields, or kick back and watch the sunset with up to three friends.

1677740.name: Stumble Guys
