1752080.name: HUNGER

1757350.desc: A realistic first-person action horror game that takes you into a dark fort overtaken by a mysterious entity. Unpredictable monsters, a visceral dismemberment system, and realistic physics create an atmosphere of relentless terror.
1757350.name: ILL

1763280.desc: Fighting Front is a retro-inspired turn-based strategy wargame. Command your forces, capture territory, and secure resources across procedurally generated battlefields. Fight on hexagonal, triangular, or square maps against challenging AI opponents.
1763280.name: Fighting Front

1771300.desc: A thrilling story-driven action RPG, with a rich open world, set in 15th century Medieval Europe. Experience the ultimate medieval adventure - through the eyes of young Henry - as you embark on a journey of epic proportions.
1771300.name: Kingdom Come: Deliverance II

1774880.desc: Blight: Survival is a PvE Action-Horror Game set in a brutal medieval world. Play in solo or team-up with up to 3 friends as you face monsters and men in a tense battle for survival. How far are you willing to go?
1774880.name: Blight: Survival

1782210.desc: Crab Game is a First-Person Multiplayer game where you play through several different minigames based on children's games, until only one player stands victorious.
1782210.name: Crab Game

1794680.desc: Mow down thousands of night creatures and survive until dawn! Vampire Survivors is a gothic horror casual game with rogue-lite elements, where your choices can allow you to quickly snowball against the hundreds of monsters that get thrown at you. Be the bullet hell!
1794680.name: Vampire Survivors

1808500.desc: ARC Raiders is a multiplayer extraction adventure, set in a lethal future earth, ravaged by a mysterious mechanized threat known as ARC.
1808500.name: ARC Raiders

1811260.desc: FIFA 23 brings The World’s Game to the pitch, with HyperMotion2 Technology, men’s and women’s FIFA World Cup™, women’s club teams, cross-play features**, and more.
1811260.name: EA SPORTS™ FIFA 23

1818140.desc: Den of Wolves is a co-op heist FPS from the creator of PAYDAY: The Heist, PAYDAY 2 and GTFO. In this techno-thriller you and your friends operate as criminals for hire in the conflicts between rival corporations in Midway City. Gather your crew, design the plan, gear up and execute the heist.
1818140.name: Den of Wolves

1818480.desc: Midwest 90: Rapid City is a tycoon survival sim in a monster apocalypse. Run a roadhouse serving monster meat and choose between profit or the city's survival, because those who fight monsters risk becoming one. How far will you go to stay in business?
1818480.name: Midwest 90: Rapid City

1840.desc: The Source Filmmaker (SFM) is the movie-making tool built and used by us here at Valve to make movies inside the Source game engine. Because the SFM uses the same assets as the game, anything that exists in the game can be used in the movie, and vice versa.
1840.name: Source Filmmaker

1846700.desc: Discover magic and mystery in Witchbrook, a spellbinding witch life-sim for up to 4-players! Start your life as the newest resident witch in the bustling seaside town of Mossport. Make friends, find love, and discover a world filled with wonder and charm on the road to graduation and beyond...
1846700.name: Witchbrook

1859550.desc: Rise from the grave in a compact third-person soulslike. Battle undead and bosses, level up your character and master timed arena challenges. Every hit taken costs time; every parry improves your score. Refine your runs and compete on Steam leaderboards.
1859550.name: Raise

1866300.desc: Dawn Apart is a space colony and factory sim with fully destructible environments. Mine, automate, and defend your settlers, or lead a rebellion against the very corporation pulling your strings…
1866300.name: Dawn Apart

1867240.desc: WARDOGS is a TACTICAL ALL OUT WARFARE FPS where one hundred players split across three teams fight over the control zone. Set in the derelict industrial mountains of Eastern Europe on a destructible battlefield where teamwork pays and cash is king.
1867240.name: WARDOGS

1868140.desc: DAVE THE DIVER is a casual, singleplayer adventure RPG featuring deep-sea exploration and fishing during the day and sushi restaurant management at night. Join Dave and his quirky friends as they seek to uncover the secrets of the mysterious Blue Hole.
1868140.name: DAVE THE DIVER

1895830.desc: Zoo Peaks: Riders is an arcade snowboarding game: race six rivals or ride freestyle for score. Every trick fills your boost meter. Max it out to unlock Uber tricks, then land five Ubers in one run and your boost lasts all the way to the finish. Solo or two-player split-screen.
1895830.name: Zoo Peaks : Riders

1900.desc: After the destruction of the EARTH in 2150, the leaders of the Eurasian Dynasty escaped on board an evacuation fleet. Now they are fighting for the survival of the human species. Their base is one large building comprising of smaller variable parts.
1900.name: Earth 2160

1903340.desc: Lead the members of Expedition 33 on their quest to destroy the Paintress so that she can never paint death again. Explore a world of wonders inspired by Belle Époque France and battle unique enemies in this turn-based RPG with real-time mechanics.
1903340.name: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33

1905180.desc: Free and open-source software for video recording and live streaming
1905180.name: OBS Studio

1916210.desc: Ride, flip and wheelie a daredevil mouse through 30 physics stunt levels. Lean to land your jumps, earn three stars on every track and unlock 8 bikes with coins earned by playing. Full controller support. No ads, no in-game purchases.
1916210.name: Moto Mouse Stunt Mania

1930.desc: ... 300 years after Aziraal has been banished, a brother and sister are drawn into the conflict which has flared up between the Orcs and the free world. Kyra, the hero's younger sister, suddenly disappears in mysterious circumstances.«...If my family really belongs to the chosen ones, why then have we always been as poor as church mice?
1930.name: Two Worlds Epic Edition

1938090.desc: The Call of Duty® experience supports Modern Warfare® 4, Black Ops 7 and Call of Duty®: Warzone™.
1938090.name: Call of Duty®

1940080.desc: In this solo and multiplayer survival game, explore an ancient overgrown world full of dangers. Salvage, build, craft, hunt,.. and try to survive alone or with your friends in an evolving and fascinating post-apocalyptic environment. Powered by Unreal Engine 5.
1940080.name: Rooted

1942280.desc: Brotato is a top-down arena shooter roguelite where you play a potato wielding up to 6 weapons at a time to fight off hordes of aliens. Choose from a variety of traits and items to create unique builds and survive until help arrives.
1942280.name: Brotato

1952620.desc: True fear is primal. Embark on an evasion-based survival horror experience against nature’s ultimate hunters — dinosaurs. Explore overgrown research facilities nestled in a lush wilderness. Be resourceful as you evade, distract, survive, and unravel the mystery at the heart of the island.
1952620.name: The Lost Wild

1966720.desc: A co-op horror about scavenging at abandoned moons to sell scrap to the Company.
1966720.name: Lethal Company

1972940.desc: Second Saga is an adventure RPG where you can level up, raise your stats, learn from an extensive skill tree, and make important decisions while traversing a large, expansive, and rich stylized 2D world.
1972940.name: Second Saga

1973530.desc: As the Executive Manager of Limbus Company, lead your group of twelve Sinners, venture into the buried facilities of Lobotomy Corporation, and lay claim on the Golden Boughs.
1973530.name: Limbus Company

1990250.desc: Four animals and a robot have been given racing cars. This was a mistake. SG Racing is a fast, ridiculous pixel-art arcade racer about tight corners, power-ups and deeply irresponsible use of eggs. 1-PLAYER CHAMPIONSHIP • 2–4 PLAYER LOCAL MULTIPLAYER • PLAY ONLINE VIA STEAM REMOTE PLAY TOGETHER
1990250.name: SG Racing

20.desc: One of the most popular online action games of all time, Team Fortress Classic features over nine character classes -- from Medic to Spy to Demolition Man -- enlisted in a unique style of online team warfare. Each character class possesses unique weapons, items, and abilities, as teams compete online in a variety of game play modes.
20.name: Team Fortress Classic

2001120.desc: Embrace mind-blowing moments as you’re pulled deep into the many worlds of Split Fiction, a boundary-pushing co-op adventure.
2001120.name: Split Fiction

201870.desc: Ezio Auditore walks in the footsteps of the legendary mentor Altair, on a dangerous journey of discovery and revelation.
201870.name: Assassin's Creed® Revelations

202970.desc: Pushing the boundaries of what fans have come to expect from the record-setting entertainment franchise, Call of Duty®: Black Ops II propels players into a near future Cold War
202970.name: Call of Duty®: Black Ops II

203160.desc: Tomb Raider explores the intense origin story of Lara Croft and her ascent from a young woman to a hardened survivor.
203160.name: Tomb Raider Game of the Year

204360.desc: Hack, slash, and smash your way to victory in this award winning 2D arcade adventure from The Behemoth!
204360.name: Castle Crashers®

2050420.desc: Survive the past. Tame the future. Suddenly awakened on a primal world filled with dinosaurs and humans struggling for dominance, you must team-up with legendary heroes to confront powerful dark forces. Saddle up, and join the definitive next-gen survival experience with ARK 2!
2050420.name: ARK 2

2050650.desc: Survival is just the beginning. Six years have passed since the biological disaster in Raccoon City. Leon S. Kennedy, one of the survivors, tracks the president's kidnapped daughter to a secluded European village, where there is something terribly wrong with the locals.
2050650.name: Resident Evil 4

2054440.desc: This game is about escaping from a terrifying presence within an underground facility
2054440.name: The Intruder

206420.desc: Experience the insane antics of Saints Row IV. The Saints have gone from the Penthouse to the White House - but Earth has been invaded and it’s up to you to save it with an arsenal of superpowers and strange weapons, in the wildest open world game ever.
206420.name: Saints Row IV: Re-Elected

2073620.desc: Arena Breakout: Infinite is a high-stakes tactical extraction shooter where every decision matters. Fight, loot, and extract—or lose it all. With stunningly realistic visuals, lifelike sound, and unforgiving PvPvE combat, every raid is a gamble between glory and ruin.
2073620.name: Arena Breakout: Infinite

2073850.desc: THE FINALS is the ultimate free-to-play FPS Game Show. Compete across fast-paced Modes and stunning Arenas, with unparalleled, unscripted destruction that turns the environment into your greatest Weapon. Steal the Show!
2073850.name: THE FINALS

2083660.desc: The Littlelands region is brimming with strange characters and magical landscapes to discover if you know where to look, for a big-headed little youngster like you every moment exploring, growing berries, searching for buried treasures or walking through these lands can be an epic adventure.
2083660.name: Littlelands

208650.desc: Batman™: Arkham Knight brings the award-winning Arkham trilogy from Rocksteady Studios to its epic conclusion. Developed exclusively for New-Gen platforms, Batman: Arkham Knight introduces Rocksteady's uniquely designed version of the Batmobile.
208650.name: Batman™: Arkham Knight

2090210.desc: Threads of Time is an era-spanning, turn-based RPG inspired by the timeless classics. Embark on a journey through time, gather a party of charismatic heroes from across ages, and uncover a plot that threatens to unravel the past, present and future.
2090210.name: Threads of Time

20920.desc: A time of untold chaos has come. Mighty forces clash behind the scenes in a struggle for power and influence. The Northern Kingdoms mobilize for war. But armies on the march are not enough to stop a bloody conspiracy...
20920.name: The Witcher 2: Assassins of Kings Enhanced Edition

2100.desc: Discover a new breed of Action-RPG game powered by an enhanced version of the Source™ Engine by Valve. Set in the Might & Magic® universe, players will experience ferocious combat in a dark and immersive fantasy environment. Swords, Stealth, Sorcery. Choose your way to kill.
2100.name: Dark Messiah of Might & Magic

21000.desc: When all the villains in Arkham Asylum team up and break loose, only the dynamic duo is bold enough to take them on to save Gotham City. The fun of LEGO, the drama of Batman and the uniqueness of the combination makes for a comical and exciting adventure in LEGO Batman: The Videogame.
21000.name: LEGO® Batman™: The Videogame

2104080.desc: Everyone was evacuated. Except you. A first-person psychological horror game set in an empty hospital. Ride down ten floors and decide on every floor whether anything has changed. One mistake sends you back to floor 10. Speak, and something in here learns your voice.
2104080.name: Discharge Pending

21090.desc: Experience the original F.E.A.R. along with F.E.A.R. Extraction Point and F.E.A.R. Perseus Mandate.
21090.name: F.E.A.R.

2109770.desc: Go back in time to a war-torn medieval era with a vast arsenal of modern weapons, change the course of history, and save the future in this epic action/strategy sandbox. Build your kingdom, grab a gun, and lead an army of thousands into massive, real-time simulated battles — solo or in co-op.
2109770.name: Kingmakers

2114500.desc: "fumotianshi" is a card building game that combines character character and Roguelike playing method. Players encounter a series of demons and ghosts in an unpredictable world. They can either drive away demons or unleash life. Every choice of players will also change their own character.
2114500.name: 伏魔天师

211500.desc: RaceRoom is free to download and built on true-to-life physics and Force Feedback. Drive DTM, FIA WTCC, WTCR and a huge library of cars and tracks—including the most up-to-date Nordschleife. Jump in, race instantly, and expand your garage with a massive selection of content.
211500.name: RaceRoom Racing Experience

2138330.desc: Phantom Liberty is a new spy-thriller expansion for the open-world action-adventure RPG Cyberpunk 2077. As cyber-enhanced mercenary V, join secret agent Solomon Reed to unravel a web of shattered loyalties and sinister political machinations.
2138330.name: Cyberpunk 2077: Phantom Liberty

2139460.desc: Once Human is a Strange Worlds Survival Game set in a strange, post-apocalyptic future. Unite with friends to fight monstrous enemies, uncover secret plots, compete for resources, and build your own territory. Once, you were merely human. Now, you have the power to remake the world.
2139460.name: Once Human

2141130.desc: Drive a 40-ton semi hauling cargo across the coastal plains of the American South, managing multiple jobs, trailers, and routes. Grow reputation from rookie to veteran owner-operator, dodging disasters and rivals to become the hero of the open road.
2141130.name: Road Kings

2151730.desc: “All roads lead to Rome, but the tolls are strictly non-refundable.” Wrapped in the parchment of ancient bureaucracy, Meet the Rome is a satirical, choice-driven narrative game.
2151730.name: Meet the Rome

2153760.desc: Wood needed! Return to the green roots of Stronghold in this narrative prequel to the original 'castle sim'. Immerse yourself in a cinematic campaign, hone your siegecraft with new mechanics in skirmish mode and customise your castles with a wide selection of castle pieces and cosmetics.
2153760.name: Stronghold 4

2161710.desc: Welcome to Port Desire, a city that doesn't belong to anyone, but where everyone wants a piece. You’re Grey Harker, an ex-military attempting to live a quiet life after near fatal injuries in the field. All you want now is peace - but in a city of no laws, what you want isn’t always what you get.
2161710.name: NO LAW

2165810.desc: Streets of Rogue 2 is a crazy, immersive RPG sandbox set in a vast randomly generated open world where freedom and fun are dialed up to 11. Fight, sneak, hack, farm, build, steal, or talk your way to power as you try to topple a corrupt president in countless possible ways – solo or with friends.
2165810.name: Streets of Rogue 2

21690.desc: This game is a port of the Games for Windows - Live version that was released in 2009. If you buy the Untold Stories Bundle here on Steam, it will be the same as upgrading to Resident Evil 5 Gold Edition.
21690.name: Resident Evil 5

2173850.desc: A high-risk, high reward shoot em up as you power yourself and your enemies up to bring utter chaos to the battlefield!
2173850.name: ASSAULT SHELL 2

2174510.desc: Manage your driver in short, tactical races. Rapidly choose from dozens of upgrades each race. Use tire compounds to shape your strategy. Machine-learned drivers make every race unpredictable. Can you become the Champion?
2174510.name: Backseat Champions

2179480.desc: The zombies ended the world. You're going to switch it back on. Ardem is an open-world zombie survival game in an immersive handcrafted world. Restore electricity, rebuild vehicles, construct your base, and permanently reshape the world. Solo, co-op, or on up-to-64-player PvE, PvP, and RP servers.
2179480.name: Ardem

218230.desc: PlanetSide 2 is an all-out planetary war, where thousands of players battle as one across enormous continents. Utilize infantry, ground and air vehicles, and teamwork to destroy your enemies in this revolutionary first-person shooter on a massive scale.
218230.name: PlanetSide 2

2183900.desc: Embody the superhuman skill and brutality of a Space Marine. Unleash deadly abilities and devastating weaponry to obliterate the relentless Tyranid swarms. Defend the Imperium in spectacular third-person action in solo or multiplayer modes.
2183900.name: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2

218620.desc: PAYDAY 2 is an action-packed, four-player co-op shooter that once again lets gamers don the masks of the original PAYDAY crew - Dallas, Hoxton, Wolf and Chains - as they descend on Washington DC for an epic crime spree.
218620.name: PAYDAY 2

2186680.desc: Made in a close partnership with Games Workshop, Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader is a story-rich classical RPG from Owlcat Games, developers of the critically acclaimed game, Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous.
2186680.name: Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader

2195710.desc: Peer beyond the veil and experience the ethereal in The Ghost and The Phoenix, a captivating neo-classical top-down shooter. Navigate the realms between life and death in this supernatural action-packed adventure.
2195710.name: The Ghost and The Phoenix

219640.desc: Besiege castles and raid villages in Chivalry: Medieval Warfare, a fast-paced medieval first person slasher with a focus on multiplayer battles
219640.name: Chivalry: Medieval Warfare

219990.desc: Enter an apocalyptic fantasy world where humanity is on the brink of extinction, iron is valued above gold and trust is hard earned. This ARPG features complex character development, hundreds of unique items, crafting and quests with choice & consequence.
219990.name: Grim Dawn

220.desc: Reawakened from stasis in the occupied metropolis of City 17, Gordon Freeman is joined by Alyx Vance as he leads a desperate human resistance. Experience the landmark first-person shooter packed with immersive world-building, boundary-pushing physics, and exhilarating combat.
220.name: Half-Life 2

2200.desc: The greatest warriors of all time and space have been summoned to battle for the amusement of an ancient alien race. Wield a variety of guns and power-ups as you fight for glory against ruthless combatants in this fast-paced single-player and multiplayer FPS.
2200.name: Quake III Arena

220240.desc: Stranded on the Rook Islands as Jason Brody, fight your way through a lawless tropical open world using a powerful arsenal to save your friends and escape the madness of this acclaimed visceral FPS.
220240.name: Far Cry 3

2208680.desc: Third-person shooter with planning, steampunk and magic on Wild West, lay the traps, use magic to support your action, sneak behind the enemy's back, and take control of the enemy to use his strength.
2208680.name: Señorita Chupacabra

2208810.desc: Return to Isla Nublar the day after the events of the beloved 1993 Jurassic Park film and survive thrilling first-person action as InGen scientist Dr. Maya Joshi in this single-player action-adventure game.
2208810.name: Jurassic Park: Survival

2209340.desc: Woolbeard the bad pirate sheep set the critters loose across the country! Only Cowboy Maloy and his pups - Duke, Hazel, Rusty, Nugget and Bear - can round 'em up. Herd, bark and howl through levels solo or co-op for 4 players. End the Herdpocalypse and earn everyone their much-needed vacation!
2209340.name: Have You Herd?

2210.desc: As part of the elite Rhino Squad, you must spearhead Earth’s military invasion of a hostile alien homeworld. But, in this desperate war for humanity’s survival against an unrelenting enemy, you may discover that the only way to defeat them...is to become one of them.
2210.name: Quake 4

221100.desc: How long can you survive a post-apocalyptic world? A land overrun with an infected "zombie" population, where you compete with other survivors for limited resources. Will you team up with strangers and stay strong together? Or play as a lone wolf to avoid betrayal? This is DayZ – this is your story.
221100.name: DayZ

2212400.desc: Chaotic 2v2 action where all 4 players clash at the exact same time! Master the frame-perfect parry mechanic and equip one of 6 powerful Gems to alter your team's playstyle. Play with 3 friends in smooth online matches powered by GGPO rollback netcode.
2212400.name: Gemion Function

221380.desc: Age of Empires II has been re-imagined in high definition. With the release of Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition, this product will not be updated further.
221380.name: Age of Empires II (Retired)

2215430.desc: A storm is coming. Venture into the complete Ghost of Tsushima DIRECTOR’S CUT on PC; forge your own path through this open-world action adventure and uncover its hidden wonders. Brought to you by Sucker Punch Productions, Nixxes Software and PlayStation Studios.
2215430.name: Ghost of Tsushima DIRECTOR'S CUT

2218330.desc: A timeless Rejet classic is reborn after ten years— now coming to PC (Windows) in a complete port! This sweeping romance visual novel weaves Japanese mythology into a tale of defying fate in another world, fully voiced throughout by a superstar voice cast.
2218330.name: If There Is a God in This World.

222880.desc: Take to the streets for intense close quarters combat, where a team's survival depends upon securing crucial strongholds and destroying enemy supply in this multiplayer and cooperative Source Engine based experience.
222880.name: Insurgency

22300.desc: Vault-Tec engineers have worked around the clock on an interactive reproduction of Wasteland life for you to enjoy from the comfort of your own vault. Included is an expansive world, unique combat, shockingly realistic visuals, tons of player choice, and an incredible cast of dynamic characters.
22300.name: Fallout 3

2231020.desc: Step into a vast, dynamic medieval sandbox set in the age of the Hundred Years' War. Explore a brutal but beautiful, historically grounded Europe, command armies in massive battles, leave a mark the chroniclers can't ignore as you make your name one fight at a time. What story will you write?
2231020.name: Chronicles: Medieval

22320.desc: The Elder Scrolls III: Morrowind® Game of the Year Edition includes Morrowind plus all of the content from the Bloodmoon and Tribunal expansions. The original Mod Construction Set is not included in this package. An epic, open-ended single-player RPG, Morrowind allows you to create and play any kind of character imaginable.
22320.name: The Elder Scrolls III: Morrowind® Game of the Year Edition

2235430.desc: A psychological survival horror game set in an eerie, isolated 90’s Polish town consumed by an ominous presence. You’ve come looking for answers, but everyone seems possessed by something foul. Explore the festering town, interrogate locals and fight ungodly manifestations to get to the truth.
2235430.name: Holstin

2236840.desc: Arm a tiny drone past common sense, then shoot absolutely everything. The research facility can reconsider science afterward.
2236840.name: Little Drone TuTuTu

223710.desc: Cry of Fear is a psychological single-player and co-op horror game set in a deserted town filled with horrific creatures and nightmarish delusions. You play as a young man desperately searching for answers in the cold Scandinavian night, finding his way through the city as he slowly descends into madness.
223710.name: Cry of Fear

223750.desc: Feel the excitement of flying the Su-25T "Frogfoot" attack jet and the TF-51D "Mustang" in the free-to-play Digital Combat Simulator World!
223750.name: DCS World Steam Edition

22380.desc: Welcome to Vegas. New Vegas. Enjoy your stay!
22380.name: Fallout: New Vegas

2239770.desc: Don’t Starve returns with an all-new uncompromising survival experience. Band together with friends to craft, farm, build and explore a world filled with strange creatures, lurking shadows, and dynamic environmental dangers.
2239770.name: Don't Starve Elsewhere

224260.desc: The chances of you surviving this all out war of society and the undead are slim to none. Already, there are millions of the walking dead shambling about, searching for food to eat. There's no known cure. One bite can possibly end it all for you. However, you aren't alone in this nightmare.
224260.name: No More Room in Hell

2246340.desc: The unbridled force of nature runs wild and relentless, with environments transforming drastically from one moment to the next. This is a story of monsters and humans and their struggles to live in harmony in a world of duality.
2246340.name: Monster Hunter Wilds

225540.desc: With over 1000 km² of complete freedom from sky to seabed, Rico Rodriguez returns to unleash chaos in the most creative and explosive ways imaginable.
225540.name: Just Cause™ 3

225840.desc: Sven Co-op is a co-operative game originally based around Valve Software's Half-Life. In this game players must work together against computer controlled enemies and solve puzzles as a team.
225840.name: Sven Co-op

2269500.desc: A free-to-play multiplayer platformer with cute animals. Jump on your rivals' heads, play ranked 1v1, 2v2 and 3v3, and climb from Bronze to Legend. Cross-play with friends on PC, Mac and mobile. Safe for the whole family.
2269500.name: Leap of Legends

2270.desc: World War II rages. The Nazis are planning to build an unstoppable, mutant army. On a mission to steal the secret plans, you were captured and imprisoned. Now, a lucky break gives you the chance to escape, but a maze of passages and trigger-happy Nazis stand in your way.
2270.name: Wolfenstein 3D

2272360.desc: Return to the RTS series’ roots with deeply satisfying strategy gameplay. Take command of four unique Warhammer 40,000 factions, including the Adeptus Mechanicus in their series debut! Fight through 70+ epic campaign missions, as well as the replayable Last Stand, Skirmish and multiplayer modes.
2272360.name: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV

227300.desc: Travel across Europe as king of the road, a trucker who delivers important cargo across impressive distances! With dozens of cities to explore, your endurance, skill and speed will all be pushed to their limits.
227300.name: Euro Truck Simulator 2

227940.desc: Shoot, blow sh!t up, fly or bark orders in the ultimate Free-to-Play, large scale, multiplayer, shooter experience. Thousands of players in multiple battles fighting one massive war of nations. The first to capture 15 cities takes the glory.
227940.name: Heroes & Generals

2280.desc: Developed by id Software, and originally released in 1993 and 1994, the definitive, newly enhanced versions of DOOM + DOOM II are available as a combined product.
2280.name: DOOM + DOOM II

2280360.desc: Scarecrow: 90s Crime Story blends narrative adventure with brutal top-down action. In a crime-ridden town of humans and animals, you're a resident by day and a hitman by night. Uncover your buried past before it catches up with you.
2280360.name: Scarecrow: 90s Crime Story

2292800.desc: Manage your own medieval smithy in Blacksmith Master and supervise the entire process from mining ores and gems to designing and selling finished products. Forge everything from weapons and armor to tools and cooking utensils to fund your craft and become the Blacksmith Master.
2292800.name: Blacksmith Master

2295170.desc: Awaken with no memories inside the Vitromotus, a vast underground world created as a magical dungeon where death no longer lasts. Explore its depths, battle dangerous creatures, rescue survivors, and rebuild the ruined town of Emberville while uncovering the truth behind this prison.
2295170.name: Emberville

2300320.desc: Farming Simulator 25 invites you to join the rewarding farm life, single-handedly or cooperatively in multiplayer. This Farm is Your Farm!
2300320.name: Farming Simulator 25

230410.desc: Awaken as an unstoppable warrior and battle alongside your friends in this story-driven free-to-play online action game
230410.name: Warframe

2307150.desc: Simple controls! BOOOM action! Throw bombs, collect BOM COINs, and become the Bomberhead Champion!
2307150.name: BOM BOM BOMBIAN  ～ ボン ボン ボンビアン ～

2310.desc: Developed by the award-winning id Software, Quake® is the ground-breaking, original dark fantasy first-person shooter that inspires today’s retro-style FPS games. With Quake (Enhanced), experience the authentic, updated, and visually enhanced version of the original.
2310.name: Quake

231430.desc: Experience the ultimate WWII RTS platform with COH2 and its standalone expansions. This package includes the base game, which you can then upgrade by purchasing The Western Front Armies, Ardennes Assault and/or The British Forces. More info in the "About This Game" section below.
231430.name: Company of Heroes 2

2318330.desc: After quitting her dead-end job, Fiona starts over on a farm and becomes the immortal herald of a dead god. Make friends, fight through horrors and pay your debt in this nightmarish life sim RPG.
2318330.name: Neverway

2319360.desc: A colorful puzzle adventure about a lost child searching for her memories, guiding her through darkness by mastering light and shadow.
2319360.name: Memento Dawn

2321960.desc: From the makers of Cozy Grove: Glide through pastel clouds, help lost spirits along the way, and design your own home nestled high on a mountain peak. Befriend strangers around a warm campfire, or share memories while lazily fishing in the sky with a friend. Welcome to your strange new home. 🏠🏔️
2321960.name: Spirit Crossing

232770.desc: Take control of The POSTAL Dude in his infamous first outing as he battles to survive in a world gone mad! POSTAL is a classic isometric shooter filled to the brim with fast-paced explosive action.
232770.name: POSTAL

2331930.desc: An action roguelite, solo or co-op with up to 10 players. Face endless hordes, combine 52 weapons and 161 items into devastating evolutions, unions and synergies, and hold on until the end as the Void awakens beyond the map.
2331930.name: VOIDRUSH

233450.desc: Only the world’s most ruthless Warden can contain the world’s most ruthless inmates. Design and develop your personalized penitentiary in Prison Architect.
233450.name: Prison Architect

2340970.desc: Railborn is a survival game where you build your train piece by piece. Navigate a world entangled by branching tracks. Find rare plants to cultivate on your farms. Upgrade your train - manage its power systems, direct resource flow, and distribute water. Designed for 1 to 4 players.
2340970.name: Railborn

2357570.desc: Overwatch®, A FUTURE WORTH FIGHTING FOR! Overwatch® is an always-on and ever-evolving free-to-play, team-based action game set in an optimistic future, where every match is the ultimate 5v5 or 6v6 battlefield brawl.
2357570.name: Overwatch®

2358720.desc: Black Myth: Wukong is an action RPG rooted in Chinese mythology. You shall set out as the Destined One to venture into the challenges and marvels ahead, to uncover the obscured truth beneath the veil of a glorious legend from the past.
2358720.name: Black Myth: Wukong

236390.desc: War Thunder is the most comprehensive free-to-play, cross-platform, MMO military game dedicated to aviation, armoured vehicles, and naval craft, from the early 20th century to the most advanced modern combat units. Join now and take part in major battles on land, in the air, and at sea.
236390.name: War Thunder

236850.desc: Rule your land and dominate the world with unparalleled freedom, depth and historical accuracy. Write a new history of the world and build an empire for the ages.
236850.name: Europa Universalis IV

2378230.desc: Sinister tides are rising in the Drowned City. Dive into a Point and Click action-RPG with fast-paced shoot-outs and retro arcade racing. Uncover the truth behind a murder you don't remember committing!
2378230.name: Neo Junk City

2379780.desc: The poker roguelike. Balatro is a hypnotically satisfying deckbuilder where you play illegal poker hands, discover game-changing jokers, and trigger adrenaline-pumping, outrageous combos.
2379780.name: Balatro

2381520.desc: Unrecord is a single-player FPS that tells the story of a tactical police officer from the perspective of his body camera. As you work to solve a complex case, you'll need to use your tactical and detective skills to succeed.
2381520.name: Unrecord

238460.desc: Welcome to BattleBlock Theater! You’ve got no where to go but up...on stage. Play single player or co-op to free your friends and save Hatty Hattington! Jump, solve and battle your way through a mysterious theater inhabited by highly technological felines.
238460.name: BattleBlock Theater®

2384980.desc: Build and manage your cafe business. Customize your shop with furniture and decorations, brew various beverages, serve customers efficiently, expand your space, and compete with rival cafés. Grow from a small shop to a thriving empire. Oh, and there's chicken wrestling too.
2384980.name: Cafe Simulator

2386960.desc: In this fast-paced 3D puzzle game, connect pipes before time runs out, while avoiding obstacles and dynamites. Boost your score by using more pipes. Advance in the Normal mode with growing challenges or play randomly generated puzzles in the timer-less Endless mode.
2386960.name: Crazy Pipes 3D

2387740.desc: Explore the depths of the ocean in this 2D-Puzzle-Metroidvania! Control the water levels and switch between various robots to solve the ancient puzzles of Atlantis.
2387740.name: Light of Atlantis

238960.desc: You are an Exile, struggling to survive on the dark continent of Wraeclast, as you fight to earn power that will allow you to exact your revenge against those who wronged you. Path of Exile is an online Action RPG set in a dark fantasy world. The game is completely free and will never be pay-to-win.
238960.name: Path of Exile

239140.desc: First-person action survival game set in a post-apocalyptic open world overrun by flesh-hungry zombies. Roam a city devastated by a mysterious virus epidemic. Scavenge for supplies, craft weapons, and face hordes of the infected.
239140.name: Dying Light

2392710.desc: Tactics: Setting Sun is a turn-based strategy game centered around the Pacific Theater of World War II. Features multiplayer and single-player modes, an integrated map editor, and a rogue-like campaign.
2392710.name: Tactics: Setting Sun

2396130.desc: Deploy and merge units into 1,500+ variations to defend your train in tight Turn-Based Strategy battles, then see if your build survives Autobattler journeys between stations against massive monster hordes. Build you crew. Defend the train. Deliver the cargo.
2396130.name: Australia Did It: End-of-the-World Railway Defense Business

2399830.desc: ARK is reimagined from the ground-up into the next-generation of video game technology with Unreal Engine 5! Form a tribe, tame & breed hundreds of unique dinosaurs and primeval creatures, explore, craft, build, and fight your way to the top of the food-chain. Your new world awaits!
2399830.name: ARK: Survival Ascended

240.desc: Counter-Strike: Source blends Counter-Strike's award-winning teamplay action with the advanced technology of Source™ technology.
240.name: Counter-Strike: Source

2400.desc: The Ship is a murder mystery multiplayer.
2400.name: The Ship: Murder Party

24010.desc: The ultimate railway hobby for more than 15 years! From historic steam locomotives to modern high-speed and heavy freight trains, and routes around the world, Train Simulator Classic is the simulation made by railfans for railfans.
24010.name: Train Simulator Classic

2402620.desc: World Guesser is a multiplayer party royale game where you and your fellow contestants compete to deliver packet to successive target countries for the sake of being the last one to remain. It's a battle royale concept geography game that sends you on a plane trip around the earth.
2402620.name: World Guesser

2406770.desc: Bodycam is the first tactical multiplayer FPS with a true body-camera view in Unreal Engine 5. Close-quarters combats feel raw and loud. Every angle, callout, and bullet matters. Play Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch, and Wingman on photoreal maps where teamplay, tactics, and clutch skill are key.
2406770.name: Bodycam

240720.desc: A game I made for a certain kind of person. To hurt them.
240720.name: Getting Over It with Bennett Foddy

2408840.desc: A first-person alchemy roguelite. Wake in a dark lord's cell. Refine pills as tribute to survive. Handle pills, add ingredients, use fire. Success, damage or ruin: decide when to stop. Combine relics, catalysts and fire seeds to bend the odds. Face new trials daily. Will you live to escape?
2408840.name: Alchedoom

2418490.desc: In the merciless sands of the arena, a gladiator is forced to fight for survival. Trakonius defies Mars, the God of War, in this Action Roguelike experience! Face gladiators, mythological creatures, and deadly challenges across four brutal arenas. The truth can only be revealed through combat!
2418490.name: Trakonius

241930.desc: Fight through Mordor and uncover the truth of the spirit that compels you, discover the origins of the Rings of Power, build your legend and ultimately confront the evil of Sauron in this new chronicle of Middle-earth.
241930.name: Middle-earth™: Shadow of Mordor™

24200.desc: DC Universe Online is a Free-to-Play, massive multiplayer online action game set in the popular DC Universe. Become one of a new breed of Heroes or Villains and wield incredible powers as you go to war with legendary characters such as Batman, Superman, Lex Luthor and The Joker.
24200.name: DC Universe™ Online

24240.desc: Take on the role of a hardened career criminal executing intense, dynamic heists in constant pursuit of the next “big score”
24240.name: PAYDAY™ The Heist

242760.desc: As the lone survivor of a passenger jet crash, you find yourself in a mysterious forest battling to stay alive against a society of cannibalistic mutants. Build, explore, survive in this terrifying first person survival horror simulator.
242760.name: The Forest

2431590.desc: Take on the role of a starship mechanic and pay off the immense debt your father left behind. Craft components, build starships, and take contracts from factions. Follow galactic events, and pay the debt before the deadline.
2431590.name: Starship Crafter

2437330.desc: A combo-based deckbuilding roguelike through a space-time loop: collect cards, receive blessings, add pets to your party, and grow stronger. Chain together cards in the right order for max power, and act before the enemy does. Build synergistic decks, find many secrets, and make BIG numbers!
2437330.name: Novus Orbis

2437390.desc: Session based survival where players upgrade and live aboard their own personal trains. Team up with friends, make new ones or go solo. Board colossal Titan Trains to fight, build, craft, gather and steal much needed resources. Fortify and stock your personal train fortress. Will you survive?
2437390.name: Enginefall

2439280.desc: CHANGE THE PAST. CONTROL THE FUTURE. Alter the course of history and rewrite the future in this steampunk first-person RPG.
2439280.name: Clockwork Revolution

2439500.desc: Overhours is a single-player action tower defense game set in a fictional agency facing an invasion of soul-eating monsters. Work the night owl shift and face the hordes with a variety of traps and special abilities!
2439500.name: Overhours

2440690.desc: Steal the spotlight in a chaotic 5-player dance-off! Dance to score, shove rivals out of the way, grab power-ups, and dodge hazards as the stage turns into mayhem. It's easy to Boogie and Bash! With just two buttons, anyone can join the party - locally or online.
2440690.name: Boogie Bashers

244210.desc: Assetto Corsa v1.16 introduces the new "Laguna Seca" laser-scanned track, 7 new cars among which the eagerly awaited Alfa Romeo Giulia Quadrifoglio! Check the changelog for further info!
244210.name: Assetto Corsa

2450350.desc: Prepare for goblin-packed, hat-stealing, and princess-fattening team based 16v16 combat! Siege the castle walls, rescue your pudgy princess, fatten up the enemy princess with delicious meat, unlock new hats & classes, and kill each other repeatedly in silly and chaotic PvP war!
2450350.name: Fat Goblins

2454980.desc: Drakantos is a free-to-play MMORPG with a nostalgic pixel art style, combined with exciting action combat and more than 20 unique playable heroes.
2454980.name: Drakantos

2483190.desc: Discover the breathtaking landscapes of Japan in over 550 real-world cars and become a racing Legend in Forza Horizon's biggest open world driving adventure yet.
2483190.name: Forza Horizon 6

2483570.desc: Castillon is an RTS + TD base-building strategy hybrid. Gather resources, explore and fortify your defenses during the day. Then survive waves of enemies attacks through the night. Level up, improve your stats, and master 4 schools of magic to become the ultimate wizard warrior.
2483570.name: Castillon

2483700.desc: HARMA is a retro dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilding game featuring a story-driven campaign. Uncover the truth behind the fallen knights, the burning kingdom, and your missing father. Harness the power of mighty artifacts to defeat demons and save a world on the brink of destruction.
2483700.name: HARMA

2486910.desc: Imagine an alien Sudoku where the numbers are elements. Figure out which element to place on the grid, where, and when!? In order to maintain balance, each element must harmonize with the others. “Aliens don't play Sudoku—they play COSMIC HOLES!” For adults and children.
2486910.name: COSMIC HOLES Junior

2487190.desc: Main Sequence is a first-person space-sim factory builder where you design spaceships, build space stations, and automate everything. Start with a single ship and grow to become an interstellar industrial empire as you leave your mark on the galaxy.
2487190.name: Main Sequence

2498890.desc: Inspired by early 2010s rage games, BOOM! Buster bursts through the arcade genre with a fresh, new experience in this unrelenting hot-potato platformer.
2498890.name: BOOM! Buster

2500500.desc: An open-world PvPvE survival shooter where cooperation and betrayal coexist. Choose between Chaos and Order to claim victory, and if you fall, revive as a formidable Mutant Player to hunt down the remaining survivors.
2500500.name: Survival Of Runt

2505230.desc: Take control of Dreadwinter, your very own magical coffee shop! Explore a vibrant, fantasy world, master your craft, and turn a small café into a legend in this spooky, cozy coffee shop sim!
2505230.name: Dreadwinter

2507950.desc: Play for free in operator-based extraction and full-scale combined arms warfare. Become elite Operators, customize an ever-expanding arsenal of weapons, and deploy into thrill-packed missions across multiple modes.
2507950.name: Delta Force

2508290.desc: Hunt down tax-evading billionaires and rebuild society in a hand-drawn, action-roguelite platformer inspired by 90's comicbooks.
2508290.name: Tax-Force

250900.desc: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth is a randomly generated action RPG shooter with heavy Rogue-like elements. Following Isaac on his journey players will find bizarre treasures that change Isaac’s form giving him super human abilities and enabling him to fight off droves of mysterious creatures, discover secrets and fight his way to safety.
250900.name: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth

251570.desc: 7 Days to Die is an open-world game that is a unique combination of first-person shooter, survival horror, tower defense, and role-playing games. Play the definitive zombie survival sandbox RPG that came first. Navezgane awaits!
251570.name: 7 Days to Die

2521670.desc: Escape the Charon is a sci-fi adventure. An ancient alien artifact has been brought to the space station Charon - soon after, the Charon goes dark. James West must search for clues and solve the mystery to discover what went wrong.
2521670.name: Escape The Charon

2523740.desc: DreamWorks Shrek 2 Remastered: The cult-classic, button-mashing co-op adventure is back with all your favorite characters and improved graphics.
2523740.name: DreamWorks Shrek 2 Remastered

252490.desc: The only aim in Rust is to survive. Everything wants you to die - the island’s wildlife, other inhabitants, the environment, and other survivors. Do whatever it takes to last another night.
252490.name: Rust

2526880.desc: Prepare your defenses during the day and survive until dawn. Defender Bros is a Top-Down Tower Defense Roguelike where you play as a Soldier defending your Base. Pick between multiple abilities as you level up to increase your power, then after each run buy perks and get stronger
2526880.name: Defender Bros

252950.desc: Rocket League is a high-powered hybrid of arcade-style soccer and vehicular mayhem with easy-to-understand controls and fluid, physics-driven competition. Rocket League includes casual and competitive Online Matches, a fully-featured offline Season Mode, special “Mutators” that let you change the rules entirely, hockey and...
252950.name: Rocket League®

2533700.desc: Love, In Debt!? is a romance simulation game. You once had a beautiful relationship, but overnight you were fired, cheated on, and even got yourself in a huge debt! In order to survive, all you can do is work tirelessly! But why does it seem like you became a chick magnet after you're in debt?
2533700.name: Love, in Debt!?

2540670.desc: In the vibrant realm of Terralysia lurk relentless enemies. Brace yourself for grueling missions, endless onslaughts, and formidable bosses in this third-person roguelike. Use the right strategy and spells to survive a bit longer, but be warned, as you grow in strength, so do your enemies.
2540670.name: Terralysia

2547010.desc: A narrative first-person platformer set inside a decaying megastructure. Traverse through ruined architecture, solve environmental puzzles, and descend into the depths of a dying world to uncover an unsettling truth.
2547010.name: Mik

255710.desc: Cities: Skylines is a modern take on the classic city simulation. The game introduces new game play elements to realize the thrill and hardships of creating and maintaining a real city whilst expanding on some well-established tropes of the city building experience.
255710.name: Cities: Skylines

2561460.desc: Burning Sword: Death Sun is a wuxia action game set in 12th century China. Play as Zhang Yixiang, cast down by the Elder of the Northern Mountain, and carve a bloody path back to him. Hardcore combat, epic boss battles, roguelite progression, and an arena built for high scores.
2561460.name: Burning Sword: Death Sun

2563090.desc: As a special agent who specializes in dealing with unstable reality, you need to use your firearms, blades, and elemental reactions to eliminate mutants in an abandoned cosmo, control the source, and escape if possible. Can be played as a single player or with 2-4 players in Co-Op mode.
2563090.name: Hume Index

2570370.desc: Brazilian Fight: Capoeira is a fighting game that features capoeira as its main fighting style. In this game, you'll experience numerous characters and ways to fight capoeira. Let's get moving!
2570370.name: Brazilian Fight: Capoeira

2582960.desc: NAKWON is a multiplayer zombie survival game set in urban South Korea. Venture into the city in the dead of night, and manage your shelter by day. Scavenge resources in a city crawling with the infected and hostile survivors. Survival is the only rule - trust no one, not even the living.
2582960.name: NAKWON: LAST PARADISE

2584270.desc: Their Flesh Is Your Weapon. Mortal Shell II is a standalone sequel action-RPG with adrenaline-charged, high-stakes combat. Possess warrior Shells, dethrone false gods, redeem a ravaged world.
2584270.name: Mortal Shell II

2586050.desc: 45 seconds, 15 questions, one rival. Math Time is a fast 1v1 math duel: race real players or quirky math machines, pick the right answer from three choices and climb the leagues. Plus a Daily Challenge, Sudden Death, Blitz and Practice.
2586050.name: Math Time

2590.desc: Somewhere in deep space, at an apparently abandoned mining base on the asteriod Alpha Prime, something has gone terribly wrong. Miners were warned that the hubbardium they were mining was too dangerous, but the lure of unimaginable wealth was too strong.
2590.name: Alpha Prime

2590240.desc: METRO 2039 is the next landmark FPS from acclaimed storytellers, 4A Games. Journey into the dark heart of post-apocalyptic Moscow in a harrowing conflict for the very soul of the Metro.
2590240.name: METRO 2039

2594620.desc: Grab your sketchbook, relax, explore, and draw in your very own Figure Drawing Garden - an immersive virtual garden designed for you to practice and improve at figure drawing.
2594620.name: Figure Drawing Garden

2600.desc: Vampire®: The Masquerade-Bloodlines™ delivers a new type of RPG experience-one that blends all the core elements of a traditional RPG with the graphical richness, immediacy and brutal combat of a first-person action game. The game plunges players into the dark and gritty vampire underworld of modern-day L.A. as a creature of the night.
2600.name: Vampire: The Masquerade - Bloodlines

2608610.desc: Step into the shoes of a cashier in Gently Packed, a relaxing store management game where you scan, pack, and serve customers with care. Upgrade your shop, run promotions, meet corporate goals, and pay off your franchise loan.
2608610.name: Gently Packed

2610770.desc: Dust Front is a classic RTS with grand strategy elements and a non-linear campaign. Lead strategic maneuvers, overwhelm your enemies with cannon fodder, or stomp them into the stone age with carpet bombing on the lifeless fields of Dust Front.
2610770.name: Dust Front RTS

261550.desc: A strategy/action RPG. Create a character, engage in diplomacy, craft, trade and conquer new lands in a vast medieval sandbox. Raise armies to lead into battle and command and fight alongside your troops in massive real-time battles using a deep but intuitive skill-based combat system.
261550.name: Mount & Blade II: Bannerlord

262060.desc: Darkest Dungeon is a challenging gothic roguelike turn-based RPG about the psychological stresses of adventuring. Recruit, train, and lead a team of flawed heroes against unimaginable horrors, stress, disease, and the ever-encroaching dark. Can you keep your heroes together when all hope is lost?
262060.name: Darkest Dungeon®

2622380.desc: ELDEN RING NIGHTREIGN is a standalone adventure within the ELDEN RING universe, crafted to offer players a new gaming experience by reimagining the game’s core design.
2622380.name: ELDEN RING NIGHTREIGN

2623190.desc: Explore Cyrodiil like never before with stunning new visuals and refined gameplay in The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion™ Remastered.
2623190.name: The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered

2624080.desc: MycoRelic is a cooperative third person action-RPG set on islands inhabited by tribal mushroom robots. Loot derelict foundries to upgrade your robotic body. Explore ancient temples to infuse your fungus with forgotten elemental powers.
2624080.name: MycoRelic

2630.desc: Call of Duty® 2 redefines the cinematic intensity and chaos of battle as seen through the eyes of ordinary soldiers fighting together in epic WWII conflicts. The sequel to 2003's Call of Duty, winner of over 80 Game of the Year awards, Call of Duty 2 offers more immense, more intense, more realistic battles than ever before, thanks to...
2630.name: Call of Duty® 2

2630420.desc: To protect the future of the Elven race and to avenge those who have perished, wage war upon the foul Undead!
2630420.name: Elven Watcher

2638080.desc: A story-driven roguelite RPG about a journey through the depths with a broken hero — and what they have to answer for. The hero's party has been annihilated: you carry one of them out of a cursed dungeon, learn what broke them, and settle it together. Four routes, four heroes, four reckonings.
2638080.name: Annihilated

264710.desc: Descend into the depths of an alien underwater world filled with wonder and peril. Craft equipment, pilot submarines and out-smart wildlife to explore lush coral reefs, volcanoes, cave systems, and more - all while trying to survive.
264710.name: Subnautica

2649560.desc: The iconic RPG series returns! The highly anticipated next chapter delivers a bold, new standalone story blending heartfelt daily life and new characters with pulse-pounding, supernatural adventure. Whether it’s your first Persona game or you’ve been here since the beginning, this one’s for you.
2649560.name: Persona 6

266410.desc: We are the world’s premier motorsports racing game. An iRacing membership provides entry into the newest form of motorsport: internet racing. Internet racing is a fun, easy, and inexpensive way for race fan and gamers alike to enjoy the thrill of the racetrack from the comfort of their home.
266410.name: iRacing

2669450.desc: My Child New Beginnings is a parenting simulator where you go through everyday life of growth. After a series of traumatic events that you and your child went through, you now get to rebuild life together in a new region of Norway.
2669450.name: My Child New Beginnings

2670430.desc: Dashoot: ABYA's Adventure is a pixel-art precision platformer. Fire your floating cannon to trigger switches and move platforms. Grab items to dash with varying charges, directions and distances. Chart a path underground, restart power stations, and uncover the AI Deus's secrets.
2670430.name: Dashoot: ABYA's Adventure

2677970.desc: Intergalactic Defenders is a retro pixel-art space shooter with roguelike progression. Blast through 20 handcrafted missions, chain combos, beat huge bosses, upgrade your ship in the hangar and uncover how the Caedon swarm always finds you. 4 difficulty modes, 21 achievements.
2677970.name: Intergalactic Defenders

2679670.desc: Fix stick drift and calibrate your controller on Windows. Health Score, guided Quick Fix, and Save to console - write centre and range to your pad over USB, then unplug and play on PlayStation, Xbox, or Nintendo.
2679670.name: DriftNo

2682600.desc: Take over heaven in this airborne-combat roguelike where you fight hordes of angels while growing stronger every minute.
2682600.name: Undergod

268500.desc: XCOM 2 is the sequel to XCOM: Enemy Unknown, the 2012 award-winning strategy game of the year. Earth has changed and is now under alien rule. Facing impossible odds you must rebuild XCOM, and ignite a global resistance to reclaim our world and save humanity.
268500.name: XCOM® 2

2686570.desc: Waltz and Jam is a single-player action-adventure platformer following the adventures of Waltz, a pure soul, and Jam, his lovable dog companion. It is set in an afterlife born from a unique reimagination of the Seven Deadly Sins.
2686570.name: Waltz and Jam

268910.desc: Cuphead is a classic run and gun action game heavily focused on boss battles. Inspired by cartoons of the 1930s, the visuals and audio are painstakingly created with the same techniques of the era, i.e. traditional hand drawn cel animation, watercolor backgrounds, and original jazz recordings.
268910.name: Cuphead

2692520.desc: Drift through asteroid fields, build your ship, and risk one more encounter. BLACKNODE is a space roguelite with two modes: explore and extract with recovered parts, or survive a Endless arena and chase the leaderboard scores.
2692520.name: Project BLACKNODE

2692660.desc: Build, repair, and grow your automotive empire — now also in co-op mode! Run a workshop together, fix cars, and expand your collection. Hundreds of configurations, thousands of parts, and full customization await!
2692660.name: Car Mechanic Simulator 2027

2694490.desc: Path of Exile 2 is a next generation Action RPG from Grinding Gear Games, featuring co-op for up to six players. Set years after the original Path of Exile, you will return to the dark world of Wraeclast and seek to end the corruption that is spreading.
2694490.name: Path of Exile 2

2709570.desc: The multiplayer supermarket has arrived to your neighbourhood for free! Stock your shop space, unlock perks and franchises, hire employees or chase those pesky shoplifters. The more players, the more action!
2709570.name: Supermarket Together

2710920.desc: Aeterna Lucis is our purest metroidvania yet and the sequel to Aeterna Noctis. Become the Queen of Light, explore a vast, hand-drawn interconnected world, awaken new powers and face epic bosses to stop the Supreme God Chaos.
2710920.name: Aeterna Lucis

2715880.desc: There is a lot of work to be done on this farm. A long-term adventure awaits you where you can take farming and orcharding to the next level with your friends.
2715880.name: Farmer's Diary

271590.desc: Grand Theft Auto V for PC offers players the option to explore the award-winning world of Los Santos and Blaine County in resolutions of up to 4k and beyond, as well as the chance to experience the game running at 60 frames per second.
271590.name: Grand Theft Auto V Legacy

2716120.desc: A cross-platform 2D pixel-based MMORPG set in medieval times with many turns and twists to spice up your adventure. Join other players in your adventure of defeating bosses, completing quests, discovering achievements, and so much more.
2716120.name: Kaetram

2718320.desc: Make the planet Green Again in this relaxing colony sim game! Help a nation of little plant people reclaim their planet taken over by defective robots, as you build, decorate, and defend your settlement. Grow crops for your citizens, explore the unknown, and protect the new natural order!
2718320.name: Green Again

2719590.desc: A game about adventure, building, survival and exploration together. Set on a fantasy planet the size of Earth.
2719590.name: Light No Fire

2724650.desc: The Bustling World is an open-world RPG set in a fictional ancient China. Enjoy boundless freedom with features such as farming, crafting, building, management, crime, and exploration. Recruit your own army, stabilize the regime, and engage in diplomacy for an immersive experience.
2724650.name: The Bustling World

2729450.desc: 10 EPISODES. 8 HOURS+ OF GAMEPLAY. PROFILING, INTERROGATIONS & INVESTIGATION! HUMOR, CHOICES & MULTIPLE ENDINGS! Play as a young FBI agent in New Orleans: search scenes, interrogate and profile suspects. Make choices that shape a branching story mixing offbeat humor with a gripping crime thriller.
2729450.name: Profiler Files - New Orleans

2735560.desc: A roguelike survival sim where you rule your bridge as a cunning or ravenous troll. Eat, toll, and spare travelers to balance hunger, greed, and favor as you choose whether to become a feared predator… or a worshiped guardian of the bridge.
2735560.name: Da Bridge Troll

2738170.desc: The population of Avaris is ravaged by the Corrosion, a terrible affliction that mutates all it infects into grotesque abominations. Play as Eline, a young nomad, and lead fierce battles alongside your allies to save the world from extinction.
2738170.name: Edge of Memories

2742720.desc: Lena wants to step into the limelight, but the voice in her head has other plans. Between artistic ambitions, romance, family mysteries and the call of the occult, the ways toward your destiny are multiple and tortuous. Lena, Magdalena ou Madeleine… Who will you be when the curtain falls?
2742720.name: After the Wane

275390.desc: The definitive version of the smash-hit Metroidvania-style action-platformer, Guacamelee! STCE adds new levels, powers, challenges, and refinements to the sprawling, ridiculous, Mexican-inspired adventure of the original Guacamelee! Gold Edition.
275390.name: Guacamelee! Super Turbo Championship Edition

2755260.desc: A boy named Taro once woke up in a mysterious world. Why is he here and how will he get out? Experience this world in Dome RPG and follow a text based prequel story in Dome Zero!
2755260.name: Dome RPG

275850.desc: No Man's Sky is a game about exploration and survival in an infinite procedurally generated universe.
275850.name: No Man's Sky

2758910.desc: Tomorrow is Harry's birthday. The Chef only wants to bake a simple cake, but the chickens have broken out and cleared out the whole pantry. Chase them through 5 worlds and 10 levels, learn new moves along the way and get the cake on the table.
2758910.name: Chef's Adventure

2765070.desc: Pilot devastating war machines as a mercenary in an tactical mech shooter. Choose your contract, customize your loadout, deploy into fully destructible battlefields, and extract with your earnings. Get paid, upgrade your arsenal, and take on increasingly dangerous missions.
2765070.name: Iron Dawn

2766120.desc: Mate. Three of you drive ONE van. The one steering can't see a thing, one's on the pedals, one's on the gears. The rest jump out with an axe, a winch and dynamite. 1-4 online co-op, every map generated from scratch. Just get the cake to the wedding. Good luck.
2766120.name: Can't See Shift

2767030.desc: Marvel Rivals is a Super Hero Team-Based PVP Shooter! Assemble an all-star Marvel squad, devise countless strategies by combining powers to form unique Team-Up skills and fight in destructible, ever-changing battlefields across the continually evolving Marvel universe!
2767030.name: Marvel Rivals

2769570.desc: Become the Hero you want to be in an immersive open-world action-RPG where each choice shapes your journey, reputation is everything, and fairytale endings are never guaranteed.
2769570.name: Fable

2772330.desc: Rebuild a ruined goblin village, put your goblins to work and explore the Mistlands. Loot dungeons, beat raid bosses, collect gear sets, mounts and companions. And every night you hold the line against the horde. Solo or online with up to three friends.
2772330.name: Goblington

2780700.desc: A mysterious carnival has appeared outside Spooky Town! Explore its spooky attractions, find Hidden Cats, meet unusual characters, unlock bonus levels, and uncover the strange secret hiding behind the fun.
2780700.name: Hidden Cats in Spooky Carnival

2781660.desc: Dawn of Defense blends RTS, Tower Defense, and Roguelite progression. In a last defense, lead your tribe against the Empire: Command warriors in battle, fortify defenses, and build an economy as you fight to reclaim your ancestral homeland.
2781660.name: Dawn of Defense

278360.desc: A Story About My Uncle is a first person platforming adventure game about a boy who searches for his lost uncle, and ends up in a world he couldn’t imagine existed. The movement is a crucial part of the games core gameplay – focusing on swinging through the world with a grappling hook that gives the player a wonderful sense of speed and...
278360.name: A Story About My Uncle

2784470.desc: A fast-paced roguelike kingdom builder. Grow your empire and fight massive battles against powerful rival kings. Break the game with thousands of insane builds to become the King of Kings.
2784470.name: 9 Kings

2792080.desc: If you have ideas about stocks, you should buy this game. Before you use real money to verify your ideas, come here to verify them. It provides 1-minute data for nearly 20 years of mainstream markets, as well as conditional order functions. There is also unrealistic simulated stock trading.
2792080.name: Stock:Retail investors

280.desc: Winner of over 50 Game of the Year awards, Half-Life set new standards for action games when it was released in 1998. Half-Life: Source is a digitally remastered version of the critically acclaimed and best selling PC game, enhanced via Source technology to include physics simulation, enhanced effects, and more.
280.name: Half-Life: Source

2800370.desc: Take on the role of a castaway on a wrecked container ship. Survive for 30 days, battle storms, hunt animals, build shelter, and maintain your mental health, attempting to endure isolation and pirates in the middle of the Pacific. Can you stay alive?
2800370.name: 30 Days on Ship

2806540.desc: Sweeten the countdown to Christmas with this fabulous advent calendar full of hidden cats for you to find in this relaxing hidden object game for the whole family by Travellin Cats - the original viral hidden cat game creator!
2806540.name: Travellin Cats Advent Calendar

2807260.desc: In My Summer, you can have a happy ending (Nice Guy Ending or Bad Guy Ending), a neutral ending (Open Relationship Ending) or a sad ending (NTR Ending) depending on how you play.
2807260.name: My Summer (InsanErotica)

2807960.desc: The ultimate all-out warfare experience. In a war of tanks, fighter jets, and massive combat arsenals, your squad is the deadliest weapon.
2807960.name: Battlefield™ 6

2814860.desc: Vindictus: Defying Fate is a dark medieval fantasy action RPG inspired by Celtic mythology. Choose a hero with a unique combat style and face colossal bosses alone or alongside other players. In a world where everyone accepts their fate, the power to change the ending is in your hands.
2814860.name: Vindictus: Defying Fate

2818110.desc: Meowxia: Idle Wuxia is an idle martial arts game with a feline desktop companion. Master inner arts, mix skills, collect gear, and fight automatically. Refine your build, unlock meridians, and reach new realms as your cat pursues its heroic dream.
2818110.name: Meowxia: Idle Wuxia

2820.desc: It is the year 2938. The long wished-for encounter of the X Universe and the Earth holds both joy and sorrow for the people. Despite flourishing trade, the clash of the diverse races, cultures and life forms creates new tensions, mistrust and open conflict that need to be overcome!
2820.name: X3: Terran Conflict

2822740.desc: A retro-inspired, classic turn-based RPG for those with nostalgia for the '90s golden era. Explore a vast world with 14 playable characters, fight hundreds of unique enemies, and delve into an epic story of war, betrayal, and redemption.
2822740.name: ONE FENIX DOWN

2826790.desc: Brave magical storms where tornadoes hunt you in this open-world survival crafting game for 1 to 8 players. Outrun the tornadoes or ride their winds, sail to new islands, defeat bosses to unlock classes, and build a home that can weather the next chaos storm.
2826790.name: Stormforge

2827970.desc: Elfscape: Ancestors is a story-driven, old-school platformer with RPG elements. Explore a vast underground world centered around an ancient temple city. Jump your way through challenging obstacles, decorate the city, and collect comics pages.
2827970.name: Elfscape: Ancestors

2828020.desc: The creative, pragmatic, limitless city builder. Engineer a masterpiece of urban design, a small sustainable town or a futuristic metropolis. With procedurally generated buildings, grid-less zoning and powerful editor tools, everything is customizable: the city is yours.
2828020.name: Citystate Metropolis

2834920.desc: The game incorporates the best of real-time strategy genre. Fight through different eras together with the Stickman heroes.
2834920.name: Stickman History Battle

2835730.desc: Ayuda a GlusiGlusi en esta aventura para encontrar el remedio a la enfermedad de su maestro.
2835730.name: Glusiverse

2838950.desc: Classic real-time strategy in the world of Westeros. Conquer the Seven Kingdoms solo, or dominate your enemies to claim the Iron Throne in multiplayer skirmish. Command the Great Houses, rally iconic heroes, and rewrite the fate of the realm.
2838950.name: Game of Thrones: War for Westeros

284160.desc: A dynamic soft-body physics vehicle simulator capable of doing just about anything.
284160.name: BeamNG.drive

2842720.desc: Create, play, and share your own chaotic 2D platforming levels! Inspired by classic cartoons, powered by your creativity, and fueled by one simple truth: My game is good. The algorithm just ignores me.
2842720.name: ToonSouls Maker

2847780.desc: Ignite your sword and explore the dark depths and towering heights of a forgotten island that consumed itself long ago.
2847780.name: Nocturnal 2

2849490.desc: Outward 2 is a challenging action RPG with survival elements, focusing around a grounded experience. There’s no hand-holding, no scaled encounters, no divine blessings to make you tower over your enemies. Eat your meal, check your map, grab your backpack: an unforgiving, rewarding adventure awaits.
2849490.name: Outward 2

2849750.desc: A top-down destruction roguelite. Bring down every building on your grudge list and turn the living town against itself: gas stations and propane tanks take out the vigilantes, police and soldiers sent to stop you. Between runs, build and customize your Killdozer with new armor, guns and mounts.
2849750.name: KILLDOZER SIMULATOR

2854640.desc: Etheriia - Travelogue is an adult visual novel where players set off on a sensual journey across different universes, from sci-fi to medieval to elven, fixing visual glitches and restoring order.
2854640.name: EtheriiA - Travelogue

2860490.desc: 【Village-Building Action RPG】Reincarnated into a ravaged world ruled by the Demon King. Gather resources, build your village, and swap hats to change classes! But when the Idol Demon King throws a live concert, a massive wave of hyped-up monsters stampedes straight toward your village!
2860490.name: Warota: I Live Next to The Demon King's Castle LOL

2861080.desc: A cozy and spooky co-op adventure where two puppies rescue their owner from a haunted mansion. Customize your puppy, solve puzzles together, and defeat evil creatures. Play locally or invite a friend for free with Friend’s Pass.
2861080.name: Haunted Paws

2861730.desc: You're the last chef in a post-apocalyptic world. Attract adventurers with monstrous food, make them sign contracts with the Food Devils and organize expeditions to collect wicked ingredients! Customize your characters, build the perfect restaurant and plan every move in this Tactics-RPG Roguelite.
2861730.name: Food Devils

286690.desc: In 2013 the world was devastated by an apocalyptic event, annihilating almost all mankind and turning the Earth's surface into a poisonous wasteland. A handful of survivors took refuge in the depths of the Moscow underground, and human civilization entered a new Dark Age. The year is 2033.
286690.name: METRO 2033 Redux

2868840.desc: The iconic roguelike deckbuilder returns. Craft a unique deck, encounter bizarre creatures, and discover relics of immense power in Slay the Spire 2!
2868840.name: Slay the Spire 2

2870790.desc: Play as a gang of mischievous raccoons in this chaotic co-op sandbox for 1-4 players. Complete ridiculous missions, steal everything you can carry, and outsmart a relentless Exterminator determined to throw your gang behind bars.
2870790.name: Dumpster Gang

2873440.desc: Chrono Odyssey, A Next-generation Action MMORPG. Game features include awe-inspiring visuals powered by Unreal Engine 5, a vast and intricately designed seamless open world, dynamic action-based combat mechanics based on time manipulation and extensive customization.
2873440.name: Chrono Odyssey

2873750.desc: A horror pool roguelite with upgradable cues, guns and procedural rituals. Shoot some balls. Unleash horrors from beyond. Go insane. Try again.
2873750.name: Pool of Madness

2878260.desc: STARDUSTER is a neon arcade game of rhythm and precision. Every move counts. Catch arrows to the beat, dodge spikeballs and master increasingly demanding patterns. Each level hides part of a message no human should be able to decipher.
2878260.name: STARDUSTER

2888810.desc: In this city, implant contracts outlive their owners. In an underground processing facility, dissolve the "waste" delivered each morning and recover the implants buried inside. A first-person work sim. Deliver them for pay, or borrow a few for yourself and others?
2888810.name: MEATRASH

2889220.desc: A Christian-themed, story driven, 1980s arcade era video game in the Nik and Kit franchise!
2889220.name: Nik and Kit

289070.desc: Expand your empire, advance your culture and go head-to-head against history’s greatest leaders. Will your civilization stand the test of time?
289070.name: Sid Meier’s Civilization® VI

2890810.desc: Neon Grid Defenders is a sci-fi roguelite tower defense game featuring a free and unique upgrade system, decision based path generation and a strong but static difficulty curve. Build your path, place your towers, hook them up with upgrades and melt your enemies!
2890810.name: Neon Grid Defenders

2891970.desc: You're a soul-shard of an Archangel. You have wings and a living sword that gets stronger each time you parry. You are Menes. Defeat gods and monsters, overcome hazards, uncover mysterious lore and explore surreal landscapes.
2891970.name: Menes: The Chainbreaker

2894950.desc: A fantasy real-time turn-based dungeon RPG. Play as the Arcane Knight, lead 5 heroes with front/back row tactics & magitech. Explore procedural dungeons, collect billions of gear & rune attributes, make choices at Obelisk Stones, rebuild a lost civilization. Native KB&M, remastered for PC.

2909400.desc: The Unknown Journey Continues... After escaping the city of Midgar, Cloud and his friends set out on a journey across the planet. New adventures await in a vibrant, expansive world in this standalone entry of the FFVII remake trilogy.

291550.desc: An epic platform fighter for up to 8 players online or local. Try casual free-for-alls, ranked matches, or invite friends to a private room. And it's free! 291550.name: Brawlhalla

2916700.desc: Experience the story from beginning to end in the ultimate culmination of the Attack on Titan game series. The ODM action has been further refined, delivering the most exhilarating and stylish combat the series has ever seen.
2916700.name: Attack on Titan 3 / A.O.T. 3

292030.desc: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered modernizes the acclaimed role-playing game with a range of upgrades and enhancements. Become monster slayer for hire Geralt of Rivia and journey across a dark fantasy open world in an epic quest to find your adopted daughter Ciri.
292030.name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered

2922060.desc: Aliens stole your horse! Saddle up, take aim, and blast across space! Every shot rockets you the opposite way and you can change directions on a dime. Can you rescue Scooty?
2922060.name: Shoot'em & Scoot'em

2924520.desc: A sci-fi mystery set on the repurposed moon hotel Samsara. Uncover cryptic experiments, face unsettling encounters, and piece together a mind-bending narrative. The deeper you go, the more the truth unravels as you confront the ultimate question: What is reality?
2924520.name: ONTOS

2928640.desc: Lead your countryball to glory in a WWII-inspired turn-based grand strategy game. Build your nation, manage resources, recruit armies and generals, forge alliances, and conquer territory across multiple historical campaigns.
2928640.name: Countryball: World 1930

2938980.desc: Go on an adventure with your friends to the abandoned St. Mercy Hospital and uncover its secrets. Can you save your friends or at least save yourself from the horror that awaits?
2938980.name: Unfriendly Friend

294100.desc: A sci-fi colony sim driven by an intelligent AI storyteller. Generates stories by simulating psychology, ecology, gunplay, melee combat, climate, biomes, diplomacy, interpersonal relationships, art, medicine, trade, and more.
294100.name: RimWorld

2944770.desc: A retro jRPG with a twist. Have you heard the one about the million dollars and the immortal snail? A Snail's Tale will let you play out the story and answer the question once and for all - can he be stopped?
2944770.name: A Snail's Tale

2947440.desc: Hinako's hometown is engulfed in fog, driving her to fight grotesque monsters and solve eerie puzzles. Uncover the disturbing beauty hidden in terror.
2947440.name: SILENT HILL f

2953940.desc: Relive the epic battles between Spartans, Persians, and Egyptians in Ancient Wars: Sparta HD. Enjoy HD graphics, asymmetric civilizations, enhanced campaigns, new maps, smarter AI, and a revamped multiplayer mode. Forge your empire, master warfare, and make history in the Ancient World!
2953940.name: Ancient Wars: Sparta HD

2956040.desc: Operate your planetary defense cannon to fend off an interplanetary invasion from the comfort of your cozy bunker. You’re here to stay, so obey your superiors, press the right buttons, and sip your daily tea ration - it's good for you.
2956040.name: PVKK: Planetenverteidigungskanonenkommandant

2957880.desc: Witch Potion: Craft of Lust is a potion-making simulator with elements of a visual novel, mini- games, and hot erotic content. The game offers not only an engaging story and vibrant artwork but also animated cutscenes where you don’t just watch but actively participate in the action!
2957880.name: Witch Potions - Craft of Lust

2960760.desc: Build huge mazes, combine towers for wild synergies, discover ridiculous spells and upgrades, and turn your Buildy into a baddie.
2960760.name: Greed Forest TD

2963950.desc: Step into a Supernatural Turn-Based RPG Adventure Solve Mysteries, Strengthen Bonds, and Awaken Your Persona
2963950.name: Persona 4 Revival

2965060.desc: "The Broken Cultivation World of Ten Thousand Swords" is a portrait‑mode wuxia single‑player game from an indie developer. Featuring gorgeous combat visuals, its idle‑style gameplay focuses on item gathering. Every idle grind prepares for thrilling high‑damage bursts in turn‑based xianxia battles.
2965060.name: 万剑之残破修仙界

2967590.desc: A surreal story-driven game that uses puzzle-solving, Guitar Hero-esque battles, and open world navigation to help Van Cat track down his evil uncle and put an end to his nefarious plans!
2967590.name: Vanakatu

2972820.desc: Vice: Magic City Mayhem is a retro action-adventure game where you fight, collect new items, and upgrade your character as you make your way through bustling nightclubs, scenic beaches, and raptor-infested yachts.
2972820.name: Vice: Magic City Mayhem

2981290.desc: A 2D adventure about rescuing magical creatures in Moscow and the role of a design bureau employee in this whole story.
