3991790.desc: Heroes and villains fight the cosmos in this tactical roguelike! Every move unleashes an attack in quick battles that reward creative strategies. Combine necromancy, explosives, mimicry and more to thwart the evolving Astral threat!
3991790.name: Attack of the Astrals

3994800.desc: An unknown signal. A silent ship. Only traces of the crew and empty corridors remain on the Sentinel. As Elara Wynn, you investigate what happened—and why the last transmission was a desperate distress call from the depths of space...
3994800.name: White Whisper

3997770.desc: Battle Runes of Metalaria is an action packed, chaos infused board game for up to four players. Stack your runes on the board to make vertical and horizontal combos or smash your opponents pieces to smithereens
3997770.name: Battle Runes of Metalaria

3999510.desc: "The Crowley blood stains the mansion's hallways, where voices whisper horrors that time tried to bury."
3999510.name: Siren's Well 2

40.desc: Enjoy fast-paced multiplayer gaming with Deathmatch Classic (a.k.a. DMC). Valve's tribute to the work of id software, DMC invites players to grab their rocket launchers and put their reflexes to the test in a collection of futuristic settings.
40.name: Deathmatch Classic

400.desc: Portal™ is a new single player game from Valve. Set in the mysterious Aperture Science Laboratories, Portal has been called one of the most innovative new games on the horizon and will offer gamers hours of unique gameplay.
400.name: Portal

4000.desc: Garry's Mod is a physics sandbox. There aren't any predefined aims or goals. We give you the tools and leave you to play.
4000.name: Garry's Mod

4001890.desc: A 1-4 player physics based fishing simulator. While drinking and boating you suddenly crash into a small island. To work your way back home you have to learn How to Fish.
4001890.name: How to Fish

4003270.desc: Help Beefit brave perilous lands and cavernous depths to rescue his bovine love in this tight, precision platformer with responsive controls, and skill-based gameplay.
4003270.name: Super Beefit

4008250.desc: Risen Ballbylon is a transformative expansion for BALL x PIT, adding new levels, characters, balls, passives, enemies, bosses, and buildings, to the smash hit ball-bouncing roguelite. Will you rise to the challenge?
4008250.name: BALL x PIT: Risen Ballbylon

4009490.desc: Explore and survive in the Arctic, where your car is the only thing keeping you alive. Arctic Drive is a 1–4 player co-op survival sim set in a procedurally generated winter wilderness. Find supplies, repair your rig, and haul it all onwards with only one hope left: there must be safety out there.
4009490.name: Arctic Drive

4010820.desc: Eye of Darkness is a survivor game with a focus on exploration. You take on the role of a dark cultist on the path to awaken ancient evil - the Eye of Darkness. The forces of Light throw everything at you to stop you from plunging the world into eternal darkness.
4010820.name: Eye of Darkness

4012970.desc: An intimate simulation game with a reclusive girl, featuring all hand-drawn pixel animations. Play as a housekeeper and raise her affection through conversation and touch! Your choices lead to either a "Redemption" or "Corruption" route. Customize scenes in "Gallery Mode"!
4012970.name: Messy Room Princess ~Reform or Ruin H-Simulation~

4013270.desc: This is the trash can where all failed works gather. When you awaken, you come across three false Alices. In order to become the one true Alice, they attempt to kill each other. Who will become the real Alice? This is a visual novel where your decisions, will change the ending of the story.
4013270.name: The False Alice -Retold Tale-

4018330.desc: Destroy the castle on the hill in this grim RPG where you play as the Dark Lord. Collect souls, summon an undead army, master dark abilities, craft powerful gear, build your base, and desecrate the lands of a vast open world.
4018330.name: Lord of Undead

4018610.desc: A minimalist game about digging a hole at the beach, now with friends. Dig together, collect resources, sell them, upgrade your equipment and search for a promised treasure buried deep beneath the sand. Play solo or with friends (1 to 4 players), with crossplay.
4018610.name: A Game About Digging A Hole™ Together

4019220.desc: Become a dressmaker! Choose fabric, cut out pattern pieces and sew them all together to make the dresses of your dreams - in this cozy crafting game, inspired by real dressmaking.
4019220.name: Dressmaker

4026430.desc: A relaxing match-3 that floats in a corner of your screen with a transparent background. Match coffee mugs, folders and sticky notes while you work, without leaving what you're doing.
4026430.name: Pop Corner

4031890.desc: Enjoy a farming life with mysterious creatures known as Pals! Team up with them to grow your farm at your own pace in this brand new creature-collecting farming sim, fully playable in multiplayer!
4031890.name: Palworld: Palfarm

4032410.desc: Dive into a wild adventure of lewd mishaps and cheeky housemates in this thrilling adult romp of hearts, secrets & tension!
4032410.name: OnlySins

4043810.desc: A rhythm game where you can play any song thanks to our advanced music analysis system, or create and share custom levels with players around the world. Play as Akemi, a unique samurai girl, and slash through waves of Zombeats to the beat of the music you love.
4043810.name: Syncblade

4045480.desc: Draw your very own fish and build a cozy little aquarium. And if you like, set it as your animated desktop wallpaper! Watch your drawings come to life. Feed them, raise them and collect golden scales to unlock new decorations. There's also some handy tools to help you focus and unwind.
4045480.name: Drawquarium

4045760.desc: After losing your job, you return to your hometown to rebuild your life—and your family house. But you’re not alone. Two old friends, Lola and Mira, offer to help you renovate… and maybe build something more.
4045760.name: Project: Home!

4051290.desc: Tape Man is a puzzle platformer full of hidden mechanics. Throw your tape measure and set off into a vast maze built out of puzzles. The tape measure can serve as both a platform to stand on and a key to opening new paths — and it can do a lot more than that. You'll just have to find out.
4051290.name: Tape Man

4054720.desc: It's the perfect time to see if you and your girlfriend are ready to be swingers. Make your choices and form your unique experience in Wild Weekend.
4054720.name: Wild Weekend

4063180.desc: A choice-driven adult visual novel where you play as an immortal navigating romance, betrayal, supernatural mysteries, and meaningful relationships shaped by every decision you make.
4063180.name: DriftBorne

4066520.desc: A multi-ball roulette roguelite. Spin multiple balls at once and rewrite the wheel: add colors, change the numbers, rebalance payouts and stack multipliers with 100+ mementos and 50 trick balls. You’re live on a twisted TV show, and the puppet Host is grinning. Hit his targets, or the show ends you.
4066520.name: Trust Your Gut

4068450.desc: Give your company more personality with The Cool Pack! Get 6 extra characters, 90 headwear options, animated name effects, more buildables and pets, a PC that streams to HQ monitors, and an extra job. Only the lobby host needs the DLC for everyone to enjoy the shared HQ features.
4068450.name: Sort It Together - The Cool Pack

4073100.desc: A horror game about the night shift at a donut shop. To help pay for your sister's treatment, you take seven nights behind the counter. Fry, glaze and box the orders, and serve the customer who comes in after closing and knows far too much about you.
4073100.name: Dreadnut

4076370.desc: Ride a hospital elevator through an abandoned ICU. On every floor, search the ward for anomalies. Nothing wrong? Go up. Something off? Go down. One wrong call sends you back to floor 1. Reach floor 13 to escape, if Lucy lets you.
4076370.name: ICU Anomaly

4077740.desc: PUBG: Black Budget is an extraction shooter built around tension, survival, and the unknown. Join a classified operation and uncover the secrets of a mysterious island trapped in a time loop.
4077740.name: PUBG: Black Budget

4078430.desc: STAR WARS: Galactic Racer™ is a ​runs-based, ​high-stakes reinvention of racing born in the lawless Outer Rim. With the Empire gone and the galaxy rebuilding, The Galactic League is created: an underground, unsanctioned circuit where syndicates bankroll chaos and champions are forged.
4078430.name: STAR WARS: Galactic Racer™

4080220.desc: Welcome to The World’s Game in EA SPORTS FC™ 27. Step into The Grounds to experience a football playground where the streets meet the stadium, and feel greater control in every mode as community-driven innovations deliver more true-to-football gameplay.
4080220.name: EA SPORTS FC™ 27

4082030.desc: Decorate the DreamHouse™ through the decades, while playing classic Barbie games. In Barbie™ Rewind, Barbie invites you into her cozy, creative world and entrusts you to customize her DreamHouse. Barbie also left you her game collection, so you can revisit your favorite Barbie video games.
4082030.name: Barbie™ Rewind

4083130.desc: A PvE roguelike deckbuilder where you can customise your deck with thousands of unique cards. Upgrade, draft, and buy new cards to field a respectable army on unique battlefields that favour tactical movement and card play. Master the five factions and stand Against the Horde.
4083130.name: Against the Horde

4084400.desc: How many times are you willing to die for revenge? Rise from the ashes to uncover a divine conspiracy in this Roguelite Strategy RPG inspired by the classics. Lead an ever-growing team on a continent-spanning quest, fight tactical turn-based battles, and synergize your skills for decisive victory.
4084400.name: Astral Throne II: Age of the Phoenix

4084710.desc: Embark on a bold reimagining of the beloved platformer, with new visuals and a retold story. Play solo or in up to 4‑player couch co‑op, explore a mysterious new realm, jam through new musical stages, and more!
4084710.name: Rayman Legends Retold

4085780.desc: Run your own fishing tackle shop in this first-person simulation game. Order and stock products, manage prices, serve customers, and expand your store over time through simple shop management and steady progression.
4085780.name: BAIT & TACKLE STORE SIMULATOR

4085920.desc: Step onto the shores of AlterMage, a first-person action-platformer featuring spellblade focused combat. Embark on a harrowing journey to learn sorcery, explore labyrinthian passages within a forbidden citadel, and uncover the truth of a dark past.
4085920.name: AlterMage

4088360.desc: Search the ashes of an abandoned Latin American town and uncover 400 years of secrets. An epic non-linear mystery where you travel back in time and untangle the history of a community cursed by generations of supernatural forces.
4088360.name: Funeral for the Sun

4088520.desc: Welcome to the MEOWFACTORY! Automate production lines and manage limited space to achieve perfection. Connect machines with conveyor lines and minimize hand (well, paw) labour! In the near and depressing future, when the world is on the verge of destruction, ONLY MEOWORKERS can revive production!
4088520.name: MeowFactory

4095380.desc: From the creators of Warframe emerges a new Fantasy Action RPG. Forge your legend with blade, bow, and magick as you lead the charge against a world-devouring corruption.
4095380.name: Soulframe

4096910.desc: Organize. Optimize. Obliterate. Void Reaver is a sci-fi bullet heaven where your backpack is your firepower. Grid-manage 300+ weapons and artifacts into explosive synergies, unlock specialized skill trees, and blast through alien hordes to a high-octane electronic soundtrack.
4096910.name: Void Reaver

4099810.desc: 1999. The protagonist, a boy named Akira, finds himself lost in the TOKOYO Building—an indoor amusement park filled with secrets and eerie rumors. There, he begins living and working alongside its peculiar staff, but... did you know? People disappear in the TOKOYO Building.
4099810.name: 1999TOKOYO Building

4101300.desc: Eyes are your weapons in this bullet heaven extraction shooter. Drop into raids, gather materials, fight waves of demons, and extract with your loot. Back in the Hideout, use your loot to craft eyes, make upgrades, trade, and take on quests.
4101300.name: Demon Eye

4102120.desc: Resequence: The Orchard is an occult-horror adventure game in which school counselor Saito approaches an inexplicable phenomena through his counseling sessions with students.
4102120.name: Resequence: The Orchard

4103580.desc: Adventurers, let's get exploring! Plunge into the mysterious dungeon and discover all sorts of wild mysteries...
4103580.name: Mystery of the Mysterious Futayuri Mystery Dungeon

4104790.desc: Drako: Blood Heist is an action roguelite set in a world of vampire cats. Hack, mod, farm and fight in a fur-raising attempt to empty the city’s blood banks!
4104790.name: Drako: Blood Heist

4107690.desc: In this nameless tavern, three women driven by desire line up one after another to challenge you, the barkeep, to blackjack. Win each hand to strip away their secrets, and their clothes!
4107690.name: PUBPET SS

4110770.desc: It’s your grandma’s 84th birthday party and nobody is trying to murder her. Stop suspecting your family members, and don’t worry about the strange man in your bedroom. A new creepy-cozy mystery thriller from the creators of Duck Detective.
4110770.name: Apple Crumble

4114080.desc: The political sandbox game where you build a career from state rep to the presidency. Authentic electoral systems, government departments, pass legislation, and a unique news landscape. Create custom scenarios, parties, and politicians in this data-driven democracy simulator.
4114080.name: StateOS: The Political Sandbox

4115450.desc: S-GAME presents Phantom Blade Zero, a fusion of classic Wuxia storytelling and exhilarating action powered by Unreal Engine 5. You play as Soul, a warrior with only sixty-six days left to live. Fend off assassins, unravel world-ending conspiracies, and defend your values with your life.
4115450.name: Phantom Blade Zero

4116260.desc: Hack into cameras, watch your hotwife, and use temptation as a tool to expose the truth behind a corporate heist. NTS/NTR unavoidable!
4116260.name: In-Security

4118000.desc: Thousands of aliens are coming. Expand your territory and build an army on a turn-based world map, then hold the line in real-time battle when a raid hits. Survive until the Final Assault on day 50.
4118000.name: Pest Termina ~ Swarm Defense

4118150.desc: Revived from a Cryonic state after World War III, you are a Recast clone waking to an Earth overrun by alien pirates and gigantic monsters pouring out from random portals. Explore an open world, forge alliances, and take your planet back. Play solo or in multiplayer.
4118150.name: Recast:DeathOps

4119020.desc: Co-op Horror (4 players). Enemies mimic your teammates, environment lies to you. A brutal corporation promises you freedom, can your team survive the chaos?
4119020.name: Doomed Crew

4126040.desc: Aniimo is a free-to-play, next-gen creature-catching open-world RPG. Explore the vast continent of Idyll, Twine with unique Aniimo, unlock new abilities. Travel to a sky-floating metropolis, meet other Pathfinders, and battle in exciting competitions. Choose your Aniimo and begin your epic journey!
4126040.name: Aniimo

4126400.desc: You embody Baihu, a swift tiger. Before you lie the guardian lands, a magnificent landscape to explore at your leisure, filled with challenges. Your goal? Succeed in the trial of the gods to become one of the guardian beasts of the world.
4126400.name: Rise Of Baihu

4126410.desc: A visual novel/game about Michael "Lucky Flash" Foster — a university student and part-time courier whose daily deliveries turn into memorable adventures.
4126410.name: Lucky Flash

413150.desc: You've inherited your grandfather's old farm plot in Stardew Valley. Armed with hand-me-down tools and a few coins, you set out to begin your new life. Can you learn to live off the land and turn these overgrown fields into a thriving home?
413150.name: Stardew Valley

4135050.desc: Three women with very particular cosplay fetishes walk into your ordinary life and ask you to be their personal photographer — which means managing their careers, chasing their dreams, and running private sessions that stop being about the photos surprisingly quickly.
4135050.name: Kameko: Cosplay Love Story

4135380.desc: Wink Out your rivals in this physics-driven 1v1 shooter! Create clever synergies, adapt between rounds, and outplay opponents by sending them flying out of the arena.
4135380.name: Wink Out

4135440.desc: Crown's Trial is a Souls-Lite Boss Rush where each battle takes place in a different realm. Master tight combat mechanics to defeat legendary heroes inspired from various historical eras like Ancient Rome, Feudal Japan, the Crusades, and many more.
4135440.name: Crown's Trial

4136550.desc: Fight endless hordes of the undead across 50 levels and 10 terrifying worlds, armed with your baseball bat, scarce ammunition and outrageous weapons. Rescue survivors, defeat monstrous bosses and uncover who has plunged the world into eternal darkness.
4136550.name: Javi Romero of the Dead

4136760.desc: Towerbit8 is a tower defense game with platformer mechanics, where you must defeat waves of enemies to build your defenses using directional turrets and defeat the 8 bosses that rule the invading monsters.
4136760.name: TowerBits8

4138760.desc: An organic android, Unit No.41—nicknamed Yoi—warps to another world in search of “Hebdomas”, a substance capable of eliminating the Saima. A short fantasy RPG that follows the traces of memories left behind in a world where humanity has already fallen.
4138760.name: The Adventure of Subject 41

4139890.desc: Explore an ancient, living forest as a tiny gnome in this co-op PVE survival crafting adventure inspired by Nordic folklore. Gather, craft and build a home for your gnome family amongst the treetops, and encounter the Väsen, mythical beings both friendly and dangerous. Play solo or up to 8 players
4139890.name: TROLLHEIM: GNOMES

4140210.desc: A party-builder rogue like, build your party to survive the monsters guarding the crystal. Master the turn-based combat system and break your limits to see how far you can take your party.

4144580.desc: An erotic adult visual novel. Play as a rebellious son trapped in a pious pastor’s home, seduced by your mother’s hidden cravings! Meet a devilish therapist who shatters her faith, enjoy steamy erotic animations, and unlock blasphemous scenes and sinful moments! ✝️🔥✝️🔥✝️🔥
4144580.name: Christian Mother

4144630.desc: Sepulcra is a unique combo-based dungeon crawler roguelike. Befriend unlikely allies and discover powerful combos to escape the Spiral. With a gorgeous, hand-drawn 2D look, explore this world of lost souls.
4144630.name: Sepulcra

4150720.desc: Face off in a Russian roulette drinking survival with a demon who'd kill for you—or kill you—where it's puke or be puked on for your soul. The more you drink, the more the rules break down, until it all spills into one hell of a night you'll never forget.
4150720.name: Drunken Goddess Reflux

4156500.desc: Rekindled is a co-op tavern game with a twist - there's no stress! Forage, Fish, Farm and Cook at your own pace, then decorate your dishes and tavern before welcoming your customers in.
4156500.name: Rekindled: Cozy Tavern Life

4157620.desc: Shades of Fear - North Loop is a first-person psychological horror game inspired by a true story. In October 2004, four old friends plan a weekend of camping on a trail they've known since they were kids. Not everyone on the trail is there to camp.
4157620.name: Shades of Fear - North Loop

4162040.desc: Zenless Zone Zero is HoYoverse’s brand-new urban fantasy ARPG. Players act as "Proxies" who explore Hollows alongside a wide range of unique Agents, fighting enemies, and completing commissions on their journey to unveil the mysteries behind New Eridu.
4162040.name: Zenless Zone Zero

4165740.desc: An automation roguelike where a run fits in one session. Place hexagonal tiles to grow a production organism while the resource demands rise over time. Roll dice in the shop to buy more tiles, and pick perks that change the rules and try to completely break the economy.
4165740.name: Vena: Hex Automation Roguelike

4165870.desc: Your games at your fingertips All the inputs to play all the games on Steam, wherever Steam is
4165870.name: Steam Controller

4165890.desc: Your games in every dimension Wireless, comfortable, lightweight VR for your Steam library
4165890.name: Steam Frame

4165910.desc: Your games on the big screen Powerful PC gaming made easy, in a small and mighty package
4165910.name: Steam Machine

4168680.desc: A fast-paced arena action roguelike about mercenaries fighting on the edge of the galaxy. Choose your hero, battle hordes of aliens, create powerful builds, and turn your body into the ultimate weapon with combat implants.
4168680.name: Doom Keeper

4169730.desc: Step into the inspection booth in Black Border 3, a thrilling dystopian border simulation game. Review complex documents, interrogate suspicious travelers, and uncover clever smuggling plots.
4169730.name: Black Border 3

4171850.desc: Hike through the worst forest full of the most horrible trees. Do not trust them. The trees will trick you. They will bully you. They will hurt you. If only you could find an axe...
4171850.name: Trees Hate You

4175050.desc: Going through a hard time, Ethan decided to go camping alone in the Pinebark woods. He wanted to get away from everything for a few days and find a little silence. He just didn't expect that, in Pinebark, the silence would be listening too.
4175050.name: No One to See – Pinebark Camp

4178540.desc: In this ruined world, nothing good happens at midnight. We fight, we hunt, we build. We tear from the earth whatever is left, just to buy a few more moments of life. You arrived here believing you were the only one. Maybe you were wrong. Would this be the last night?
4178540.name: END US

4178790.desc: Clicky Islands is an incremental game with a full city builder inside. Settle procedurally generated islands, build production chains, put your workers to work and ship goods for gold as your economy grows. Unlock permanent upgrades and find the perfect island for His Majesty’s future kingdom
4178790.name: Clicky Islands

417910.desc: First, realistic PvP brawling game for up to 8 vs 8 players with original, dynamic combat system and fast, round based battles. Create and develop Your character. Earn new skills and items that helps You beat Your opponents. Gather Your friends and fight together in a clan.
417910.name: Street Warriors Online

4179700.desc: Command a mighty fleet of battleships. Upgrade and customise your ships with powerful modules, and traverse the cosmos to outmanoeuvre and defeat your opponents in this strategic single-player card game.
4179700.name: Galactic Arms

4179990.desc: A farming and automation game where your automation is people. Hire workers, pay their salaries, build their houses, and lay out your farms and factories like a town. Produce and sell valuable goods to keep your business profitable. This isn't colony survival, it's running a company.
4179990.name: Agromatic

4181790.desc: A collection of four atmospheric horror games about brokenness and malfunction. Inspect toys for defects, cheat on an exam, follow a radio signal, and explore the darkness by the light of matches.
4181790.name: Broken Horror Anthology

4183130.desc: Experience minigame chaos in WE’RE ALL IN!, an online party game for 1-8 players where you win by betting on your friends in a series of fast-paced games and challenges.
4183130.name: WE'RE ALL IN!

4184810.desc: An adrenaline-pumping bullet heaven where death is permanent. Hire and evolve unique companions, discover 950+ weapon variations, and fight through swarms of enemies and bosses. Grow stronger every run, but if your team falls, they're gone for good.
4184810.name: Bullet Meltdown

4185040.desc: A collection 48 lovingly hand crafted and hand-drawn micro games. Play with just a mouse and shoot for ALL the high scores! Try a random selection of games, or play each individually!
4185040.name: The Great 48

4185770.desc: cenker's mod is a multiplayer physics sandbox with many mods. Every mod has a different experience. Play included, community-made, and your own mods together with friends.
4185770.name: cenker's mod

4189160.desc: On Love, On Monsters is a Frankenstein-inspired story with an emphasis on love in its many forms. Play as three characters with alternating POVs; the Doctor, The Priest, and The Exile. Bond with allies and enemies, avoid raising suspicion in the town of Blackmoore, and learn what it means to love.
4189160.name: On Love, On Monsters

4191110.desc: Two vampires — an ambitious Kindred and a wretched Thinblood. Their fates clash in this Visual Novel set in the World of Darkness, where your arsenal extends beyond just words — from political machinations to forbidden Alchemy. Claw your way to power and leave your bitemarks on Berlin's underworld.
4191110.name: Vampire: The Masquerade - Oaths & Ashes

4192780.desc: A peaceful and relaxing diorama builder that features interactive little villagers and online map sharing! Create a cozy getaway for curious visitors to enjoy!
4192780.name: Cloud Getaway

4193300.desc: A short incremental game where you are tasked to clean a lab from fleshy growths using your flamethrower. Collect resources and spend them in a vast upgrade tree to unlock new abilities.
4193300.name: Fleshborn

4199600.desc: 你今年22岁，大学刚毕业，但是马上就失业了。 你决定，带着大学4年积累下来的18000元， 冲进华强北，当一回背包客。 泪水打湿猪脚饭，发誓要赚一百万！
4199600.name: 勇闯华强北

4199910.desc: Experience the brutal fusion of galactic strategy and grimdark warfare in Total War: WARHAMMER 40,000. Take command of iconic factions, customise your war machine, and engage in devastating battles as you carve a bloody warpath across the stars.
4199910.name: Total War: WARHAMMER 40,000

4200960.desc: The shadows are your ally. Return to the city as Garrett, master thief, in this remastered classic by Nightdive Studios. Pickpocket, prowl, and outsmart in a world where trust is a luxury and every stolen secret comes at a price.
4200960.name: Thief: The Dark Project Remastered

4207260.desc: Fall in love and relax with gorgeous women! Build the Greatest Festival of Pleasure of this era & improve your skills to seduce all the ladies in this incremental dating sim~
4207260.name: Party To Oblivion

4207470.desc: A crew of SEXY SPACE PIRATE BABES blows up your prison ship and claims you in Void Sirens! Become captain — recruit hot heroines, build your squad, lead galactic raids and unlock their deepest NAUGHTY scenes! 💦 Ready to command the hottest crew? 🔥
4207470.name: Void Sirens

4207920.desc: The Rocked and Loaded Pack grants you the gear of the most lethal Glyphid-slaying dwarf squad, plus the first batch of the brand new tattoos introduced in Season 7!
4207920.name: Deep Rock Galactic - Rocked and Loaded Pack

4210250.desc: Logic Arrows is a sandbox game where you design your own mechanisms: from logic gates to an entire computer. Use simple elements to build complex systems, solve engineering challenges and master computer logic.
4210250.name: Logic Arrows

4212960.desc: Tisuland brings together 2D shooting and tower defense in two distinct game modes. Experiment with 6 classes and 10+ skills to discover combinations that suit your playstyle. A typical run lasts around 10–30 minutes. Experiment with different combinations and see how long you can survive.
4212960.name: Tisuland

4213770.desc: This is a true-harem galgame set in a Western fantasy world.
4213770.name: 孤狼之春

4215660.desc: After his fiancée returns to Japan for work in this visual novel by Dark One!, our protagonist begins dreaming of being a woman in the Middle Ages. The more he has these dreams, the more he becomes a woman in real life. Can he reverse his transformation, or will his life take a different turn?
4215660.name: TORAWASE: The Girl in the Mirror

4217650.desc: Command your dice to glorious victory in this strategic rogue-lite dicebuilder. Cast devastating spells, recruit powerful dice, and prove yourself worthy to challenge the great Commander Talis.
4217650.name: Tome of Talis: A Dice Conquest Game

4218360.desc: Build and lead a colony on the surface of an endless Wall. Manage resources and your people, develop new technologies, defend against relentless zyrex attacks, and send robo-spiders on risky expeditions. Keep the colony from collapsing – in Wall World, it's easy to fall.
4218360.name: Wall World Strategy

4220070.desc: Comrade, thousands of bio-experiments are escaping. Line escape routes with guns, blast holes through the horde, and unlock absurd Soviet weapons in this incremental tower defence. Excessive force is authorized.
4220070.name: Comrade, Secrets Escape!

4224090.desc: Powerfuel is an action FPS set in a gritty dieselpunk world. Play as the legendary ex-criminal known as the Cricket, and harness the mystical properties of powerfuels. Fight your way through the gangs of New Lyon and shed light on the conspiracy plaguing the city.
4224090.name: Powerfuel

4224490.desc: Start with one trash PC and build a packed 1998 internet cafe. Serve customers, upgrade your hardware and network, and research new tech in this retro incremental tycoon.
4224490.name: Internet Cafe 98

4228810.desc: Fourteen Years of Flames is a story-driven FPS that replays China’s struggle in the Second Sino-Japanese War (1931–1945). Players embody 7 key characters and battle through 16 real historical events, experiencing the hardships and sacrifices over 14 years of struggle. Land weeps in 14 years of war.
4228810.name: Fourteen Years of Flames

4230530.desc: The Legend of the Crystal Revolver is a fast paced rogue-like platformer with an emphasis on fluid movement, satisfying combat, and fearsome challenges. With unique abilities to master, tightly generated levels, and the ever-looming threat of Death, each run has something new to experience.
4230530.name: The Legend of the Crystal Revolver

4232910.desc: Build your fortune in Silk & Silver, a Major Expansion for Crusader Kings III introducing new mercantile styles of play. Establish a trade empire as a landless Merchant family or vie for control of a Republic, where patrician families scheme, bribe and win over the people to rule.
4232910.name: Crusader Kings III: Silk & Silver

4237900.desc: One cold case, four deathbed flashbacks. Every shift in perspective overturns the "truth" you believed. Story-driven, with exploration, deduction, puzzles, and combat. Ready for a mind-bending thrill ride with twists at every turn?
4237900.name: Point Zero: Victoria

4241440.desc: Give the Galaxy Something to Believe In In the vast expanse of the cosmos, ideas can go farther than FTL drives. Rally galactic civilizations with evolved Ideologies in Stellaris: Willpower, or face the wrath of their rebellion. The galaxy is ready to believe. What will you teach?
4241440.name: Stellaris: Willpower

4241820.desc: A business strategy tycoon set in the 80s arcade boom, where your company exists on the map. Develop hit games, command a workforce of specialist Agents, move cabinets and cash across the city, and outmuscle rival companies on the charts or in the streets.
4241820.name: Arcade Warlord

4249520.desc: Run an inn in the Otherworld, where forgotten things become tsukumogami. By day, tend to guests burdened by Kegare. By night, survive the horrors born from the impurity left behind. Your choices shape the guests’ healing and the inn’s fate.
4249520.name: 異界ノ宿帳

4250370.desc: Sol Protocol is a dynamic VR Co-Op roguelike where you team up and physically pilot a spaceship through dangerous, procedurally generated stellar systems. Manage your spaceship, man the turrets, explore abandoned stations on foot, and make strategic decisions as you push deeper into the deep space.
4250370.name: Sol Protocol

4250810.desc: Start a new life in the cozy town of Rivendale and build your own culinary business. Grow ingredients, explore the world, create unique dishes, and develop relationships with the town's residents.
4250810.name: Rivendale

4251210.desc: Backflip Madness is a fast-paced, parkour-flavored extreme sports game. Your goal is simple - make tons of spectacular tricks and stunts. Take it to the extreme!
4251210.name: Backflip Madness

4253570.desc: Gently restore old objects by cleaning away layers of dust, rust, and time. Reshine is a minimalistic, relaxing experience: use a range of tools to watch years of grime disappear before your eyes. No management, no pressure - just you and the satisfaction of bringing vintage treasures back to life.
4253570.name: Reshine

4255520.desc: Defend Santa's last presents in this pixel-art Christmas defense game! Throw snowballs, hire penguin, owl and fox helpers, master a 29-skill tree and survive endless waves, giant bosses and the dreaded Red Moon. How long can you save Christmas?
4255520.name: Presentfall: Santa Defense

4255780.desc: A gritty bodycam-style first-person shooter where a failed coup throws the city into chaos. Fight through gang-controlled streets, uncover the truth behind your wife's disappearance, and take back what was stolen—one bullet at a time.
4255780.name: No Mercy

4256130.desc: A short, linear narrative-driven psychological horror walking simulator set in Malaysia. Play as a traumatized veteran on his first night as a school security guard, where routine patrols quickly reveal that something is wrong within the school.
4256130.name: Late Night Duty

4257680.desc: Odds At Oddity is a blackjack based roguelike deck builder. Manage your power betting deck, create diverse combinations and scale your points as far as you can go!
4257680.name: Odds At Oddity

4258290.desc: You and your friends are in trouble. Big trouble. You’ve accidentally killed someone, and now you have to get rid of the evidence. "We Are So Cooked" is a 1-4 player co-op physics-stealth game where the objective is simple: Get the body to the exit. The execution? That’s the hard part.
4258290.name: We Are So Cooked

4258680.desc: Uncover the mystery of an arctic cargo outpost's lost crew in this horror game. Take in the frozen sea and delve into the depths of the facility, finding items and uncovering new paths with each one to learn what really happened here. But be careful, because something else might be here with you.
4258680.name: Arctic Grave

4258790.desc: Solve over 150 tile based lawn puzzles. Explore the grounds of a forgotten manor. Discover mysterious flora and figure out their rules. Cut grass and have fun!
4258790.name: The Gardener

4258970.desc: Raise a procedural pet on your Windows desktop. Hatch eggs, feed and evolve pets, collect Crystals, unlock toys and scenes, and shape each body part to create a companion of your own. Switch between windowed and transparent desktop modes, enable click-through, or invite friends online.
4258970.name: Crawling Desktop Pet

4259360.desc: Rebuild a community one bottle at a time in this tiny delivery adventure with your pet cow Milki. Gather resources and upgrade your barn, then bike along dirt paths, breezy meadows, and seaside docks to bring fresh milk back to the sleepy countryside.
4259360.name: Milki Delivery

4259950.desc: ANU: Tablets of Thoth is a 3D platformer adventure where you play as Anu, a reincarnated jackal god. Sprint, scale, swim, and sail across Ancient Egypt. Use Soul Syphon to defeat undead enemies, discover hidden secrets, collect artifacts, and stop the dark sorcerer Voodoo Vulture.
4259950.name: ANU: Tablets of Thoth

4260840.desc: A fifty-year, action-adventure saga of men with nowhere to go and their desperate struggle to find a home. Use extreme violence to survive, and musical talent to thrive as a showman across five cities and eras of modern Japan.
4260840.name: STRANGER THAN HEAVEN

4262460.desc: ROB RUN is a brutal crime sandbox featuring thousands of players. Rise above everyone through the grit, the grime, and the struggle. Break free and take yourself from squalor by any means.
4262460.name: ROB RUN

4264000.desc: Orion Blue is a cozy fishing adventure set on a beautiful alien planet. Catch fish, gather resources, and build relationships with the locals. Play actively, or relax and let the game progress with Idle Mode.
4264000.name: Orion Blue

4264410.desc: WELCOME TO THE “STEP THEATER” :) “STEP THEATER” is a vibrant rhythm game where the story unfolds and the screen comes closer to success with every step you take. Dive in and enjoy this charming, vibrant drama!
4264410.name: STEP THEATER

4265000.desc: An erotic management simulator in which you build your very own monster girl parlor from the ground up!
4265000.name: Isekai Parlor Simulator GOLD

4268090.desc: Drop your pen through cursed charms, bounce it into the cauldrons below, and upgrade your board between rounds in this hand-drawn, slightly haunted roguelite pachinko.
4268090.name: Drop That Pen

4268590.desc: Func Key is a spelling roguelike deck builder where your keyboard is the deck! Customize your keyboard to be the ultimate spelling machine, or leave words behind with rule breaking mods. Spell, build, and relax, all to the soothing thock of the keyboard.
4268590.name: Func Key

4275000.desc: Desktop Island is a co-op life sim to be enjoyed through both an active or idle playstyle. Play solo, or with up to 5 friends to restore your island and create a communal hub. Meet the inhabitants, choose your profession, master deep progression, and gather resources to build your dream island.
4275000.name: Desktop Island: Idle Together!

4275900.desc: Every decision has a cost. Scavenge, hunt, craft, and build a life in a procedurally generated post-apocalyptic wilderness. Last State is a hardcore survival simulation where hunger, cold, injuries and one bad decision can end your story for good.
4275900.name: Last State

4279300.desc: One day, she receives a letter from an unknown sender. Upon her arrival to the mansion indicated inside, she finds vampire hunters and royal knights. They're to form a squad and invade Nyx, the world of vampires. However, this is but the beginning of a game wherein the fate of her world is at stake.
4279300.name: The Red Bells Lament

4281800.desc: A small idle kingdom that lives on your desktop while you work or relax. Your pawns gather on their own, your army fights through three realms, and you decide which gear and skills each unit gets.
4281800.name: Windowed Realms

4285140.desc: Hired Blade is a tactical turn based RPG set in a medieval fantasy world. Become a warchief of your own mercenary band, recruit hired blades, take on contracts, fight bandits and monsters. Unwind in taverns to boost your squad's morale! Embrace the hard life of a true gritty sellsword!
4285140.name: Hired Blade

4288310.desc: BOUNCE, BATTLE AND BASH your friends in this fast paced movement party game! Engage in 7 different game modes where winning requires speed, strategy and skill! Customise your Bert with unlockable outfits galore!
4288310.name: Blobby Bash

4288390.desc: On Filka Island: Explore the abandoned clinic, collect items, solve puzzles, and unlock doors while avoiding Aunt Safa. Can you find the treasure and escape before she catches you?
4288390.name: Um Al-Saaf

4289450.desc: PegLotto! is a roguelike that combines slots, pachinko, and deck-building. Pick your items, place them on the board, and pray that luck is on your side! Sit back, enjoy the view from the train window, and ride the waves of fortune!
4289450.name: PegLotto!

4289830.desc: Victoria just wanted to take a shortcut through the usual parking garage in order to get home... she just didn’t expect to find an untold danger there.
4289830.name: Watch Eye

4293670.desc: Think from all four sides. Quad-Merge is a dynamic puzzle game where you launch numbered blocks from the edges of the grid to combine them, build massive combos, and clear the board. Strategize your angles, unlock powerful boosters, and survive an ever-escalating challenge!
4293670.name: QuadMerge

4293910.desc: You are a lone space customs officer. Every day, spaceships from different galaxies fly past your tiny asteroid. Tourists, truckers, travelers... Bad news: There are terrorists among them. If you miss even one, your home planet will explode. Good news: You carry a shotgun!
4293910.name: XenoFeels

4294670.desc: Move in with a family friend, the missing owner of Artimus Corp, a tech mega-conglomerate. As androids act strangely and your dreams unravel, uncover the truth of your past in this adult cyberpunk visual novel where choices shape relationships and a growing harem.
4294670.name: Aurora Protocol

4294880.desc: Face your enemy. How? BY CREATING PLATFORMING LEVELS! Build a level in 5 minutes, beat your own level to set a record, and then take on your enemy's level while trying to beat their record.
4294880.name: LevelFighters

4295070.desc: Will Earth survive? Experience the Martian invasion from three perspectives. Survive terrifying alien attacks as human, conquer Earth as a Martian, or play the city builder and defend your city against towering Fighting Machines and deadly heat rays. Three games. One war for Earth.
4295070.name: War Of The Worlds Trilogy

4295190.desc: An adult steampunk Visual Novel where you take on the role of a scientist joining a mission of discovery and wonder. Travel to strange new worlds and get to know your traveling companions (quite intimately so, in some cases).
4295190.name: The Velan Reach - Book One: An Unbroken Line

4297050.desc: Have you ever wondered what your robotic vacuum feels when it's wandering through your house? Picking up your messes, leaving your floors pristine again. Wonder no more! Experience the joys of cleaning various houses through the LIDARs of several judgemental robotic vacuums.
4297050.name: VacBot Simulator

4297980.desc: Garden of the Atom is a combat-focused Metroidvania where you hold nothing back. Start with every movement ability unlocked and play as the 'Prodigy,' an exiled genius infiltrating a futuristic dictatorship to stop a tyrant from harnessing a cataclysmic meteor shower.
4297980.name: Garden of the Atom

4298260.desc: Dodge balls, take risks and grow stronger in this incremental survival game. Near misses pay more, upgrades stack up, and soon you are smashing whole waves with chain lightning and kill combos. Beat 11 stages and their bosses.
4298260.name: A Game About Dodging Balls

4301730.desc: You are blind and trapped in an infinite hospital corridor. Use your guide cane and other senses to detect anomalies, question illusions, and find a way out.
4301730.name: Blind Phobia

4302300.desc: A steam engine simulator based in a water pumping station. Operate and maintain your pumping station day and night, maintain city water pressure and fulfill contracts. Interact with realistic steam, coal-firing, and audio simulation in a vintage setting.
4302300.name: Empire Water Works

4303120.desc: Blank Slate is a first-person crime sandbox — craft graded fake IDs, run shady storefronts, launder dirty cash, hire a crew — ID makers, a dealer and a store manager — train them up, pay their wages, and let them lift the work, and outrun the heat in a city that looks the other way.
4303120.name: Blank Slate

4303280.desc: A simple typing narrative game exploring the depths of the mind. Sometimes cozy and warm, sometimes intense and challenging, always interesting.
4303280.name: Some Type of Trip

4303400.desc: Bun G Bop is a low-stakes high-chaos co-op platformer about flinging your friend with a bungee cord while tagging a big tower. We built this game to be fun for all duos, even ones who suck at platformers.
4303400.name: Bun G Bop

4304060.desc: The co-op action puzzle game series PICO PARK is back... and this time, we're teaming up with SEGA's legendary Sonic the Hedgehog! This collaboration is packed with co-op gameplay that combines the flair of Sonic with the puzzle teamwork fun of PICO PARK! Play locally or online with 2 to 8 players!
4304060.name: SONIC PICO PARK

4308270.desc: Earn gold by capturing and dismantling monsters? Buy rifles at the shop? Defeated allies vanish forever? Welcome to the new standard of permadeath monster RPGs. Experience a retro, yet refreshingly addictive gaming adventure.
4308270.name: Hunter Road

4308630.desc: Manage your dopamine, earn money, build decks, and navigate life's challenges in this psychological life-simulation roguelike. Every choice shapes your story as you struggle to survive your own mind. A project developed individually over more than two years.
4308630.name: Dopamine rogue

4314170.desc: Physics-driven ski game with fully simulated bodies and flexible skis. No trick buttons. Control, timing, and motion earn every move. Full customization, tunable physics, community maps, multiplayer.
4314170.name: Jibbers

4314350.desc: Shipwrecked with a haughty Chinese noble, Pirate Captain Jack finds that survival is a very naked business. 🏴‍☠️ Abandon honour for heat in Silk and Sabre! 🌴 Explore exotic taboos, raw desire, and explicit encounters where East meets West in the most intimate ways. 🌊🔥💦 Your prize awaits
4314350.name: Silk and Sabre

4314600.desc: TOE-TAL WAR is an action-puzzle platformer where you kill people with your foot smell. Run and jump to make your feet smelly, change your shoes and socks to control the smell — then get close to enemies and stink them to death. Some levels may require a little practice and hard thinking.
4314600.name: Toe-tal War

431960.desc: Use stunning live wallpapers on your desktop. Animate your own images to create new wallpapers or import videos/websites and share them on the Steam Workshop!
431960.name: Wallpaper Engine

4325750.desc: A choice-driven anime romance visual novel about love, friendship, and finding your own way. Shape Kenta and Hina’s relationship through branching dialogue, enjoy story minigames, and discover three endings across café days and a journey to Aokamori.
4325750.name: A Quiet Place Between Us

4330500.desc: An incremental extraction simulator set in a ruthless world inspired by the extraction genre and book Roadside Picnic. Manage your inventory, navigate hazardous events, and upgrade your hideout. Same tension, but with time to think.
4330500.name: Zone Idle

4335460.desc: BOXROOM allows you to design, define and decorate a room - a sanctuary - for your Steam library, and then revel in the organisation of your game collection.
4335460.name: BOXROOM

4335520.desc: A relaxing idle desktop companion game about a little cozy miner living at the bottom of your screen. Watch Monty mine, upgrade his skills and minerals to yield more coins, find or purchase his 142 little treasures, and decorate his tiny world. All while you work, study, or just relax!
4335520.name: Monty's Idle Mine

433850.desc: Z1 Battle Royale is a Free to Play, fast-paced, action arcade, competitive Battle Royale. Staying true to its "King of the Kill" roots, the game has been revamped and restored to the classic feel, look, and gameplay everyone fell in love with. Play solo, duos, or fives and be the last ones standing.
433850.name: Z1 Battle Royale

4343470.desc: A competitive online multiplayer typing racing game where speed comes from skill, build flow, hit boosts, and out type your opponents.
4343470.name: Typing Drag Racer

4346860.desc: Run a cozy flower shop alongside Alice, right on your desktop. Grow plants, watch them bloom, and slowly turn an empty corner into a warm, living space. A gentle companion game designed to keep you company while you work or relax.
4346860.name: Alice Flower Room: Lo-Fi

4348910.desc: Probably Stolen is a cyberpunk shopkeeping simulator set in a dystopian space station. Craft, trade, and smuggle goods of questionable origin, navigate faction loyalties, and decide how far you’re willing to go to stay afloat. Earn enough to buy out your shop before rising rent forces your hand.
4348910.name: Probably Stolen - Cyberpunk Shopkeeper Sim

4351380.desc: Run a men's hair removal salon! Zap body hair with a laser, watch the pain meter, and pitch aftercare packages for every budget. Earn good reviews to bring in new clients, then use your profits to upgrade your gear, hire staff, and make your shop the go-to spot for hairy hunks.
4351380.name: Hair Removal Salon Simulator

4352680.desc: A sci-fi low-poly tower defense game. Design your defense against waves of aliens using a wide arsenal of different towers.
4352680.name: Aurora Reach: Frontline

4354570.desc: The final battle to decide the fate of the world has begun. Take to the skies, chart your course, and stand with your companions against Sephiroth one last time. A vast planet awaits. Everything leads here.
4354570.name: FINAL FANTASY VII REVELATION

4355110.desc: A tilt-based platformer game for everyone. Players control Marupoyo’s momentum as he rolls through 120 vibrant levels, avoiding obstacles, exploring, and rescuing his lost siblings.
4355110.name: Marupoyo: The Round Chick's Adventure

4356430.desc: The hustle doesn’t stop and the run never ends in NBA 2K27. Chase greatness around the clock in MyCAREER, MyTEAM, and MyNBA, and make your hoop dreams a reality.
4356430.name: NBA 2K27

4357320.desc: Above Par is a physics-based precision platformer about climbing high and falling hard. Master a 4-club toolkit, calculate your trajectories, and get ready to fall... a lot.
4357320.name: Above Par

4357650.desc: The Pro Pass: Season 3 unlocks access to 40 levels of premium rewards! Get the Pro Pass: Season 3 & automatically receive 4 additional Season Pass Rewards.
4357650.name: NBA 2K27 Pro Pass: Season 3

4357660.desc: The Hall of Fame Pass: Season 3 includes everything in the Pro Pass: Season 3, a 15% XP Booster, 10 Level Skips, & 15,000 VC!
4357660.name: NBA 2K27 Hall of Fame Pass: Season 3

4357670.desc: NBA 2K27 Season 3 MyCAREER Bonus Offer includes 75,000 VC, a 120-Minutes 2XP Coin (MC), Phoenix Suns Holiday Mascot, and an Electric Rose Hoodie and Joggers for your MyPLAYER.
4357670.name: NBA 2K27 MyCAREER Bonus Offer: Season 3

4364650.desc: A short incremental game about space mining. Walk around your ship, physically interact with it's systems, blast asteroids, collect resources, upgrade your gear and watch numbers go up.
4364650.name: Space Numbers Go Up

4364740.desc: These Eyes is a no-text adventure game with elements of action, platforming, quests, and horror. Explore locations, solve puzzles, and interact with other characters.
4364740.name: These Eyes

4366550.desc: 2D warband sandbox — roam the map, raise an army, fight turn-based battles.
4366550.name: Tenrei

4366900.desc: Run your own idle bar and click your way to pleasure — earn money, unlock girls, and progress through increasingly explicit rewards.
4366900.name: I Opened an Idle Bar So I Can GOON to HOT GIRLS

4368520.desc: 不愿入睡的少女，渴望长眠的少年。 当两人的梦重叠之时，传说将再度流转。 最终，与你一同坠入浅眠之国。
4368520.name: pieces/渡り鳥のソムニウム

4369110.desc: Enjoy character development. Over 100 character slots. Auto-progression dispatch system. Over 50 stages. Auto-progression is also possible. `tactical role‑playing game (tactical RPG)` `strategy RPG (SRPG)` `grid‑based turn‑based tactics game` `Japanese turn‑based tactical RPG series`
4369110.name: DEMØNS GATE & Paintball Ops

4369620.desc: Zombie Apocalypse On A Boat. You’re stranded on a boat during a zombie outbreak in the beautiful San Juan islands of Washington State. How will you survive an open-world archipelago, where the living are just as much of a threat as the dead?
4369620.name: Last Harbor

4370210.desc: You and your friend are locked in the same body! In this co-op adventure, learn to control the same character, venture into your spiritual realm, and unravel the machinations of the Samsara megastructure! Communication will be key!
4370210.name: Split Brain Samsara

4377160.desc: Nineteen-year-old Aaron Tekin was reborn from the brink of death in a repair shop and gained the ability to control machinery. He came to the college and befriended three mature female tutors, but was caught in a crisis due to a mysterious signal and had to protect them.
4377160.name: Mechanic and Healing Girl

4380710.desc: 3D Pretty Girl Dress-Up Fighting Game, earn DNA in battles to unlock skills and outfits. Experience the authentic feel of an arcade-style fighting game, with an original combat system, delivering exhilarating infinite combos and counter-infinite combos.
4380710.name: DNA FIGHT

4380910.desc: You are invited to join Unicorn Academy! Create a magical connection with your own unicorn and forge friendship bonds with Sophia, Ava, Layla and the other heroes from the series. Wield unicorn magic and discover every corner of Unicorn Island.
4380910.name: Unicorn Academy: Island of Magic

438100.desc: Join our growing community as you explore, play, and help craft the future of social VR. Create worlds and custom avatars. Welcome to VRChat.
438100.name: VRChat

4382510.desc: On the mysterious Mysteria Island, embark on an exciting dice adventure with charming and unique monster girls! Use strategic board game mechanics to collect resources, buy lands, and compete in friendly matches while building heartwarming bonds and exploring the fantastical island together!
4382510.name: Monster Girls Dice Board

4388690.desc: "Noodles are the food of solitude." Trapped by agoraphobia and social anxiety, your only friend is Samantha. She is your courage to open the door. But in a room of broken mirrors, who is actually speaking? A short psychological visual novel about isolation and the lies we tell ourselves.
4388690.name: Poor Samantha: An Agoraphobic Visual Novel

4388880.desc: Command your defense in an ever-changing roguelite TD. Harvest resources from mine nodes, explore the fog of war, and repel alien waves. With a deep branching tech tree and permanent progression, every defeat is just a step toward ultimate power. Build. Die. Research. Repeat.
4388880.name: Star TD

4390080.desc: Join a family of bears and run the buzziest little honey farm! Collect and discover rare bees, bottle honey jars, expand your farm, and watch your flowery field bloom in this cozy idle management game.
4390080.name: Bottled by Bears

4390380.desc: Build. Command. Conquer. Take control in a fast-paced VR RTS packed with intense battles, dynamic defenses, and strategic depth. Survive brutal enemy waves, defeat epic bosses, and battle rivals online in explosive 1v1 multiplayer!
4390380.name: Crystal Commanders

4391570.desc: VOiD: Reshaped is a gravity-bending 2D puzzle platformer. Flip gravity to solve tricky puzzles, dodge deadly traps and survive enigmatic bosses as you guide a tiny cube through a relaxed yet challenging adventure for all ages.
4391570.name: VOiD:Reshaped

4395610.desc: Deilist: And Nothing Remains is a boss fight where you play as an evil force determined to destroy the gods. Dodge, fight back, do everything necessary to survive, for the odds are definitively against you.
4395610.name: Deilist: And Nothing Remains

4396160.desc: This Advent 4-themed gallery unlocks 24 additional levels for WooLoop! Working as an advent calendar, open one image per day to count down the days until Christmas! The fourth Advent in WooLoop! Count down the days to Christmas in style!
4396160.name: WooLoop - Advent 4 Pack

4396640.desc: A survivors-like auto-shooter where the hero is an armored convoy. Grow it car by car, take a crew on board and mow down hordes of thousands of enemies. The fate of the planet rides on your choices — and your convoy.
4396640.name: Last convoy

4398690.desc: MoSimulator is a robotics simulation game with an arcade feel that lets players mod in their own robots. Experience the excitement of competitive student robotics in a fun, accessible format where you can bring your own robot designs to life and compete in simulated matches.
4398690.name: MoSimulator

4398870.desc: A fast top-down roguelike maze-runner. 4 abilities, 78 upgrades, and 47 gadgets (12 of them risky) for countless builds. 6 enemy types and 6 escalating boss designs across a 30-level descent.
4398870.name: ETCH

440.desc: Nine distinct classes provide a broad range of tactical abilities and personalities. Constantly updated with new game modes, maps, equipment and, most importantly, hats!
440.name: Team Fortress 2

4400020.desc: A co-op horror strategy game for 1–4 players. Guide field clients from an underground bunker, recover supplies and get your clients home before the shift ends. Sell spare loot and gear up for the next run. Beware of monsters!
4400020.name: The Dust Between: Observer

4402200.desc: A base-building survival game with terraforming and crafting. Earth lies poisoned and abandoned ten thousand years after invasion. Awaken from stasis, defend your fragile foothold, and restore a dead world so humanity can live here again.
4402200.name: Project Tomorrow

4408320.desc: An award-winning 4v4 third-person class shooter with more personality than sense! The mobile classic millions grew up with is now on PC. Choose from 11 unique classes, mix hundreds of thousands of loadout combinations, and battle it out online or with friends across 16 wacky maps!
4408320.name: BATTLE BEARS GOLD

4408850.desc: TIME TO PUT SOME MAGIC HATS ON YOU BALDY! Hatfinity is a top-down roguelike arcade experience set within a dark crystal cave. Play as a powerful wizard that combines his spells into something greater than their elements. Your choices determine whether you become the man with infinite hats!
4408850.name: HATFINITY

4414620.desc: Build miniature diorama scenes, piece by piece. Complete beautiful book nooks as you place furniture, decorations, and small details. Relax and enjoy the peaceful satisfaction of every detail falling into place, as you discover more about each moment in time.
4414620.name: Book Nook

4416070.desc: Accompany Nai in her normal Sunday routine of watching TV, eating ramen and ruminating on her past.
4416070.name: Naishitai: The parts I'm missing.

4416390.desc: Terminus: Day Zero is a free, short zombie survival adventure set in the world of Terminus: Zombie Survivors. On the first day of the outbreak, Daisy is home alone, and the dead are getting closer. Hide, shut the doors, and run.
4416390.name: Terminus: Day Zero

4417760.desc: Enter the sewer one more time! Snotty's Sewer Reflushed is the remake of the indie horror where survival is key, and buttons must be pressed.
4417760.name: Snotty's Sewer Reflushed

4422260.desc: "Hakoniwa Electric" is a cute relaxing puzzle game. Explore adorable isometric stages, solve puzzles, and light them up. Why not spend a leisurely year as Akari, who's taken over grandpa's electronics shop, helping with the monthly troubles from the townsfolk?
4422260.name: Hakoniwa Electric

4423270.desc: Take to the streets solo or with a partner in this fast paced, high-impact arcade beat ’em up. Takeover returns with refined gameplay, upgraded visuals and a pulse-pounding new soundtrack.
4423270.name: Takeover 2

4424420.desc: A multiplayer social deduction horror where spells are spoken aloud. One of you is altered. Cast magic with your voice, hunt the traitor, survive the ritual. Every word can save - or kill.
4424420.name: Alterum

4424750.desc: Live out Moeka’s hidden exhibitionist desires in a 3D anime experience. Push your limits in public, gain confidence, and unlock new challenges… all while staying one step away from being caught.
4424750.name: Moeka: Exposure’s Temptation

4425610.desc: KILLFLOW is an insanely fast retro-FPS set in a stylish procedurally generating world. Destroy red psychopaths with destructive weapons to save yourself from getting corrupted, and get the high score.
4425610.name: KILLFLOW

4426410.desc: Potted Pets is a cozy farming and pet simulator, with an adorable cast of living plant pots. Spend time cultivating a personal garden while growing a personal relationship with your collection of “Potted Pets!” Sit down for a relaxing, customizable experience that brightens up your busy day!
4426410.name: Potted Pets

4427540.desc: "Forget skills—buy your way to victory!" <P2W: The Party Show> is a chaotic multiplayer party game where cash is king. Grab gold in hilarious minigames and shop for overpowered items to wreck your rivals. Ready to test your friendships? In this flashy show, the deepest pockets win it all!
4427540.name: P2W : The Party Show

4433840.desc: Collect dazzling anime girls in an idle game at your own pace. Battles, recruiting and leveling are automatic: just leave the game running. No click spamming or constant upgrades. When you feel like it, adjust your gear and formation to deal even more damage with your favorite!
4433840.name: Starlit Archive: Idle Collector

4434380.desc: The world has been taken over by the Synchronization Network. A co-op action horror game with crafting, raids, and extraction. Defend your base, rescue survivors, gather resources, fight Network Agents, disable Signals, and make it back to camp alive.
4434380.name: Blackout Route

4434550.desc: Play with people from other countries without knowing their language. You speak yours and they hear theirs, in your own voice if you want. What they say reaches you as voice or subtitles. Voice and text chat in your games and Discord. Speak and write in 18 languages, with 50+ features.
4434550.name: GAME CHAT TRANSLATOR

4435490.desc: War erupts on the Korean Peninsula as North Korea launches an invasion that threatens to destabilize the world in Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4.
4435490.name: Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4

4435810.desc: 经典1:1原味复刻，战法道三职业重聚！⚔️ 踏入充满争夺与挑战的传奇世界，挑战强大 BOSS，收集装备，培养并肩作战的英雄，施展强大的英雄合击。集结行会伙伴征战沙城，争夺战场上的荣誉与资源。老情怀与新体验碰撞，焕新出发！
4435810.name: 焚天烈火之元素领主

4437290.desc: Lorenium Orbit is a fast-paced 2D team-based space combat arena where players pilot specialized warships, customize loadouts, and battle in tactical 7v7 matches. Master momentum-based flight, precision aiming, and coordinated fleet strategy to dominate orbit.
4437290.name: Lorenium Orbit

4437450.desc: A heartwarming Neko comedy that connects these felines from all across the globe! With over 7 million copies sold worldwide, the latest entry in the popular adventure game series NEKOPARA is here!
4437450.name: Nekopara Sekai Connect

4437670.desc: Welcome to Earthia, your aim is to mine every ore in Earthia and send all those ingots to mainland. You can upgrade your pickaxe, buy items and mine ores easily in a chill land with different types of biomes.
4437670.name: Earthia Mining

4438110.desc: Build your monster team, combine skills, and create absurd builds to push farther and farther in this strategic auto battler!
4438110.name: Nightmare Conquest

4438940.desc: A casual musical puzzle game - make beats with bots! Listen to the target beat, then solve how to replicate the beat by manipulating bots that each represent a different drum sound
4438940.name: Beat Bots

4440750.desc: Aftertaste is a 2.5D indie platformer game where you play as Tami, the tongue of a burned-out chef, Keh, and rediscover her lost passion. Let’s embark on a journey of regaining her taste through adventure and puzzles!
4440750.name: Aftertaste

444090.desc: Paladins is the ultimate fantasy team-based shooter experience, with over 50 customizable Champions fighting in 5v5 action across a diverse Realm of modes and maps!
444090.name: Paladins®

444200.desc: Blow off steam and tank turrets in a free-to-play online 7v7 tank shooter! Drive hundreds of tanks, from museum classics to "did-that-ever-exist?" specials, in quick 5 to 7-minute brawls packed with metal mayhem. Play solo or team up with a friend and enjoy smooth action even on modest hardware!
444200.name: World of Tanks Blitz

4443690.desc: Cornerwitch is a cozy idler game that sits on the corner of your screen. Study new spells and advance through a magical journey. Unlock cosmetics to dress up your little witch, level up and become stronger.
4443690.name: Cornerwitch

4444310.desc: A shooter primarily focused on constantly aiming at various difficulties.
4444310.name: Rend

4444800.desc: You are the magistrate, and Lucifer stands trial as the defendant. Judge the fallen angel in this dark romance visual novel. Decide whether he is worthy of salvation, or doomed to destruction. One single, final choice.
4444800.name: Obey Me! Sinner's Choice: Lucifer

4449800.desc: In TaskFall, you and your friends take on tasks from the mysterious Citadel. The work is not difficult. At least, that’s what they say in the Citadel. Complete tasks on fully destructible levels, make it out alive, buy new equipment, and gradually uncover the secrets of the Citadel.
4449800.name: TaskFall

4450600.desc: Explore the marvelous world of Crackheads alone or with up to 50 players. Team up, turn on your friends, make money, build your empire, scavenge trash for questionable meals, and stay high through all of it.
4450600.name: Crackheads

4450660.desc: Flick light switches on and off throughout a long-abandoned house to shift the environment from a safe reality to a blood-soaked echo where grisly puzzles manifest. A psychological horror experience where you must balance the light you need to progress with the terrifying nightmares it summons.
4450660.name: Flick

4451040.desc: Psychological anomaly horror set in an abandoned school corridor. Find what has changed and make the right choice. But even the right choice doesn't guarantee escape. The corridor won't let you leave that easily.
4451040.name: Corridor 13

4451510.desc: Use cards to build a garden in this cozy puzzle game. Each level has a different deck. Each card has different interactions with other cards. Discover them and decide what kind of garden you want to build for yourself.
4451510.name: Wisp & Willow

4452620.desc: Smash containers. Grab the gold. Find the hidden keys before time runs out. Recruit a crew of thieves and rob the lord again in this short medieval heist incremental.
4452620.name: Thieves and Gold

4452700.desc: Build your band, hit the stage, and go on tour in Stage Tour, the next evolution of music rhythm games. Rock over 90 officially licensed tracks, unlock over 180 authentic Gibson®, Epiphone® and Kramer® guitars, and experience five game modes, including the all-new roguelite Tour Mode.
4452700.name: STAGE TOUR

4453700.desc: Explore an abandoned and decaying village in this immersive first-person psychological horror experience, search forgotten houses and shadowed paths, piece together disturbing clues, and uncover the truth that waits within the suffocating darkness.
4453700.name: The Beckoning

4459590.desc: A roguelike auto-battler defense where luck meets strategy. Spin a 3x3 slot machine to summon units and grow your army by absorbing others. Use Items and Cores to manipulate the odds and survive challenging judgement waves and boss waves. Every spin and every choice counts.
4459590.name: Slotbound

4459600.desc: PICK A BOO is an online co-op roguelike escape action game for up to 6 players. Explore ever-changing stages and haul furniture and cargo with magnetic power. Upgrade your character, evade enemies, or fight back. How greedy will you get? When will you escape? It's up to you!
4459600.name: PICK A BOO

4459990.desc: An idle survivor-like that sits in the corner of your screen.
4459990.name: Screen Survivors

4461460.desc: Become a Master Blacksmith in this cozy fantasy simulator. Restore and upgrade your workshop, forge magical weapons and armor, craft jewelry, and enchant powerful gear. Meet magical creatures and mysterious figures as you enjoy a relaxing crafting experience, solo or with friends in co-op.
4461460.name: Fantasy Blacksmith Simulator

4463480.desc: ArcaneBound is a pixel-art bullet heaven action RPG. Collect familiars, defeat hordes of monsters, gather rare cards, level up, and create increasingly devastating builds.
4463480.name: ArcaneBound

4463520.desc: Midsummer is right around the corner in Moominvalley, when a sudden flood sets the Moomins adrift! Join Tove Jansson’s beloved Moominfamily and friends on an adventure of mirth and mischief aboard a mysterious floating theatre.
4463520.name: Moomin: Midsummer Madness

4469080.desc: Disguise yourself as little demons on a pilgrimage West to become Buddha! A cozy, hand-drawn party-based RPG with auto-battle, so you can easily fight, upgrade, and clear trials with a cast of funny misfit monsters.
4469080.name: Monk & The Misfit Monsters

4475300.desc: Top-down PvE looter shooter. Fight, loot, and survive—extract to keep your items and clear the stage.
4475300.name: Smash Dash: Demolition Run

4475970.desc: Sell boxes of dice to silly clients in this cozy roguelike deckbuilder! Each die has unique effects based on the positioning of other dice in the box! Create your own crazy combos, make numbers go up, and overcharge shamelessly to pay rent!
4475970.name: Prerolled

4476390.desc: After the death of your mother and with no other choice, you take the only job available: guarding and maintaining a lonely campsite in the mountains. But what seemed like a quiet place hides mysteries that will change everything.
4476390.name: Lost Camp

4481330.desc: An incremental game where you dig through cursed tombs, harvest bones, flesh, and various resources; stitch together your own creature from nothing. Discover powerful artifacts, experiment with unique combinations, and bring your creation to life—piece by piece.
4481330.name: Frankenmine

4483020.desc: Two parties. Alternating perspectives. A story-driven 2.5D turn-based RPG. Master strategic combat with flexible ability builds, unravel the world's deep lore using "Key Words" you discover, and see their fate unfold.
4483020.name: Echoes of the Flame

4483090.desc: Robot Basketball League is a gritty sports game featuring a modified version of 1v1 Basketball. This is where the most competitive robot athletes gather. Do you have what it takes to succeed in this League?
4483090.name: Robot Basketball League

4483900.desc: Build an impossible tower. Defend it against endless sieges. Watch it crumble, then rebuild stronger.
4483900.name: The Tower Must Fall

4484970.desc: Use animated wallpapers on your desktop. Explore unlimited live wallpapers from the community, or create your own with included AI generations that refill daily.
4484970.name: Wallpaper Animator

4487360.desc: A Slavic-myth slot roguelike. Build a deck of symbols, hang Ancients over the grid, bargain in the shop, and squeeze multipliers from every spin before the Kolovrat slips into a spiral for good.
4487360.name: Spinova

4488240.desc: Catch the beer, keep the buzz, and unlock three thick, hung futa bartenders. Score enough in each stage to open the gallery, then play their sex animations, swap outfits and hairstyles, and pick your partner. A playful, sultry arcade game with an adults-only reward loop.
4488240.name: Futa: beer & sex

4488990.desc: A dark yuri horror visual novel inspired by a classic gothic novella. When the enigmatic Carmilla arrives, Laura is swept into a fever dream of obsession. Is this stranger the cure for her loneliness or a herald of corruption? And what caused the mysterious deaths of two girls in the nearby village?
4488990.name: Carmilla : Crimson Moon

4492400.desc: Click Flip is a short incremental game about clicking tiles, earning points, buying upgrades, and causing crazy tile combos.
4492400.name: Click Flip

4492480.desc: A strategy game blending deckbuilding, auto-battler, and roguelike elements. Recruit and upgrade units to build your squad. Draw random numbers to activate matching units’ skills on the board, earn points, and defeat the boss. Test your strategy and arrangement — with a little luck.
4492480.name: Pick Squad

4492500.desc: The Cinder Throne is an Idler RPG where you passively kill enemies, level up, loot enemies, change pieces of equipment and find spells. Create powerfull synergies. Rebirth and come back stronger than ever
4492500.name: The Cinder Throne

4493130.desc: You're the Ski-E-O - build the cozy ski resort of your dreams in this management tycoon game. Adapt to ever-changing weather, paint trails, build lifts, and place the lodges and après bars that keep thousands of skiers warm, fed, and happy.
4493130.name: Ski-E-O! Ski Resort Tycoon

4494800.desc: Survive the siege in this high-octane top-down shooter. Blast your way through relentless waves of enemies and use Bullet Time to slow the chaos and dismantle the swarm. You can’t play it safe. Stay aggressive if you want to survive. In this place, an aggressive offense is your only defense.
4494800.name: Void Rhythm

4498140.desc: A scientific expedition team composed of Chinese and foreign researchers fell into a sinkhole due to an accident, and the entire team mysteriously lost contact. As the captain of the emergency search and rescue mission, you will overcome numerous obstacles and confront the unknown fate head-on
4498140.name: 天坑追匪

4498540.desc: Spooky's Playground is an arcade-inspired Score Attack physics sandbox game where wreaking havoc is rewarded! Complete challenges, find secrets and perfect your scores with each new run!
4498540.name: Spooky's Playground

4500.desc: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Shadow of Chernobyl tells a story about survival in the Zone – a very dangerous place, where you fear not only the radiation, anomalies and deadly creatures, but other S.T.A.L.K.E.R.s, who have their own goals and wishes.
4500.name: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Shadow of Chernobyl

4504650.desc: This is a Sword And Sandals inspired Turn-based arena RPG. Play a skeleton gladiator in the Greek underworld: pick one action per round, shatter enemy armor, forge and enchant weapons, cheer up a crowd of ghosts. Beat 4 arenas and 4 bosses to face Hades, who swore the winner goes free.
4504650.name: Bone Bazaar

4504940.desc: Explore Ancient Egypt in search of its lost treasures. A relaxing low poly 3D spot-the-difference game set across beautiful, hand-crafted scenes.
4504940.name: Pharaoh's Secrets

4504970.desc: AetherCycle is a first-person action RPG featuring fast-paced combat, character leveling, abilities, and loot-driven gear progression. Explore a vast world, conquer dungeons, and grow stronger solo or in co-op as the Cycle affects the world.
4504970.name: AetherCycle

4505200.desc: A customizable retro-inspired music widget that lets you import your favorite songs, create vinyl records, organize collections, and enjoy reactive visuals while you listen.
4505200.name: Retro Music Player

4506380.desc: Well, I did randomly toss in a couple of tracks from other games just to make myself sound a little less monotonous during the game, but hey, whatever, this is the soundtrack for ‘Cosdarica's Journey at the End of the World’, so those two got the boot! ——Mo Cixia
4506380.fullgame_name: Cosdarica's Journey at the End of the World
4506380.name: Cosdarica's Journey at the End of the World Soundtrack

4507410.desc: An interactive escape room game where your choices determine your fate. Right before a "long holiday," you find yourself trapped in the office with beautiful women for unknown reasons. Collect clues, cooperate with them, and escape this place!
4507410.name: Locked in love : The Office

4509300.desc: Get your friends together for Prinny Party: Going Overboard! In this party game, you’ll traverse the board as you take down demons, earn experience, and buy new equipment—all to make sure you’re strong enough to defeat the Supreme Overboard!
4509300.name: Prinny Party: Going Overboard!

4512860.desc: Get ready to nyan-nyan and nin-nin in the latest entry in the NEKO-NIN exHeart franchise with even more ninja catgirls than ever before.
4512860.name: NEKO-NIN exHeart SPIN! 2

4514060.desc: Taimanin Asagi, the legendary anti-demon ninja, returns in the second installment of this classic visual novel series! Asagi and Sakura head to Tokyo Kingdom, a lawless district overrun with demons and criminals, to determine the whereabouts of their fellow Taimanin who have gone missing in action.
4514060.name: Taimanin Asagi 2

4514880.desc: A VR hoverboard roguelite. Lean your whole body to steer and dodge, no thumbstick's needed. Use your duals blaster and abilities to dodge and build your run from 9 rival sponsors offering 90+ enhancement cards. Clear the hyperlanes to impress the sponsors, every death is monetized.
4514880.name: Hyperlane Highway

4515800.desc: "The Veil Chronicles: Nix University" is an exciting and vibrant adventure in a well-thought-out author's world, combining the genres of visual novel, RPG, and turn-based combat system.
4515800.name: The Veil Chronicles: Nix University | Part 1

4515920.desc: You are a real estate agent whose job is to determine which elderly woman is an ordinary seller and which one is a scammer granny.
4515920.name: BABKA-TERROR

4516210.desc: Build a film and television empire in a living entertainment industry beginning in the 1980s. Create and manage productions, cast unique talent, outmaneuver rival studios, climb the box office and grab television ratings in this immersive, old-school tycoon sim.
4516210.name: Studio Sim

4516500.desc: Explore. Trade. Fish. Whale. Colonize. Fight. Pillage. Survive. You are a sea captain in the year 1522, and the whole world is yours to discover in this roguelike sandbox historical sailing simulator.
4516500.name: Marque & Reprisal

4518950.desc: Discover the challenging fun of validating logical proofs, beginning with simple propositional calculus and ending with complex, multi-domain predicate calculus. Prove yourself to be a master of logical thinking!
4518950.name: Quod Erat Demonstrandum

4521650.desc: Grow fresh ingredients and run your own little restaurant. Enjoy a peaceful day that stretches from the field to the table. Plan a fresh menu for a delightful day, keep your pantry full, and make your customers happy. Earn your own money and build your little world step by step.
4521650.name: Farm & Feast

4523120.desc: Volvy's Adventure: Reslimed is a spectacular remaster of the original remake of the unreleased action-platformer starring the most famous video game mascot of all time.
4523120.name: Volvy’s Adventure: Reslimed

4523170.desc: A short, sweet, 3D simulation game about a café with a "unique" marketing strategy! And in case you were wondering, no, you won't be serving coffee...
4523170.name: Glory Hole Barista

4525890.desc: A cartoon-style skateboarding game where you link grabs, tricks, and grinds in smooth, flowy lines through colorful environments—easy to pick up, satisfying to master, and punishing if you wipe out!
4525890.name: Kick&Rip

4526450.desc: Semi-idle incremental RTS. You don’t micro units. You build factories, pick upgrades and let your army flood the battlefield. Start with nothing, research tanks, artillery, flankers and mega units. Scale and survive enemy surges. Pure auto-battle chaos.
4526450.name: Incremental RTS

4528040.desc: A grounded open-world survival crafting game where you're stranded alone on Mars. Explore the red planet, extract resources, build a pressurized base, manage oxygen, power, and food, and construct the rocket that's your only way home.
4528040.name: Sol One
