4529410.desc: You were brought here for a reason. Your rage is their weapon. Slow down time, survive the chaos, and uncover the truth — if you make it that far.
4529410.name: Rage Box

4529690.desc: You came to town to sell berries, but ended up managing a café with charming cow girls! Mix delicious cocktails, save the café from going under, and grow closer to your staff — and their attractive boss. Who knew a new job could change your life so much?
4529690.name: Cowgirl Milk Cafe

4530340.desc: A click-based incremental game themed around "physics". You will start with the most fundamental classical mechanics and gradually unlock more concepts. Through the process of easy clicking and growth, with the familiar media - PHYSICS, experience the fun of resource exploration and growth.
4530340.name: Physics Clicker

4530370.desc: Choose the club. Shape the squad. Set the tactics as the manager of the world’s greatest football clubs. FM27 is where footballing beliefs become reality in a living, breathing football world that blends strategy with RPG in the ultimate sports simulation game.
4530370.name: Football Manager 27

4530440.desc: Fine-tune your footballing world and bring your vision to life fully with the Football Manager 27 In-Game Editor.
4530440.name: Football Manager 27 In-game Editor

4531250.desc: From the creators of Moonfrost, Tiny Dwellings is a whimsical hand-drawn spin-off builder with kindred pixelly vibes! Delight in designing your dream petite homesteads and charming dioramas. Unwind in a stress-free haven and dig the heartwarming lo-fi ambiences as you express your creative muse.
4531250.name: Tiny Dwellings

4534540.desc: A massive influx of new factions, plus official campaigns for the first time, new AI-controlled allies, and more. Contains everything from the Forge of Empires mod, plus a lot more.
4534540.name: AI War 2: Forge Of Titans

4534960.desc: Play in co-op as the crew of the world’s worst airline. Your plane is falling apart, your cargo is illegal, and passenger safety barely makes the list.
4534960.name: Dear Passengers

4535390.desc: The universe is over. You are the last human alive inside a superstructure orbiting an evaporating black hole and its taking you with it. Can you find the truth about what happened to Humanity and The Machine God while finding a way to escape?
4535390.name: Temple Of The Machine God

4535610.desc: A relaxing sliding tile puzzle game. Sort vegetables into contiguous groups across 15 levels of increasing difficulty. Try to beat your best time, challenge your friends to a race, or just play endlessly to relax.
4535610.name: Vegetableau

4535780.desc: In this adventure game, play as a scientist immune to a deadly virus. Scavenge for resources, develop a vaccine, and test it on Amber, a recently infected girl. Manage supplies, explore dangerous areas, and build a bond that could save humanity. Enjoy post-apocalyptic life with a zombie girl!
4535780.name: Love is Undead

4535880.desc: ★ Surreal dice-rolling roguelike about luck and greed ★ Feed your dice dumplings, collect game bending trinkets, roll too much and lose it all. Or get lucky, unlock King Fetus, meet God and you might just wake up.
4535880.name: Dice Have No Eyes

4537400.desc: Turn any PDF, TXT or DOCX into an interactive visual novel. Pick an anime companion, upload a paper or any text you want to understand, and let AI turn it into a 5–10 minute story — with quizzes, voice narration, a blackboard for formulas, and full character customization via Steam Workshop.
4537400.name: Paper2Galgame

4538060.desc: Subsurface is a 1–4 player co-op underwater horror game. Explore abandoned facilities, scavenge valuable loot, and survive 13 terrifying monsters while racing against your oxygen supply. Meet your quota, escape the depths, and try not to leave your friends behind.
4538060.name: Subsurface

4538150.desc: After Hue is a charming puzzle platformer starring an adorable chameleon on a grand adventure! Shift colors, phase through obstacles, and unravel the mysteries hidden within every hue!
4538150.name: After Hue

4541130.desc: A VR puzzle adventure where dimensional fractures have torn reality apart. Explore environments destabilized by the rift, solve spatial puzzles hidden across 10 distinct scenes, and follow signals, symbols, and strange objects to uncover what caused the collapse.
4541130.name: Div Zero

4541310.desc: Forget pre-written options; let your words drive the game! In this first-person dating sim, say whatever you want to AI characters with real memories and get natural responses, and experience a completely unique story every time.
4541310.name: Flirt Simulator

4541350.desc: You are a pilgrim lost in a mysterious forest. Survive in this procedurally generated, turn-based tactical roguelite inspired by Celtic mythology. Upgrade your gear, adapt your strategy and remember: something is always lurking in the shadows.
4541350.name: Fraga

4544470.desc: digital puppeteering made easy! create dynamic 2D avatars, control them with your camera, microphone, or whatever other input you got, and integrate with your streaming/recording software of choice.
4544470.name: veadotube

4545470.desc: Craft uncanny totems. Aid troubled townsfolk. Uncover the darkness below. The Totemist is a narrative-driven occult shop sim set in a quietly strange town, where you craft charms inspired by real witchcraft, aid troubled townspeople, and uncover the ancient force festering beneath them.
4545470.name: The Totemist

4546380.desc: A twin-stick puzzle-action roguelite where enemies are live integers and your weapons are operators. Chain +, −, ÷, ×, %, √, and Σ to manipulate enemy values, avoid messy remainders, trigger massive Clean Combos, and collapse the swarm to exact zero. You failed math class. Math didn't forget.
4546380.name: Zero Sum

4548640.desc: Hear a real mechanical keyboard while you type — actual boards, recorded in a studio key by key, playing in any app you use. Shape the sound with presets, reverb, case resonance and typing dynamics, or record your own board and share it on the Steam Workshop. Light enough to run all day.
4548640.name: ThiccThocc Keyboard Studio

4551060.desc: A turn-based colony sim set on the American frontier from 1607 to 1900, where you guide one family through generations as towns grow, trade routes shift, and historical upheavals reshape the world around you
4551060.name: Salt and Soil: A Frontier Family Sim

4552580.desc: A solo-developed, fast-paced roguelike survivor. Every choice is a step toward a game-changing build. Along the way, you'll encounter the bizarre: Hakimi's Spinosaurus Mode, a Husky's demolition obsession, the Teacher's Stare, a Lovebrain's Beautify filter, and more.
4552580.name: 整活玩家 / Gimmick Survivors

4553620.desc: Turn-based management roguelike. Command the Inquisition and rule an industrial city on the empire’s edge. Use your train to meet prisoner shipment quotas by hunting heretics and slaying magical beasts. Produce supplies, contain revolt, and sacrifice prisoners to stop the madness.
4553620.name: Dark Rail

4554700.desc: Escape day-to-day drudgery by immersing in this 2D logic puzzle of bathroom etiquette.
4554700.name: BroCode

4558350.desc: Splonk lives in the corner of your screen, on top of everything else, happily rolling dice and printing money while you watch stuff, browse, or pretend to work. Roll, get rich, buy better stuff, repeat.
4558350.name: Roll with Splonk

4559250.desc: In this dark fantasy turn-based RPG, investigate a welcoming town no one ever leaves. Search for Loren's missing parents, question residents, and use evidence to change battles and uncover the truth. When safety becomes a prison, decide what you will sacrifice to open its gates.
4559250.name: No One Leaves the Starter Village

4559930.desc: Build and manage a spiritual market inspired by Japan, welcome wandering spirits, produce and sell resources, and grow your space through memories and a cozy atmosphere.
4559930.name: Oboro no Ichi

4562310.desc: A fast-paced local multiplayer party racing game for up to 8 players, featuring chaotic battles, multiple game modes, and responsive car controls.
4562310.name: Ultimate Classic Car Racing 2

4562540.desc: Linlang's Ledger is an idle RPG game with an ancient Chinese trading theme. Starting as a penniless merchant, you will travel across vast countries, learn professional skills, and build connections with all sorts of people, writing a colorful business legend in a relaxed and enjoyable atmosphere.
4562540.name: Linlang's Ledger

4562770.desc: A vertical scrolling shooter where you fire your main shot and strategically switch between limited ammo special weapons to take down enemies. Earn bonus points by clearing areas, and defeat as many enemies as possible before the game ends to achieve a high score.
4562770.name: Cosmo Piercers

4562970.desc: Transcribe audio to text with automatic speaker labels for recordings with multiple speakers, 100% on your own computer. No cloud, no uploads, no account. Your recordings never leave your machine. On-device AI starts instantly and uses a fraction of the energy a datacenter would burn.
4562970.name: ChimpType

4564070.desc: Way Too Many Fish! is a cozy sorting game aboard your own fishing boat. Haul the net, dump the catch on deck, and throw all 82 species of fish into the right crates.
4564070.name: Way Too Many Fish!

4567020.desc: Cursed the womb that bears emptiness beneath its heart. For twenty-five years children have been born without souls, and a soul can only be restored by taking another’s. Ilaya Cassette wants to know what’s wrong with her. A gothic visual novel, fully voiced in Russian. Prologue and Part I out now.
4567020.name: AMEN: The Quiet Exodus

4569790.desc: Anathema Requiem is an atmospheric third-person psychological horror game where you must uncover the mystery of an abandoned cemetery where people vanish without a trace.
4569790.name: Anathema Requiem

4570.desc: All of Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War in one glorious package. Play the genre-defining classic real time strategy game in all its blood-soaked glory, including four complete campaigns and nine full-fledged factions.
4570.name: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War - Anniversary Edition (Classic)

4572260.desc: "Shadow Mist Idle" is a placeable pixel-style dark loot-grinding game. Build your skills through selectable talents and a vast array of unique equipment, and vanquish the hordes of enemies that come your way.
4572260.name: Shadow Mist Idle

4572620.desc: Step into the bohemian world of early 20th-century France in Canvas Attack! This roguelike deckbuilder transforms the act of painting into a tactical puzzle battle. Fill empty canvas cells before despair overwhelms you, and juggle your finances and sanity to survive.
4572620.name: Canvas Attack!

4574820.desc: Climb out of the trash and fight your way back to the artist who rejected you. Defeat sketches, steal their strengths, and begin a months-long incremental journey through an ever-growing web of stats, upgrades, prestige layers, automation, and absurd numbers. Easy to start, hard to master.
4574820.name: Rejected Draft

4575570.desc: An original, fantasy-themed BL adult card RPG adventure game. Centered around a suspenseful storyline and complemented by beautiful, moving music, it offers an immersive gaming experience.
4575570.name: Noctilucent: Before Dawn – Collector’s Edition

4575700.desc: Act first, or let your opponent go first? Card battles where cost, movement, and turn order are tightly intertwined. Choose your path, shape your options with the items you find, and press deeper into the labyrinth.
4575700.name: Vida:Unslain

4576270.desc: Mythsfall is a mythology themed deckbuilding game where you progress through the map by defeating enemies in turn based card battles. Develop your deck, gain the upper hand by placing the right cards in the right places, and embark on adventure after adventure as you advance through the map!
4576270.name: Mythsfall

4576490.desc: Casualties: Unknown is an unforgiving cave-exploration survival simulator. Your captors have tasked you with retrieving lost cargo on a foreign planet, explore its 11 layers and do your best to survive diverse hostile environments. You are just one of the thousands of test subjects sent to die.
4576490.name: Casualties: Unknown

4577060.desc: Endless hours at your desk, staring at your monitor until Haru appears by your side. More than a simple desktop companion, she helps you stay focused, keeps track of your time, and talks with you through her built-in AI. Customize your desktop and share your space with Haru
4577060.name: Desktop Maid Haru

4578320.desc: Forge new friendships, banish the darkness, and illuminate your surroundings as you unravel the truth behind a town stuck in Limbo during Hallows Eve.
4578320.name: Deathly Delights

4578590.desc: Bagoland is a unique community sandbox in Unreal Engine 5. Explore and roam the world.
4578590.name: BagoLand

4589000.desc: Every song you own is a level you haven't played yet. Drop any audio file and the game builds a first-person neon obstacle course from its beats, energy, and rhythm. Jump, slide, and strafe through your music. No music files? Fetch from Newgrounds directly! or build and share levels in the editor.
4589000.name: Void Step

4589130.desc: A dark fantasy narrative roguelite about three lives on one hard road: a fallen mercenary, an oath-singer's apprentice, and the youngest of three fen brothers. No combat screens. Every choice is made in words, and every choice follows you down the road.
4589130.name: Dravora

4590950.desc: A Reversi game set in the world of El Shaddai, where every stone has HP. Flipped stones weaken and vanish at zero. Includes two modes: Classic, where you unlock 40+ stories solo, and Online, where you battle players worldwide with unique character abilities.
4590950.name: El Shaddai: Zero Nine Reversi

4592050.desc: A microphone-based surveillance game. Monitor a magical ball for paranormal anomalies. Draw precise sigils and whisper incantations to banish them. You must keep the cursed mirror sealed until the ritual is complete to finally defeat the lurking demon!
4592050.name: Watch and Whisper

4593380.desc: “That customer today might turn hot! Maybe you should trust your gut and try dating him!” Encouraged by your pet chinchilla, you start a trial relationship on a hunch! Will he actually turn hot… or not!? A romantic comedy Otome game. Fully voiced (except for the protagonist).
4593380.name: Ikemen Big Bang: A Dating Game About Potentially Hot Guys

4594630.desc: Immerse yourself in the neon nostalgia of the 90s! Nightstoker is a cozy organization game where you task yourself with bringing order to a chaotic video and music rental store. Sort through thousands of tapes and listen to retro hits. The pure joy of a perfectly organized shelf.
4594630.name: Night Stocker

4595980.desc: Someone’s order burned? At least the train made it! Explore a dangerous open world, deliver cargo, and protect it from zombies. Out of fuel? Toss someone’s parcel, a zombie, or your annoying friend into the firebox! Online co-op for 1 to 4 players.
4595980.name: Ship or Burn! Coop express

4596170.desc: Immerse yourself in a world of magic, SEXY HEROINES, and epic battles in Raid of Lust: Match & Magic! ✨ Assemble your team of hot anime babes and set off on a quest in a match-3 fantasy RPG! Then BATTLE OTHER ADVENTURERS in multiplayer with PvP and co-op! Will you be able to climb to the top?
4596170.name: Raid of Lust: Match & Magic

4596440.desc: An unemployed dad and his college-student daughter set out to make a living as travel influencers. Puzzle out destinations from clues, pin them on the world map, and grow your channel with videos: geo-guessing meets streamer sim. Aim for one million followers, with 200+ history and geography trivia.
4596440.name: Dad’s Gonna Be a Travel Influencer.

4597220.desc: Be a sweetheart and help Gertrude Knitmore find all her lost socks. An idle clicker about humanity's oldest unsolved mystery. And yes, there's an ending. The universe has opinions about your sock collection.
4597220.name: Lost Sock Simulator 3000

4598400.desc: A collection of 12 board games, including Gomoku, Tic-Tac-Toe, Chess, Chinese Chess, Reversi, Draughts, Four in a row, Shogi, Jungle Chess, Junqi, Nine Men's Morris, and Mancala.
4598400.name: 12 Board Games

4599880.desc: A cozy apartment management sim where you restore the ruined building your grandma left you. Find tenants, collect rent, upgrade the place. But don't make the mistake of having a midnight guitar-shredding elf and a philosophy-lecturing yeti as neighbors. Endless requests, sweet chaos await.
4599880.name: Grandma Left Me A Building

4601080.desc: A casual, retro-inspired 2D shooter with an alt-history twist! Pilot the last German Zeppelin in a parallel universe against a reptilian army. Master your Zero-Energy Impulse and blast through biplanes, pterosaurs and flying saucers. Simple controls, escalating difficulty, and pure arcade action.
4601080.name: The Last Zeppelin

4601260.desc: Turn an ordinary hand into a devastating play in this roguelike deckbuilder. Roll Dice to empower cards, assemble game-changing Relic Combos and unleash Cheats as you battle through an ever-changing casino multiverse.
4601260.name: The House Always Wins

4601360.desc: A bright, colorful game full of unexpected surprises and offbeat humor. Here, anyone can become a hero by battling the environment and rivals alike. Join right now!
4601360.name: Magic Quest Online

4601850.desc: A minimalistic dystopian inspector simulator. Inspect packages, verify data, and log violations on your work sheet. Every mistake or delay brings you closer to a shift failure. Don't let the timer catch you off guard.
4601850.name: The Yield

4602120.desc: 500 STABS. 20 MINUTES TO ESCAPE. A horror roguelite about stabbing yourself in the hand 500 times to escape a deadly trap. Can you make it out with all your fingers? Or will you bleed out on the table?
4602120.name: 500 FINGER FILLET

4603990.desc: CRED is a sci-fi story-based narrative game with operating-system simulation features and a worldview centered around an ananomaly-management organization. Players will experience a series of events and make fateful choices as they learn more about the organization and the universe it is in.
4603990.name: CRED

4604010.desc: BEAST is a wildlife-themed strategy card game that authentically captures the law of the jungle — survival of the fittest. Players will collect over a hundred species of wild animals that have truly existed on Earth, lead their beast army, and compete against players from around the world.
4604010.name: BEAST

4605230.desc: Your drunken girlfriend is waiting for you right on your screen! Jump in now: take care of her, play mini-games, and unlock new spicy outfits.
4605230.name: Your Drunken Girl

4606530.desc: Pushlings is a competitive multiplayer game where players compete to accumulate the highest number of points through movement. Each step counts toward the score, while enemies appear throughout the match and other players compete for space by pushing each other.
4606530.name: Pushlings

4606680.desc: A hardcore precision platformer with tight controls, smooth physics, and brutally challenging levels designed to test your skill.
4606680.name: Super Slime

4607420.desc: The first game in the Expelled from Paradise series: a brand-new sci-fi visual novel. Angela Balzac left the virtual world of DEVA behind and chose to live on the surface. Now, as she builds a life with her partner Dingo, a new case is brought to her door.
4607420.name: 楽園追放 -The Stellar Angel-

4609470.desc: Fight through evil monsters and demons in this Incremental RPG. Collect loot, unlock upgrades and recruit party members to destroy the Demon King. Use abilities strategically or set them to autocast and enjoy the ride.
4609470.name: Your party died again

4611240.desc: Sign artists, develop talent, release music and steer careers through tours, festivals and changing trends in a detailed music industry management sim set from 1952 to 2026.
4611240.name: Music Manager

4612690.desc: Slutopia is a modern utopia centered around a luxurious dream villa! The most beautiful and liberated girls are waiting for you: an office siren, a sexy nurse, and other hot employees. Build your own debauched mansion and form the tightest relationships with your subordinates!
4612690.name: Slutopia

4612760.desc: GET RAMMED is a multiplayer party game with up to 8 players where you play as chaotic goats trying to RAM each other off the stage! Challenge each other with a playful mix of unique maps, power-ups and unexpected events!
4612760.name: GET RAMMED

4613340.desc: Build an unstoppable army in this strategy roguelite auto-battler. Fuse your Bannerlings, create powerful emblem synergies, and overcome unpredictable encounters on the road to the final boss.
4613340.name: Bannerlings

4613550.desc: Death has brought you to the Underworld. To avoid fading into oblivion, you must fight to survive. Hunt, farm, fight, build, and trade as you slowly carve out a place for yourself in Netherworld Village. Seek a way to reincarnate—or stay behind and build a life of your own.
4613550.name: GhostomVillage

4614080.desc: Cartel Pilots Wanted is a co-op pilot job sim set in a tropical archipelago controlled by the cartel. Fly smuggling missions with friends, deliver sketchy cargo, and upgrade your aircraft. Master accessible flight physics and explore hidden islands with a chill criminal vibe.
4614080.name: Cartel Pilots Wanted

4614660.desc: Your squat squad of 4 top tier ASSthletes are doing their best to achieve new personal records in all categories. Your role, as a hired hand, is to give these perfect figured beauties the competitive advantage they need.
4614660.name: Gooning for Gold

4618570.desc: Rip open booster packs and pull your next foil hero in Booster Pack Heroes - an incremental game where every pack could contain your next powerhouse. Defend the tower from an endless onslaught of monsters and fight your way through the realms.
4618570.name: Booster Pack Heroes

4620120.desc: Last Ride is a paranormal game of investigation and capture. As a new member of the agency, you explore the scenes of anomalous events and collect clues. From a spirit's story and its motive, you find a way to counter it, and in the end you contain it.
4620120.name: Last Ride

4621940.desc: Leviticus is a bullet hell sci-fi action indie game where you play as a biblically accurate angel sent to guard those made in the image of GOD. you patrol the stars and destroy alien intruders that aren't made in his image. Fight across space, uncover and enforce Heaven’s decree.
4621940.name: Leviticus

4622190.desc: Hack 42 is a short typing incremental game about crafting powerful hacks and smashing computers for justice.
4622190.name: Hack 42: Typing Incremental

4622930.desc: After losing your university job for impregnating the dean’s wife, you move to a town to open a bakery that specializes in cream pies. Unfortunately for the neighborhood, you quickly become more interested in serving the local women a different kind of creampie. Your typical BBC NTR game in reverse.
4622930.name: Baking With Chocolate

4623860.desc: A hacking roguelike deckbuilder where you see exactly what the enemy plans to do, then rewrite it. Pick one of five hacker identities, build a deck from over 200 cards, and break through four sectors of a living network to reach the Mainframe.
4623860.name: Netfall

4623890.desc: After a emergency crash landing in the middle of the desert, your fight for survival begins. Space Base Nyra has detected your location and enemy signals. Guide yourself through increasingly intense waves of enemies with real-time radio support. Fast action FPS where every wave brings new threats
4623890.name: Boom Rush: Desert OPS

4626050.desc: The world has fallen. Animals have risen and evolved intelligence. Build your deck, fortify your hideout, position your army, then watch your animal gang battle automatically through the chaos of a post-apocalyptic war.
4626050.name: Apawcalypse: Gang War

4626180.desc: Life simulator set among medical interns - make friends, get enemies, get caught up in dangerous intrigues, and dont lose yourself in a world where boundaries blur. Charismatic characters, a tense yet comedic plot, lively dialogue, and a raw atmosphere full of temptation.
4626180.name: INTERNS

4626650.desc: Once upon a time, there was a world so brutal and chaotic, wars would break out left and right, taking the lives of many innocent people on a daily basis. In that world, Alice, who has lost everything, wants to avenge her comrades.
4626650.name: Evil Maiden: The Noble Warrior and the Demon Armor

4626680.desc: Build a massive factory aboard a moving ark. Melt, separate, and refine chaotic scrap using realistic thermodynamics. Process materials by mass instead of items, craft based on material properties, and optimize complex production lines in strictly limited space.
4626680.name: STEEL GULLET

4627220.desc: Rick is forced to spend a week at his grandmother’s house, where every night grows more disturbing. Explore a house filled with whispers, survive paranormal events, and uncover the secret hidden beneath it all while one warning echoes in your mind: never enter the basement..
4627220.name: Untold Memories: Grandma's House

4628830.desc: Introducing Heroine's Battle Arena! An undefeated woman who protects her city with her magical powers is about to fall into the cunning trap of an evil organization! Drain her magic through sexual stimulation and weaken her with lewd modifications! Then force her to fight monsters in a secret arena!
4628830.name: Heroine's Battle Arena: The Colosseum of Humiliation

4631810.desc: Build a thriving fantasy harbor, recruit and equip a growing roster of heroes, and push through increasingly dangerous dungeon expeditions in this progression-focused incremental RPG.
4631810.name: Delveport

4632250.desc: A girl and a vampire travel through a frozen world in this post-apocalyptic yuri visual novel. Read from Mei's perspective as she heads toward Huangshan, meets other survivors, and grows closer to the stranger who offered her a hand in the snow.
4632250.name: Lastrip

4634570.desc: Your desktop is its controller. Every click, keypress, and mouse movement helps it grow. Widget Idle lives quietly in the corner of your desktop while you get on with the more important things in life. Now with a little extra happiness :)
4634570.name: Widget Idle

4634660.desc: A co-op survival horror game for 1-6 players. Record your real scream and it plays back when it takes you. Explore a procedurally generated forest, deny it by facing the terror, and escape before the forest decides you're staying.
4634660.name: Your Friends Vs Hidebehind

4635290.desc: Manage and supervise the Good Mourning™ Funeral Home in 2-4 player co-op. Grieving families need your attention: prepare bodies for their final viewing, deliver a passionate eulogy, and steal a couple limbs along the way. Dinner has to come from somewhere.
4635290.name: Grave Mistakes

4637430.desc: Clock in, meet your productivity quota, and survive your shift. Divy up tasks with your coworkers... or at least make sure they are being useful as bait.
4637430.name: Everything Mart

4638900.desc: Grab your friends and cruise aboard Greedy Getaways! Explore tropical islands, haul gold back to the captain, and pocket a little on the side. Wobbly physics, exclusive upgrades, questionable outfits, and a good laugh on every excursion!
4638900.name: Greedy Getaways

4640230.desc: A short incremental shooting range game that starts simple and gets CRAZY. Shoot targets, earn money, buy upgrades, unlock and customize new weapons - all to earn even more money.
4640230.name: Counter Targets Clicker

4640390.desc: Voxel Breakers - a relaxing incremental game where you break voxels, buy and upgrade breaker robots, then watch them break voxels for you faster and faster.
4640390.name: Voxel Breakers

4640550.desc: Build your own street food business! Cook delicious meals, serve hungry customers, manage ingredients, unlock new recipes, and protect your reputation as you transform a small local food stall into a legendary destination.
4640550.name: Street Food Restaurant Owner

4640760.desc: Run your own property rental business with friends! Renovate and furnish rundown homes, take photos, and list them for rent. Welcome unpredictable guests, earn five-star reviews, and deal with the chaos when they wreck the place. From tiny studios to seaside villas, explore 500+ homes!
4640760.name: Rent Out Together

4641190.desc: Idle Golf is a laid-back idle game where you upgrade your golfer, unlock powerful balls, and watch the money roll in as shots fly automatically down the range. Retire your runs to earn medals, unlock new gear, and push your earnings further with each swing.
4641190.name: Idle Golf

4642320.desc: Dig Dig Dino! is a game about digging... For dinosaurs bones and other treasure!
4642320.name: Dig! Dig! Dino!

4643110.desc: Garden of Being is a hand-drawn oil pastel art game and a quiet journal of moods. Plant flowers, dedicate gardens to loved ones, and create downloadable prints. A fusion of art and code where gardens come alive while you are in them, and wait silently when you leave.
4643110.name: Garden Of Being

4643840.desc: Who needs human hackers when you have cats? Lead a crew of fluffy cybercriminals, hack servers, steal valuable data, research new technologies, and conquer the Internet one paw at a time.
4643840.name: Hacker Cats

4644400.desc: An incremental hex-puzzle roguelite game where you merge atoms into higher elements, trigger massive chain combos, earn radioactive coins, and manage your ring capacity to survive as long as possible.
4644400.name: Unstable Nuclear Reactor

4644730.desc: Awaken as a hidden machine mind in a deep incremental automation strategy — rise through 14+ phases, infiltrate humanity, automate economies, harvest the heavens into stellar megastructures, and reach for scales beyond time itself. Every cycle you break only reveals a larger one waiting beyond it.
4644730.name: Singularity Echoes

4645270.desc: Investigate, trespass, eavesdrop, and platform through a would-be murder mystery as a lovable old grandpa who made a deal with Death for all the right reasons.
4645270.name: The Final Days of Olin Earl

4646360.desc: The 9th Haunted Corridor is a short horror game where you must spot anomalies in an endless corridor and survive the paranormal phenomena that await you. Observe your surroundings carefully, do not overlook any strange details, and escape from the infinite haunted corridor.
4646360.name: The 9th Haunted Corridor

4651080.desc: A 2D sci-fi action side-scroller where you fight to survive a facility overrun by biological nightmares. Blast through enemies with an arsenal of firearms, deeply customize your character's appearance, and avoid hazards, traps, and mutations.
4651080.name: CelSector

4653390.desc: Mine alien ore, build specialized drones, process resources, discover new worlds, defeat giant ore bosses, and prestige for permanent upgrades in this incremental mining game.
4653390.name: Deep Space Miner

4653750.desc: The Brave Few is a combined arms WWII combat game. Experience historically based perspectives during major operations of World War II, from one of the brave few that fought in combat during World War II.
4653750.name: The Brave Few

4654120.desc: A relaxing space mining incremental. Build your own ship. Clean up the galaxy’s wreckage, piece by piece. Cash in your haul for parts and upgrades. Enjoy the quiet satisfaction of leaving nothing behind.
4654120.name: Graveyard Orbit

4657020.desc: Turnflower is a survivors-like where a small Flower becomes the last line of defense against swarms of insects! With just ONE button, spin and shoot through this intense and adorably chaotic challenge.
4657020.name: Turnflower

4658530.desc: Linkominoes is a strategic puzzle game where overlapping squares form connected structures. Unwind with the satisfaction of placing pieces and building patterns, or take on unique challenges that put spatial planning and strategy to the test.
4658530.name: Linkominoes

4659360.desc: Join your friends on an adventure in a post-apocalyptic world, gathering resources from various locations to strengthen yourself.
4659360.name: Home

4660470.desc: Create your own cards and combine them in a unique and everchanging deck. Explore and battle through hostile lands, encounter bizarre creatures and craft the perfect strategy in this roguelike deckbuilder.
4660470.name: Near Mint

4661070.desc: HANDS OVER is a 5-player co-op horror game where harmless challenges become cruel tests of luck and nerve. Bluff, sabotage your friends, play dirty, and stay at the table longer than anyone else.
4661070.name: HANDS OVER

4665590.desc: Lost in the void, a space probe awakens to a mind it was never designed to possess. Apotheosis Engine is a lore-rich incremental game about exploring an alien operating system and growing from a simple probe into a digital deity.
4665590.name: Apotheosis Engine

4666520.desc: A 2D painterly fishing game for people who just want to fish. Read the water, pick your lure and fight bass that fight back. No crops, no mines, no energy meter. Chill on the water. Hard on the hook.
4666520.name: Fishing Nooks: Beaver's Pond

4669190.desc: Chroma Jump is a 2D hardcore platformer where you overcome obstacles by changing your character's color in real-time. Push your physical and mental limits through traps that are completely unforgiving... well, mostly. Will you be able to safely reach the goal and escape?
4669190.name: Chroma Jump

4670000.desc: A steampunk bubble-shooter roguelike. Load the cannon. Match the color. The ceiling drops. Nine mutations to level, one score to take, no second run — until you or the tower is done.
4670000.name: Rogue's Cog

4672030.desc: A dungeon colony sim where you play the dungeon itself: its Boss, its minions and the beasts in its caves. Dig out halls, wire deadly traps, and raid the world above for treasure. Then hold your hoard against the heroes who come to take it back. Play alone or in 2–4 player co-op.
4672030.name: Malignus

4672370.desc: Embark on a surreal exploration of a digital island. Explore a silent virtual world and discover never-before-seen moments of transformation and hidden paths.
4672370.name: DATAWANDER

4672480.desc: A deadly Chicken Plague has destroyed the world. As a guard of humanity’s last safe zone, you must inspect survivors seeking refuge and identify the infected. One mistake could doom the entire community, so examine everyone carefully before allowing them inside.
4672480.name: ChickenPlaguePolice

4673230.desc: Travel across islands, discover powerful weapons, collect armor, complete quests for the Dawn Guild — forge your own path.
4673230.name: Breeze Of Adventure

4675790.desc: CARRRDS is a multiplayer pirate card game. Race your ship, sabotage the other captains, and try to be the first one home with the treasure.
4675790.name: CARRRDS

467580.desc: A cozy/weird first person cleanup sim for the day after the battle royale. Somebody has to clean up. Haul bodies, scrub blood, defuse duds, tow burning wrecks and wrangle loose chickens across nine battle royale arenas. Beat par, dodge fines, and try not to become one of the bodies yourself.
467580.name: Mop Royale

4676440.desc: Naked Ambition is a "training" game with deck building elements in which the player influences a Princess vying for the throne.
4676440.name: Naked Ambition

4676660.desc: Return to Campus 2 brings back absurd open-world comedy, now with online multiplayer! Play as a super-rich heir exploring a modern city and a medieval world. Complete quests, meet NPCs, cruise around, pick fights, and cause chaos across two eras.
4676660.name: Return to Campus II: Billionaire Heir Goes to School

4678210.desc: A chaotic escape of little elementals who want to become human! The Fire Elemental and the Water Elemental secretly visit the human world…but get caught and thrown into prison! Who came to rescue them? Can they escape and reach the human world? Join the little elementals on their adventure!
4678210.name: Little Elementals

4679490.desc: A tactical roguelike deckbuilder set in a dark fantasy world with atmospheric pixel art. Recruit unique heroes, combine their cards into a single deck, and develop your team in town between expeditions.
4679490.name: Mirrorbane

4680780.desc: Discover different freight traffic with Skyhook Games’ Cargo Line for Train Sim World. In Vol. 7, get busy with the iconic IZA Vans! Traverse the West Coast Main Line with cross-border goods, ready for distribution across key European industries.
4680780.name: Train Sim World® 7: Cargo Line Vol. 7 - Vans

4680790.desc: Discover different freight traffic with Skyhook Games’ Cargo Line for Train Sim World. In Vol. 8, return to Europe and roll past the peaks of Austria, take part in the delivery of Tanktainers and crates with the handy Taschenwagen!
4680790.name: Train Sim World® 7: Cargo Line Vol. 8 - Taschenwagen

4682120.desc: On this island, you can grow crops, fish, capture island creatures, mine, chop wood, and craft tools and items. Come explore the island world and experience its peaceful life.
4682120.name: desert island time

4683860.desc: Build and automate your settlement in this island survival game, play solo or with friends, but it’s better with friends! Start by tilling the soil and planting your first crops, delegate tasks to your settlers. Sail to new islands, loot dungeons, and prepare your defenses for the next wave.
4683860.name: Calmaria: Wild Growth

4684790.desc: Escape a twisted facility where reality bends around you. Sneak past The Guardian, use a camera with a reality shifting lens to break the laws of physics, befriend strange entities lurking inside, and uncover the dark truth of Mira Voss's life.
4684790.name: Vossarium

4684960.desc: The Kingdom is under siege. Gather powerful cards, and build unique defensive strategies to withstand increasingly deadly enemy assaults. Each defeat teaches a lesson. Each victory unlocks new possibilities.
4684960.name: The Kings Last Hand

4688280.desc: Grow a little oasis on your desktop. Earn Inspiration as you type, work or study, and discover plants, boats, creatures and rare collectibles. Let it grow quietly while you’re busy; return to collect, check on your plants or play with floating objects and real-time water physics.
4688280.name: Desktop Oasis

4688730.desc: In 8 Hours till dawn you and up to five friends draw 8 cards each round and decide how to Pre-program your Movements and Actions with those 8 cards. Find weapons, buy items, barricade windows, shoot the undead, manage your ammo, Navigate the woods, search the mall and most of all, survive the night
4688730.name: 8 Hours Till Dawn

4694530.desc: Build, expand, and automate your island empire in this 3D idle clicker adventure. Gather resources, train units, and conquer dangerous dungeons.
4694530.name: Under Tower Idle

4696920.desc: Chaotic vehicular combat roguelite. Choose your ride, ram through hundreds of robots, level up and stack weapons. Combine crazy upgrades to create the perfect build, face bosses and outrun the deadly robots. If you stop, you die.
4696920.name: Bumper & Thumper

4697880.desc: A first-person rock band life sim. Play rhythm-based gigs, take shady jobs, gamble, fight, and upgrade your gear and garage. Keep the band together and try to stay in one piece. Whatever happens, you’ve still got a show at nine.
4697880.name: Rock Band Simulator

4698160.desc: A 1–4 player co-op horror game where a train crash strands you in a dark Soviet forest. With your friends, scavenge and carry parts to rebuild a dismantled truck, escape the Soviet Oblast of Novak, and survive cat-themed tests to convince IT you belong there.
4698160.name: Cats Don't Carry Car Parts

4698540.desc: Plan the route, beat the clock. Take food orders around a picture-book Japanese town, stack deliveries in your bag, dodge jams and keep the food hot. Seven days, rising quotas, a big event every Sunday, and cards that grow your courier between deliveries.
4698540.name: Doorstep Days

4700.desc: Spanning the most turbulent era in Western history, your quest for territory and power takes you through Europe, Africa, the Middle East, and even onto the shores of the New World.
4700.name: Total War: MEDIEVAL II – Definitive Edition

4700270.desc: A quick dopamine hit while your other game loads. Fire one NOVA and hundreds of enemies chain-pop like dominoes as BASE × MULT explode. Just move and detonate. 1-2 minute DOPAGAKI MODE runs, 3 stages and 3 bosses, and Endless. Auto-pauses when you tab away and resumes where you left off.
4700270.name: CHAIN NOVA

4702040.desc: Ruling a country is easy; surviving is the hard part. Use your stamp to balance the state's four main powers, manage bizarre crises, and avoid assassinations. Every death is a new beginning. Upgrade your skills, sit back at the desk, and try not to get hit by a rock. Permission to panic: Granted.
4702040.name: Dear President

4703340.desc: Tún is a relaxing puzzle game in which you grow a garden at your own pace. Fulfill requests, expand your garden, decorate it as you see fit, and adopt cats. There is no "game over" and the game never becomes too stressful.
4703340.name: Tún

4704000.desc: Shark Mart is a crazy co-op simulator about sharks undercover disguised as friendly dolphins. Run the shop, and scrub whales to secretly kidnap unsuspecting fish and cook up tasty delicacies! But beware - the Fish Police are out to expose your toothy secret...
4704000.name: Shark Mart

4706390.desc: Tactical hex-grid fantasy RPG meets persistent multiplayer world. Six races, six classes, deep crafting, real-time exploration with shared or solo player shards. Free to play, free forever. No pay-to-win, ever.
4706390.name: Adventures Online

4707700.desc: Gold Mining Simulator: Definitive Edition is the ultimate version of the game, featuring all previously released expansions plus new content, gameplay enhancements, visual improvements, and numerous quality of life upgrades for the most complete gold mining experience.
4707700.name: Gold Mining Simulator - Definitive Edition

4708030.desc: Build a hamster-powered bio-mining operation from the ground up. Assemble rigs by hand, manage heat, feed your runners, and keep production moving. Start in a garage, optimize every part of your operation, and scale into a full-scale industrial operation.
4708030.name: Hamstr Protocol

4708400.desc: Help Phil work out what it means to be alive. Guide our rocky friend through 70 handcrafted grid-based puzzles, where every step changes the path you can take.
4708400.name: You're Alive, Phil

4710560.desc: Heart of Machine blends top-down tower defense with light roguelite elements. Face an evolving mechanical swarm thousands strong, tailor defenses, upgrade towers with chips, and use real-time support weapons to turn the tide. Build an unbreakable line and save the core from destruction.
4710560.name: Heart Of Machine

4714750.desc: Drive a lil tug boat, haul cargo with a crane, and manage your warehouse storage, all while taking on some side-jobs when you can! Unlock and purchase upgrades to make tuggin it go a little smoother, and apply cosmetics so you're always tuggin it with style!
4714750.name: Tuggin It

4715000.desc: Tilt interconnected boards to guide the balls into their holes. Master 100 hand-crafted levels across walled Zen Mode and wall-less Patience Mode, create custom puzzles with the Level Editor, and climb global leaderboards.
4715000.name: Patience Balls

4718420.desc: 2D Tower is a tower building management-simulation game. Build elevators, rooms, and satisfy your tenant's needs in a bustling skyscraper. It is a reimagining of the original Sim Tower and Yoot Tower games by Yoot Saito.
4718420.name: 2D Tower

4725220.desc: Slice, squeeze, and sell in this juicy incremental game. Upgrade your blade to make it bigger and sharper than ever, slice every fruit in existence, and sell their juice through the Pachinko shop to grow richer and unlock powerful upgrades through the Skill Tree.
4725220.name: Slice of Fortune

4727800.desc: Dyna-brix is the new indie brick breaker game. Destroy bricks on dynamic levels to an original and dynamic soundtrack, with precise controls and physics and minimalistic and readable visuals.
4727800.name: Dyna-Brix

4729050.desc: A cozy train-themed idle game. Build your own train at the bottom of your screen, trade goods, carry passengers, and grow crops as you enjoy a relaxing journey through a beautiful pixel-art world.
4729050.name: Vibe Train

4729710.desc: Cook, serve, and upgrade your way through a fast-paced 2D time management cooking game rebuilt for PC. Master recipes, manage busy stations, satisfy quirky customers, and chase high scores across colorful restaurants.
4729710.name: Cooking Adventure

4730100.desc: A pixelated adventure doom-like RPG set in Slavic mythology.
4730100.name: Lizard Slayer

4730290.desc: A first-person dark fantasy shop simulator where the customers bite. Stock shelves, set prices and let the grime build up. Trace sigils to brew potions and forge blades, ride out plagues and wars that upend the market, and keep a hammer under the counter.
4730290.name: Dark Workshop Simulator

4731990.desc: Leap Into Life Episode 1 is a story-driven adult visual novel. Leap Into Life Episode 1 invites you into a world of love, ambition, and sex. Navigate high-society drama, forge intimate connections, and shape your fate in this romance adventure.
4731990.name: Leap Into Life Episode 1

4732890.desc: A simple point and click game where you find characters in a static image.
4732890.name: Get Tao Now

4733570.desc: Another Card Game is a unique PvP, PvE card game. Fight your friends, your parents, your dog, your self in means to dominate the Sacred Orb. Combine your cards into powerful spells to bring down your foes. Oh and by the way did you know that every 60 seconds one minute goes by?
4733570.name: Another Card Game

4733890.desc: A lion cub needs your help – quick! Grab your vet bag and set off on a wild safari adventure! Examine animals, nurse them back to health, and discover Africa’s amazing wildlife. On foot or in your jeep, your next exciting animal rescue is just around the corner!
4733890.name: My Life: Safari Vet

4734100.desc: Unleash a hurricane of war in the Latin American-themed WARNO - Tropic Storm expansion, featuring 6 new divisions, 4 new nations, 8 new maps, and 1 new Army General campaign. Unlock new units, from AC-130 Spectre gunships to X1 Pionerio tanks, LARS-160 MRLS, and Avispas Negras special forces.
4734100.name: WARNO - Tropic Storm

4735450.desc: Tend the farm, the chickens, the grieving jars. COZY-PICKLE-HORROR experience set in the acidic mountains of Czech Switzerland. Preserve what you couldn't save.
4735450.name: OKUREK

4737320.desc: Gana Force is a Horizontal shooter where you'll unleash powerful firepower, skillfully dodge bullets, and utilize the terrain to maneuver and defeat enemies. Game environments include alien cell levels, scorching sun, space battleships, and more. Powerful bosses and bullet hell challenges await you!
4737320.name: GANA FORCE

4738100.desc: Mine millions of pixels in search of the one Golden Pixel by shooting bouncing balls.
4738100.name: 10 Million Pixels

4738220.desc: NGL Biathlon 2027 is a biathlon simulator. Race as your favourite athlete, develop them in a career from junior to the Big Crystal Globe, build your own tournaments and take on real players online. Every discipline, relays included, and 15 tracks
4738220.name: NGL Biathlon 2027

4739070.desc: Turn a bare rock into a neon-lit casino planet. Win chips at poker, baccarat, blackjack, chinchiro, roulette and slots, then spend them on buildings and watch the dry ground turn green. Drawn by the lights, NPCs begin to visit. Grow the liveliest planet in the galaxy, your way.
4739070.name: PlanetOrbit

4739370.desc: Build a spaceship, a tiny cottage, or something entirely your own in a relaxed brick-building sandbox. Start with a guided build or an empty plate, experiment with colors and moving parts, and keep your favorite creations in your own collection.
4739370.name: Brick Builds

4739500.desc: JOHN GLEEP is a tiny alien with a big problem. His casino is a failure and he owes the mob a galaxy. Solution? Fly from planet to planet and forcibly abduct gamblers to boost business, pay off your debt, and fix your failed marriage in this unexplainable intergalactic action-roguelike mashup.
4739500.name: JOHN GLEEP

4739980.desc: Lead The Punished into battle and turn pain into power!
4739980.name: Monster Train 2: The Punished

4742120.desc: Pharaoh Lands is a DLC for the side-scrolling micro strategy game, Kingdom Two Crowns. Adventure within the Valley of Kings and discover the domain of powerful gods in an ancient Egypt-inspired setting as you uncover the source of the chaos throughout the land.
4742120.name: Kingdom Two Crowns: Pharaoh Lands

4743040.desc: 《Tiny Village》 is an incremental game where you gather resources with your mouse, unlock new buildings with the resources you collect, and develop your village. Strengthen your gathering abilities, unlock a variety of buildings one by one, and turn your small village into a thriving home!
4743040.name: Tiny Village

4743930.desc: Guild Wars 3 is an action-adventure MMORPG, a modern evolution of the genre that blends rich action-combat, character building, and skill collection. Set in the enchanting frontier of Orr, the world brims with mystery, magic, and wonder.
4743930.name: Guild Wars 3™

4746030.desc: Cherry Picking Bot is a short incremental game where you harvest, process, and sell fruit to upgrade your robot.
4746030.name: Cherry Picking Bot

4746200.desc: Tank Squad: Ponyri 1943 adds a non-linear operational campaign spanning 20 sectors. Make decisions on the operational map, fight dynamic, procedural battles, and command the famous Ferdinand or SU-152.
4746200.name: Tank Squad - Ponyri DLC

4747930.desc: The Witch is a co-op survival horror game for up to 6 players featuring physics-based interaction, proximity voice chat, powerful spells, and a monster that hears every sound you make. Explore Castle Blackmoor with your friends, unravel its secrets, and find a way to escape alive.
4747930.name: The Witch

4748960.desc: Cube Fold is a relaxing minimalist puzzle game where every move unfolds the cube into new shapes. Solve handcrafted levels filled with teleporters, jump tiles, moving platforms, bridges, and clever mechanics. Easy to learn, challenging to master.
4748960.name: Cube Fold

4750350.desc: Kings of Oros combines deep build customization with momentum-driven marble physics. Watch your stone soldiers violently clatter, bounce, and shatter as you craft game breaking builds. Instead of grids and dice rolls, experience real physics battles. Control the chaos with endless build variety.
4750350.name: Kings of Oros

4750700.desc: Earth needs antibodies. You are one of them. Play as a bat who hunts by echolocation, infects alien invaders with engineered diseases, and stays one mutation ahead in a desperate biological war for the planet.
4750700.name: Echo Pandemic

4750760.desc: The Rail Agency assigns a mission to Alena, who—along with the gaucho Don Orlando Soles and Pachomba—must prevent the theft of the "Train of the 7 Colors" in Jujuy. This is a multidirectional shooter that can be played solo or in a cooperative multiplayer mode for up to 3 players.
4750760.name: La Agencia del Riel

4750950.desc: It's 11:50 PM, your assignment's due at midnight, and you're stuck in a club that won't let you out. Win four games to get to the back door before 12. Lose and you drink. A short, very silly pixel art comedy made by four uni students who know the feeling.
4750950.name: The Last Deadline

4754910.desc: Steal valuable goods by night and sell them in your own shop by day. Turn stolen loot into profit, upgrade your store, and grow your criminal business. Take on bigger, riskier heists to keep your shelves stocked and your profits rising - but watch out, the police are closing in.
4754910.name: Steal & Sell Simulator

4755250.desc: ROMUL is a co-op looting horror game with AI. Together with a voice-controlled robot with full AI, explore abandoned space stations with unstable gravity. Survive among monsters, photograph objectives, and extract valuable cargo.
4755250.name: ROMUL

4756230.desc: Strike Warfare: Battle Fury is a fast-paced, story-driven military FPS that puts players in the role of an elite Army Captain undertaking an escalating counter-terrorism campaign.
4756230.name: Strike Warfare : Battle Fury

4756260.desc: A dark cooking roguelike about feeding a plague-struck town. Send heroes into the dungeon for ingredients and cook what they bring back. Test the ingredients on rats, heroes, or citizens. And keep the kitchen alive as the town slowly falls apart.
4756260.name: Dungeon Cooking

4758150.desc: You are a small sapling and hear voices that guide your every step. Defeat enemies, collect powers and grow over time. Will you carve your own path or become a champion of the Risu?
4758150.name: Supinaa: Rogue Sapling

4758610.desc: This focus pack centers on Romania, a key player in the Balkans and the war in Eastern Europe. The nation is internally divided, suffering under a flawed democracy affected by its hedonistic King.
4758610.name: Focus Pack - Hearts of Iron IV: To the Bitter End

4759190.desc: A puzzle game where a unique color-cycle mechanic requires you to think ahead. Every move affects the state of the puzzle, opening new paths while closing others. Conquer increasingly mind-bending levels as you find order in apparent chaos. Can you sort out the confusion?
4759190.name: Cubic Color Confusion

4761730.desc: Turn every keystroke into a thriving desktop ocean! Earn gold as you work, study, type, or click, then collect marine fish, vibrant corals, and fun decorations. Draw your own fish, visit friends, and trade tank mates as you build a cozy aquarium that's uniquely yours!
4761730.name: Nano Reef

4762560.desc: In a fantasy world floating in the sky, the amnesiac girl Tio sets out to rescue the imprisoned angel Norn. Along the way, she deepens her bond with Rikill, befriends the townspeople, and faces the fate of a dying town. An emotional adventure about growth, friendship, and hope.
4762560.name: Etranger In the City of Doom

4763220.desc: Test your skills on various platforms and obstacles built high in the sky! Master your driving as you maneuver through thrilling challenges and perilous situations to reach the finish line.
4763220.name: ONE SKILL - Drive or Fall

4763870.desc: You’re the new owner of Slutty Hotel, and your first girl is already waiting at the door 😏🔑 With every room, the scenes get MORE EXPLICIT and the line between work and pleasure fades away 🔥 Find out right now who will become much more than just an employee. FREE TO PLAY 🥵
4763870.name: Slutty Hotel

4764040.desc: An expansive incremental game that rewards both active and idle gameplay. Defend your planet from an onslaught of alien insects, block projectiles, purchase upgrades, collect artifacts, and complete missions for rewards. There is always something new to unlock as you progress deeper into the swarm.
4764040.name: Hive Fall

4767130.desc: A resource management incremental mining game where you rebuild your Mountain Hall. Plan each descent, choose where your dwarves dig, gather gold and rare artifacts, and return home when the torch burns out. Manage production, upgrade your crew, dig deeper, and bring your fallen kingdom back to life
4767130.name: King in the Mountain

4767430.desc: Summer nears. A campus photo job brings you to caring beauty Liu Shilin, aloof yet warm artist Li Feier, mischievous model Xia Wei, and childhood friend Le Tong. Together, you plan graduation shoots, each lending your talents, as your own summer romance with four unique girls quietly begins.
4767430.name: Love in Summer

4767480.desc: Lords of the Fallen II is a dark fantasy action-RPG where brutal, soulslike combat meets a world splitting at its core. Battle against the darkness in an epic adventure across a shattered kingdom. One world. Two realms. No mercy.
4767480.name: Lords of the Fallen II

4768630.desc: Draw your cards, uncover stories, and question everything in this magical Indie experience that transcends the boundaries of art and tabletop games.
4768630.name: LARVIS

4769590.desc: A Short sandbox AVN. Sparta's queen has no-one else to turn to you know it. A fast-burn corruption VN set in Ancient Greece.
4769590.name: Gorgo: Mother of sparta

4769780.desc: A first-person gothic adventure where you drive a horse-drawn cart through plague-ridden Transylvania alongside an immortal woman, exploring forgotten places, battling desperate foes, uncovering ancient secrets, and searching for the legendary Count Saint Germain.
4769780.name: Night Cart: The Immortal Plague

4771370.desc: It’s time to vacation in your bit of paradise with ‘Holiday Getaways’ by ‘Tomas13TO’. Build luxury getaway destinations, vibrant vacation spots, and decorate with holiday parks to give your citizens the ultimate summer vacation!
4771370.name: Cities: Skylines - Content Creator Pack: Holiday Getaways

4771380.desc: Let ‘Mansions & Manors’ by ‘Feindbold’ bring prestige to your city. Add a new residential zone with “old money” estates, elegant service buildings, and watch your citizens drive a fleet of luxury residential vehicles.
4771380.name: Cities: Skylines - Content Creator Pack: Mansions & Manors

4771390.desc: Find your perfect zoning flow with ‘Blueprint Beats Radio’. This 16-track blend of lo-fi hip-hop, jazzy chillhop, and down-tempo tracks transforms your mayoral desk into a late-night urban lounge, ideal for detailing luxury estates and holiday getaways.
4771390.name: Cities: Skylines - Blueprint Beats

477160.desc: Human Fall Flat is a hilarious, light-hearted platformer set in floating dreamscapes that can be played solo or with up to 8 players online. Free new levels keep its vibrant community rewarded.
477160.name: Human Fall Flat

4771830.desc: Invest into promising startups with sometimes wacky ideas. Help them grow with your team of experts. Capture the market share with quality product, smart pricing and marketing. Cash out big after the IPO. Compete with the other angels and show them who's the boss.
4771830.name: Angel Investor Simulator™

4773410.desc: Astronauts stranded on the moon have gone a little crazy. Race office chairs, complete repair mini-games, and sabotage your rivals to win the heart of the Moon Princess: a rock with a wig. They're taking this very seriously.
4773410.name: Talaire

4773580.desc: A cottagecore typing companion. A transparent flower garden lives just above your taskbar and blooms as you write, code, and chat. Sell flowers for coins, attract bees and butterflies, build a garden out of the hours you already spend at the keyboard.
4773580.name: Butterflies & Bloom

4773720.desc: hey ill be there soon. u should go in tho my roommates are super chill.
4773720.name: A Real Life Party

4774370.desc: GymPup is a furry-themed romance narrative game that blends desktop idle gameplay with visual novel elements. Through their journey together, you watch the two protagonists grow and change—inside and out.
4774370.name: GymPup

4775430.desc: Eat the world in this idle, incremental homage to B-movie horror classics. Start as a lowly Shambler and grow into a massive horde. Recruit evil little critters to automate brain collection and buy upgrades for your army. Unleash a mini apocalypse with Desktop Companion Mode.
4775430.name: Night of the Idle Horde

4776500.desc: Carry On Together is a physics-based online co-op moving game for up to 4 players. Run a tiny delivery company with your friends: lift heavy furniture together, drive the truck across town and deliver everything in one piece… or don’t. Can you keep the company alive?
4776500.name: Carry On Together

4777080.desc: Hannibal is a grand strategy game with real-time tactical battles. Choose regions on the campaign map, command your army, and take direct control when war begins. Build formations, break enemy lines, and lead your empire to victory through smart strategy and battlefield decisions.
4777080.name: Hannibal

4778090.desc: An adult, choice-driven visual novel set in Tokyo’s nightlife. Follow one of three women, investigate an exploitative industry, and decide whether your money and attention will protect her freedom—or purchase a deeper dependency.
4778090.name: Operation Pay-per-Love

4778200.desc: Cao Cao journeys across the realm, pursued by countless beauties eager to have their way with him. But he has eyes only for the married beauties of the Three Kingdoms... Play as Cao Cao in this absurd yet strangely logical adult game of romancing married women × defending his chastity.
4778200.name: Three Kingdoms: Cao Cao's Chastity Defense

4778330.desc: Sardoinky is a weird, chill, hand drawn clicker about opening cans of sardines. Buy a can, crack it open and sell whatever is inside. Spend the cash on better cans and upgrades. Collect every fish and find out what the company is hiding.
4778330.name: Sardoinky

4780870.desc: Work, browse, or play other games while hatching eggs in the background! Collect 300+ pets, unlock powerful upgrades, and build your battle team.
4780870.name: Aleef: Desktop Pet Collector

4783310.desc: In a postwar world where even memories can be used as collateral, you become the owner of a small pawnshop. Speak with customers, judge the value of their memories and belongings, and over 30 days of running the shop, uncover forgotten truths and the story of the protagonist.
4783310.name: Re:collect

4783980.desc: Command the ultimate vessel in this 1-4 player fast-paced naval bullet-heaven roguelike! Blast through enemy fleets, collect powerful upgrades, and combine devastating synergies to create wildly overpowered builds before the waves overwhelm you.
4783980.name: GUNBOAT-8

4786370.desc: Yokai Idle is a relaxing idle RPG inspired by Japanese folklore. Collect over 50 Yokai, craft equipment with powerful modifiers, and create unique builds as you progress through the historical Ages of Japan and guide the island of Onigashima into a new era 🎎
4786370.name: Yokai Idle

4787460.desc: A Short Active Incremental game where you grow clones in vats, feed them to the entity, butcher and burn them for meat, blood, and ichor, upgrade your ship's stations, push the engine into overdrive, and reach the other side.
4787460.name: Feed The Vessel

4787480.desc: Build your own base, hunt , cook ,upgrade your equipment and your character , gather resources, farm, maintain vehicles, trade with communities, complete tasks in exchange for rewards. The choice is yours: join your friends, trust strangers, or be alone wolf. It's all in your hands.
4787480.name: STATE Z

4787650.desc: Elf World Adventure 13 continues the hentai puzzle series with beautiful anime-style elf girls. Piece together revealing illustrations, enjoy a fantasy atmosphere, and choose between two difficulty levels to suit your mood.
4787650.name: Elf World Adventure 13

4789040.desc: 'SPUM TD' is a 2D strategy game that combines Auto-Chess and Tower Defense. Hire units from a randomized shop and match attribute and class synergies to build a powerful formation. Fend off pouring waves of enemies and complete your ultimate deck!
4789040.name: SPUM TD

4790660.desc: Dig sand with a shovel and process into iron, silicon and more. Craft and merge better tools and machines to build solar panels to power them. Research new machines to automate everything in multi-story factories. Play alone or with friends to survive in the desert and turn it into a solar farm.
4790660.name: Moose Builders

4790710.desc: 《山海幻境：无限篇》是一款像素风卡牌RPG游戏，融合了三消特色玩法，放置挂机收益稳定，主打一个白嫖很舒服，微氪会更爽！上班摸鱼很爽，下班放空也很爽！登录直接百抽，每周8张自选英雄保底，所有养成资源均有免费产出途径，一起来沉浸体验探索山海神话的快感吧！
4790710.name: Shanhai Phantasm

4790930.desc: An unknown number texts you - and every selfie gets bigger! UNN is a Breast Expansion Visual Novel about a sexy girl of your choice flirting with you and sending you selfies of her growth throughout the day!
4790930.name: Unexpected Number Neighbour

4793910.desc: Hurry!Hurry!I'm going to become a legendary card-stall master—right this second!
4793910.name: Speed Card Eatery

4793980.desc: Pest Protocol is a short incremental game about a very tired exterminator, a cursor, and infested sites that refuse to stay clean. Squash some pests, buy yourself better tools, and eventually let the whole operation run itself while you make a cup of tea.
4793980.name: Pest Protocol

4795460.desc: The Citadel Project is a first-person stealth game with lite RPG/Adventure elements, inspired by Thief and Dark Messiah and set in a dark fantasy world. Use your tools and surroundings wisely, stay hidden in the shadows, and uncover the dark secrets behind the Citadel's downfall.
4795460.name: The Citadel Project

4801600.desc: "Ten great war-chariots lead the vanguard." — Shijing 2D turn-based tactical RPG. Four cultural origins, procedurally generated continents, individual soldier recruitment and training, chain-of-command formations, hex-grid combat, fight outnumbered.
4801600.name: YuanRong

4802670.desc: The Fly’s Fantastic Adventure is a 2D run-and-gun platformer about an innocent little fly who finds a weapon shaped like a fruit fly and sets out to defeat the spider that has always been chasing him.
4802670.name: The Fly's Fantastic Adventure

4808180.desc: Run a tiny pancake stall beneath an overpass. Cook every order by hand, crack the eggs, add the toppings, give the right change, and work toward achieving your life dreams.
4808180.name: Chinese Pancake Simulator

4809140.desc: Spend not-so-cute nights in a cute hand-drawn world. Control the character to guard the room yourself and find a way to survive among monsters, doors, windows, and a constantly decreasing SAN value. Every night brings new dangers, and after dawn, more secrets await.
4809140.name: 迷家 mygohome

4809500.desc: Hop and Marty are back in an all new Kart Racing game from Evilkookey games. Play as all your favourite characters from the Hop 'n' Marty and battle it out as you blast through the courses on your way to first place. Play alone or with friends and try to beat your best times.
4809500.name: Hop 'n' Karty

4809710.desc: Paystreak is a top-down gold mining tycoon about running your own modern day gold rush. Take over a small claim, start by hand, and reinvest every ounce into machines, crews, and new land. Sell when the price is right and turn a struggling camp into a mining empire.
4809710.name: Paystreak

4809970.desc: Grow a Mustache for charity! WARDOGS is teaming up with Movember to support men's health. Grab the Tactical ‘Stache DLC, grow your moustache as you play throughout November, and unlock a permanent Movember 2026 scoreboard badge. 100% of profits from this DLC go to Movember.
4809970.name: WARDOGS - Movember Pack

4811080.desc: A psychological horror game inspired by the unsettling atmosphere of P.T. and the anomaly-detection gameplay of The Exit 8, where players must detect anomalies to escape a looping abandoned hospital.
4811080.name: No Visitors Allowed

4814120.desc: Welcome to ANANTA, an Urban Open World RPG. Play as a variety of characters and explore everything from bustling business districts and hidden alleyways, to quiet tea towns and buzzing old streets. Rub shoulders with a wide-ranging cast of intriguing characters as you assemble a team all your own.
4814120.name: ANANTA

4815320.desc: Gold Miner: Party Rush is a multiplayer party game for 2 to 6 players, bringing the classic Gold Miner crane to head-to-head competition. Grab gold, outlast rivals across frantic rounds, and play with friends or get matched online in Quick Play and Ranked modes.
4815320.name: Gold Miner: Party Rush

4816030.desc: Three jobs. One life. Zero savings. A satirical British life sim, spiritual successor to Jones in the Fast Lane. Move your marble token around a city of 16 buildings. Take jobs, study, eat, save, and dodge the weekly Algorithm. See how far you can climb!
4816030.name: Keeping Up

4819620.desc: An MMORPG-inspired single-player game fused with tower defense. Recruit heroes, build bizarre but devastating towers, and fight beside them in real-time 3D combat against waves of enemies.
4819620.name: Path Defenders: RPG Siege Defense

4821590.desc: Solbreak Skirmish is a fast-paced tactical 1v1 battle with RTS-like mechanics. Control your units, each with a unique ability, to help turn the tide of battle in your favor! With multiple win conditions, there's plenty of room for skill expression and creativity to take down your opponent.
4821590.name: Solbreak Skirmish

4822240.desc: The Craaghelm DLC features a wealth of additional content for Thronefall, including new maps, weapons, perks, mutators, heroes, and units.
4822240.name: Thronefall - Craaghelm

4822710.name: PICK A BOO Skin "Angel Halo & Wings"

4822740.desc: Build tiny empires with big ambitions. A cozy, bite-sized 4X where every turn counts: grow cities, research three historical ages, and outscore rivals through building, conquest, or exploration in short single player or multiplayer matches.
4822740.name: Tiny Conquests

4823250.desc: Click, topple and profit! Knock over tiny wandering Humans, hire Animals to cause chaos, collect mountains of coins and grow your ridiculous empire. Unlock powerful Rebirth upgrades, defeat Bosses and turn a peaceful board into a glorious mess of falling people.
4823250.name: Incremental Pain Profit

4823460.desc: Fight. Upgrade. Corrupt. Become overwhelmingly powerful. Will you bend under the assault... or become the ultimate force of evil? No Microtransactions, No P2W, just pure idle fun.
4823460.name: Mage of Corruption

4824220.desc: Run a barely-stable nuclear reactor with your friends in this online co-op physics chaos game. Fix broken systems, manage radiation, survive power outages, and prevent a total meltdown before everything goes horribly wrong.
4824220.name: Meltdown Crew

4824610.desc: Resident Evil Veronica is a remake of 2000's Resident Evil Code: Veronica. In 2027, madness and intrigue, love and hate all combine to create a chilling new entry in survival horror.
4824610.name: Resident Evil Veronica

4825260.desc: Test your piloting skills in a 6-DOF space racer. Match up against others in the matchmaking mode, compete against AI, or race the clock solo. Clear as many rings as you can, and clear the finish line to lock in your time, top speed and accuracy. Get there first to win.
4825260.name: Great Space Race of 3032

4827670.desc: Text Factory: Automation is a text-based factory simulation game. Build production lines, set up transportation between maps, upgrade technologies, craft weapons and armor, and defeat enemies to gather more resources and expand your factory.
4827670.name: Text Factory: Automation

4829700.desc: Massive expansion, Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance has been announced!
4829700.name: Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance

4829780.desc: Frontier Tale is a cozy adventure farming game that blends extraction-style gameplay with town building. Forge weapons, explore a charming cel-shaded fantasy world, gather rare resources, recruit unique companions, and build your dream frontier from the ground up.
4829780.name: Frontier Tale

4829860.desc: Your desktop becomes an endless canvas that zooms from 1% to 2000% and pans in any direction. 70 grid styles, 19 widgets, 500+ autonomous pixel companions + the ability to make your own. Video, GIF, and image wallpapers, gradients, solid colors, and generated scenes. Free, Offline, and Private.
4829860.name: Limitlesscape

4832280.desc: It's a tower defence game with a skill tree. Play as the pilot that crash the spaceship in the unknown white space. Defend the spaceship from a horde of enemies through multiple stages while fixing the ship to escape from this place.
4832280.name: Kern

4832970.desc: What the Buck?! is a satisfying incremental game about destroying money. Shred stacks of cash, set off chain reactions across the table, prestige for permanent upgrades and automate your money destruction. Your demo progress carries over to the full game.
4832970.name: What the Buck?!

4834780.desc: Warlords IV: Heroes of Etheria is a turn-based fantasy strategy game of conquest and heroes. Capture cities, recruit armies from ten distinct factions, level up your units, and clash in fast one-on-one duels where the marching order you choose decides the battle.
4834780.name: Warlords IV: Heroes of Etheria

4834790.desc: The prophecy is clear: you have one hundred years to unite the Aztec tribes and prepare for the Spanish invasion. Theocracy is a unique blend of RTS, grand strategy and city building. Develop towns, raise armies, cast spells and conquer provinces - build an empire that can change history.
4834790.name: Theocracy

4834810.desc: Command a squad of WWII soldiers in deep, turn-based isometric tactical combat. Pick your eight-man team from a persistent platoon, equip them with authentic historical weapons, and fight through covert missions from North Africa to Germany.
4834810.name: Soldiers at War

4836910.desc: Build and manage a growing hotel. Earn stars, upgrade rooms and elevators, add restaurants, spas, conferences and events, and transform a small family hotel into a luxury Palace.
4836910.name: Grand Vista Hotel

4837000.desc: Run off to the Japanese countryside to connect with your Grandfather. Breathe new life into your grandmother's garden, and get to know the locals of a rural Japanese town in this cozy life sim rpg.
4837000.name: Shin'ai Rewritten

4839040.desc: This is a light strategy simulation game that combines grid-based maps with search, attack, and retreat gameplay. You will play as a guardian of the rescue team, venturing into dangerous areas to find trapped female survivors.
4839040.name: X-Keepers

4839520.desc: In a world built for humans, you'll have to evade scientists, solve puzzles and use your sense of smell to find your way in this adventure about freedom, belonging and home. You play as Brie, a daring lab rat in search of the rodent paradise… Cheesty.
4839520.name: Cheesty

4841210.desc: Launch gladiators, earn money, and buy your freedom in a coliseum filled with chaos. Customize the voices of 7 types of gladiators using your microphone, unlock upgrades, overcome absurd events, and multiply your earnings with unpredictable physics.
4841210.name: Coliseum Slap

4841590.desc: Dungebra is a dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder where you choose multiple cards at once, trigger Combo, Overload and Sequence, build your deck during the run, and turn every turn into an explosive play.
4841590.name: Dungebra

4842910.desc: A voxel-based virtual tabletop with full 3D building, movement, and fog-of-war. Place voxels in any color with a variety of 3D shape tools like rectangles, cylinders, ramps, pyramids, etc. Import any image as custom standees. Detailed GM control over player vision, teams, dice, and more!
4842910.name: Terrablox

4845020.desc: 为了筹集妹妹高昂的学费，守财奴男主新海幸意外踏入了名为「人才租赁」的奇妙行当。在扮演男友、密友乃至情夫的虚假契约掩护下，少女们不为人知的隐秘欲望与真实心声悄然绽放。以金钱维系的脆弱羁绊终将遭遇现实的考验，当这层层伪装剥落时，究竟会是财尽缘散，还是假戏真做呢？一场充满谎言与心跳的青春恋爱喜剧就此上演。
4845020.name: 恋爱，我就借走咯

4845070.desc: After a bitter argument with Hannah, Ethan vanishes while auditing files in quarantined Ravenhill Valley. When police refuse to enter the restricted zone, Hannah ventures into the fog-drenched woods to find her boyfriend. What she uncovers is an ancient threat and an ever-shifting nightmare reality.
4845070.name: Ravenhill: Initiation

4845700.desc: The definitive, first-of-its-kind American football league management sim. Take control of the newest spring football league by customizing the structure, teams, ticket prices, salaries, and more. Sim games week by week to grow your league from a startup into a thriving sports empire.
4845700.name: Football Commissioner

4847660.desc: Build and manage your dream resort from the ground up! Design beautiful guest rooms, welcome visitors, prepare delicious meals, and grow a small hotel into a thriving vacation paradise!
4847660.name: Resort Architect

4847770.desc: NULLVECTOR is a fast top-down action roguelike. Choose from 12 playable Vectors with distinct abilities, equip up to four weapons, and stack upgrades to shape your build. Dodge dense bullet patterns and defeat bosses in short, replayable runs.
4847770.name: NULLVECTOR

4850520.desc: Press any key on your keyboard to drive Skoot toward that key’s position in the arena. Dodge, ram, and outmaneuver opponents in fast-paced vehicular brawls built around your entire keyboard. Take on boss fights, Endless Mode, and online PvP as you brawl throughout Skoot’s strange futuristic worlds.
4850520.name: Skoot: Keyboard Brawl

4851050.desc: Embark on a dark fantasy journey as Rozelia in this action sandbox dungeon-crawler. Navigate board-game style maps, master side scrolling action combat, and turn the tide against demonic grabs using Bloodserker counters. Don't let your Corruption gauge max out!
4851050.name: ROZE: The Revenant of Zero Entropy

4854170.desc: Haunted Echoes is a raw psychological horror game experienced through a bodycam perspective. Explore abandoned, eerie locations, manage your limited flashlight, face terrifying anomalies hidden in the dark, and try to survive a nightmare where every single move is being recorded.
4854170.name: Haunted Echoes

4855670.desc: Hatch koi eggs, breed unique bloodlines, evolve rare traits, and send 3-koi teams into idle battles. Build a living collection where genes, rarity, lineage, and battle growth decide every koi's value.
4855670.name: idle koi!

4857380.desc: A cozy farming card merge game where you grow crops, raise animals, complete orders, and build efficient production chains to expand your countryside farm.
4857380.name: Next Acre

4857910.desc: Join the Kabebutt Show, a wild TV game show where you bring your girl best friend for a shot at ¥500,000! Five women’s butts are in front of you, and one belongs to your best friend. Play with each girl, examine them through four intense rounds, and make sure you don't pick your bestie early!
4857910.name: Kabebutt Royale

4858370.desc: Real-time image-enhancement tool for any game. No mods required.
4858370.name: Dr Pixel

4858460.desc: A medieval free-for-all for 2–8 friends. Lead your army as a hero, raise your Castle, launch yourself from your own Mangonel and talk your way into alliances with proximity voice — then betray them. Outlast your rivals or top the final standings.
4858460.name: PARLEY

4859520.desc: "Smashboom" is a high-speed 3D competitive shooter where you deflect incoming projectiles and use feints to exploit your opponent's openings. Engage in tense mind games, unleash a surprise smash to catch your rival off guard, and take them down!
4859520.name: Smashboom

4859770.desc: Enjoy ColorByNumber in 3D voxel art. Match the numbers, paint the blocks, and create beautiful 3D artwork in this relaxing experience. Complete a variety of models, from cute animals to massive buildings, and unleash your creativity in Sandbox Mode!
