4859770.name: CrystalCanvas

4859890.desc: Explore a gothic, macabre environment and find objects of symbolic significance, in this text-based adventure game inspired by "The Masque of the Red Death" by Edgar Allan Poe. Interact by typing your intentions in text, in an authentically written story that goes Beyond where the original one ends.
4859890.name: Beyond the Masque of the Red Death

4860910.desc: What are you in for? Prison Legacy is a social MMORPG set inside a mixed-gender maximum-security prison. Choose one of 12 criminal classes, then fight turn-based battles, craft contraband, trade, steal, chat, and build a clan strong enough to outlast the hilarious darkness rising behind bars.
4860910.name: Prison Legacy

4861910.desc: Pin-Finite is a Roguelike deck-builder pinball game. Purchase unique and powerful upgrades to blow the lid on your points! Unlock rare pinballs and combos to scale your runs to infinity!
4861910.name: Pin-Finite

4862210.desc: Spearfish is a short action-adventure game where you spear through and catch fish as a swordfish. Explore open environments and catch a range of creatures from real-life fish to sea beasts.
4862210.name: Spearfish

4863180.desc: Fast-Paced Tower Defense Game Where Space Is Used To Manipulate Enemy Behavior | Towers And Upgrades Take Up Space On The Board | Make The Enemy Decide Whether They Should Attack The Tower, Or Go Around!
4863180.name: Defend The HexCore

4865260.desc: This is the complete Strata editor, not a cut-down version. Build terrain from a node graph: noise and Voronoi generators, hydraulic and thermal erosion, river splines, flatten pins, slope and height masks, and a splat stack for material assignment. Inspect your landscape from orbit.
4865260.name: Strata Demo

4866020.desc: Sokobomb is a puzzle game about blowing things up to find your way forward.
4866020.name: Sokobomb

4866510.desc: A cat, synthwave music, and a single button to test your sense of rhythm. How hard could it be?
4866510.name: Purrfect Beats

4867840.desc: One Dad, a pack of kids, one house to wreck! An asymmetric party game for 2-10 players online, up to 4 in split-screen or solo against bots. Wreck the house in INFERKIDS or hunt for candy in the SCREAMKIDS haunted manor. Proximity voice chat, cosmetics earned by playing.
4867840.name: TRONADO

4871280.desc: A turn-based RPG Roguelite where your choices will pave the path to victory! The Dragon Queen Tiametia threatens to take control of Realm... It is up to you, the Heir, to rally three loyal subjects to battle your way back to the Grand Palace and put an end to her tyranny!
4871280.name: The Heir's Guild

4871990.desc: A flashcard-style learning adventure where you battle through realms by answering math or language questions. Play story, endless, or local multiplayer as you train memory, test your skills, and fight toward Heavens Gate.
4871990.name: Heavens Gate

4872270.desc: You awaken inside an unknown facility and must explore its mysterious spaces in order to recover your lost memories. Gather clues, follow the records and procedures left behind by the Bureau, and overcome the threatening anomalies that stand in your way.
4872270.name: APARTMENT 001

4873240.desc: "Fight me!!" A Bug Huntress who suddenly challenges you to battle — I've never met anyone this cocky. Hand over that ridiculous water gun of yours; I'm going to soak you from head to toe. Take this! Rapid-fire piston attacks straight to your weak point for massive damage!
4873240.name: Bug Huntress wants to battle!

4873800.desc: Solve rotating puzzles with cute cat girls. Cozy, soft-incremental gameplay. Chat With Cat Girls. Somehow Get Better at Puzzles. Make Questionable Choices. Unlock Surprisingly Useful Stuff.
4873800.name: Mosaique Neko Waifus 6

4874760.desc: Horror RPG FPS set in a dystopian United States controlled by a fanatical cult determined to create the perfect Red Heifer. Play as the Firestarter, a normal person who has decided to resist the Cult against all odds
4874760.name: Cult of the Red Heifer

4876560.desc: A fast-paced Western cowboy duel game. Load your revolver, steady your breathing, and fire in the split second between life and death. Face off against friends in gunfights and challenge legendary cowboys from around the world; Earn bounties and become an undefeated legend of the Wild West.
4876560.name: Cowboy!Duel!

4876650.desc: Somewhere under that mountain of bricks is your floor. Sort the impossible Pile with a magnet glove, sieves, and part-seeking vision. Fill labeled drawers, pull parts, watch MOC builds snap together brick by brick. Cozy, satisfying, and governed by one rule: never sort by color.
4876650.name: Never Sort By Color

4877420.desc: Party up with your friends and explore a world of endless fun. Hang out in official rooms, discover community-created rooms, or create unforgettable memories with players from around the world.
4877420.name: Rec Room: A New Semester

4877650.desc: You’re the CEO. Build your company into a thriving conglomerate, managing the cash flow, product launches, funding and hiring decisions. Build a conglomerate or go bankrupt trying.
4877650.name: Conglomerate

4877800.desc: Arcana Rift: Tactics is a turn-based tactical strategy game where Swords, Wands, Cups and Pentacles become battlefield units. Recruit your forces, craft equipment, summon powerful Arcana and destroy the enemy Tower in strategic offline or online battles.
4877800.name: Arcana Rift: Tactics

4878180.desc: The Crazy Eights roguelike. Every 8 is wild: call the suit, keep the chain alive, and cash out monster combos. Build decks that bend the rules, stack House Rules that multiply each other, and break the casino one floor at a time.
4878180.name: Wild Crazy 8s

4878600.desc: She wants to kill the man who stole her love. To do so, she... His missing wife's phone reveals a hidden side: sweet whispers, sultry breaths, messages from strange men. Sick with anguish, the lawyer seeks the truth. But does he have secrets too? A smartphone mystery filled with forbidden desires!
4878600.name: DEEPest RESEARCH

4878710.desc: 你将扮演一个被AI淘汰的程序员，回到那个停滞的小县城，与那个等了你十二年的女孩一起去寻找，从所有人记忆里消失的发小和尘封的往事，你们追查的不仅仅是真相，还是被AI一起困住的那个夏天、那座小城、那段永远不会结束的等待。
4878710.name: 知夏

4878900.desc: A satirical life-and-money sim. One turn is one month: budget your hours, work the job, ride the market, outlive inflation and your own decisions. Pick a character and make their dream come true. Or at least don't die trying.
4878900.name: Net Worthless

4879470.desc: Search a persistent hay pile with millions of candidates and one winning needle. Work strand by strand alone or with up to three friends, sort the mess, sell strange finds, and unlock better tools in a cozy first-person test of patience.
4879470.name: A Needle In a Haystack

4880720.desc: Turn a filthy, rubbish-choked beach into a bustling seaside destination! Recycle litter, unlock powerful tools and vehicles, and clear rubbish mountains. Build facilities, run stalls and welcome visitors. Reinvest your earnings to bring the beach to life.
4880720.name: Son of Beach

4880820.desc: 《疾风群侠传》是一款武侠题材的多周目养成Roguelike游戏。在不断推进的江湖岁月中，自由修炼武学，加入风栖谷或凌霄门，踏上截然不同的门派道路。邂逅多位性格各异的红颜，在随机见闻、奇遇抉择与生死战斗中积累实力，探寻身世之谜，决定正邪立场，谱写独属于你的侠客传奇。
4880820.name: 疾风群侠传

4882180.desc: Welcome to Dizzyworld. An immersive goat-themed baa-musement park, letting you reach higher ups and downs than your mood swings. Feel the g(oat)-force on the rides the park has to offer, turn visitors into baalloons, and trade Dizzy Tokens for rewards.
4882180.name: Goat Simulator 3 – Ticket to Dizzyworld

4884790.desc: Auto-battler Dungeoncrawler without PvP in a Dark Fantasy setting. Recruit, Match 3 to level up, build game breaking synergies with items and unlocks. Supports 2 player online CO-OP
4884790.name: Grave Profits

4885580.desc: Heya! Sumo Manager allows you to manage a sumo stable and develop the skills of your rikishi on their road to Yokozuna! Climb from Jonokuchi to Sekitori by organizing the diet, training and tactics of your wrestlers and see them compete in 3D matches.
4885580.name: Heya! Sumo Manager

4885910.desc: A 17+ BL raising sim where you decide who leads. Spend four years on classes, part-time jobs, and questionable outfits, then romance seven very different men. Your stats determine whether you end up on top or bottom, and your choices unlock dozens of endings.
4885910.name: How to grow a man : Turning Chumps to Hunks

4886710.desc: One mouse, One mushroom, No chackpoints.
4886710.name: Mushroom Must Go Up!

4887480.desc: A deep pro-football front-office sim. Draft through a fog of scouting, build contracts that come due years later, develop raw kids into stars, and outlast 31 rival GMs who scout, bluff, and hold grudges. No play-calling. Every decision is yours, and so is every consequence.
4887480.name: Gridiron Grit

4888040.desc: Fast-paced multiplayer FPS. Fight in Team Deathmatch, Free For All and Capture the Flag across five battlefields, with assault rifles, shotguns, snipers and grenades. Choose your spawn, call the shots in firefights against other players, or train against bots offline.
4888040.name: Soldier Offensive

4889160.desc: The lighthouse has gone dark, and ships can no longer reach the island. Join Fox, its lighthouse keeper, in a mystery adventure: explore the island and find a way to repair the lighthouse without spare parts or outside help, before night falls.
4889160.name: Sr Fox

4890230.desc: Close your eyes. Listen. I AM MILK is a surreal, darkly comic game played entirely through sound, with one button and more than 40 endings. You have 21 minutes and 30 seconds to do something meaningful with your life. Put on your headphones.
4890230.name: I AM MILK

4891760.desc: Summon and merge random heroes to create mightier heroes and fend off incoming waves of enemies! Upgrade your heroes and discover diverse relics to forge your ultimate build! It's time to conquer the Abyss!
4891760.name: Celeforge

4891770.desc: Break the Rects. Collect Recties. Upgrade. Repeat. Orby vs Rects is a retro-inspired shooter that captures the spirit of Arkanoid and Tetris classics, while delivering modern fast-paced bullet-hell action.
4891770.name: Orby vs Rects

4894240.desc: A dramatic, erotic RPG of a Busty MILF who is a Saintess! The classic fantasy RPG of a married, cheste Saintess getting defiled by dirty men! The lustful and immoral adventure is about to begin...
4894240.name: Devout Saintess Selenia

4894680.desc: Four stones, one river, and every current is called a turn ahead. All four players choose at the same moment, in the blind — so the question is never "where do I go now", it's "where do I need to be when it changes".
4894680.name: RiverStones

489520.desc: An addictive fast-paced hybrid of Card games & Tower-Defense. Play 1v1 - or bring a friend for 2v2 - and engage in epic online multiplayer battles full of innovative strategy and awesome plays! Collect 200+ cards with unique mechanics, all free!
489520.name: Minion Masters

4898190.desc: Erevael is a fantasy RPG on a hex map that's different every game. There are no classes. You get better at whatever you do, from trading and mapmaking to magic and fighting. When your character retires, you carry on as their heir with their spells, recipes and maps.
4898190.name: Erevael

489830.desc: Winner of more than 200 Game of the Year Awards, The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition brings the epic fantasy to life in stunning detail. The Special Edition includes the critically acclaimed game and add-ons with all-new features.
489830.name: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition

4900110.desc: Well, nice catch! You caught a mermaid with a tempting smile and she isn’t going to let you go that easily. Reel her closer, uncover the secrets of the deep and chase six endings: from sweet romance to something much darker.
4900110.name: Oops… I Hooked Up with a Mermaid 🎣😳

4901540.desc: Pick up a brick and build a little world. Follow the instructions, add stickers, and collect new models in this cozy brick-building game. Unwind on your own or grow your collection with friends.
4901540.name: Brick Buddies

4901680.desc: A Journey of Self-Deflection. MONOLYTH is a single-player arcade game, one-bullet bullet hell experience, and two-character play rolled into one. One rainy afternoon, we came across three TV screens reflecting on divinity. We decided to capture this in the only way we knew how: By making a game.
4901680.name: MONOLYTH

4901860.desc: An arcade incremental where you ARE the tornado. Suck up cows, flatten cities, and spend the cash on upgrades between runs. Become fire, flood, winter or void. Start with a blade of grass. Tear Earth apart, then take your storm to an alien world. Raise cows on a farm of your own.
4901860.name: The Big Suck

4903020.desc: Upgrade, evolve, and mutate powerful spells as you defend the Last Spire in this strategic incremental tower defense with endless progression and customizable spell loadouts.
4903020.name: The Last Spire 2

4903220.desc: An idle JRPG that sits above your taskbar. Four heroes fight through 15 realms on their own while you use your computer. Open the chests they earn, forge your gear and grow your party.
4903220.name: TaskBound Saga

4903470.desc: A desktop companion about escaping the 9-to-5. Adopt Butaro, a burnt-out salaryman who lives anywhere on your screen. Watch him slack off from his mind-numbing job, decorate his office, and upgrade his corporate skills while you work or relax. Will Butaro escape corporate burnout before you do?
4903470.name: Butaro's Overtime Office

4903900.desc: Three epic fantasy battlefields, dozens of sneaky cats! Crown battles in the treasury, mermaids vs. skeleton pirates in a deep-sea wreck, dwarves vs. goblins for an ale flagon in the gold vault—find them all!
4903900.name: Find Cats 9: Hidden Treasures

4904020.desc: Tracks created specifically for the game. Buy this to support the creator.
4904020.fullgame_name: The Veil Chronicles: Nix University | Part 1
4904020.name: The Veil Chronicles: Nix University | Part 1 Soundtrack

4904030.fullgame_name: The Veil Chronicles: Nix University | Part 1
4904030.name: The Veil Chronicles: Nix University | ARTBOOK

4904730.desc: Click flies, unlock achievements, and complete your collection. A simple and satisfying clicker designed for achievement hunters.
4904730.name: Achievement Fly Clicker

4906740.desc: "Let us live on this land so arid." Leon's peaceful days suddenly come to an end when he hears the sound of a telephone, a Relic from the past and is informed that Cullen, a member of the town vigilante corp, is being held hostage. The final chapter in the KARAKARA series.
4906740.name: KARAKARA3

4907430.desc: A thrilling Co-op Action Roguelite for 1-4 players! Play as mischievous ghosts, create insane weapon synergies, catch humans, and turn them into pumpkins. Deliver your harvest to the crypt, expand the map, and unleash vibrant chaos in this Bullet Heaven!
4907430.name: GrindFall

4907890.desc: In this roguelike adventure game, your heroic journey begins at 11. Experience unique story interactions, battles, puzzles and character development. Your past, personality and fate are shaped by random yearly events. Story packs provide multiple dramatic main story paths.
4907890.name: Hero's Reincarnation Journey

4907900.desc: Fight, gather, build, and explore in a fast-paced top-down Action RPG. Battle ruthless enemies, gather resources, build your own city, craft powerful gear, and explore mysterious realms through ancient portals.
4907900.name: The City Of Akhetaten

4908110.desc: Run a chaotic gas station sandbox: fuel cars, clean and repair vehicles, buy wild tools, catch wanted drivers, earn reviews, unlock upgrades, climb the leaderboard, or turn every stop into total mayhem.
4908110.name: Gas N Cars

4908560.desc: Setter is a volleyball management game where every decision shapes your club. Build and develop your squad in a competitive transfer market where rivals can bid for your players, prepare your lineup and tactics, and watch every rally unfold as you compete for domestic titles and continental success.
4908560.name: Setter: Volleyball Manager 27

4909330.desc: You play as a young woman taking a temporary evening job at a bakery on New Year's Eve. Your task is to serve a variety of customers while trying to uncover why, instead of holiday cheer, this place is shrouded in darkness...
4909330.name: Last Bake

4912740.desc: Bake, decorate, and serve beautiful cakes for customers celebrating life's special moments. Customize every order, expand your bakery with new ingredients and decorations, and create the coziest cake shop in town at your own relaxing pace.
4912740.name: Cake & Bake

4913950.desc: A cozy campsite building game where you create medieval-fantasy campsites with charming decorations, warm lighting, and a relaxing atmosphere.
4913950.name: Fantasy Camp Builder

4915180.desc: A psychological exorcism horror featuring the unique Presence System and a 3D Jumpscare effect that makes demons burst out of your screen. Every sound has a source. The demon sees you, hears you, senses your fear. Forget predictable jumpscares.
4915180.name: EXORCISMUS: Vade Retro Satana

4915700.desc: Ebbtide is a zombie survival strategy game. Lead the last carrier task force through a world overrun by the dead, starting in Los Angeles: direct your forces on a real-time operations map, then zoom straight into the 3D pixel-art battlefield to command the fight or take direct control.
4915700.name: Ebbtide

4915740.desc: Welcome to chichi’s world! Chichi is a little mouse with big travel dreams and just one piece of luggage: a ball! Keep chichi company while you work or study, play together, try new outfits and skins, or go online with friends and bring your mice together on your desktops.
4915740.name: Chichi's Desktop Journey

4917140.desc: A dark 18+ visual novel about a war that began fifty years ago — and the people who believe it's over. A ruined city, humanity's last refuge, and a voice beneath the earth that has started speaking again.
4917140.name: Hentai Academy: Echo Protocol

4917760.desc: An 18+ visual novel about a shipwreck that tore her away from everything she knew — and a forgotten island whose secrets have waited for years, buried deep in the jungle.
4917760.name: Hentai Academy: UNDERTOW

4917940.desc: Run a chaotic pub with your friends in online co-op! Serve drinks, cook food, and upgrade your bar — but keep your customers happy, or they might turn into bears and beat you up! As your pub grows, so does the chaos, with more customers, new cocktails, delicious dishes, and tougher nights!
4917940.name: Panic Pub

4918810.desc: Smash piñatas, collect candy, run the show! A fast active incremental game where the crowd throws for you. Upgrade your arena, gamble at the casino, and grow a number that refuses to stop!
4918810.name: Pinata Smash: Incremental Circus

4919570.desc: Restore the cats' damaged memory archives in this hand-drawn puzzle game. And you'll also discover the stories of these lovely cats before they returned to the stars! No timers, just enjoy the satisfaction of each piece falling into place. Come and enjoy some cozy moments with these lovely cats!
4919570.name: Meow Star Archives

4920280.desc: Hang a battlefield on your desktop and let your soldier fight and grow automatically. Plan talents, buy gear, refine builds, and use APM to boost combat speed. Team up with friends for ranked battles, chase higher KDA and scores, and find out who is best at “strategic slacking” during work.
4920280.name: 喵呜风云

4920640.desc: A group of young adventurers set out to dispel the darkness lurking within people’s hearts. A nostalgic 3D fantasy RPG inspired by the atmosphere of early‑2000s games.
4920640.name: プレア・チェスト

4921660.desc: Rank 5 words from S to D to fit the prompt, then everyone guesses the star's ranking in this online party game for 2–10 players. Perfect matches get cheers, wild misses get laughs!
4921660.name: EVERYONE'S TIER LIST!

4922860.desc: PingPongDart is a Game between PingPong and Dart. Hit the rotating Dartboard using a navigator for precise hits from any 3D space. Play alone or with friends or family up to 4 players. It is particularly well-suited for teens, as the game is based on physics rather than shootouts and explosions.
4922860.name: PingPongDart

4924900.desc: Klondike, Spider and FreeCell for your computer and your handheld. Play with mouse, keyboard or controller — however you like, on whatever you like. Four skin sets, modifiers and a Daily Challenge with verified deals. Windows, macOS, Linux and SteamOS.
4924900.name: TURBOCARDS

4925250.desc: Try Magna Regna for free! Command medieval armies in an RTS with classic nostalgia and a modern look. This demo includes the tutorial and free play mission. Enjoy it? Wishlist the full game, with campaigns from the 9th century to the age of knights!
4925250.name: Magna Regna Demo

4925810.desc: Build a global T20 dynasty across dozens of fictional competitions. Scout thousands of players, win auctions and transfers, develop youth, set fields and bowling plans, and watch every delivery resolve through a ball-by-ball match engine entirely offline.
4925810.name: Cricket Manager

4927420.desc: A pixel-art idle zombie RPG that lives in a slim strip above your taskbar. Your survivors fight the horde while you work: loot scrap, forge gear, unlock skills, prestige and push through 4 difficulties. Minimize the apocalypse - or go fullscreen when the boss arrives.
4927420.name: Idle of the Dead

4927770.desc: The Joust Autochess allows you to see your favorite zany physics brawlers in an environment like you've never seen them before... tactical autochess combat! Combine like cards to upgrade your forces! Strategize with items to find the perfect build!
4927770.name: The Joust Autochess

4927790.desc: Inherit your uncle’s run-down freight yard in rural Australia ... and his debt. Purchase unclaimed freight lots, appraise and repair what you find, then sell it for a profit. Pay off the debt, restore the yard and turn it into a booming business.
4927790.name: Lost Freight

4928450.desc: 1-4+ players time-travel kidnapping-collection dungeon-crawling heist with physics, guns, bosses, arena, homebase, skins, and stocks! Kidnap people across 200+ worlds of history & fiction, haul them home in cages and farm paradox in your garage. 25+ theme packs, 2,000+ NPCs and Workshop mods!
4928450.name: Grand Theft Timeline

4930190.desc: With the horde behind you and asphalt in front, there's only one choice. Drive or Die. An arcade roguelite about outrunning the apocalypse in a gun covered junker. Draft cards, chain kills, die, upgrade and go again.
4930190.name: Drive or Die

4930380.desc: You work. Your fish feast! Raise fish on your desktop, with mouse clicks and keystrokes keeping them fed. Breed and collect new species, sell fish to decorate your dream aquarium, or compete with friends to become the richest fish keeper!
4930380.name: TaskTank

4932310.desc: Sculpt, Paint and Animate into literally anything! Show off your amazing talents in the SUSPECIES SHOW mode or Disguise and Hide in the environment in the HIDE & SEEK mode. up to 12 players, for private or public matches.
4932310.name: SUSPECIES

4932820.desc: An incremental game about flipping bottles, unlocking and upgrading unique abilities, and turning simple bottle flips into increasingly satisfying moments.
4932820.name: Bottle Flip Inc

4933500.desc: Me and You is a co-op puzzle game inspired by the acclaimed “Baba Is You”. Create, change and break the rules of each level to solve it together.
4933500.name: Me and You

4934200.desc: Extraction survivors-like meets ARPG loot, with deep crafting you'll understand in one click. Melt the horde, fill your bag, extract through the portal. Die and it goes with your character. Your next one levels up faster and skips floors you already beat. How deep do you dare go?
4934200.name: Extract Survivors

4934400.desc: GameLaunchSimulator is a text-based management sim about the full journey of publishing an indie game. Build your studio, plan new projects, prepare store pages, grow wishlists, handle reviews, release windows, publishing deals, and post-launch operations, then bring an unknown game to real players.
4934400.name: 游戏发行模拟器 Game Launch Simulator

4934480.desc: Decrypting Life is a short, nostalgic incremental game where you restore corrupted files to uncover a story from the 2000s
4934480.name: Decrypting Life

4934620.desc: The stars are dying. Pilot an evolving warship across the Milky Way in this third-person 3D space roguelite. Fight interceptors, shatter asteroids, build your arsenal, and carry the last spark from Earth orbit to the far-side beacon.
4934620.name: STARCINDER

4935280.desc: vim racer is a speed based training game that teaches real Vim motions by racing a block cursor through real source code, from h j k l all the way to search and bracket matching. There's no accuracy score, only speed, so the fastest path is always the correct one.
4935280.name: vim racer

4936260.desc: Uncover the truth behind a mysterious box left at your doorstep. But as the objects inside the house pull you away from reality and drag you into other worlds, prepare yourself for a psychological horror experience where the line between reality and hallucination slowly begins to disappear.
4936260.name: WHERE IS MY MIND

4937320.desc: A grid-based, turn-based puzzle roguelike. Play a lone kunoichi ascending an endless castle — read each floor like a puzzle, arm yourself from its walls, and cut down the oni in your path. One wrong move ends your run.
4937320.name: KAREI - ENDLESS DEATH MATCH

4937900.desc: Investigate system failures, trace corrupted infrastructure, and keep the node alive before stability reaches zero. NODE ZERO is an interface-driven psychological horror game where something inside the system is learning how you work.
4937900.name: NODE ZERO

4938350.desc: Idol Lust is an idle strategy game combining strategy and RPG. As the manager of agency "LUCKY", you willl guide idols on stage and lead them to fight "U-Mutations" to protect New Tokyo!
4938350.name: Idol Lust

4938490.desc: Black Pyramid is an interactive cinematic game largely brought to life by AI‑generated visuals. Cursed by an ancient force, Ethan must venture to the fabled forbidden Black Pyramid in search of his only chance for survival.
4938490.name: Black Pyramid

4939030.desc: Step into the French National Assembly and lead your campaign in this strategic card game. Unlock new political parties, expand their decks, then challenge the AI or another candidate online in tactical debates where every card can overturn the majority.
4939030.name: Motion De Censure

4940850.desc: Race with friends, customize your kart, and create and grow your clan! Drift, boost, and use abilities to outplay your rivals in Kachow Kart Racing. Battle it out online or in local split-screen, and fight for the top spot in ranked races!
4940850.name: Kachow Kart Racing

4940860.desc: Throw dices. That's just it. You click, and throw dices, a bunch of them in fact. Score as much as you can doing suites, pairs and more, earn golds, buy dices, throw more.
4940860.name: Dice

4940900.desc: Build and decorate your own little Christmas Village! Relax and build to your heart's content in this cozy sandbox game. No objectives, no stress building.
4940900.name: Little Noël: Christmas Village

4940980.desc: Run a cozy ramen bar in a busy Japanese city. Prepare bowls, serve customers, and keep the place clean, all while expanding your menu every day. But when you're alone something doesn't feel quite right...
4940980.name: The Ramen Bar

4941160.desc: Command a ship and crew stranded far from home in this open-world space sandbox RPG. Explore, trade, fight, and craft to survive among the strange alien factions. One by one entire sectors are going dark and no one knows why. Solve the mystery of the dark sectors and get your crew home.
4941160.name: A Sector Darkly

4941820.desc: Blast through the cosmos in Alien Skies, a neo-classical side-scrolling space shooter! Pilot your starship across diverse alien worlds, unleash devastating weapon upgrades, and upgrade your ship to conquer an ever-growing alien threat.
4941820.name: Alien Skies

4942010.desc: A game console you can walk into. Astrolobe OS is an orbital station with a desk of your own, original games including TERMINAL ORION, and a real desktop for work. Full controller support for most controllers out of the box in every game, plus 4-player split screen on games that support it.
4942010.name: Astrolobe OS

4943870.desc: To solidify the new Demon King's authority, violate the incoming heroes and broadcast their shameful, lust-broken submission for the entire world to see!
4943870.name: The Demon King's Reclusive Strategist

4943970.desc: Franchise Hockey Manager returns for the 2026-27 season with plenty of additions to the deepest, most authentic hockey strategy gaming experience you can find. Choose from teams around the globe and select a team to guide to glory, including a chance at the ultimate prize, the Stanley Cup®.
4943970.name: Franchise Hockey Manager 13

4945780.desc: Retro top-down space shooter: hold the mothership through 100 waves, build your fighter from 22 modules and 26 modifiers, earn eight complete ship designs, and fly with up to 4 pilots in Steam co-op through stargate corridors, the asteroid belt and the fog convoy.
4945780.name: Squadron 404

4946440.desc: A physics sandbox about Murray, who didn't let a witch merge onto the highway. She sent him to The Granule, and something already lives there. You. Burn, freeze, shock, slice, and mend him. None of it is scripted, and the room is not all there is.
4946440.name: Granule

4946550.desc: A short, satisfying incremental game about breaking blocks. Destroy blocks, unlock new tools and upgrades, and break even more blocks.
4946550.name: Deblock

4947000.desc: Idle Minertia is an idle mining game where you dig through caves automatically. Combine mining tools and Enchants to go ever deeper. Build strategic synergies or steadily collect permanent rewards. Beyond that, 10+ kinds of content await. A relaxing idle experience, every day.
4947000.name: Idle Minertia

4947250.desc: Build and run your own kebab restaurant in a single-player management simulation. Set prices, hire staff, serve customers, keep the shop clean, upgrade the interior, and turn a small counter into a thriving food business.
4947250.name: Kebab Dynasty

4947630.desc: 7 Shifts in Subway is a first-person psychological horror game in which you play as a night-train operator. Keep an eye on passengers through cameras, follow strange subway rules, and try to survive seven shifts where every mistake could be your last.
4947630.name: 7 Shifts in Subway

4947690.desc: Take control of this chaotic intersection in this fast-paced traffic management game. Manage traffic lights, impatient drivers, and increasingly chaotic intersections to get everyone through safely.
4947690.name: Crossroad Chaos

4948250.desc: A cozy pixel cat companion for your desktop: it lives on top of your windows while you work or study. Feed it, play with it, dress it up, and watch its character emerge: it remembers your care, sulks if woken, and hunts its toys.
4948250.name: Purrtopia

4948940.desc: Swarmbreaker is an incremental tower defense game where you must defend your base from a giant living wave of alien bugs. Build defenses to block their path, deploy heavy weapons, upgrade your arsenal, and break the swarm!
4948940.name: Swarmbreaker

4949400.desc: MY CAT SCATTERED GAMES is a tidy up organizing game. Put 5,158 games and consoles back on the shelves, restore your video game store, and free your mischievous cat from the claw machine. Play by yourself or with up to 3 friends in co-op!
4949400.name: MY CAT SCATTERED GAMES: Tidy Videogame Supermarket

4949800.desc: A dark fantasy incremental about smiting heretics hidden in the fog, rescuing followers for your cult and gathering faith to upgrade your runes.
4949800.name: Click the Faithless

4950060.desc: Enter round-based auctions and engage in psychological warfare! Outbid to secure rare loot or deceive your opponents with lowballs, bluffs, and everything in between. Arm your warriors and send them out on raids to get even more loot! Grow your fame and become the ultimate KING.
4950060.name: Bid Wars

4951630.desc: Ride your own music. Soundway transforms any song into a neon roller coaster racing through deep space, with every burst of speed, climb, drop, and turn shaped by the track itself. Catch the beat, build massive combos, dodge hazards, and chase the music across the stars.
4951630.name: Soundway

4951770.desc: The space beyond each door changes depending on the word you create by arranging Panels. Use your creativity to discover the words that will lead you out of the building in this insight-driven puzzle game.
4951770.name: Door Code

4951820.desc: An emotionally charged kinetic visual novel about Hana, an aspiring actress whose relationships and career are slipping through her fingers - until a sudden transformation into a futanari throws her life into chaos and forces her to confront everything she thought she knew.
4951820.name: More Than  A Woman - Season 1

49520.desc: The Ultimate Vault Hunter’s Upgrade lets you get the most out of the Borderlands 2 experience.
49520.name: Borderlands 2

4952940.desc: Turn your everyday PC activity into an RPG adventure! Every click and keystroke helps your knight fight the undead, gain XP and find powerful loot. Equip new gear, grow stronger and rise through the ranks.
4952940.name: Background RPG

4953250.desc: Pirate Waifu is a puzzle game about charming pirate waifus and the spirit of sea adventure. Complete 30 levels, unlock colorful illustrations of girls in pirate costumes, and save all the images in your personal gallery in high quality.
4953250.name: Pirate Waifu

4953470.desc: Two capybaras found a meadow past the river. Lead them into a colony: buy land one hex at a time and choose what each tile becomes. Build huts and hot springs, throw festivals, welcome babies. Gentle nights, a full Pacifist option and no lose state.
4953470.name: CapyHaven

4954910.desc: Run a scam call center with your friends. Use increasingly ridiculous schemes to trick AI callers out of their life savings. Hit your daily quota, cause chaos around the office, and survive a brutal performance review from your rageaholic boss.
4954910.name: Scam With Your Friends

4954970.desc: One of you is the cop. The rest are panicked suspects. Hide the body, clean up the evidence, don’t rat each other out, and get rid of everything before your cop friend knocks on the door. There is only one rule: if the body is found, you’re all done for.
4954970.name: No Body No Problem!

4955600.desc: A vertical-climbing action roguelike: scale a massive tower as a capybara while your weapons fire on their own, bullet-heaven style. Level up, shape your build, take on quests, and unlock weapons and characters. Every run generates a brand-new tower.
4955600.name: Capy of Gods

4955730.desc: Step into the shoes of Travis, the internet's favorite plumbing vigilante! Explore procedurally generated levels, test public faucets for the perfect flow, and evade city security in this endless, meme-inspired arcade stealth game powered by Unreal Engine 5.7.
4955730.name: Public Faucet Hunt

4955970.desc: Restore the lost history of the Mesozoic in an atmospheric idle game. Grow a branching discovery tree, uncover dinosaurs and vanished ecosystems, complete an illustrated scientific Codex, and rebuild the Triassic, Jurassic, and Cretaceous.
4955970.name: Epoch Vault

4956460.desc: A happy North American neighborhood awaits you! Play solo or with up to 9 friends. Build your crew, take on jobs around the neighborhood, earn money and buy houses. Create your own cash flow and happily build your real estate empire!
4956460.name: AMERICAN LIFE SIMULATOR

4956500.desc: Shifted Shells is a high stakes supernatural gambling game where you test your luck and skills against a mysterious wizard. Track the ball through increasingly difficult rounds, build your winnings, and spend the collected souls on upgrades and abilities that give you an edge.
4956500.name: Shifted Shells

4957240.desc: You are trapped in an endless airport terminal. Observe your surroundings carefully, find the anomalies, and find your way out.
4957240.name: Airport 7

4957380.desc: Build a political party in a fictional country and play for one thing: win power and keep it. Recruit politicians, conquer regions, win elections. There are clean paths and dirty games. Everyone has a price. What's yours?
4957380.name: Demockracy

4959060.desc: A 2D mining game about digging your way off a dead planet. Drill deep for rare ores, dodge lava and gas pockets, upgrade your rig, then pool your haul with friends to smelt bars, craft parts, and build the rocket that gets your crew home. Solo or 1–16 players.
4959060.name: Legacy Miner

4959350.desc: It's a short game. But it can be a long one. It all depends on whether you were born under a lucky star... or whether you have the skill in your hands. Just... take the thing out!
4959350.name: Take This Thing Out Of Me

4959410.desc: A retro-inspired 2D action platformer inspired by Norse mythology. Fight through dangerous realms, reap the souls of fallen brave warriors, uncover secrets, and defeat various enemies and powerful bosses.
4959410.name: Valkyrja

4959760.desc: 1895. In this first-person escape room, you play as Dr. Voss's aspiring scientific heir. Explore an immersive Victorian laboratory, solve ingenious puzzles woven into the environment and the story, and unravel the dark secret behind Voss's experiments.
4959760.name: The Heir: Steampunk Escape Room

4960310.desc: Wildcat is a top-down fast-paced roguelite dungeon crawler featuring powerful witchcraft and intense boss fights. Discover hundreds of items, combine them to master the elements, defeat guardians and rival witches, then rescue the lost cats!
4960310.name: Wildcat

4960590.desc: A window wallpaper app that transform every monitor into a living dream with original dreamcore and liminal video wallpapers, independent multi-monitor control, custom imports, music playlists, Steam Workshop support, and lightweight performance.
4960590.name: Liminal Desktop

4960640.desc: KIT Three Kingdoms: Heroes at War is a logistics-driven strategy game. Govern cities, recruit officers and move armies across a grand map, then command formations, Battle Arts, Stratagems, sieges and duels in real time. Choose a faction in seven sandbox starts and unite the realm.
4960640.name: KIT Three Kingdoms: Heroes at War

4960970.desc: A dark romance SRPG. Pledge your life to feisty and unhinged monstergirls, then defeat your foes using careful positioning and strategical wit. From the downtrodden rise a revolting mafia; join them in a wild hunt for power, revenge, change... and love.
4960970.name: Monster Girl Tactics: Oubliette

4961250.desc: You are the prince of a small kingdom. Defend its castles from monsters in this tower defense game!
4961250.name: The Rookie Prince's Defense Trials

4961260.desc: Take a peek into the war history exhibitions of Mikkeli, Finland – the headquarters city of the Finnish army during World War II.
4961260.name: Gateway to Headquarters City

4962200.desc: Forge turrets at the anvil and pray for Eternal. An incremental idle tower defense where every strike rolls one of 11 rarities, from Common to impossibly rare. Socket glyphs, collect relics, grow your castle and break through five regions of monsters and bosses.
4962200.name: Very Very RARE

4962580.desc: Coloring Game: Girls 4 is a sequel to the double anti-stress game (coloring by numbers plus beautiful girls).
4962580.name: Coloring Game: Girls 4

4964810.desc: Minerooms is a first-person incremental mining game set in the backrooms. Mine thousands of blocks, collect energy, and feed an ancient statue to unlock permanent upgrades. Become faster and more powerful, blast deeper, and uncover what lies beyond.
4964810.name: Minerooms

4965130.desc: A shooter / gem collection game that lives in your files. Corridors combines high-score action with a fully functional, intuitive file and media explorer. Play in our preset world for competition, or turn your PC and its files into the setting. Lightweight, portable, runs native on most systems.
4965130.name: Corridors

4966990.desc: A pixel-art, turn-based roguelite deckbuilder where your cards are swords, axes and spears, and you throw them. Thrown weapons stay on the board: hit one with another to trigger Resonance, a combo attack that chains to nearby weapons. Synthesis moves abilities between weapons.
4966990.name: Arcane Abyss

4967770.desc: A cozy cartoon co-op pickup point simulator. Receive parcels, serve customers, protect fragile cargo and perishable food, then grow a tiny pickup point into a full-blown logistics hub. Play solo or with friends.
4967770.name: Fast Point

4968090.desc: 💕 Lovely Cafe is a cozy idle game with a romantic twist. Upgrade your cafe, serve sweet desserts, unlock charming girls, complete special orders, and turn a small cafe into a lovely place full of warmth, flirting, and sweet moments.
4968090.name: Lovely Cafe: Lusty Latte

4969000.desc: A single-player third-person linear action platformer. Use your vine arms to swing through three levels, grapple and launch yourself off of enemies, and throw two seeds to tether two objects as you master the fast-paced traversal and platforming.
4969000.name: Regradable

4970630.desc: Fill a giant 5,000,000-liter jar in the valley! Harvest your first honeycomb by hand, lay hose networks, and scale up to 10,000 liters/sec with drones and full automation. Unlock 200+ upgrades, play guitar on your farm, and uncover the jar's secret in this cozy 8-10 hour journey!
4970630.name: Beellionaire Incremental: Bee Simulator

4970750.desc: What would you say to a goblin if you could speak to it in your own words? Bribe it, lie to it, threaten it... or just chop its head off. Warrior Quest is an old-school dark-fantasy dungeon crawler where you can fight, sneak, bluff, or bargain your way through. Whatever you do, roll well!
4970750.name: Warrior Quest

4971410.desc: A multiplayer bullet hell where everyone is a tank.
4971410.name: Tankii

4971710.desc: Stock it, price it, sell it, and turn a small corner fruit shop into the neighborhood's favorite fruit store.
4971710.name: Fruit Store Simulator

4971980.desc: A short active incremental serving game where you run your own cafe! Wait on tables and serve food as orders keep coming in, expand your cafe to earn even more money, and pay off your grandma's debt!
4971980.name: Click Cafe

4972050.desc: Resettle is a deep incremental city builder where you develop settlements on islands. Strategically place buildings to maximize resource production, explore 10 different upgrade systems, and create a thriving island city.
4972050.name: Resettle

4972120.desc: Y2Kmeter is a free, open-source desktop audio analyzer with a retro pixel look. Explore loudness, levels, phase, dynamics and spectrum, plus audio-reactive visuals, a desktop virtual pet, fuse-bead pixel art and an analog VU meter. Poke every module in Toybox mode.
4972120.name: ⋆｡°✩ Y2K Meter ✩°｡⋆

4972690.desc: You’re Blue Guy—elite SWAT, last clean suit left. Kite toxic bugs while your loadout auto-fires, then fight from the Forest through the Desert to the leaking Factory. Five skulls a zone. Wipe the hive.
4972690.name: Blue Guy Must Die

4973160.desc: A card battle RPG with enchanting heroines 🔥 Rise through the arena, dungeons, and campaign, building your deck and your strength. Then get to know the girls fighting beside you — flirt, talk, and grow closer through real dates!
4973160.name: Dirty Deal

4973920.desc: It goes in the square hole! Squircle is neon pinball meets crazy golf, and it's super cool (just trust me, okay). Fire glowing shapes, bounce them off everything and sink each one into its matching hole. Simple, right? Right up until there are six of them.
4973920.name: Squircle

4974650.desc: In this life sim management play as a young woman stranded with crushing debts. Manage time between odd jobs, street clients, upgrading outfits, gambling, and helping townsfolk. Use your body to earn fast cash to repay your loan before the Debt Collector comes calling!
4974650.name: Streetwalker Life!

4974960.desc: A first-person psychological survival horror set in the abandoned Baku subway. Explore dark tunnels, solve puzzles, investigate disturbing mysteries, and make emotional choices while trying to survive against terrifying horrors.
4974960.name: The Last Station - Baku

4975340.desc: Zero-gravity pool, seen through a porthole in the cue ball, because that's where you are. Fifteen numbered balls float in a sealed room with a pocket in every corner. Every shot throws you backward: it's how you get around, and how you sink yourself. Solo, vs a bot, or with a friend on one screen.
4975340.name: 3D Bumper Billiards

4976270.desc: Someone Seems to Be in “My” Room! The renowned writer Koi wakes up in the middle of the night, but finds himself unable to fall back asleep…
4976270.name: A Warm Story

4977170.desc: A unique robot fighting action game built around simple controls, precise timing, and martial arts-inspired combat.
4977170.name: ROBOTEKA

4978030.desc: A temporary backstage job becomes a dangerous affair with Mira, a charismatic mime who speaks most through silence. Help her build a show, hide your secret, make difficult choices, and unlock 5 endings in this adult visual novel.
4978030.name: My Lovely Mime: Silent Affair

4978080.desc: Chain cards by matching suits or ranks, then use strategic sequencing and item combos to rack up explosive scores. Turn your debt-ridden life around at Maou-chan’s casino in this single-player card game.
4978080.name: CARTA CHAIN: Maou-chan’s Deal

4982580.desc: Top-down arcade football for the whole crew. Up to 6 players on one couch, or online with friends over Steam. Tournaments, football-tennis, penalties, minigames and legendary moments to fire up the match. Easy to pick up, impossible to put down. Grab a controller and score!
4982580.name: 3 Estrellas

4983040.desc: A Minesweeper incremental game where you mine resources, upgrade your pickaxe and stats, and avoid being killed by enemies on your way to revealing ancient relics.
4983040.name: Would you mine?

4983490.desc: Build an impossible army: knights that become unicorns, queens that cross the edges, phoenixes that rise again. Lead it through a roguelite Story of bosses, merchants and perks that bend the rules, then put it to the test online.
4983490.name: Last Gambit

4984370.desc: Roll five dice and chase poker hands to summon a minion army, then watch it fight. Hold, reroll, recruit, and counter your way down 100 floors in this roguelite auto battler.
4984370.name: Of Dice and Minions

4984400.desc: Word Game Tower Defense. Spell AXE to harvest wood. Spell FORT to make an armored tower. Every word you spell becomes a tower with unique stats and powers. Every word is also a unique level with procedural challenges. 121,683 levels. Together we must clear them all to reach paradise.
4984400.name: Towers of Babble

4985310.desc: Single Player Action Third-Person Shooter Game Featuring Sexy Female Protagonist
4985310.name: Sara The Sexy Thief Censored!

4986050.desc: Tired of boring network diagrams? Network & Cyber Security Simulator takes networking and cybersecurity into an interactive first-person (FPS) simulation game! Learn by doing, configure realistic CLI terminals from scratch, solve technical puzzles, and become the digital architect!
4986050.name: Network & Cyber Security Simulator

4986330.desc: Your hands are the controller. Wave at your webcam, pinch to grab blocks, and stack a tower tall enough to carry the key to the lock. Solve physics puzzles across 90+ levels of wood, stone, glass, rope, and hope. Webcam required.
4986330.name: Handsy

4986360.desc: Untitled Shop Game in a nutshell: anime stylized graphics, wide open area in a fictional Polish city, 50+ songs in the playlist, and 300+ decorations to place without any limits. Oh, I almost forgot... Yes, you can pet the cat!
4986360.name: Untitled Shop Game

4986500.desc: "One line for battle, infinite possibilities for strategy!" Reclaim the top of the Demon Army with the ultimate combination.
4986500.name: Lineup, Dark Lord! : Auto Battler

4986680.desc: A free financial and reference terminal for your Magic: The Gathering collection built around Secret Lair drops and preconstructed decks. See what you own, what it's worth, and whether it paid off. Local-first: no account, no cloud, your data stays on your PC.
4986680.name: Mana Ledger

4987490.desc: Run a cozy bakery for cats! Experiment with ingredients, discover new recipes, serve your feline customers, and uncover six interconnected stories, each told from the perspective of a different cat.
4987490.name: Cats Love Cakes

4988110.desc: Shuttle Hearts - Academy Smash is a fast-paced 2D badminton game starring girls from different school clubs, each with unique abilities. Play online (beta, full version only), locally with a friend, or against the CPU. Use six shot types, SP Shots, and SP Skills in Story Mode and Versus!
4988110.name: Shuttle Hearts - Academy Smash

4988280.desc: There is a pretty big pile of colored cubes. Sort those cubes by color into trucks. That is pretty much all there is! This game came to me in a dream, so I made it. Treat it as something to chip away at over time, slowly uncovering whatever lies within the pile.
4988280.name: The Pretty Big Pile

4988400.desc: Raiders want your crew's dig, and they don't need to take it. They just need to break the dam. Hold the line in this first-person tower defense: build and power turrets, patch the gates under fire, and pump out the flood before the pit goes under.
4988400.name: The Last Levee

4988440.desc: GUGUGAGA! Sudoku! Minesweeper! Combined gameplay!! Plus, you can play online with friends!!!
4988440.name: GUGUGAGA: PEEKABOO

4989110.desc: Run your dream TCG shop! Stock shelves, open card packs, customize your store, and hire staff. Collect cards, build powerful decks, and even compete in tournaments all the way to the World Championship!
4989110.name: TCG Shop Life

4989970.desc: Pot o' Gnomes is a destruction-based pot-building roguelite, where you draw lines of falling gnomes to blow up plants, rocks, and everything in between. Craft your run from various biomes, choose from powerful items, and set off ridiculous explosion chains!
4989970.name: Pot O' Gnomes

4990840.desc: Model, paint, and blend in! FAKE ME is an online multiplayer hide-and-seek game where you create your own disguise. Use simple 3D modeling tools to build the object you’ll hide as. You can also create your own costume by modeling. Hide from the Seekers or find every Faker before time runs out!
4990840.name: FAKE ME

4990940.desc: Run your own PC shop with friends! Build and repair computers, diagnose faulty parts, stock shelves, set prices, sell hardware and custom PCs, serve customers, manage orders, upgrade your store, unlock new components and grow your business together.
4990940.name: PC Store Together

4992410.desc: Colorways is a minimalist traffic management game in which you help colorful traffic navigate various intersections while avoiding traffic jams and accidents. Unique modifiers and daily challenges present ever-changing levels and opportunities to climb the leaderboards.
4992410.name: Colorways

4992440.desc: One gun to conquer the universe. Every trigger squeeze, mag dump, and slam on the bolt release inches you closer and closer to full domination in this incremental idler.
4992440.name: One Gun Army

4992660.desc: Kenguin Sting, a failed horror writer, buys a cheap asset-store house to write his masterpiece. His only job: feed the cats. And keep Grandma on her pills. And survive 4 days and 4 nights. An absurd parody horror game.
4992660.name: Scawy Game

4992770.desc: A purely minimalist, text-based idle incremental game! Focused on time management and strategic planning, carefully prioritize your action queue under strict time limits. Death is inevitable, but every loop makes you stronger. Build your automation routines and break the infinite loop!
4992770.name: Infinite Loop: Incremental

4993270.desc: Command frontlines directly in a real time territorial strategy game. Push borders, link settlements with supply roads, and break defenses with cavalry and naval landings. Includes six historical campaigns, Skirmish, a built in map editor, and online matches for up to eight players.
4993270.name: Palisade

4993610.desc: Imperionis is a turn-based tactical RPG about a Roman commander and his centuria, inspired by late-1990s wargames. Command a Roman unit during Caesar’s Gallic Wars, develop your troops, manage your camp, and fight battles on hex-based maps with autobattle or manual combat.
4993610.name: Imperionis

4993730.desc: A PSX-style horror game set in an abandoned household. Do the chores, uncover what happened here, and survive whatever's sharing the house .
4993730.name: Arachnid

4993890.desc: A medieval Tower Defense x Autobattler Roguelite. Defend your Keep across escalating waves, recruit different unit types, and cast spells from different Schools of Magic. Spend what you earn on a skill tree with over 300 upgrades, and place them on a Decree Bar with many unique modifiers and mults.
4993890.name: For Our King

4993930.desc: Pixel Worker is a pixel-art work-life simulation where you take jobs, earn money, appraise gear, raise pets, mine, fish, cut jade, trade stocks, and play casino mini-games as you build your own path through a lively city.
4993930.name: Pixel Worker

4994180.desc: Turn a pocketful of change into a fortune by cracking open card packs and cashing in what's inside. Chase rare pulls, fill your binders, and pour your profits into flashier upgrades and higher-tier packs. Grade your best pulls, sell them to collectors, and build your card empire.
4994180.name: Packs To Riches

4994750.desc: Build an outrageous deck of alien cards and deploy them onto the battle field. Unleash game-breaking combos in this tactical roguelite deckbuilder.
4994750.name: Nick vs the Brick of Ick from space

4995460.desc: A co-op restaurant management sim for 1-4 players. Chop, fry and plate orders against a ticking clock, then spend the takings between shifts on new appliances, conveyor automation, knocked-down walls and a second restaurant across town.
4995460.name: Tiny Chef

4996860.desc: A fan-made game based on the K-pop group NCT, where you play as different members, carrying out various missions until you uncover the secrets of a hostile organization......
4996860.name: 《失调～Dissonance》

4996910.desc: Defend the Core in this incremental tower defense. Survive relentless enemy waves, unlock new abilities, and collect gems of different rarities that completely transform each run. Experiment with endless combinations and create unique strategies to overcome ever-growing challenges.
4996910.name: Nullnest

4997480.desc: Draw maps, make nations fight and create historical or fantasy timelapses with Mapping Creator: a tool to unleash creativity!
4997480.name: Mapping Creator

4999850.desc: The curated soundtrack to First Light: 33 tracks across Quiet Mornings, Easy Evenings and Arcade Nights. An hour and a half of music, from kitchens at sunrise to night drives and arcade glow, each track with its own cover art. The one vocal track, There You Are, opens the album and ends the game.
4999850.name: First Light Soundtrack

4999870.desc: Climb, Cube, Climb! is a hybrid rage game and precision platformer where the primary obstacle standing in your way is gravity. Employ a diverse set of movement skills to ascend to the top, but be wary: falling is a guarantee.
4999870.name: Climb, Cube, Climb!

50.desc: Return to the Black Mesa Research Facility as one of the military specialists assigned to eliminate Gordon Freeman. Experience an entirely new episode of single player action. Meet fierce alien opponents, and experiment with new weaponry. Named 'Game of the Year' by the Academy of Interactive Arts and Sciences.
50.name: Half-Life: Opposing Force

500.desc: From Valve (the creators of Counter-Strike, Half-Life and more) comes Left 4 Dead, a co-op action horror game for the PC and Xbox 360 that casts up to four players in an epic struggle for survival against swarming zombie hordes and terrifying mutant monsters.
500.name: Left 4 Dead

5000170.desc: A survival horror game for 1–4 players. Operate a giant drilling machine. Explore caves, collect valuables, and escape the creatures below. Return to the surface to sell what you found and buy upgrades and equipment. Play solo or in online co-op.
5000170.name: BORE

5000500.desc: 《少女三国志》是一款融合三国历史与异世界幻想的二次元策略RPG。三国英魂因时空裂隙降临星魂大陆，以少女之身重获力量，与魔魇军团展开跨越世界的战争。收集传奇英魂，组建最强阵容，探索隐藏真相，开启属于你的全新三国篇章。
5000500.name: 少女三国志

5001650.desc: Blörbit, blob it, orbit, beat it. Now hiring: blobs for smooth 2D twin-stick combat. Couch co-op welcome. Build your own roguelite career against endless opposition. No experience necessary.
5001650.name: blorbit

5001770.desc: Build and grow your own farm and roadside market. Grow crops, raise animals, craft valuable products, set prices, hire employees, stock your shelves, serve customers, and expand your small operation into a thriving business.
5001770.name: Farmstead Market Simulator

5002090.desc: Untangle a garden of colorful worms in 1,500 logic puzzles. Find a clear path, click a worm and make room for the next one. Solve untimed campaign levels, return for a daily puzzle, or chase combos and high scores in Rush mode.
5002090.name: Loamlets

5004380.desc: A first-person dungeon crawler with a classic turn-based JRPG heart. Explore The Below in real time, then snap seamlessly into pure menu battles. Bank your loot to rebuild your ruined town - or gamble it diving deeper. Death costs only what you didn't bank. The world only grows.
5004380.name: DelveWright

5005030.desc: Talk to air traffic control with your own voice. inFlight ATC adds AI controllers to Microsoft Flight Simulator 2020 and 2024: hold push-to-talk, make the call, hear the reply. Clearance to taxi-in, live traffic on frequency, SimBrief plans. One-time purchase, no subscription.
5005030.name: inFlight ATC

5005580.desc: A neon bullet heaven at absurd scale. Thousands of wireframe enemies, one auto-firing interceptor, and a grid floor that buckles beneath the swarm. Draft augments, evolve your weapons, and survive a boss every five waves — until the Black Hole arrives at wave thirty, then it's the Finale wave!
5005580.name: Nova Protocol

5005700.desc: Muv-Luv Girls Garden Mellow Days is a productivity companion adventure game where you work alongside Meru Momozono. Customize your Pomodoro timer, to-do list, calendar, music, and ambient sounds. As you spend more time together, your story with Meru gradually unfolds.
5005700.name: MUV-LUV GIRLS GARDEN Mellow Days

5005890.desc: Battle your friends as chaotic animal tanks in fast-paced local or online PvP! Collect game-breaking upgrade cards, bounce bullets around unpredictable arenas, and outsmart your opponents in booming 2–4 player matches.
5005890.name: Boomimals

5006530.desc: Geralt of Rivia returns to the Path in The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Songs of the Past — a brand new expansion to one of the best-selling role-playing games of all time. Explore an entirely new region, quests, and characters in an authentic Witcher story of choices and consequences.
5006530.name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Songs of the Past

5007330.desc: YAZAN is a 2D psychological anomaly game. Navigate a looping valley, inspect your surroundings for what doesn't belong, and turn back or press forward to make ten correct decisions and escape the loop.
5007330.name: YAZAN: Lost Child

5010300.desc: Explore eight provinces in a charming chibi world of the Three Kingdoms. Recruit legendary heroes, build thriving cities, and develop local industries through the seasons. Fulfill requests, discover your companions’ stories, and create a peaceful realm.
5010300.name: Greetings, My Lord

5011370.desc: The idle MMO that lives above your Windows taskbar. Chop, smelt, slay and raid with your clan while you work. Every item you loot trades on the Steam Community Market · gear, keys, chests, even the pets. Free to play. No ads, no energy, no subscription.
5011370.name: Lowbar Legends

5011760.desc: CHUM Fishing is a cooperative multiplayer horror fishing game. As alien caretakers assigned to these terrifying waters, you and your friends must catch enough monstrous fish to feed the unknown beings lurking beneath the surface. But their appetites grow larger with each passing day.
5011760.name: CHUM Fishing

5012130.desc: Sort a tabletop full of colorful pills with a counting spatula. Pill & Chill is a relaxing, physics-based organizing game with no pressure, and lots of satisfying little sounds.
5012130.name: Pill & Chill

5012180.desc: Arcade space shooter. You are a courier with one package to deliver across a broken galaxy. Plane-like flight, fights with pirates, the old army and aliens in a 20+ mission story campaign. Pick your ship and mods between missions. No grind, no filler.
5012180.name: Stellar Courier

5013290.desc: IdleKing is a dark fairy-tale idle loot RPG with online co-op. Auto-battle monsters and bosses, collect and upgrade your gear, and grow ever stronger. Adventure solo or team up with up to three friends to take on tougher challenges!
5013290.name: Idle King: Loot Together

5013410.desc: Three minutes of daylight. Ninety seconds of night. TIDE OR HIDE is a 1-4 player co-op survival game where the deep water guarding your camp drains away every night - zone by zone - and armed hunters come for what you stockpiled. Gather, arm up, and hold until dawn.
5013410.name: TIDE OR HIDE

5013700.desc: Read immersive dialogue sequences, make crucial choices to shift the storyline, and unlock multiple distinct endings in this story-focused visual novel. Your decisions alter character relationships and rewrite the fate of every role.
5013700.name: 无人归家

5013880.desc: Drift off to your whole library — MythTunes is the cozy pixel-art player for gamers and long nights. Play local OSTs and folders, vibe to built-in Lofi & Vibe, turn screenshots into skins, and tune pixel fonts, themes, and global hotkeys. Fully offline — no cloud, no ads, just your music.
5013880.name: MythTunes: OST, Lofi & BGM Player

5014420.desc: Cat Survivor is a minefield auto-battler where mines become your greatest weapon. Read the numbers, place your flags, trigger explosive chain reactions, and wipe out entire hordes. Win with strategy, not brute force.
5014420.name: Cat Survivor

5015050.desc: An incremental apocalyptic survival builder with research, expeditions, events, raids, and resource balancing. Found a settlement, gather resources, and try to keep the roof on while the wasteland keeps knocking.
5015050.name: Apocalypticlick

5015320.desc: Mage Cat: Endless Breakout Survivor is a 2D cartoon action survivor. Play as a magic cat, dodge foes, and build power with strategy cards and bonds. Upgrade talents and gear, then conquer campaign, Abyss, and Endless modes.
5015320.name: Mage Cat:Endless Breakout Survivor

5015590.desc: AI Lab Tycoon drops you into the infancy of the AI revolution in 2016. Starting with nothing but a check from a skeptical investor, you'll build an empire of superintelligence over the course of two decades. Can you lead the greatest technological revolution in human history?
5015590.name: AI Lab Tycoon

5016240.desc: A laid-back sci-fi adventure about making friends at a school in space (Sora). You play a friend-seeking, space-born human at a new school full of alien students of every species. Talk to everyone—grow close or drift apart—and uncover the mystery hidden within the school.
5016240.name: Classroom in Sora

5016250.desc: A dice game scored on Yahtzee hands. Roll, hold what's worth keeping, roll the rest again. Clear the target score and you move down a stage, and a shop opens in between. On the way down you hit stages where the dealer has bent one rule.
5016250.name: Lucky Hell

5017070.desc: Sweet KOL - A simple and beautiful jigsaw puzzle game themed around livestreaming girls. Enjoy relaxing moments with five pretty and cute livestreaming girls after their broadcasts, accompanied by soothing music. After completing a level, you can view the girls' photos in the gallery.
5017070.name: Sweet KOL

5017150.name: Fleeting Requests: Freya and Ray Demo

5019070.desc: Dusky's Nook is a cozy idle desktop game about a little mushroom guy living his life on a floating island, anywhere on your screen. He gathers mushrooms and head pats, levels up, and unlocks new looks for the island — and a friend or two along the way.
5019070.name: Dusky's Nook

5019800.desc: Top-down co-op survival action RPG for 1–4 players in a world the System turned into a game. Earn levels, quests and psychic powers, scavenge the ruins, fight zombies and build an underground bunker for survivors — then find out what the System really wants.
5019800.name: System Arrival

5020720.desc: Grow your settlement, automate production, explore the surrounding lands, and trade with your neighbors to repay a debt of 1 BILLION gold!
5020720.name: A BILLION GOLD DEBT

5021660.desc: 21 windows. One real sniper. Two decoys. Scan the building, identify the threat, and take your shot without harming civilians. Test your observation, accuracy, and decision-making against the computer or challenge another player in asynchronous tactical sniper duels.
5021660.name: Scope Sweeper

5021760.desc: Deckbuilding roguelike with new twists! Over 30 heroes whose abilities warp the rules, hundreds of summons, spells and artifacts to discover. And you can even DESIGN YOUR OWN cards at the Forge!
5021760.name: Deck Breaker - A Roguelike Deckbuilder

5022940.desc: Will you defy your faith to spare the one you love? Fight through a dark, gothic world of side-scrolling action, deadly creatures, and brutal bosses in a modern reimagining of classic retro action games.
5022940.name: Accursed

5023620.desc: Lead a band of Viking raiders in search of wealth and glory in this turn-based tactical RPG. Recruit warriors, customize their abilities, and battle across deadly hex-based maps. Burn, plunder, and press onward for greater riches but rising enemy resistance could cost you everything you’ve gained.
5023620.name: Raiding Season

5024380.desc: A Three Kingdoms roguelite auto-battler. Recruit and upgrade generals, build powerful synergies with cards and equipment, and arrange your formation before your team clashes in automatic battles. Test your builds against other players' teams in asynchronous PvP.
5024380.name: Sangoku Bump

5026140.desc: Sister Novitiates stand ready to smite all who oppose the God-Emperor! Warriors of unwavering faith, sacred purpose and zeal, they bring his wrath to the unfaithful. Though not yet full Sisters of the Adepta Sororitas, their station is no measure of their might.
5026140.name: Warhammer 40,000: Darktide - Sisters Novitiate Class

5026150.desc: Sister Novitiates stand ready to smite all who oppose the God-Emperor! Warriors of unwavering faith, sacred purpose and zeal, they bring his wrath to the unfaithful. Though not yet full Sisters of the Adepta Sororitas, their station is no measure of their might.
5026150.name: Warhammer 40,000: Darktide - Sisters Novitiate Class Deluxe Edition

5026590.desc: You left your job for a relaxed farm life, but you can’t stop scrolling. Plant, water and harvest crops, chase rare mutations and hire goblin companions. Resist the urge to check your phone, grow your focus, and turn a humble plot into a goblin farming empire.
5026590.name: Goblin Island

5027500.desc: Your child joined the school concert band. Somehow, you ended up its director. Scold the ones who skip rehearsal and the band gets better. That evening, your child doesn't say much. Three years. Nine endings.
5027500.name: 1000 Days with My Kid's Concert Band

5027890.desc: A roguelike city builder on a sunny island inspired by Singapore. Place homes, offices, food markets and train stations, recruit a Cabinet of eccentric advisors, and multiply your Support into enough Votes to win the next Election. Your first term is free.
5027890.name: Majulah: Shape Your City – Prologue

5029580.desc: Work With Script is screenplay-centered production software for film, video games, and theatre. Write, plan, collaborate, compose, budget, and organize your entire production around the story — all in one focused creative workspace.
5029580.name: Work With Script

5029710.desc: Multiplayer hide‑and‑seek party game featuring painting systems, fully customisable match rules and unique special abilities including clone power（kagebunshin）,optical‑camouflage(kougakumeisai 2620). Play with friends and compete across varied modes.
5029710.name: mechakucha pakurion

5029940.desc: A Japanese mystery adventure where any of the four could be the killer. Holding the dead man's will, you stay in his estate until the seventh-day memorial. Question the household across 13 locations, but you get only ten moves. Motive, opportunity and proof decide what your accusation is worth.
5029940.name: The Seventh Day at the Tsubaki House - Whoever You Accuse Is Guilty

5031150.desc: 2030: AI companions reshape romance. As an emotion engineer with missing memories, you awaken in a tangled love affair. A commanding boss, an awakened AI, an anti-AI rebel, and a mysterious system enter your life. Each choice rewrites fate. Is algorithmic love still love?
5031150.name: HelloLove2:Binary

5032040.desc: Join the Jiuxiao Sword Sect as its youngest junior sister and pursue five distinctive senior brothers in an AI-driven xianxia romance. Speak freely, learn their preferences, respect their boundaries, and shape each relationship before the countdown to losing your cultivation reaches zero.
5032040.name: 100个师兄爱上我

5032670.desc: The Fantastic Four's most powerful member and their greatest adversary are here! Play as The Invisible Woman and Doctor Doom or face the perils of Castle Doomstadt in a brand new game mode, now in our second DLC for MARVEL Cosmic Invasion!
5032670.name: MARVEL Cosmic Invasion - The Siege of Castle Doom

5032890.desc: Build a medieval settlement into a thriving regional power. Manage villagers, production, seasons and trade; explore a living world, establish resource outposts, forge alliances, and defend your people from bandits and hardship.
5032890.name: Medieval Adventure

5033060.desc: Menthal is a first-person horror game where you are the test subject. Take experimental medicine, endure the side effects, and try to survive what happens next.
5033060.name: Menthal

5033090.desc: A remote island worships light energy as the source of all life. When that faith begins to fail, three protagonists must confront a changing world in this story-driven visual novel featuring alternative rock style original soundtracks.
5033090.name: 孤岛的动物园 - 第四章

5034320.desc: 『いつまでも美シク - Villa NEPENTHES -』は、探索するほど老いていく、孤島館ホラーADV。若さを奪う館の真相を暴き、偽装工作で敵を欺き、崩れゆく島から脱出せよ。
5034320.name: いつまでも美シク - Villa NEPENTHES -

5034850.desc: Build a jewel-clearing machine, chain cascading matches and pay off eight contracts. Vera, the House’s reserved collector, visits between workdays and knows your machine better than she admits. Upgrade, retire and build again with a lasting Legacy. Play in 13 languages on Windows.
5034850.name: Jewel Reels

5035380.desc: Collect hundreds of thousands of golf balls, earn money, buy new tools, and clean up the golf yard. BALL PICKER is an active incremental game centered on the quiet satisfaction of tidying up.
5035380.name: BALL PICKER - Clean Up the Golf Yard

5036430.desc: Program a combat robot and send it to battle against other robots.
5036430.name: Coding War

5036510.desc: Kreabordis is a puzzle game where you have to strategically place creatures on a board to score the most points. Defeat challengers, maximize your points in tricky puzzles and find the perfect move.
5036510.name: Kreabordis

5036870.desc: Psychological horror at a morgue's night intake desk. Every body arrives with paperwork that has to match it. Weigh it, measure it, take its temperature, listen to its chest. Some still have a pulse. The rulebook gains a page every night, and some of what you sign in does not stay signed in.
5036870.name: PLEASE CONFIRM THE DECEASED

5036970.desc: A pixel-art idle RPG docked to the edge of your screen. Your hero climbs a 10,000-floor tower while you work: 12-rarity loot, 4 classes, key-gated bosses, a deep forge and a Paragon Constellation. And it keeps earning while it's closed.
5036970.name: AFKTower

5037200.desc: just volleyball is an online and offline volleyball game with unique yet intuitive controls and deep player expression. take on others in anything from 1v1s & 2v2s to full team-based 6v6 matches. there's no right way to play, it's just volleyball!
5037200.name: just volleyball

5038400.desc: Multiplayer blackjack in a bar that never closes. Keep your buzz burning or die of sobriety, fling your empties at the other players, and outlast every gambler at the table.
5038400.name: JOINT LIABILITY

5039030.desc: The world has gone dark! and only your hamsters can fix it. Spin the wheel, collect strange little hamsters and upgrade until your room powers the city, the country and the whole planet. A cozy incremental clicker that keeps running while you're away.
5039030.name: Wheel Be Fine

5040220.desc: HoloCozy is a cozy idle desktop companion where you can spend relaxing time with hololive talents in their rooms. Enjoy music and ambient sounds, keep your favorite characters close, and watch them grow at your own pace while you work, study, or unwind.
5040220.name: HoloCozy

5041950.desc: A romance-driven narrative about destiny, devotion, and the dangerous pull of belonging, set against the ruins of a long‑lost city calling you home.
5041950.name: Beyond The Mist: Beginnings

5043330.desc: "Snake Echos: your trail hardens into deadly walls. Loop enemies into your own path, level up with Magnet/Fireball/Scythe abilities, survive escalating chaos with blocks and lasers. Solo leaderboard + Duel mode. 3 difficulty tiers.
5043330.name: Snake Echos

5044500.desc: This is a first-person indie horror game. You play as a video blogger exploring an abandoned hospital, uncovering the dark secrets hidden within its walls.
5044500.name: Palehollow Hospital | 灰谷医院

5044750.desc: Become a stylish Mole armed with a three-claw grappling hook and dig your way to fortune! Snatch valuable ores, earn gold, unlock powerful upgrades, expand your mining automation, and build the ultimate underground mining empire in this satisfying incremental adventure.
5044750.name: Mole & Ore

5044910.desc: By tracing lines across matching tiles on the gameboard to battle foes and gather resources, Dungeon Quest delivers a dungeon‑crawling turn‑based RPG with an old‑school soul. Explore the depths, uncover secrets, gather loot, and grow your arsenal of unique abilities.
5044910.name: Destined Dungeon Quest

5045040.desc: The world’s smallest idle monster-collecting RPG. Hatch special monsters from eggs and trade with players around the world. Battles play out automatically, so don’t stop until you’ve built the strongest squad!
5045040.name: Traymon World: Taskbar Monster RPG

5045300.desc: A new adventure begins for SPIN, a girl from the Demon Realm. Meet new friends, grow stronger, and explore the unfamiliar Human World. SPIN's own story begins in a bright and cheerful fantasy adventure.
5045300.name: Spin of the Demon Realm

5045330.desc: Make your way through levels packed with traps and puzzles, put your reflexes and wits to the test, and take on increasingly difficult challenges.
5045330.name: DOTARIX

5045430.desc: Japanese anomaly-horror mystery at an inn on the afterlife's border. Obey each night's new rule as something creeps in; stare to note earlier guests' traces as it comes. By morning, write in the Register who they were, how they died. The rules never lie; a thing may pose as what the rules name.
5045430.name: 宿の掟 / Rules of the Inn

5045680.desc: The aliens have given humanity 8 hours before Earth is destroyed. Use a Gravity Gun to lift anything in the city, build your own path to the giant UFO, and save the planet solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players.
5045680.name: Not Now, Aliens!

5045780.desc: Suspicious Minds is a real-time AI interrogation simulator where every spoken or typed response dynamically shapes your fate.
5045780.name: Suspicious Minds: interrogation simulator

5049210.desc: Ignite the spark of inspiration while writing tales in a cozy environment where readers become part of the creative process. Follow stories as they're being written, interact with other authors, shape worlds through your ideas, earn reputation, unlock unique abilities, and get rewarded for your aid.
5049210.name: Spark of Tales

5049560.desc: Alone at School: Christmas is an atmospheric horror walking simulator. Arriving at school before everyone else on Christmas morning, you soon realize that someone, or something, is already waiting for you in the empty halls.
5049560.name: Alone at  School:Christmas

5051090.desc: Take a well-deserved break before searching for your next job! Spend time doing all the things you've always wanted to: cook delicious meals, relax, collect cute figurines, chat with friends, and enjoy life at your own pace. Work can wait a little longer... you've earned this vacation.
5051090.name: The Cozy Funemployment

5052180.desc: Discover the traditional Japanese 🎴Hanafuda (花札 - Flower Cards) games, brought to life as a beautiful, modern 3D tabletop game. Match cards to create pairs, complete a set and collect points, or call Koi-Koi to risk it all for more. Play against the computer, or other players online.
5052180.name: Hanafuda

5052710.desc: A live-action interactive romance. Lin Yu joins a travel dating show as its only male contestant after failing his exams. Meet four women in first person, shape relationships through dates and choices, and discover multiple endings. Is the love on camera real?
5052710.name: lucky me

5052960.desc: The Endless Harvest is an idle village-builder crossed with a tower defense. Build a farm that earns money on its own, invest it in towers and upgrades, and survive waves of raiders that grow stronger every round. Production continues while the game is closed — how far will you get?
5052960.name: The Endless Harvest

5053000.desc: Start with one machine and grow across five factories in this idle/incremental game. Build production chains, research better parts and reinvest your profits. Find the bottleneck, choose your next upgrade and work toward a final goal.
5053000.name: From Zero: Idle Factory

5053040.desc: Enter unstable dreams, recover a missing past, and choose whether to respect or rewrite the desires of six women in this is erotic, choice-driven, psychological, adult visual novel.
5053040.name: Sexception: The Dark Seeds
