5053640.desc: A co-op tactical RPG set on the eve of the year 1000. Lead a free company of mercenaries across a doom-haunted medieval world. Take the contracts, win the fights, and decide what your company becomes before the millennium turns.
5053640.name: Free Company

5053940.desc: Build the theme park of your dreams. Lay the roads, place the rides, open the shops and keep every guest smiling from the gate to the last bus home. A bright, cozy park builder with a ten-location campaign, free play with no limits, and a front-seat view of every ride you put down.
5053940.name: Amusement Factory

5054700.desc: In Fakin’ It XL, one player, the Faker, never gets the prompt and has to bluff their way through. Choose in-room or remote play up front, and get round types built for either. New content, new question types, same lying and grilling you love.
5054700.name: Fakin It XL

5054950.desc: I'm Your Boss, Olivia! - This is a visual novel where you take on the role of the boss of a company where a lustful employee named Olivia works. Office challenges, funny jokes, and lots of sex await you.
5054950.name: I'm Your Boss, Olivia!

5054990.desc: Sex-Pop Demon Hunters: Kinky Crimes continues the saga of the original game 🎵 😈 Join our demon half-blood protagonist for brand-new challenges, captivating new beauties, and steamier encounters than ever before in this story-driven DLC 🔥🔥🔥
5054990.name: Sex-Pop Demon Hunters - Kinky Crimes

5055010.desc: Bounce through a hand-drawn world of sweet chocolate and soft marshmallows! Relax to delightful animations, play at your own comfortable pace, and gently learn real chess tactics along the way. Play cozy, play smart, and watch your tiny pawn evolve! 🍫✨
5055010.name: Life of Pawn: Chocolate and Marshmallow

5056320.desc: Fantorob is a futuristic take on classic monster-taming genre. Build robots and fight against your opponents to collect components and upgrade your team in this thrilling turn-based combat RPG with brain-twisting puzzles. Join the journey to become the greatest robot master!
5056320.name: Fantorob

5056840.desc: Enter a block-sized world and conquer the world by defending your towers in this colorful strategy game!
5056840.name: Toybox Tactics

5057050.desc: Rulebound is a surreal horror incremental game where survival depends on split attention. Trapped in the Void, play a strange disc-merging game on an old CRT TV. Bounce and merge discs, buy upgrades, and forge 3 Golden Discs while watching for entities in the dark.
5057050.name: Rulebound

5057800.desc: An incremental loot game where you drop your heroes onto hordes of slimes. They do the fighting, you grab the loot and fill your treasure chest. When time runs out, it bursts and rains it all back down. Upgrade your army in a huge skill tree and go again for a bigger haul.
5057800.name: When Chests Rain Tons of Loot

5058180.desc: 《BLINDFOLD: Sound Chase》 is an asymmetric online tag game where one blindfolded seeker faces off against several runners. An invisible seeker and runners who are in danger if they make a sound. A simple game of tag turns into a tense psychological battle.
5058180.name: BLINDFOLD: Sound Chase

5059840.desc: Spike Force is a roguelite deckbuilder soaked in 90's action anime. Build your volleyball team, draft your cards, and represent your school in a supernatural battle for the fate of humanity. Every match is a fight for survival, and every card is a move in the game.
5059840.name: Spike Force

5061060.desc: Plum is a 3d cozy platforming and collectathon game where you will have to roll and bounce through the valley in search for home. On your way, meet different ghost plums each which a story to share. This game is a colorful stylized short adventure (about 1h) made to chill or speedrunning.
5061060.name: Plum

5061290.desc: A cozy first-person sorting game set in a cluttered 1980s basement. Find thousands of scattered dice, identify their sets and return each one to the correct display. Play solo or in co-op, choose a fantasy class and unlock magical powers that make sorting easier.
5061290.name: Roll for Order: Sort Every Set!

5061450.desc: Suika games have evolved! CyberKitty: Neon Merge is a cozy, yet action-driven, dynamic 2D physics puzzle game for 90s retro, pixel art, and match-3 fans! Instead of watermelons, merge a cast of colourful cats. With the CatCade system, swiftly match kitties to boost your multiplier for mega scores!
5061450.name: CyberKitty: Neon Merge

5061890.desc: The definitive pirate-themed roguelite word game. Use letters from your grid to make words that move you along the treasure map, then obtain tools and powerful charms to keep the expedition going. With a pool of over 300 effects to discover, every run is unique and sometimes there's a coconut.
5061890.name: Scramshaw

5062420.desc: An idle RPG for the corner of your screen. Follow Iris's long adventure, battle for equipment and resources, and grow Life Skills like Mining, Logging, Fishing, Cooking, Farming, Writing, Painting, and Commerce. Play or step away—Iris's day goes on.
5062420.name: Iris's Idle Log

5062970.desc: Launch balls! Upgrade the board! Earn mountains of medals—and keep paying off your debt! A short pachinko incremental with a skill tree that keeps giving you new ways to earn!
5062970.name: Incremental Pachinko Heaven

5064170.desc: Your weapons fire on their own. Your job is to keep moving. Wall-run, dash and bunny-hop through hordes of monsters across 11 worlds, and turn 71 weapons and 131 items into an unstoppable build. Play solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players.
5064170.name: Go Next!

5064300.desc: We want to create a "warm-hearted rogue" — not just endless cycles of death and stat grinding, but meaningful stories behind every return. The martial world is not just about fighting and killing; it's also about human relationships and the complexities of life.
5064300.name: Wuxia Survivor: Return

5065500.desc: Do the math and survive the aftermath. An easy-to-learn card battler: pull off math combos, get stuck in a fraction, stack functions until the numbers go absurd, break the enemy lines, try not to divide by zero. Real, modern, correct math. But when math isn't enough, resort to more arcane means...
5065500.name: Vinculum

5066010.desc: Here Comes the Horde is an incremental auto-battler where your vast armies defend your castle against hordes of undead enemies. Survive the attacks, unlock new units, obtain powerful abilities, and fill the screen with thousands of troops.
5066010.name: Here Comes the Horde

5066090.desc: A cozy first-person game about restoring stained glass. Relax and enjoy cleaning up dusty shards, as you match their shapes and colors, and rebuild six beautiful windows in a ruined mountain chapel. Unlock magical upgrades and take as long as you want, with no deadlines and no way to lose.
5066090.name: Piece and Quiet: A Stained Glass Restoration

5067250.desc: A tank shooting simulation game. The protagonist works himself to death and lands in Hell. A demon hands him a tank. You control it, blast enemies, dodge attacks, and fight your way out of Hell back to reality. Simply put: pure shooting satisfaction!
5067250.name: Tank: Kill Them

5067510.desc: A fast-paced action game where you ski through dangerous slopes, dodge obstacles, and shoot enemies (in bullet time) while navigating procedurally generated mountains. Race for high scores or beat your best times.
5067510.name: Shiver Slopes

5068940.desc: A mesmerizing cooperative exploration for two to eight people, or a sandbox for one. Explore the colors and motion dynamics, save presets of your favorites to enjoy later and swap with others, and share a canvas with a friend, or a stranger, and make something neither of you could have made alone.
5068940.name: Swirl Together

5069180.desc: Hakurei Reimu comes to your desktop. Poke her or pick her up and she reacts just like Reimu would, and she'll keep an eye on your to-dos and alarms too. Blunt, but the type who quietly sticks by your side.
5069180.name: Touhou: Your Reimu

5070720.desc: A chaotic asymmetric racing party game for up to 6 players. Racers fight for the finish line while one Saboteur, watching from a tower, sets traps to stop them. Race, drift, and survive the sabotage.
5070720.name: SaboTour

5070970.desc: The Warfare 3 Pack adds over 30 new blocks! These are cosmetic and decorative blocks that don't affect gameplay balance. If you enjoy Space Engineers and want to support its continued development, this is a great way to do it - and you'll get a lot of new building options in return!
5070970.name: Space Engineers - Warfare 3 Pack

5071200.desc: 《仙帝神兵》是一款国风神话题材的史诗级3D动作游戏。游戏以中国古代神话为背景，打造恢弘壮阔 的六界战场，采用高品质3D画面，呈现震撼唯美的仙侠世界。上古神兵现世，六界风云再起，群雄争 霸，强者为尊！你将化身天命修行者，从凡尘崛起，历经重重试炼，收神兵、斩妖魔、破苍穹，一路 杀上巅峰，成就属于你的不朽传说！
5071200.name: 仙帝神兵

5071360.desc: A turn-based tactics roguelike on a hex board. Command a group of miniatures, outmaneuver enemies, and spend your gold between fights on weapons, gear and potions. Lose your party and the run is over. Every run is completely different than the last.
5071360.name: Prevail

5071690.desc: In Nostalgia Game Shop: Tidy up you will have to organize more than 4000 copies of games from your childhood and put them in the right shelves. Relax with the nostalgic atmosphere and check out what games you can recognize. No AI was used to make the art of this game!
5071690.name: Nostalgia Game Shop: Tidy Up

5071760.desc: Lace up your boots and rise from the lowest league to the top! Blast through defenders with powerful shots, collect and upgrade gear, train around the neighborhood, defeat the goalkeeper, and build your footballer into an unstoppable champion.
5071760.name: KICKSLAUGHT: Football Idle

5071950.desc: Inherit a mysterious estate and its secret, high-profit barn operation. Manage milk extraction, upgrade tech, and pursue three claimable women—Kate, Emma, and Donna—while running a bustling seven-woman household. Explore the estate in real time and unlock dozens of fully animated 3D explicit scenes!
5071950.name: Milk Homestead

5072600.desc: Build a family of thousands of wolf children with your own wolf partner!
5072600.name: Family Time

5072610.desc: A voluntary supporter pack containing only a heartfelt thank-you letter (.txt) from the developers — no extra game content included. If you enjoyed Futa Paradise Resort and want to buy our tiny team a coffee, this pack is for you! (๑>◡<๑)♡
5072610.name: Futa Paradise Resort Supporter Pack

5072620.desc: A supporter pack containing 4 PC wallpapers from the world of Futa Paradise Resort — no in-game content included. Send your desktop on vacation while supporting our tiny team! (๑>◡<๑)♡
5072620.name: Futa Paradise Resort Wallpaper Pack

5072630.desc: A 15-track MP3 collection of Futa Paradise Resort's original soundtrack — no in-game content included. Take the resort's melodies with you while supporting our tiny team! ♪(๑>◡<๑)♡
5072630.name: Futa Paradise Resort Soundtrack

5073610.desc: A physics roguelike where you build the pachinko board yourself. Place and upgrade pegs, arrange powerful Arcana, split balls, trigger elemental chains and create absurd scoring machines before Hell's rent catches up with you.
5073610.name: Pegs of Hell

5073710.desc: A compact puzzle game about guiding two inkfish one at a time to collect every star. Each star switches control to the other. Think ahead and leave the right trail. It blocks one inkfish but helps the other.
5073710.name: Inkturn

5074300.desc: Smash ore off a conveyor, then pull one lever to pour your haul into a plinko settlement machine. A first-person mining game: grow your workshop with your payouts and pay off your company debt. The company calls this a benefit.
5074300.name: PAYDIRT

5075260.desc: You've planned a beach getaway with married women and radiant ladies you've met through your work. Play a simple falling-object merge game to unlock steamy encounters with each character! Your secret romances with these married women will all be laid bare under the sun!!!
5075260.name: Perfect Wives: Midsummer Party

5075270.desc: Fog of War is a DLC for the Diplomacy is Not an Option. In the new story campaign, you’ll build cities, conquer strongholds, and defend against waves of enemy hordes in epic battles. Continue the story of the Ironbrow dynasty and help the young Prince save the long-suffering Samreignia.
5075270.name: Diplomacy is Not an Option: Fog of War

5075620.desc: Upgrade your Talent Tree with 4 unique skins that enhance all of the different Talents and Connections with brand new visuals and a splash of colour.
5075620.name: Talented - Tree Worlds

5076430.desc: Carry a song from a quiet tavern to the Grand Concord. Meet townsfolk, earn their trust, build the right set for each crowd and perform on five instrument-themed rhythm boards in a story-rich medieval adventure.
5076430.name: Wandering Bard

5076560.desc: Dive into Sex Drive Isekai - build your deck, awaken your HOT HEROINES, and find out exactly how grateful they get after a win 💦 Ready to play your cards right?
5076560.name: Sex Drive Isekai

5077430.desc: Dead Man's Clock is a fast-paced 2D pixel-art western shooter where every second counts. Fight through an endless saloon shootout, gun down outlaws to steal back precious seconds, chase high scores, and survive as long as you can before the clock strikes zero.
5077430.name: Dead Man's Clock

5077820.desc: Most deckbuilders take your health. Starhand takes your options. Every card runs on a ship system, and enemies shoot those systems offline, locking cards out of your hand mid-fight. Six pilots, 295 cards, eight zones. Learn to win with half a ship.
5077820.name: Starhand

5078760.desc: An uncomfortable game about collecting plushies.
5078760.name: Uncosy

5079620.desc: A slow-paced, cozy sorting game, where you organize 2900+ potions in a fantasy alchemy shop. Read the book to learn about each new potion. Use narrative deduction to find the correct placement and tidy up the mess!
5079620.name: Potions Galore

5079630.desc: Turn the games you're playing into awesome guides! Capture your epic moments! With all the tools you'll ever need right at your fingertips, there's no learning curve. It offers the simplest way to help you build guides or take notes.
5079630.name: GameGuide Notes

5081060.desc: Just Up: 2D Platformer is a vertical platformer where the goal is to reach the top. Jump and dash across platforms as you climb higher. Discover new places, explore changing environments, leave the atmosphere behind, and find out what awaits you at the top...
5081060.name: Just Up: 2D Platformer

5081180.desc: Last Train Temptation is an adult visual novel about Max and Yuna, whose seven meetings in an almost empty train car turn shy glances into intimate encounters. Make choices, exchange messages, play varied mini-games, and unlock detailed erotic CGs.
5081180.name: Last Train Temptation

5081270.desc: Run your own cozy little grocery shop and restaurant! Stock the shelves, pack every bag with real physics, cook for hungry diners and hire a chef and waiters. Build your shop your way, open a second store across the street, and run it all with friends.
5081270.name: Express Lane

5081980.desc: Command a hex arena where your weapons fire themselves, but the build is yours. Mark targets, drop abilities, vent the heat. Between rounds, crack capsules, merge mods and rewire a 13-socket grid. Six zones, one long run, and a machine that slowly starts playing itself.
5081980.name: HEXFORGE

5082170.desc: The viral brain-rot fruit novela, now a chaotic 3D fighting game. Live the soap-opera betrayals and the reveals nobody asked for while fruit brawlers settle it in the gym. Farm aura to unleash weapon ultimates, in offline duels and online PvP.
5082170.name: Fruit Kombat

5082320.desc: Cut through hostile arenas, close risky trails, and capture territory to reveal anime character art. Master 10 escalating stages..
5082320.name: Riskline

5085380.desc: A cozy 3D jigsaw restoration game. Hundreds of shards lie across a cottage museum floor, and every glaze, curve and pattern is a clue. Work out which pieces belong together, rebuild the artifacts by hand, and restore the full artifact collection.
5085380.name: Kintsugi Cottage

5085520.desc: Build and decorate cozy little businesses for a community of hamsters. Design the layout, choose furniture and style, hire staff to keep things running, and unlock new shop types as you grow.
5085520.name: Tiny Tycoons

5086430.desc: A card shop simulator where you draw all the cards that you sell. Crack open packs, sell cards, host tournaments, and invite your friends to help grow the store.
5086430.name: Drawmi: Card Shop

5086460.desc: A chaotic multiplayer party game where you drink, fill your bladder, and compete with your friends to pee on as much as possible. Drink up, aim well, and claim the most territory to win!
5086460.name: PeeVPee

5086490.desc: The Computerian-Workplace-Initative! Need a Job? Need some Excersize? You need some Jobcersize!
5086490.name: Computer Sillow: Jobcersize

5086660.desc: The original soundtrack for The False Alice -Retold Tale-, featuring over 30 tracks, including in-game music composed by Kazuki Yanagawa, the opening theme “Alias” performed by Isekaijoucho, and the ending theme “さよならを綴じて” performed by HACHI.
5086660.name: The False Alice -Retold Tale- Original Soundtrack

5086710.desc: The official digital art book for The False Alice -Retold Tale-. Explore character illustrations of the three Alices, event stills, background art, design materials, rough sketches, promotional artwork, and more from the game's production.
5086710.name: The False Alice -Retold Tale- Digital Artbook

5087290.desc: The unemployed Louis Thompson accidentally catches a glimpse of the private moments of his neighbor, Holly Phillips, through the surveillance. The two then fall into a forbidden love, while mysterious nano-insects quietly set their sights on them.
5087290.name: Sexy female neighbor and her wet cucumber

5087470.desc: Party Link is a collection of Russian party games for groups. Launch on a big screen, connect friends from their phones via QR, and pick a show — drawing, bluffing, and guessing games. Original modes with Russian voice-over — ready in a minute, no installs on phones.
5087470.name: Party Link

5087540.desc: Invisible traps, different perspectives, and only one way out! In this 2–4 player online co-op platformer, every player sees different traps. Warn each other, overcome the course together, and climb to the top of the leaderboards with your best time!
5087540.name: Watch My Step!

5087760.desc: Sweet Chocolate - A simple and beautiful jigsaw puzzle game featuring five pretty and cute girls in a chocolate shop. Enjoy relaxing moments with them accompanied by soothing music. After completing a level, you can admire the girls' photos in the gallery.
5087760.name: Sweet Chocolate

5088910.desc: A challenging & fast paced SINGLE PLAYER arcade-style beat 'em up!
5088910.name: DecoGear Dimensions

5089020.desc: You owe 1 million $ and all you have is a disco ball! A hectic but satisfying incremental swiping game about creating the perfect party night with light effects. Juggle cooldowns, upgrade equipment, earn $$$ and most importantly: Make numbers go up!
5089020.name: Disco Ball Simulator 2000

5089680.desc: An autobattler focused on the creating synergies to buff your team. Upgrade your units and defeat increasingly stronger enemies in this rogue-like game.
5089680.name: Magua: Twenty Sorrows

5090040.desc: Space Catnips is an incremental game where you harvest catnips from alien planets and showcase them in your bar to attract a wide variety of space cats!
5090040.name: Space Catnips

5090170.desc: Become a magical mermaid and plunge into the waters of the Keepsake Sea! Uncover what secrets lie beneath the waves and embark on a thrilling new ocean adventure.
5090170.name: Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Keepsake Sea

5091990.desc: A minimalist twin-stick shooter drenched in neon glow. Deep weapon customization and more than 350 weapon and ability combinations provide your arsenal as you delve deep in rogue-lite progression and complex mounting challenges.
5091990.name: Hell is Neon Colored

5093040.desc: Trails of Starlight is a Japanese-style fantasy RPG with real-time combat. Explore a starlit continent with lost astral ruins and elemental Stellar Spirits. Travel with companions across kingdoms, snowfields and deserts, and uncover ancient truths beneath the starry sky.
5093040.name: Trails of Starlight

5093110.desc: Merge ingredients on a tiny platform, cook up dishes, and sell your way to survival. The landlord shows up every week like clockwork, and rent only gets steeper—so merging isn't enough, you need a plan. Hire robots to automate production, unlock a tech tree to expand your farm.
5093110.name: Harvest Story

5093180.desc: Cave Diving With Friends is a chaotic co-op adventure for up to six players (but still fun alone!). Pick your mission and difficulty, squeeze through cramped passages, explore unpredictable procedurally generated caves, survive against enemies, help your friends, and don't get lost in the dark.
5093180.name: Cave Diving With Friends

5093250.desc: A party-based fantasy RPG in a living world where NPCs pursue their own adventures. Fight tactical battles, explore, trade, raid, or rule. Speak to characters in your own words with optional offline AI dialogue, while kingdoms and rival adventurers follow their own ambitions.
5093250.name: Nine Thrones

5094400.desc: Command your army, build your economy, and advance through the ages in Warchaic, a fast-paced online 1v1 strategy game. Deploy units, construct buildings and defenses, choose powerful cards, and outsmart your opponent to destroy their base.
5094400.name: Warchaic

5094930.desc: Restore order to a massive armory solo or with friends in co-op! Sort over 3,000 weapons based on real-world firearms, ammunition, grenades, and military equipment into their proper places. Unlock abilities to work faster, or take a break at the shooting range!
5094930.name: Armory Keeper

5095450.desc: The Funeral of Kay is a visual novel style adventure game. Exiled noble Jun need to launch a space burial for his guardian Kay who died for protecting him. Guide him to the launch site, and reminisce about memories with Kay.
5095450.name: The Funeral of Kay

5096660.desc: 山の中にてあなたは偶然にも、怪談寺に迷い込む――。そこにいたのはとある4人の人物だった。まともな人物はゼロ。もはや語り手のほうが怖い？聞かされる怪談話の数々。王道ホラーから人怖、SFホラー、ホラーコメディなど多岐に渡る癖の強い物語たち。VHS風画面短編集邪道ホラーノベルゲーム。
5096660.name: 怪談寺

5097300.desc: PUSH MID is a roguelite auto-battler where MOBA heroes fight on their own. Pick your team, send each hero to a lane, equip them with items, choose powerful perks, and watch your strategy play out as they push toward the enemy base.
5097300.name: PUSH MID

5097530.desc: It moves the way you built it. It wins the way you built it. Assemble the 18cm-tall autonomous hobby robot “SIGNOS” and program its behavior logic with flowchart-style “Thought Tiles.” No controls during battle — SIGNOS fights on its own, guided solely by the logic you designed.
5097530.name: SIGNOS: AI Robot Builder

5100140.desc: Use the adorable garden eels' stretchy movements as clues to identify the notes in a melody! Collect medals, fill your eel collection, and create custom melodies up to 32 bars to share with friends and stream viewers in this oddly addictive, laid-back music quiz game.
5100140.name: EEL KNOW:Perfect Pitch

5100200.desc: Brew forbidden potions, run a seductive alchemy shop, and satisfy the desires of your most tempting customers. Discover their secrets, experiment with dangerous recipes, and watch things get hotter with every unexpected side effect. Some potions unlock more than magic.
5100200.name: Horny Orc Alchemist 🧪🔞

5100640.desc: "Lyra Mahjong Manager" is a career simulation game for professional mahjong players. Players will oversee a mahjong team, and a mahjong players, experiencing the full spectrum of mahjong league matches.
5100640.name: LYRA MAHJONG MANAGER

5102300.desc: From Earth to the Moon and beyond, build colonies, develop industries, and manage supply chains in this incremental logistics game. Harness the resources of the Solar System to build an ark and carry humanity to other stars.
5102300.name: STARLINERS

5102610.desc: Grab your trusty bat and smash piñatas in this colorful incremental game. Buy weapons, unlock upgrades, rebirth, and build your strangely arranged home. Everything is cute, everything is fine, and the piñatas are definitely not alive.
5102610.name: Kick The Piñata!

5103180.desc: Nib Unleashed is a cosmic incremental shooter. You play as Nib, a hungry little space alien who snacks on rocks. Blast through endless swarms of rocky foes and unlock new weapons, slicker moves and wilder ways to attack. Turns out the rocks don't like being eaten, so expect heavy resistance.
5103180.name: Nib Unleashed

5104100.desc: Ever wonder what another life would be like? In Lifespan.exe there is no undo. Shape your destiny in a retro terminal with stylish ASCII art: Be a musician, athlete, surgeon, or mobster; pick your spouse and career. Marry, fall into debt, go to jail, or explore the world. Enjoy your chosen life!
5104100.name: Lifespan.exe

5105000.desc: Lead a Norse colony in Vinland across 50 years of survival, politics, relationships, and faith. Make difficult choices to manage food, shelter, defense, popularity, and the colony’s shifting allegiance between the old gods, Rome, and Constantinople.
5105000.name: Vinland: 1000

5105490.desc: Kick down doors, hunt sinister cults, and face bloodthirsty gods in a dark diesel-punk metropolis. Lead a group of magic-school students into turn-based battles with carefully chosen spells, talismans, and occult weapons.
5105490.name: Sorcerous 2 City of Cults

5105650.desc: Love, Death & My Daughter is a free game that combines a virtual desktop interface with narrative storytelling. you will repair a memory program within an old software system, gradually recover memories from the past, and come to understand the love a mother left behind in a new light.
5105650.name: Love, Death & My Daughter

5106240.desc: Prospect is a mining roguelike where you carve through the depths of the mines on a perilous journey towards the world above. Vanquish your foes, find mythical artifacts, and forge your own path with your trusty pickaxe. Will you be the first dwarf to ever reach the surface?
5106240.name: Prospect

5106420.desc: Leverage Real Estate Simulator is an incremental clicker game. Play as an ambitious, ruthless property developer and expand your capital empire through a cycle of borrowing money, buying land, constructing and selling properties—all while stacking every form of leverage you can find.
5106420.name: Leverage Real Estate Simulator

5106660.desc: A romance visual novel where you loop through the story with Ruika, a losing heroine, collecting bad endings as you try to help her win at love. She cries, gets mad, and loses again—but never gives up. Can Ruika finally find her happy ending?
5106660.name: Save Ruika! — Looping with a Losing Heroine

5109010.desc: Enter Sexhelgard, a dark fantasy adult visual novel where you play a charming mercenary hunting a stolen magical artifact. Seduce powerful women, unravel an occult conspiracy, and discover how far desire can lead a hero.
5109010.name: Sexhelgard: Shadow of Lust

5109550.desc: Everyone sees the same thing. Except you. Now every eye is on you. In this bullet heaven roguelite, their attention makes them deadlier and charges your strongest weapon. Find items, shape your build, beat challenges, play co-op locally or online, or join online conquests.
5109550.name: ALL EYES ON ME

5110520.desc: 2040. You wake in a city half-swallowed by another world. Dig anywhere, build anything - a shack, a castle, a fortress. Capture the monster girls roaming the wastes and they fight, work and live beside you. Every seventh night a horde comes. Raise walls, set traps and survive until dawn.
5110520.name: Monster Girls Survival & Craft 2040

5111020.desc: The world beyond the gate is rolled fresh for every soul — ring after ring of wilds, delves, and buried gold, each one deadlier than the last. Take a contract, read the map, bring a shovel. Bring friends: everyone gets their own loot, and nobody fights over a chest.
5111020.name: Lost Gateways

5111280.desc: Raise a family, carry on through generations, and fight demons to break a curse passed down through your bloodline in this family legacy simulation game.
5111280.name: Dear My Son

5111700.desc: A political life simulation: enter in middle age, assemble bills, run elections, take the money, bury the trail. There is no win condition — only how you are remembered when you die.
5111700.name: Political Life

5111930.desc: Don't let your buddy kill you! :)) 2-player co-op panic asymmetrical game. Team up with up to 8 players in 4 cars for chaotic co-op rallying. Dodge wildlife, wipe mud off the windshield, and trust your navigator’s directions. Paint your car, buckle up, and try to keep the friendship on the road.
5111930.name: Rally Panic with the BRO!

5111980.desc: Yuki leads an ordinary life, weighed down by debt, surrounded by a few friends, and consumed by poems shared with no one. Until the arrival of a transfer student. Because some presences cannot be resisted. Only surrender is possible.
5111980.name: Highschool J

5113890.desc: An asymmetrical co-op parkour adventure for two players sharing a single body: one controls and interacts with the environment, while the other sees platforms and guides them through puzzles. Solve puzzles together, progress to the end and get your lives back!
5113890.name: 2in1

5114180.desc: Wire rainbows in a factory of light. A prism splits white light into red, green and blue. Bend the beams, mix them, and deliver the colour each order asks for: red and green make yellow. Orders keep coming, until your single white beam becomes rainbow wiring across the whole board.
5114180.name: Prism Factory

5115080.desc: Pack your products in this active incremental game and ship countless orders to your clients. Pay your debt to your supplier before time runs out and earn your freedom.
5115080.name: Pack It Up!

5115260.desc: Gather your friends, their moms, stepsisters and stepdads around the big screen. Connect through your smartphone browser — and get ready for your best night in ages! Easy, beloved party games for trivia, humor and laughs. Endless content, built-in AI and an integrated Workshop.
5115260.name: Party Box

5115930.desc: A short incremental clicker about the progress bar that stops at 99%. Destroy bars by hand, unlock skills that click for you, and fight through installers, updates and a blue screen — one bar at a time, then hundreds at once.
5115930.name: I hate progress bars

5116360.desc: Circora is a first-person psychological horror set in a vast corporate entertainment complex. Explore its abandoned spaces, interact with strange systems, and use Child Mode to reshape how fear, distance and reality are perceived.
5116360.name: Circora: Part 1

5116650.desc: One person buys and installs it on the TV. Everyone else scans the QR code and their own phone or laptop becomes a bridge station, no install, no second copy. Nobody aboard sees the whole picture, so the ship only works if you talk. Crews of 1 to 9, and death is permanent.
5116650.name: Space Couch Command

5117550.desc: Fart Together is a physics-based co-op game where 2–4 players steer a shared raft using fart power. Coordinate your direction, timing and gas power with friends to overcome challenging obstacle courses.
5117550.name: Fart Together

5118500.desc: Run a safari agency with friends in chaotic 2–4 player co-op. Drive a fully destructible, physics-based truck, take care of tourists, and survive wildlife encounters. Film the chaos, watch your videos together, and grow your in-game channel.
5118500.name: Safari-TV

5118760.desc: Family Business is a horror game where you work in your uncle’s burger shop. Prepare food, serve it to customers, make new friends and uncover the mystery surrounding your family.
5118760.name: Family Business

5119450.desc: Every applicant needs the money. Most of them are lying. Find it in the paperwork, stamp APPROVE or REJECT, call the next one in. The rules change every morning and nobody explains why. You are reviewing them. Somebody upstairs is reviewing you.
5119450.name: Pending Review

5120080.desc: Build one tower. Hold endless waves. Spend what each wave drops on damage, crit and six weapon mounts firing at once — then bank the run into a 453-node passive tree that carries into the next. A premium incremental tower defence: no ads, no timers, no energy bars.
5120080.name: Everhex

5120640.desc: This is an action game featuring a mysterious girl who takes on hordes of monsters with her sword and bombs.
5120640.name: 世界防衛少女!!-DEFENDER MAIDEN-

5120940.desc: You inherit a cafe with two faces: a third-wave coffee bar by day, and after midnight, the city's quietest sanctuary for its femboy and futa regulars. You have 45 days to save it from the chain that wants it gone — and six people who make it worth saving.
5120940.name: Femboy Futa Cafe

5122130.desc: Card Builder is everything you need to design, build and export a card game. Templates, artwork and effects for the design, your spreadsheet for the data, and print-ready or game-ready files at the end.
5122130.name: Card Builder

5122570.desc: Everything from the food stands, to the game booths, to even the rides has been ransacked! Even the Carnival tent has been flipped upsidedown. Gather up all the misplaced items and bringing them back to their homes to get the Carnival ready to open again!
5122570.name: Carnival Catastrophe

5122610.desc: Reclaim the Forsaken Isles in this NSFW fantasy adventure blending visual novel storytelling, RPG progression, and strategic match-3 combat. Battle monsters, unlock powerful abilities, upgrade your character, and build spicy relationships with the exotic and horny characters you meet along the way.
5122610.name: Lust Isles

5122760.desc: Dodge enemy fire, shoot back, and keep getting stronger in this easygoing action shooter! Switch between 9 different costumes to completely change your playstyle and turn the tide when the battle gets tough!
5122760.name: COSPECO: Greedy Bullets

5125210.desc: OPEN cylinder. INSERT round. AIM well and SHOOT. COUNT your remaining rounds. Become a true gunslinger! Your revolver is not a toy, you MUST respect it in order to survive! Oh and you have a DICE too...
5125210.name: THUD: Dicey Reload

5126230.desc: A co-op INFINITE creature collector auto-battler where you can draw all the creatures you collect while battling your way to a Scribble Fighting art degree. Grab new creatures from the Community Workshop to infinitely grow your collection and world.
5126230.name: Drawmi: Creature Collector

5126340.desc: A pixel-art rune auto battler. Cast runes, summon and merge heroes, temper your troop at the Rune Forge and march through four acts to Surtr, who rises again in blue flame. Then pick your doors and climb the Endless Tower, floor by floor.
5126340.name: Runecast

5126360.desc: A puzzle game where every clock must count down to zero together!
5126360.name: Clocks Sleep at Zero

5127260.desc: An isometric medieval city builder. Grow one manor from a few hovels into a market town. Houses upgrade when the families in them get the food, water and services they need. Stock up before winter, when nothing grows. Later, raiders come to set the town on fire, and you build towers to stop them.
5127260.name: Salt of the Earth

5127280.desc: Corposlop is an automation game that lives on your desktop. Harvest resources using bureaucracy, and refine it into components to feed the corporate machine. Make better factories and efficient pipelines to make the most out your limited area.
5127280.name: Corposlop

5127530.desc: Incremental tower defense game about one simple problem: TOO MANY CLANKERS. Build an absurd amount of firepower and reduce the CLANKERS to scrap.
5127530.name: TOO MANY CLANKERS

5127680.desc: A first-person ice cream roguelike. Serve the line, hit the quota, and hand every cent to a boss who is very clear about what happens if you come up short. Draft cards between shifts to build a run that survives one more day. The truck is locked. The phone is ringing. Get scooping.
5127680.name: BRAINFREEZE

5129200.desc: Build a football club from the lower leagues up. As the owner, hire your manager, discover players and develop young talent. Explore a detailed football world and shape your club over decades. Leave the team and tactics to your manager or have your say before each match.
5129200.name: President FC: Football Club Owner

5129220.desc: This title is an interactive narrative game set in an urban elite‑family backdrop, where a grand tale of revenge and political intrigue spanning three corporations unfolds.
5129220.name: Undertone

5130120.desc: In a world where human civilization is threatened by monsters, only the rare few individuals who wield forbidden skills dare challenge them. However, these brave warriors have to face an even more dangerous hazard... The Hero Syndrome. Only a young doctor can hope to cure the disease in this JRPG!
5130120.name: Evenicle - Next Fragment Medica

5130370.desc: Meet your AI desktop companion. Chat by voice or text, play games together, or let them watch along as you play. Choose expressive Live2D or 3D characters, customise their personality, and edit what they remember. Buy once for local AI on compatible hardware. Optional cloud features cost extra.
5130370.name: Desktop Companion - Asiden

5130880.desc: Digbound is a short and relaxing first-person mining game. Dig through the earth, uncover valuable ores, sell what you find, and upgrade your equipment to reach new depths.
5130880.name: Digbound

5131070.desc: A tiny stock market deckbuilder on a retro trading terminal. Start with $11, play cards to move prices and sell before the bell. Can you keep up with a daily cost that grows every day?
5131070.name: BEAR THE BURN: A Stock Market Deckbuilder

5132330.desc: A darkly comic top-down driving game about being forced behind the wheel in the middle of a crowded pedestrian district. Drive carefully or embrace the chaos. Either way, your only reward is freedom.
5132330.name: RoadKill Rally 2

5132410.desc: An original game of patience and relaxation where the jigsaw puzzles only have two edges! Reassemble them and wrap them around objects of your choice to display on your shelves. Human-made unique designs. Choose between 100 and 2,000 pieces, and have fun!
5132410.name: Wrapuzzle

5132920.desc: Pigeon Ball is a fast-paced first-person/third-person multiplayer sports game where pigeons fly, peck, pass and battle for the ball. Master your movement, outplay your opponents and score spectacular goals in chaotic arena matches.
5132920.name: Pigeon Ball

5135440.desc: A desktop idle RPG where monsters battle on their own while you work or study! Recruit a colorful cast of monsters, build your own squad, and reclaim the Dungeon Cores stolen by humans.
5135440.name: DPS: Desktop Pension Squad

5136620.desc: S.O.S is a roguelike deck-building game built on blackjack. Collect cards, build your deck, and turn the odds of blackjack in your favor.
5136620.name: SOS :Should I Stay or Should I Hit

5138990.desc: Drain the life from everything around you in this reverse-farming incremental game. Infect all that grows, upgrade your plagues, and wither the world until nothing living remains.
5138990.name: Unharvest

5140150.desc: “A Glimmer”is a FMV . Set in 1940’s China, the protagonist takes the identity of agent Wang Qiming. Navigates bandits, National Revolutionary Army, Japanese‑puppet forces and Communist underground groups. Choices between justice, personal revenge and self‑identity bring totally distinct endings.
5140150.name: 流火 A Glimmer

5140770.desc: A cozy co-op tidy-up game with a compelling story. Clear an old barn filled with hay, explore rooms, upgrade your tools, and sell what you collect. Team up with friends to uncover the story as you search for a tiny needle.
5140770.name: Story of The Needle In a Haystack

5140980.desc: The Odyssey: Threads of Fate is a story-driven adult visual novel about survival, desire, destiny, and the meaning of home. Guide Odysseus through a seductive reimagining of Greek myth filled with gods, monsters, romance, war, mystery, animated NSFW scenes, and a full gallery.
5140980.name: The Odyssey: Threads of Fate

5141440.desc: Every hand must win. ALL-HU is a single-player mahjong puzzle with every tile face-up: read the wall, plan each draw and discard, and guide two — or four — hands to victory at once. 1,100+ solver-verified puzzles, including Steam-exclusive Gambit mode. No luck, no in-app purchases: pure tile logic.
5141440.name: ALL-HU: Mahjong Puzzle

5142680.desc: A first-person psychological horror strategy where diabetes becomes a deadly table duel. Balance blood sugar with insulin, manage your supplies, and defeat Doctor Dealer to claim the cure.
5142680.name: Expiration

5146090.desc: A cozy soda-sorting sim set in a little shop. All 5760 cans have spilled across the floor - pick them up, read the labels, and shelve every one by flavor. No timers, no pressure. Sort alone, or with up to three friends.
5146090.name: You Can Sort It!

5146380.desc: ÅTTKAND is a minimalist color puzzle. Tap a chip to see the reaction wave around the board. Use the special chips to change the waves. Turn all the chips to the same color to win.
5146380.name: Attkand

5147680.desc: You uncovered a fraud, so they locked you up. Prisoners are quietly disappearing, and you're next. Sneak past the guards, trade cigarettes for information, fight when you have to, and take over the prison before they come for you.
5147680.name: PROCEDURE ZERO

5147980.desc: Packages won’t deliver themselves! Jump into your van with up to 4 friends, drive out to a massive shifting facility, and retrieve high-value cargo from deadly horrors. Every run is unpredictable. Deliver at all costs. Have a fearless delivery!
5147980.name: DELIVERX

5150150.desc: Top-down arcade box lacrosse inspired by an all-time childhood favorite. Pick skinny, medium, or heavy body types - each with radically different speed, power, and checking. Versus, Co-Op, Multiplayer. Global leaderboard. GET IN EARLY. Lowest price during inaugural version.
5150150.name: Arcade Lacrosse

5150350.desc: 『ふりむいちゃだめ』は、廃校となった学校を探索し、怪異から逃げながら脱出を目指すシングルプレイヤー向け3Dホラーゲームです。探索中には「動くな」「高い場所へ逃げろ」「指定された色の場所へ向かえ」「隠れろ」など、さまざまな命令が突然発生します。暗い校舎を探索して鍵やアイテムを集め、安全な場所を見つけながら命令を乗り越えてください。怪異に見つかったときは、教室や廊下、階段を利用して追跡を振り切り、学校からの脱出を目指します。
5150350.name: ふりむいちゃだめ

5151340.desc: [No AI] Sort My Pigs is a 2D organizing simulator where you sort over 5,000 cute pigs into their correct pens. Pick a pig, find its pen, earn coins, and unlock upgrades as your farm grows. No timer, no pressure, just pure, cozy sorting bliss.
5151340.name: Sort My Pigs

5152560.desc: 🥕Harvest an absurd number of carrots! Start with your bare hands, unlock powerful tools and helper robots, explore six farming zones, catch living carrots, survive explosive ones, and turn manual labor into harvesting chaos. 🤖
5152560.name: Quadrillion Carrots

5153550.desc: Play with friends in this poker-based kart racer- Get the best hand and cross the finish line before you lose it!
5153550.name: Pokart

5154050.desc: Once a prince, but accidentally turned into a frog. Lash your tongue to collect insects, feed the witch’s cauldron, and turn catches into magical essence. Upgrade your skills, survive nasty bugs to restore your prince status in this cozy incremental clicker.
5154050.name: The Frog Prince: Unfrogged

5156510.desc: A top-down roguelite where you are the monster. Absorb colors, mix them into impossible forms, and tear down the "heroes" who farmed your kind. Nine apex awakenings, hand-built rooms dealt fresh every run, and an altar that trades your curses for power.
5156510.name: Mool: Chroma

5157030.desc: Become a general in the Three Kingdoms and rewrite the original tale in this text-based TRPG. An AI game master responds to every choice and line you write, generating the story on the spot — no fixed branches, just a narrative that forms as you play. Command armies, negotiate, write your Romance.
5157030.name: 삼국지-다시 쓰는 연의

5157300.desc: Spend three days with a woman you shouldn't even be thinking about. Make choices, experience sensual scenes, unlock explicit illustrations, and watch a long-buried forbidden desire become all too real. Adults only.
5157300.name: My Friend's Hot Mom

5158540.desc: Mine ore, forge ammunition, and build a railway through a moon overrun by swarms. Keep your automated turret supplied, switch between travel and siege, and upgrade your mobile rig in this top-down logistics and defense game.
5158540.name: Keep The Ammo Flowing

5158710.desc: A logic puzzle game where the fixed order of the Chinese zodiac is the key to finding the answer. Spot the cats hiding among the zodiac animals as you journey through the four seasons of Japan and meet all twelve zodiac friends!
5158710.name: 干支になりたい猫

5159310.desc: A bunch of Normal Retro Classic games, but what if, you need to change to another game when the Count Down ends. How many Score can you get?
5159310.name: Limited-time Game Bundle Challenge

5159330.desc: Master a tethered blade in a mouse-only incremental action game. Throw it, build up speed, and upgrade it to fight back waves of enemies before corruption consumes your world.
5159330.name: YoYo Blade

5159800.desc: Mutual Occult Insurance is a 1-4 player co-op psychological horror and corporate satire. You investigate insurance claims for the only insurer that covers supernatural damage, and decide whether a haunting is real, or whether someone staged it for the payout, then survive whatever the answer is.
5159800.name: Mutual Occult Insurance

5160370.desc: Match-3 is your sword. Read each boss's telegraphed strike, then dodge, block, or land a perfect parry by shaping an L or a cross inside the danger zone. Duel the twelve Zodiac maidens, break their posture, and end them in a single overclocked blow. A tarot-driven action match-3 roguelike.
5160370.name: HOSHIKIRI: Parry the Zodiac

5160550.desc: Wake in your own home, only to discover your body is still lying in bed. Trapped outside yourself, explore a familiar house shared with beings from other dimensions, uncover the truth, and find a way back before reality collapses.
5160550.name: Astral Phase

5161950.desc: Burdened by debt, you move into an eerie villa, forced to survive for seven days. When night comes, all kinds of uncanny anomalies emerge. Stay alert, track every shift, find what feels wrong, and reveal the horrifying truth hidden in the villa.
5161950.name: HauntedHouseNO14

5162240.desc: A chaotic multiplayer football game where you steal goalposts, cast spells with your voice, and occasionally get into a fight with Mr. Penwings (the referee).
5162240.name: Pit & Pat

5164050.desc: Explore the canyons, plains, meadows, and hills of the Texas Hunting Reserve. Hunt a rich roster of antlered and horned species and build a trophy collection unique to Texas.
5164050.name: theHunter: Call of the Wild™ - Texas Hunting Reserve

5164110.desc: Bio Inc. Total Defense is an incremental tower defense game set inside your body. Command your immune system against massive hordes of viruses, bacteria, and other pathogens. Upgrade your defenses, place them wisely, and fight for every inch of your body.
5164110.name: Bio Inc. Total Defense

5164620.desc: Life simulation and psychological horror. Meet ALISA. Rebuild your life, find a job, explore the town, do anything for her...
5164620.name: Horror Stories: Social Problems

5165390.desc: Local gangs got you laid off your shit job. In the urban jungle of possibilities, your survival instincts kick in to keep a roof over your head, find ways to make bread alone or with your buddies.
5165390.name: HOOD

5165430.desc: A Pomodoro timer × idle × command-battle RPG. Resources build up while you work — pull commands, power up your party, and battle other players between sessions. Your focused time becomes your strength.
5165430.name: PomoIdle Arena

5165490.desc: Top-down 3D retro arcade shooter where the smart shot bounces. Grab a friend for couch co-op against twelve genuinely rude AI tanks across 50 levels, or go it alone and skip the witnesses. Gauntlet runs, seven Versus modes, a map editor and a garage full of tanks keep you coming back.
5165490.name: Glass Tanks

5165580.desc: Found a carmaker in 1890 and keep it alive until 2040. Design cars part by part, grow your works from a shed to an assembly line, sell across a world shaped by wars, oil shocks and laws — and spend political capital to bend that history.
5165580.name: Automotive Tycoon

5165650.desc: A first-person survival horror game set in a cursed circus shaped by childhood memories. Move carefully and hide from the demonic clown stalking you. Explore dangerous attractions and burn circus posters to break the curse and save your life.
5165650.name: Mind the Clown: Reborn

5167670.desc: Cast your line, catch fish, and watch the numbers go up! Upgrade your gear, reel in bigger catches, and rebuild Starlight Cove in this cozy fishing incremental. Just one more fish, one more upgrade… and maybe you’ll finally help Grandpa catch the four legendary fish that have eluded him for years.
5167670.name: Starlight Cove

5168570.desc: Historical War: The Animation is a library of classic-war animated reconstructions. Watch famous campaigns from Alexander to the Gulf War on a scrubbable timeline—play, pause, replay. Each film is about five minutes. Napoleon is the dividing line: earlier wars are Ancient, later wars are Modern.
5168570.name: Historical War：The Animation

5169060.desc: Dig in and give your party a fighting chance with the Dust to Dust Character Pack!
5169060.name: For The King II: Dust to Dust Character Pack

5169710.desc: Witchkeeping is a cozy narrative organizing game about a witch urgently appointed to an academy library. Fly your broom and shelve the books by solving their puzzles. Open the letters the owl still brings for Madame Vesper, and sort out the valley's odd troubles.
5169710.name: Witchkeeping

5170000.desc: The world is drowning, and the Tainted are evolving. Scavenge, upgrade your raft, and survive each passing day in this roguelite survival RPG. Master match-3 combat, dodge deadly attacks, craft powerful abilities, and fight to finish a mission humanity cannot afford to lose.
5170000.name: Tainted Tide

5172070.desc: Incraiders is an active incremental game where you get energy from fallen Invaders to become a cross-dimensional guardian of the cosmos.
5172070.name: Incraiders

5172830.desc: This is a relaxing and cozy auto-fishing game. Choose your character, prepare your fishing rod, cast your line, watch the fish bite, collect your catches, and build your own fishing journey step by step.
5172830.name: Little Cat Goes Fishing

5172860.desc: Defeat the horde. Raise the fallen into a skeleton legion and lead it with your spells. Reclaim the Seal of Return, bring the dead home, and rebuild a workshop and a camp where people await your return. Eastern dark fantasy action. Play the free demo.
5172860.name: Necro Rising

5172870.desc: Bomb Them Ores is a short arcade incremental mining game. Explode caves, collect minerals and unlock upgrades to delve deeper!
5172870.name: Bomb Them Ores

5173190.desc: Ilenor the Brave's cat Shadowtongue has been catnapped! Run, jump and blast through 36 levels in this retro inspired DOS-style pixel platformer to get Shadowtongue back, plus his stolen wand, cauldron and diamond. Try the free demo!
5173190.name: Arcane Dash - A Pixel Adventure

5173530.desc: Dive into the heart of the southern french region of Provence, in a tiny hamlet where the only people left are seniors gradually growing apart. Shake up their routine to bring them back together at the local café, in a short experience where you're never too old to look towards the future.
5173530.name: Soleil & Suspense

5173540.desc: A retro pixel desktop idle RPG. Warrior, Mage, and Taoist. Auto-combat, offline gains, and it can hide on your desktop.
5173540.name: Idle Legend

5174190.desc: Draw tracks, mix colours and guide every train to its matching station. Tiny Trains is a colourful railway logic puzzler with handcrafted challenges. Plan your routes, test your solution and keep refining until everything clicks.
5174190.name: Tiny Trains

5174600.desc: One Step War is a modern minimalist tactical board game. Different pieces have different effects, creating meaningful tactical choices. The game includes standard battles, campaign puzzles, and roguelite expeditions.
5174600.name: ONE STEP WAR

5174790.desc: Enemies come in endless waves and your soldiers fight on their own. You spend the gold: pick races, buy troops, stack synergies. March across seven regions and beat seven Bosses. Lose and you only lose gold. Gear, Star Map and Talents stay.
5174790.name: Don't Panic, Defend!

5175310.desc: 1 Teacher vs 7 Students. Hide. Prank. Survive. Up to 8-player asymmetric party chaos! Mischievous students blend into dozens of NPC classmates, secretly snacking, texting, and causing trouble, while the teacher must spot these wannabe delinquents and restore complete order to the classroom.
5175310.name: Worst Class Ever

5175420.desc: Turn language learning into a pixel adventure. Study English and Japanese, battle monsters with every correct answer, and grow your mage through spells and upgrades. Explore new chapters, revisit tricky words, and build a learning habit at your own pace.
5175420.name: Language Learning Quest

5175990.desc: Blades and scarabs locked in a tango of death. A multi-ending sci-fi seinen visual novel inspired by 90s anime OVAs. Will you find the truth behind the alien invasion? Or will you bring the world to the brink of destruction again?
5175990.name: Mors Blade - UNSLASHED

5176420.desc: Drain the ocean one bucket at a time. Scoop up water, sell it, and spend your cash on bigger buckets, a wheelbarrow, a golf cart, pumps and a crew of hard-working seagulls until the sea floor is bone dry and only the plug is left to pull.
5176420.name: One Million Gallons

5177230.desc: recruit an ever-growing force of heroes in this pixel-art idle clicker RPG. Develop skill trees, unlock new territories, prestige for greater power, and come back stronger with every run.
5177230.name: Territory Idle Defense

5178010.desc: Endless Battle：Idle & Build is an idle loot-farming game with 8 skills, 4 enhancements… Tons of build effects, and unique support companions Defeat the enemies on every floor and keep climbing. Farm loot whilst the game runs in the background, until you reach—the Realm of the End!
5178010.name: Endless Battle: Idle & Build

5178240.desc: Pull 100,000 weeds! Zone out solo or chill and chat with up to 6 players in this endless weeding sim. Feed your goat to earn cash and unlock better weeding gear!
5178240.name: Just Weeding

5179500.desc: Featuring a whole new area to explore, Idol of the Town adds new erotic scenes, enemies, story, minigames, and much more!
5179500.name: Idol of the town

5179550.desc: Turn a bankrupt recycling yard into a smooth-running operation in this relaxing incremental management game. Open bags and sort waste by hand, hire a crew, install processing machines, and automate the journey from truck delivery to valuable recycled goods.
5179550.name: Trash Inc.

5179700.desc: An auto-battler RPG where you cultivate and evolve heroes and monsters. Evolve your units to unlock new potential, and combine diverse heroes and equipment to build the ultimate formation. Explore dungeons, farm powerful gear, and assemble your very own elite squad!
5179700.name: Auto Squad RPG

5179950.desc: Tick & Tired is an incremental game about overcoming your to-do list. Complete short desktop tasks like sorting emails and organizing files, hire interns to automate the work and get massive combos at the end of the day to upgrade your workflow in a skill tree.
5179950.name: Tick & Tired

5181860.desc: A psychological horror about Tomi, a teenager unraveling the truth behind a tragedy that struck his school ten years ago. Explore the 1990s town of Oford, gather clues, and discover what the darkness is really hiding.
5181860.name: TOMIDER

5182720.desc: Restore a chaotic waifu museum by finding, sorting, and displaying collectible scale figures. Collect, organize, and build the perfect exhibition!
5182720.name: Waifu Curator

5182760.desc: Supernova is a sci-fi movement FPS about a doomed star thief who, with the help of their protégé and an other-worldly stranger, must battle through hordes of cosmic monsters, explore an abandoned metropolis, and unlock new abilities to save themselves and the galaxy.

5268040.desc: Lead one of four kingdoms in a real-time war for a continent. Seize land that feeds your armies, raise outposts and citadels, unleash griffins, minotaurs, golems or dragons, and crush your rivals in massive battles where the losing side never retreats.
5268040.name: Merkalis: Conquest

5268650.desc: This is an online game of tag for 3–10 players. Runners must escape the Tagger and collect objects, while the Tagger can curse Runners or corrupt objects!
5268650.name: CatchCatch

526870.desc: Satisfactory is a first-person open-world factory building game with a dash of exploration and combat. Play alone or with friends, explore an alien planet, create multi-story factories, and enter conveyor belt heaven!
526870.name: Satisfactory

5268810.desc: Crew a WWII anti aircraft gun with your friends. Spot incoming bombers, call out ranges, set fuses and load each round by hand. Flak Simulator is a firstperson coop simulation where getting a shot on target takes the whole crew.
5268810.name: Flak Simulator

5269140.desc: Help, My Capybaras Escaped is a casual and fun hidden object game where you have to rescue all the capybaras in various colourful images!
5269140.name: Help, My Capybaras Escaped!

5269530.desc: Management has ordered a more Hands-on approach! Introducing the Knockout expansion for Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor.
5269530.name: Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor - Knockout Expansion

5270220.desc: Sound is everything. Explore a dark, misty world, activate mysterious crystals and survive a relentless hunter who sees through sound. Scream to run faster, stay quiet to hide, and use the environment to your advantage. Every noise has consequences.
5270220.name: Sound Bounded

5271070.desc: Sort Their TEETH is a surreal first-person sorting game set inside a living mouth museum. Pick up scattered teeth, match them to bizarre creature exhibits, and gradually clear the chaotic floor. Collect Golden Teeth to unlock unusual upgrades that make sorting even more satisfying.
5271070.name: Sort Their TEETH

5273050.desc: 💕 Your new desktop companion is the mom of one of your Steam friends! Chat with her, spark a romance, and customize her look. Play mini-games, solve jigsaw puzzles to unlock photos, invite friends for online co-op, choose pets, and explore tons of handy tools! 🥵
5273050.name: Your Friend's Mom 2

5273080.desc: Sort thousands of colorful balls into matching pipes. Unlock upgrades and work more efficiently, but be careful: every mistake adds more balls to the pile.
5273080.name: Ball Pit Cleanup

5274690.desc: From a veteran 4X developer comes a game of logistics, trade and empire. Lead one of seven European powers from 1500 to 1950: explore the New World, ship its wealth home, industrialise your Capital, and hold an empire that wants to break free. Can you exploit the New World to control the Old?
5274690.name: Imperialist Demo

5274910.desc: This game is a simple casual puzzle game. In the game, you use the arrow keys to get all the yellow blocks to the green flag goal to win~ Weird creativity that leaves you wanting more, various traps that keep you on edge, and fascinating mysterious features are waiting for players to explore~
5274910.name: SlippingBlocks

5275070.desc: I Ching — Chinese Tarot & Wisdom of Change is an interactive divination experience based on the 64 hexagrams of the ancient I Ching. Ask questions about love, career, study, choices, or the future, then explore your hexagram to reflect on change, timing, balance, and the paths ahead.
5275070.name: I Ching: Chinese Tarot & Wisdom of Change

5275590.desc: Use incredible physics to create roads by pushing dirt, felling trees, moving rocks, hauling gravel. Dig a pit for resources, build a race track for the dirt bike! Get paid and buy more machines. Multiplayer for up to four players
5275590.name: Dirt Town

5276120.desc: 全新传奇《1.76流派传奇》，耗时两年精心雕琢，倾尽心血打造诚意巨献！以原创剧情为灵魂的基础上，它保留了传奇的核心玩法（打怪、升级、爆装备、攻沙巴克）超级大陆为舞台🌏，秉持“不肝不氪”的友好理念🥰，同时增加了魂器、专属装备、不同职业的多种流派等独具特色的新内容，让游戏体验既怀旧又新奇，该版本节奏快，爆率高，材料易得，PK更爽快，主打一个“爽”字，为玩家开启一场别具一格的传奇冒险之旅🚀！！！
5276120.name: 1.76流派传奇

5276600.desc: Haunted Movers is a 1–4 player online co-op physics comedy about hauling possessed furniture that fights back. Grab, lift, squeeze through tight spaces, survive paranormal chaos, and get everything onto the truck—preferably without destroying the client's house.
5276600.name: Haunted Movers

5277000.desc: Dejinochi is a tiny virtual pet that lives right on your desktop. Feed it, care for it, and see what it grows into. Eventually, you'll have to say goodbye as it heads out into the world, but old friends come back to visit.
5277000.name: Dejinochi

5277480.desc: Republic of Chaos is a political satire game where the right, the left, unlikely alliances, and outrageous caricatures fight for control of a republic on the verge of collapse. Pick your side, provoke your rivals, and see just how far the chaos can go.
5277480.name: República do Caos

5277780.desc: Suspect Express is a first-person multiplayer game for 2 to 4 players. Play as an Inspector tasked with identifying the Troublemakers hidden among the passengers, or become a Troublemaker and wreak havoc aboard the train without getting caught before reaching your destination.
5277780.name: Suspect Express

5279740.desc: Four days after Hurricane Honora, catastrophe adjuster Arlo Fontenot arrives on powerless Corvina Key to make fast, final calls. Choose between three divergent romance routes as Vivienne, Tess, and Poppy force him to confront what he owes the island—and them.
5279740.name: Claim Me After the Hurricane

5279840.desc: You're a lone robot that was left behind to clean up all of humanity's trash. Break down trash piece by piece and recycle them into tools, upgrades and a whole crew of helper bots. Stack up all the trash and restore the planet in this physics-driven incremental game.
5279840.name: SCRAPSCRAP

5280100.desc: The Bridge That Must Not Be Named became the main DVIZHUHA. Go online, one on one: take the wheel of the tanker that survived and deliver the fuel, or pilot the FPV drone and make sure IT never arrives. And it's all in PS1 style. Weather favors the operator, smoke and a jammer favor the driver.
5280100.name: Mad Dvizhuha: Benzovoz

5281600.desc: A reverse-survivor where the army is the weapon. Raise skeletons, ghouls and wraiths from what the living drop, watch them lock into ever-widening rings around you, and hold the night.
5281600.name: Necromarch

5281980.desc: Pixel Cartographer is a cozy builder, where you're tasked with building out all the locations on the map! Each area has a unique biome, along with limitations to channel your creativity - but of course there's also a sandbox mode with limitless freedom!
5281980.name: Pixel Cartographer

5282320.desc: Return to the world of Obey Me! Sinner's Choice: Lucifer through the soundtrack that accompanies your story with Lucifer. From moments of breathless tension and quiet comfort to the bittersweet longing that draws you closer, these melodies let you relive the emotional ups and downs of the story.
5282320.name: Obey Me! Sinner's Choice: Lucifer Soundtrack

5282510.desc: A free dark-fantasy idle RPG that keeps fighting in a strip above your taskbar while you work. One persistent world on Steam, web and Android with a single account: loot, world bosses, the endless Eternal, clan wars. No energy walls. Power is never for sale.
5282510.name: Shadow Realms RPG

5282710.desc: Quiet Bloom is a cozy idle game. Awaken the wind, dig wells, and call the rain to tend your land for you. Gather wood, stone, and water, raise wind vanes and solar panels, and watch a cracked desert slowly bloom into a luxuriant green oasis.
5282710.name: Quiet Bloom

5283120.desc: An idle RPG that lives in a thin strip above your Windows taskbar. While you work, your party fights on its own through 22 zones toward the Demon King. On a short break, open the panel: gear, talents, farm, alchemy, forge, and seven beacons to defend.
5283120.name: The Seven Beacons

5284880.desc: Star Imperium is a sci-fi collectible card and deck-building strategy game where two commanders wage war across the stars, each defending a home planet. Marshal Ships, Soldiers, Forces, and Actions, powered by five resource factions — Anti-Matter, Crystals, Light, Metals, and Organics.
5284880.name: Star Imperium

5285010.desc: An elegant watch shop lies in chaos: over 1,000 watches are scattered across two floors. Read each dial, recognise its brand and its mechanism, and return every piece to its cabinet in this cozy tidy-up game, all while a narrated story about time and life unfolds.
5285010.name: Time Well Spent: Tidy Up the Watch Shop

5285190.desc: Build one life across an entire connected world. Choose from hundreds of careers, run businesses from raw materials to retail, invest, own property, raise a family, enter politics or crime, and deal with active NPCs and lasting consequences.
5285190.name: That's My Life

5285500.desc: Betray your friends. Haunt them afterward. A turn-based dungeon card game for 2–8 players: fight monsters, grab loot, and turn on your allies. When you die, return as a ghost and keep meddling with the survivors.
5285500.name: Peril and Plunder

5285650.desc: Warstead combines settlement building, resource management and tactical real-time combat. Build, trade and lead your troops. The game is still in development and is not yet finished. Multiplayer: joining is available; hosting requires special access.
5285650.name: Warstead

5286160.desc: Tidyspell is a cozy first person magic tidying game. Lift and place every object with your wand, catch invisible thieving spirits, fly on your broom, brew potions and step through doors into rooms that are bigger on the inside.
5286160.name: Tidyspell

5287500.desc: Santa's Workshop: Tidy Up Christmas is a cozy first-person present sorting game where you help Santa and his elves sort 2,352 presents! With each present you sort, you get one step closer to unlocking Santa's gifts, which will help you sort even faster. Are you willing to help Santa this year?
5287500.name: Santa's Workshop: Tidy Up Christmas

5287810.desc: This is a relaxing idle auto-battler game.Starting as a lone hero, gradually recruit powerful subordinates to form a mighty legion, upgrade powerful abilities, and then conquer the entire world.
5287810.name: Advancing Legion

5289190.desc: VALHALLA ARCHIVE is a tactical fantasy CCG where matches are decided in 5 turns. Deploy a 20-card deck across front and back rows, master 3 unique win conditions, and conquer the roguelite 'Dimensional Corridor'. Harness unpredictable Mana Rifts and claim your place as the ultimate Archivist!
5289190.name: VALHALLA ARCHIVE: CCG

5289620.desc: Enter the exclusive Rich Ladies Club! Challenge four powerful, ultra-wealthy heiresses in addictive bubble-shooter matches: a strict lawyer with forbidden desires, a casino countess, an innocent noblewoman seeking sin, and an oil princess. Master the art of high-society seduction.
5289620.name: Strip Bubbles: Rich Ladies Club

5289760.desc: A casual erotic action RPG with fully animated sex scenes and over 200 animated pixel-art CGs! Explore, earn money, and visit monster girl brothels. Write about your encounters and sell your articles to fund your next visit. Enjoy simple one-button combat, fishing, and casino games along the way!
5289760.name: Monster Girls of Another World: Pleasure Chronicle

5290110.desc: Design a cruise ship deck by deck, hire the crew and take paying guests out to sea. Keep them fed, entertained and away from reception while the buffet runs low, the lifts back up and somebody does something in the pool.
5290110.name: Project Overboard

5290430.desc: Hop aboard and play in bite-sized days! A relaxing incremental game where your train rolls through the forest while your lumberjacks fell every tree in reach. Logs fly into the wagons, the wagons fire saws and drones, and every upgrade makes the next day bigger. Just one more day!
5290430.name: Choo chop

5292020.desc: Run your own kebab business on the night streets of Istanbul. Prepare ingredients, cook different meals, serve customers, manage your supplies, upgrade your shop and deal with unexpected events in this first-person cooking and business simulation.
5292020.name: Master Of Kebab

5292120.desc: Command 40+ historical armies across 3,000 years of warfare, from Persian spearmen to Abrams tanks, in real-time pixel-art battles where every soldier fights and flees on his own. Engage in unhistorical warfare across a detailed roguelite campaign!
5292120.name: Unhistorical Warfare

5293270.desc: Bring the relaxing atmosphere of Reshine wherever you go with its original soundtrack, composed by Kevin "Kounine" Colombin. A collection of calming melodies to accompany your work, rest, or quiet moments.
5293270.name: Reshine ‒ Soundtrack

5293350.desc: Coach your way from high-school and AAA 18U benches to the top of world hockey. Run the lines, the systems, the training and the room; answer the board; take the job that calls. A text-first career sim across 140 leagues and 2,109 clubs — and every name is yours to edit.
5293350.name: Hockey Coach Dynasty

5293850.desc: To every dreamseeker, from another dreamseeker. Sit down and rest for the night, feed your flame, and brave the wind. Keep it burning.
5293850.name: Keep It Burning

5294070.desc: A social deduction party game for 6–10 players, with bots to fill empty seats. Bluff, vote and play cards as secret roles change mid-game. Even after death, you can keep stirring up trouble as a ghost.
5294070.name: Chaos Table

5294220.desc: Move blocks and build paths to guide each colorful ball to its matching flag in 400 handcrafted 3D logic puzzles. Relax, think and solve increasingly challenging levels.
5294220.name: Spin Ball 3D Puzzle

5294230.desc: ひとりでも、最大20人でも。シンプルな見下ろし型鬼ごっこ！ミッションでアイテムを獲得し、狭い視界と足音を頼りに鬼から逃げ切れ！「逃走者」かあるいは「追跡者（鬼）」か、好きな陣営が選べるぞ！友達と同じ部屋に集まって遊ぶモードや、知らない人と対戦するランダムマッチも搭載！オフラインではNPCを相手にした対戦や、クリア条件の達成を目指すステージチャレンジが遊べる！さらにマップ作成機能、キャラクターカスタマイズ機能なども充実！
5294230.name: Onidot: Game of Tag

5294820.desc: Explore the artistic journey behind Reshine through a collection of concept art, design explorations, and behind-the-scenes artwork that shaped the game's world and forgotten treasures.
5294820.name: Reshine ‒ Digital Artbook

5295330.desc: Water TD is a tower defense game where the enemy is a real flood. Hundreds of thousands of drops pour downhill toward your base, piling up, finding gaps and carving the terrain as they go. Shoot it, burn it, zap it, or blow it back. Just don't expect the ground to hold.
5295330.name: Water TD

5296870.desc: A fast paced MOBA that is easy to pick up and play with friends. Conquer the map and dominate the battleground!
5296870.name: Battle For Pluestar

5297870.desc: Hellmouth is a bullet hell top-down shooter that drops you right in the middle of post-industrial hell. Blast through hordes of demons, create unique upgrades, and hopefully escape?!
5297870.name: Hellmouth

5298430.desc: Team up for explosive co-op, take on the campaign solo, or challenge friends in Arena PvP. Clear 20 levels of enemies and spawners, find upgrades and plan your escape before the bombs go off. Play with up to four in campaign or eight in continuous Arena battles.
5298430.name: Detonator Squad

5300300.desc: Explore a vast pixel-art MMORPG where adventure, progression, crafting, trading, PvE, and ranked PvP shape your journey. Play alone or with others, master your class, conquer powerful bosses, and build your legacy in the world of Elementys.
5300300.name: Elementys

5300620.desc: Build a 3x3 slot board in this word-combination strategy roguelike. Combine Subjects, Adverbs, and Verbs to attack, defend, and heal. Explore changing islands, collect words and relics, and shape a build around class traits and synergies.
5300620.name: Random Slot Adventurers : Matched Words... Now I'm the Strongest

5300950.desc: Rise, level up, and arm yourself for an endless war between two rival nations. Choose your allegiance and carve a path of destruction through your enemies in this reimagined and customized world of Helbreath.
5300950.name: Helbreath Mystic Tavern Classic

5301110.desc: Guide museum conservator Rafe Sowerby through a six-week restitution programme in this adult romance visual novel. Choose one of three distinct routes, navigate professional and personal consequences, and pursue relationships with Yewande, Elspeth, or Blythe.
5301110.name: Lust and Restitution

5301630.desc: HOT DOG translates on-screen text in Windows with OCR and adjustable overlays. Once the local engine is set up, you can translate offline, whether you’re reading game dialogue, working with images and documents, or writing a reply.
5301630.name: HOT DOG AI Translator

5302070.desc: Embark on a pixel-art fantasy card adventure into the unknown. Every step is a gamble, and every choice could lead to opportunity—or danger.
5302070.name: MiniHero: Wonderbound

5302260.desc: Lead a militia through a realm in turmoil. Build your settlement, manage resources, recruit troops, and defend your people when night falls. This single-player demo combines settlement management with real-time strategy combat.
5302260.name: change dynasties Demo

5302340.desc: Fleeing a future that executes the obsolete, Dr. Solis Renforge crash-lands among the dinosaurs, 65 million years in the past. Build a life with a prehistoric tribe, contain the corruption you unleashed, and face a people who fear what your technology makes of them. A sci-fi isekai visual novel.
5302340.name: Solis Chronicles

5302410.desc: A relaxing 2D space-flight game with real gravity. Carry a whole people asleep on board through eighteen exoduses to a world to land on, or explore the open universe of the Drift. Beautiful suns best admired from afar, and not a single weapon: when trouble comes, you fly.
5302410.name: Crossing Space Zen

5302550.desc: The lights are on in a house where no one lives. Shoot down the dead closing in, save the ones taken, and end it at the source. A first-person on-rails horror shooter with online co-op for two and worldwide leaderboards.
5302550.name: DEADWICK

5302700.desc: Turn an overflowing card market into your personal empire! Tear through cards, unlock powerful cutters, unleash five tiers of explosive booster packs, build your skill network, manipulate market prices, and grow stronger with every Prestige.
5302700.name: Sort and Stack!

5302870.desc: One dragon sneeze. 6,000 mixed-up coins. Your holiday cancelled. Explore a fantasy museum, inspect coins and find their rightful places in this first-person sorting game. Unlock skills and magical powers to turn a glorious mess into a perfectly organised collection.
5302870.name: The Coin Keeper : Tidy up !

5303130.desc: Bring your glorious republics to the final frontier with a space program packed with dedicated technologies, buildings, vehicles, and mechanics that unlock the stars.
5303130.name: Workers & Resources: Soviet Republic - Space Program

5303440.desc: In the far future, explore an abandoned planet aboard three distinct vehicles. Drive deep beneath the sea, glide high amongst the clouds, and fly even higher in orbit. Immerse in the atmosphere, avoid eldritch dangers and figure out the truth in this two hours long cosmic horror adventure.
5303440.name: The Temple

5303460.desc: Enamelist is a cozy tidy-up simulator where you organize over 2,000 unique enamel pins into themed sets on pin boards. Enjoy beautiful artwork as you place each pin back where it belongs.
5303460.name: Enamelist: Tidy Up the Pin Collection

5303470.desc: Hexel is a puzzle game unlike any other. Learn the rules and overcome over 100 levels, each exploring a different aspect of every mechanic introduced. This game respects your intellect with no filler puzzles, every level requires you to find a new way to approach the problem.
5303470.name: Hexel

5303520.desc: A short kinetic visual novel about nationality, prejudice, and doomed love. Set in the Free City of Danzig in the 30s, Amber Eyes tells the story of a Polish taxi driver hopelessly in love with a German man.
5303520.name: Amber Eyes

5304170.desc: Monkey Overdrive is an action roguelike where your flying saucer is the weapon. Hold to charge, release to ram, and send whole crowds of jelly slimes flying into traffic, presses, and runaway trains. Beat 24 bosses and steal every one of their moves.
5304170.name: Monkey Overdrive

5304760.desc: Bring order to a perfume archive of 3,240 bottles, solo or with a friend, in this relaxing first-person organizing game. Read labels, place bottles on the right shelves, develop helpful skills, and watch completed collections light up the archive.
5304760.name: Scentkeeper: Tidy Up the Perfume Archive!

5304930.desc: Refluff is a first-person ASMR sim about running your own rug-washing workshop. Scrape, soak, foam, scrub and squeegee filthy carpets clean on a real fluid simulation. Get paid for every percent, upgrade your tools, take on bigger, dirtier rugs.
5304930.name: Refluff: Carpet Cleaning ASMR

5305100.desc: Three tanks. One arriving fish. Read its request, inspect the habitats, and send it to the right home. Build clean placement chains across 50 handcrafted shifts in this colorful pixel art aquarium puzzle game.
5305100.name: Wrong Tank!

5305400.desc: A raycast ASCII roguelike. Ram a room of letters into itself and every kill raises the trip. The color turns first; later the letters stop agreeing with the room they describe. Twenty floors down. Five loops to the end of the book.
5305400.name: GLYPHTRIP

5306710.desc: A Beat-Em-Up starring a J-Pop-inspired magical girl Aiko who bashes corporate demons over the head while swapping between a Pop mode and a Metal mode.
5306710.name: Idol On Duty

5307180.desc: Your furniture is hot. Your AI sex doll is confused. And apparently, you have no idea what you're into. Explore your home, meet bizarre women, complete absurd quests, and discover your hidden desires in this wild adult adventure!
5307180.name: Fuck Everything 👉👌💦

5308360.desc: An incremental game (a clicker) where everything keeps growing while you decide where to put your resources. And a history lesson: as you play, you learn the real story of Gestalt therapy — its people, theories, books and organisations.
5308360.name: Gestalt Journey
