5308680.desc: A cheerful supermarket game for kids ages 3–6. Shop with animal friends, scan groceries, count coins and enjoy 12 playful mini-games. Collect stickers and decorate your little store, with picture shopping lists and friendly voice prompts.
5308680.name: Little Supermarket

5308970.desc: The MSX classic evolves into LotLotLotLot! Race the clock, trigger Fever Mode, double your score with diamonds, and rotate the entire field! Music by Yuriko Keino (Xevious, Dig Dug). Includes the original and a lightly remixed version. Celebrating 30 years of VIDEO GAME CLASSIC!
5308970.name: Lot Lot Lot Lot

5309380.desc: Hidden Front is a military real-time strategy game for up to 6 players. Deploy your army, scout through the fog of war and combine infantry, armor, artillery and air support. Fight other commanders or team up with friends against bots.
5309380.name: Hidden Front

5311120.desc: A free adventure idle single-player hero game where you defeat enemies, collect treasures, challenge dungeon bosses, enhance equipment, and forge your own combat style. With hundreds of talents to choose from, Please note that it is entirely in Chinese and not in English
5311120.name: Treasure Hunt Dungeon

5311340.desc: A single-player card puzzle for five-minute sittings. Seat nobles, priests, soldiers, and peasants by each house's own rule, bank your chains before an event can break them, and satisfy all four houses to win the day. A fresh Daily Court is dealt to every player, every day.
5311340.name: Royal Court

5311750.desc: Command the Iron Maw, an armored war train, against the Meridian Iron & Ordnance Company's Legions. Build a devastating convoy, crush colossal war machines, and defend the ten free cities that refuse to kneel.
5311750.name: Iron Maw

5312680.desc: France, 1940. Follow a Polish-Jewish family as the Nazi occupation transforms their lives. Experience their story through the choices, struggles, and everyday moments that reveal the human cost of the Holocaust. A free narrative game.
5312680.name: The Light in the Darkness: Director's Cut

5312920.desc: Take charge of your very own local trading card shop! Order booster packs, hunt for ultra-rare foils, design your store layout, and set market prices. Rip packs to display holy grail singles or sell sealed boxes to build the ultimate card collector's paradise.
5312920.name: TCG Card Market Simulator

5312950.desc: You are the keeper of a lighthouse on a frozen northern island. Keep the lamp lit, the stove fed and the car fueled. And when the storm comes, don't step out where the light can't reach: a wendigo walks the island at night. And it is listening.
5312950.name: Lightkeeper: Frozen Bay

5315880.desc: Colonies get wild with the Classic Critter Cosmetics Pack! This crowded collection of cosmetic blueprints contains Puft and Pip-inspired takes on a wide range of buildings, atmo suits, and wallpapers, as well as an intrepid new Duplicant.
5315880.name: Oxygen Not Included: Classic Critter Cosmetics Pack

5317080.desc: Little cars. Big grudges. Race solo, with Steam friends, or turn Twitch chat into your rivals. Upgrade your car, build your own tracks, throw a chair into the race, or leave it all behind for a long drive and some music.
5317080.name: Race on Stream!

5317930.desc: This is a "collection game" where you unlock and collect beautiful girls. Once unlocked, the girls are sealed within bottles, allowing you to reunite with them whenever you wish. Each girl features unique animations and voice lines, offering a truly immersive experience!
5317930.name: Seek Futa!

5318160.desc: Cable Management Sim is a chill organizing game where you install cables to provide internet for a building. Plan, trace, measure and cut your cables for the perfect install. learn abilities, unlock mini games, customisation and build out your server room in a no pressure no rush environment.
5318160.name: Cable Management Simulator

5318240.desc: Five citizens on one track, the president on the other, and your friend is screaming at you to pull the lever. Trains don't stop coming. Run between the switches, fight over who gets hit, shove whoever's blocking the lever — with your fists or with a train.
5318240.name: Trolley Together

5318250.desc: Stratagem of the Three Kingdoms: Card Single-Player Edition is a card-builder set in the Three Kingdoms era. Marshal 300 generals and 100+ strategists, read your enemy's units and each campaign, forge the best formation, and land the biggest War Merit. The realm is divided in three; take your seat.
5318250.name: Stratagem of the Three Kingdoms: Card Single-Player Edition

5318580.desc: "Jyoka" is a 16th-century Japanese castle town builder. Develop your territory with 190+ facilities and grant rice fields to retainers to secure loyalty. Defend against bandits and daimyos. Once stable, launch epic sieges against 70+ real-inspired castles to unify Japan!
5318580.name: Jyoka -Castle town-

5319020.desc: A cozy first-person organizing game set in an art shop of rare and beautiful things. Sort 2,942 fine art supplies and artisan pieces in dozens of distinct forms, shelf by shelf, color by color, and unlock skills as the shop becomes a gallery of perfect order.
5319020.name: Art Shop: Tidy Up!

5319410.desc: Build a business empire with a workforce that's already dead. Recruit and train ghosts, run supernatural attractions, and balance profit, reputation and suspicion in this darkly humorous estate-management sim. The guests think it's all special effects. You know better.
5319410.name: My Staff Are Dead! Paranormal Tycoon

5319860.desc: A single-player seduction card game: read each card, guess each woman's qualities, and win her over turn by turn.
5319860.name: Deck of Desire

5321150.desc: An official patch for Mors Blade - UNSLASHED which restores all the additional content and scenes cut from the 16+ version of the game.
5321150.name: Mors Blade - Unslashed: Uncut Patch

5321440.desc: Everyone Lola meets wants her, and she has no idea why. Follow her on a wild adventure to uncover the mystery, with plenty of sex along the way!
5321440.name: Lola's Adventures

532210.desc: After a tragic incident, brothers Sean and Daniel Diaz run away from home. Fearing the police, and dealing with Daniel's new telekinetic power, the boys head to Mexico. Each stop on their journey brings new friends and new challenges.
532210.name: Life is Strange 2

5323250.desc: Starfall Defense is a real-time multiplayer tower defense game blending ancient mythology with cosmic sci-fi. Deploy legendary heroes like Pangu and Nuwa, trigger class synergies, and fend off alien swarms! Features 2-player co-op and ranked PvP. Free to play, pure strategy!
5323250.name: Starfall Defense

5323500.desc: DEEP SEAL is a 1–4 player co-op underwater horror game. Dive into dark, labyrinthine caves to recover bodies, find your way through the depths, and avoid the shark that's always hunting you. Grab what you can, find your teammates, and swim back alive.
5323500.name: DEEP SEAL

5324880.name: PICK A BOO Skin "Headphones with Ears"

5324990.name: PICK A BOO Skin "8-Bit Sunglasses + Necklace"

5325220.desc: Create a human or animal avatar that lives on your desktop. Dress them up, let them keep you company while you work or listen to music, use them as a VTube Avatar or send them to a friend’s screen with a wave, a hug or a little gift. Free to play forever to spread the warmth.
5325220.name: DeskHugs: Desktop Friends

5325790.desc: Don't Blow UP! brings minesweeper into first person, solo or in co-op for up to 4 players. Dig up tiles, flag mines, and face seven rule-twisting modifiers. One wrong choice can blow everything up.
5325790.name: Don't Blow UP!

5325990.desc: Neon pinball meets incremental progression. Earn coins, upgrade the table, and automate your launchers and flippers. Combine 120 skills to unleash multiball, chain lightning, and fever-fueled score explosions. Prestige for permanent upgrades and awaken OVERDRIVE!
5325990.name: OVERDRIVE PINBALL

5326270.desc: The fully original soundtrack of Dawn Aerowar, composed to picture by Jose Pavli. The music is orchestral, epic and fast-paced, with choirs, Bulgarian voices, classical guitar and the two original songs of the film. It comes as MP3, with lossless FLAC as an optional download.
5326270.name: DAWN AEROWAR Original Soundtrack

5326470.desc: Three thousand pieces of clothing just hit the floor. Iron out every crease, fold each one by hand, and file it back where it belongs. A cosy first-person tidying game that slowly automates your own ritual. Invite some friends to help, up to 8 players!
5326470.name: Walk-In: Fold It Together

5326680.desc: Experience a complete football career, from the youth academy to stardom. Create your player, develop through training, earn a place in the senior squad, compete matches, negotiate contracts, and turn every decision into part of your legacy.
5326680.name: Career Manager 27

5326850.desc: Build your own record label from the ground up, release music, grow your reputation, expand into global markets, and turn a small music business into a worldwide empire. Manage your catalog, discover opportunities, and make the decisions that shape your success.
5326850.name: Music Empire Tycoon

5327890.desc: Step into the serene celestial sanctum of Tarot: Deck of Celestials. Draw from an authentic 78-card arcana imbued with cosmic lore, consult classic and custom spreads, record your journey in the persistent journal, and import custom decks to make the cosmos your own.
5327890.name: Tarot: Deck of Celestials

5328020.desc: Memórias de Arassay is a pixel art game based on legends from Guarapuava, Brazil. Journey through 2D platforming stages inspired by the Lagoa das Lágrimas, the Capela do Degolado and the serpent beneath the Cathedral, in a retro style that brings players closer to local memory.
5328020.name: Memórias de Arassay

5328170.desc: Anissa works long days and comes home to Theo. He cooks, she teases, and they've always liked it that way. Then she joins a gym, and a trainer named Marcus starts coming up in conversation.
5328170.name: Cucked By My Girlfriend : Part 1

5328230.desc: Two teams, one river, and every shot is visible. Play the story through six chapters and five towns, gear up your heroes and face twelve bosses, or fight up to 4v4 online. Tap close, charge far, use your second skill, and dodge what you can read.
5328230.name: Riftwater

5328440.desc: A rabbit, a jetpack and a lot of holes to dig. Collect every capsule, trap the robots, and hop from the launch pad to a black hole and up the Ascent across 37 levels. Three stars per level, ten time-trial sprints, a level editor. Old-school arcade platforming with a modern spring in its step.
5328440.name: Hoppernaut

5328470.desc: From the fall of Troy in 1200 BC to 1941, the whole Old World on one map. Rule one city, outlive your rivals, and pass the throne down two or three generations — 46 scenarios, 80 cities and 6,608 real historical figures. Not one of them is invented.
5328470.name: Age of Dynasty & Dust

5328980.desc: Defend the worlds of the Gaia Empire against the threat of the Abyss in this pixel-art action survival roguelite. Battle hordes of creatures, combine powerful abilities, grow stronger with every run, and defeat formidable bosses.
5328980.name: Cosmos Knights - Abyss Survivors

5329520.desc: There's something exciting about staying at a business hotel. A room you've never seen, a night all to yourself. What will you do? Please relax and enjoy your stay with us.
5329520.name: Staying at a Japanese Business Hotel

5329820.desc: Pirates trashed the island! Grab thousands of scattered goods and sort them into the right crates and shelves, solo or in 3-player co-op. Unlock portal doors, uncover secrets and race a friend in 1v1 sorting duels.
5329820.name: Island Sort

5329860.desc: Play as Frank, a developer at a highly secretive game development studio rushing to finish the studio's most anticipated release, while being disrupted by an obsessed fan trying to gain information on the long awaited game. Survive Frank's final night alone in this Psychological Horror experience.
5329860.name: Overtime : Development Hell

5330310.desc: Run a blood powered console company through 13 weeks of investors, scandals, negotiations, layoffs, promises, crises, and increasingly terrible business decisions. Keep the board happy. Keep Shawarma happy... Keep the customers quiet. Keep your job?
5330310.name: Shawarma Karma

5332920.desc: A turn-based western roguelite where your revolver is a slot machine. Load it round by round, fuse bullets into jackpot rounds, let your winnings ride at THE COUNT and take the rails all the way to The House, the casino at the end of the line.
5332920.name: ShotMachine

5332990.desc: A night atlas you draw roads across. Link towns, untangle jams with junctions and highways, throw bridges, run ferries and air links. Four worlds — from a 16-area island to a map of 120 — and a new map every day.
5332990.name: Roadweave

5333020.desc: Six new heroes, new Equipment and 15 Version Rules join Esports Godfather. Hunt isolated targets, build up to a decisive execution or bring the Final Fight forward. Create new lineups and Hero Card combinations, and find your winning strategy as the meta changes.
5333020.name: The expansion pack 3 of 'Esports Godfather'

5333130.desc: Enter a first-person horror experience inspired by folklore or legend. Explore haunting environments, investigate strange clues, record discoveries in your journal, and survive supernatural encounters. Learn the stories, follow the evidence, and decide what is hunting you before it's too late.
5333130.name: Trick Nor Treat

5333250.desc: Get 5,500 Premium Credits, the Premium Season Pass, one Classified Assignment, an exclusive outfit, a 15% Season Pass XP boost, and 20 Tier Skips. Only available while this season lasts!
5333250.name: Tom Clancy’s The Division 2 – Spearfall Supply Drop

5333560.desc: Ribbit Racing is a multiplayer racing game where you play as a frog on a bike. Race up to 4 players locally or 8 online. Use your tongue, your wits, and the track to win.
5333560.name: Ribbit Racing

5334110.desc: Run a parcel inspection desk. Weigh, X-ray and look up every shipment, compare it with the declaration and the latest regulations, then stamp and route it: approve, return, hold, confiscate or dispose. Earn cash, upgrade your workplace and keep up with a growing quota.
5334110.name: Parcel Inspector Simulator

5334410.desc: Malpractice never looked this fun. A falling-pill puzzle roguelike where you cure patients, climb a 10-floor hospital, and build runs from 32 prescriptions, five flawed doctors, and no clean bill of health.
5334410.name: Adverse Reaction

5335100.desc: It's Halloween night. The parents are out until midnight, and you're the babysitter. All you have to do is keep the porch light on and hand out candy.
5335100.name: Halloween 2026

5335510.desc: An entire Moon to clean. One toothbrush to start. Team up with up to 16 players, collect and sell lunar dust, upgrade your tools, and unlock cleaning vehicles. Turn a ridiculous job into a thriving operation, if your friends actually help.
5335510.name: Moon Sweepers

5336540.desc: Build high-scoring hands from shared traits in this deck-building roguelike. Combine 100 historical figures, 124 Legacies and 114 Event Cards. Add marks, draw or import your own cards, and challenge 100 historical bosses!
5336540.name: Chronicle Hands

5337360.desc: Fight, grow stronger, and uncover the secrets of a dangerous kingdom. Meet ten beautiful women, each with her own story, personality, and desires. Earn their trust, build relationships, and discover where this adventure will take you. Can you win their hearts?
5337360.name: The Elder Dildo

5337410.desc: An idle cultivation game that lives in the corner of your desktop. Meditate for Qi, break through realms by hand, hunt monsters for gear, and keep cultivating after you close the window.
5337410.name: Desktop Immortal

5337610.desc: Put your geographical prowess to the test, identifying countries on an interactive 3D globe. Challenge yourself, improve your skills, and get a better understanding of the global landscape! Not sure why two global super powers are constantly at odds? Maybe it's geographical!
5337610.name: Map the World

5337960.desc: A chess-fighting game where nothing is captured for free. Every capture drops both pieces into a 3D arena for a real-time 1v1 duel: attack with melee, cast spells, grab powerups! Only the survivor takes the square! An old school, fast-paced 1v1 PVP experience both in local couch-mode or via Steam!
5337960.name: Pawnage Demo

5338480.desc: A game based on chess. Solve 50 puzzles on boards of every kind and shape, with different types of tiles. Mechanics and rules that are a little crazy but a lot of fun.
5338480.name: Crazy Chess

5339560.desc: AMIDA Q is a high-difficulty amidakuji (ladder lottery) puzzle game. Place pieces on the board and guide the balls from the left to their assigned lanes, in the assigned order. New gimmicks keep appearing as you progress, making the board ever more complex. A dynamic, dramatic amidakuji experience.
5339560.name: AMIDA Q

5339970.desc: Guide master miller Alvaro through a drought-struck olive harvest in this adult romance visual novel. Choose among three routes with Rocio, Jimena, or Nieves, and face the personal costs of debt, rivalry, secrecy, and life in a village under pressure.
5339970.name: Extra Virgin Bedfellows

5340870.desc: Under a forest that forgot how to grow, one small mushroom wakes up. Spread a glowing web through nine hidden worlds, meet their small, strange neighbours, and wake the Heartseed. A cozy incremental game with a real ending.
5340870.name: Underbloom

5341700.desc: CrackBound is a 3D tabletop companion game based around gem generation and automation. Produce ores, watch stones move on conveyor belts, earn money and develop your growing industrial facility.
5341700.name: CrackBound

5342780.desc: A catgirl who lives in a cardboard box on your taskbar. Leave your PC too long and she pops out, knocks on your screen and nags you back to work. Pet her, pick her up by the scruff, teach her your own lines. Launches with a second character: Naiwa, the belly-laughing frog. Free to play.
5342780.name: 喵～该工作啦！ Nya! Back to Work

5343400.desc: A first person car flipping game. Find cheap used cars on your phone, on the side of the road or at storage auctions, and inspect them yourself. Fix what a buyer will notice, then sell them on, rent them out or race them for pink slips. Play solo or with up to three friends online.
5343400.name: Car Flipper

5343510.desc: High above the clouds, The Ironkeep Armory houses a legendary collection of weapons gathered from across the realm. Help an eccentric lord restore order to an overwhelming arsenal of swords, axes, daggers, and more. Every weapon has its place. Can you find them all?
5343510.fullgame_name: Shelves and Sorcery: Tidy Up the Enchanted Shop
5343510.name: Shelves and Sorcery - Too Many Weapons!

5343650.desc: An adult pixel-art airline sim. Serve the cabin in 20 hands-on mini-games, hire and dress your crew, build your plane piece by piece and climb to 5,280 feet to join the Mile High Club.
5343650.name: Mile High Club

5344130.desc: Learn Chinese from scratch with 1000 princes! Choose from Chinese courses at different levels and themed courses taught by the prince teachers, ask them questions and receive their answers. Each prince teacher shares his own story while teaching you Chinese.
5344130.name: LEARN CHINESE WITH 1000 PRINCES

5345650.desc: Fight through a shifting rift in a 3D action roguelite. Choose Lumi, Bram, or Nox and master melee, shield, or rune abilities; shape each eight-stage, 64-area expedition with routes and blessings; and bring down eight stage bosses with friends in online co-op or with AI companions.
5345650.name: ASCENT: MASKLINGS

5345780.desc: A flirty match-3 puzzle game with 10 distinct characters and 99 levels. Pop bubbles, break heart locks and ice, and master new chapter mechanics as expressions and vocal reactions heat up with your combos. Match gems. Catch feelings.
5345780.name: BlockBabe

5345880.desc: Small choices. Wonderfully weird stories. Meet fictional companions, explore illustrated Solo adventures and keep your favorite endings. Or invite a friend to a private word story in browser Multiplayer. Adults 18+; separate accounts required for Multiplayer.
5345880.name: QuipKite

5346980.desc: Play 30 fps console games at 60 fps, and 40 or 60 fps games at 120 fps, with experimental frame generation. NitLink is a low-latency capture card viewer with real HDR10 passthrough, picture-in-picture and native support for Elgato 4K Pro, 4K X and 4K S capture cards.
5346980.name: NitLink

5347440.desc: Spend your last cash on a gun, a perk or a way out. DEADSHIFT is a single-player & multiplayer, top-down zombie survival roguelike. Repair barricades, unlock rooms and evolve your weapons across six maps. Beat the wave-30 boss, then keep fighting in endless mode.
5347440.name: Deadshift

5347650.desc: Defend real cities from night raids on a satellite map of the Earth. Build launchers, nets and radar by day. At night, hunt drones and missiles in the dark before they hit.
5347650.name: Steel Umbrella

5348620.desc: Sort thousands of tiny lands in this cozy tidy-up. Each piece rises as real land you can walk on, and every one earns you upgrades. Play Solo or Co-op.
5348620.name: Tidy Up the Wonderlands of Mirad

5348940.desc: Build your interstellar empire in Exo7! Colonize new worlds, extract Metal, Silicium, Tridioxid, and Antimatter, build mighty fleets, and explore hyperspace. Choose your faction, conquer raids and bounty hunts, and dominate Sector 7!
5348940.name: Exo7

5349000.desc: The Second Advent world works just like an actual advent calendar; you can count down the days to Christmas in Coloring Voxels this December as you unlock 1 level each day from the 1st of December to the 24th! Build a selection of Christmas scenes this year as we get excited for the big day!
5349000.name: Coloring Voxels - Advent 2 Pack

5349180.desc: Shout your spells. Logosmancer is a chaotic wizard brawler where you cast with your actual voice - yell FIREBALL, FREEZE, FLY, TRANSFORM... or FART. King of the Hill, Team Deathmatch, Free-for-All, and a Sandbox with optional monster waves, solo or with friends. Mic required.
5349180.name: Logosmancer

5349710.desc: A new kind of horror game that builds a stage just for you from the results of a fear diagnosis. Scary, and a little funny. Heights, tight spaces, bugs, ghosts, even paperwork: your fears combine into over 2 million stages, so no two runs are alike. Too scary? Exclude any fear in the settings.
5349710.name: IAFT Fear Diagnosis

5350040.desc: A free 1v1 collectible card game with a mean sense of humour. Build a 30-card deck from six kinds of mana, climb the ranked ladder, draft from sealed packs and fight in weekly tournaments.
5350040.name: Manafest

5350670.desc: In this game, you'll give massages to girls currently in heat. As a staff member at a massage parlor, your goal is to fulfill the requests of visiting girls and leave them thoroughly satisfied. Four unique characters are eagerly waiting for your touch!
5350670.name: EstrusEcstasy

5351930.desc: Why wait for heroes to come for you? Build and deploy a monster army to eliminate them before they grow strong enough to defeat you. A strategy roguelite from the Demon Lord’s perspective!
5351930.name: Against Heroes

5352470.desc: Bring the greatest sport in the world to your Twitch stream with Corgi Race Live! Stream corgi races and have your chat compete with you; picking winners, exactas and trifectas with hopes of topping the leaderboard. Take on the mantle of corgi racing host and bring everyone to the party.
5352470.name: Corgi Race Live

5352510.desc: Understand game chat and write back in another language. Capture your saved chat region with a shortcut, read original messages beside their translations, then translate and copy your reply. Local OCR and translation are included, with optional support for your own external service.
5352510.name: Game Translation

5353330.desc: Crack stones, discover what's inside and build a legendary collection. Break rocks from a giant quarry pile, sell your ore, upgrade your tools and hunt 20 rare special stones with your detector. Play solo or in online or LAN co-op for up to 4 players.
5353330.name: Cairn & Carat

5353720.desc: Customize your mouse cursor with 500 unique styles and give it a trail. 352 trails: comets, dragons, fireflies, a pet that naps by your pointer. Tune genes in the Lab or splice two trails into new ones. Featherweight and click-through, with no hooks or injection, on Windows 10 and 11.
5353720.name: MorphTrail

5353910.desc: One tree. An entire ecosystem to grow. Build your defenses, unleash spores and summoned allies, and survive relentless waves of pests in this incremental defense game. Earn permanent upgrades and help the last tree grow stronger with every cycle.
5353910.name: The Last Tree

5354090.desc: Speedboats that race, jump and fight on the water, then open their wings and take the battle into the sky. Up to four players online or against bots, real physics, a crown on the leader that everyone hunts, and full gamepad support.
5354090.name: Clash of Boats

5354240.desc: A used-game shop after closing, its floor buried under 5,000+ games and consoles. Pick one up, read the label, and put it on its console's shelf until the shop is tidy. A first-person tidying sim with no timer and no game over. Get faster, find small rewards, and play with up to 3 friends.
5354240.name: THE BACKLOG

5355990.desc: Shanghai, 1994. A young footballer refuses to quit after losing his place. Move one player as AI teams play around you, pause to choose key actions, and seek another trial through local jobs, 3v3 matches and ten club training games.
5355990.name: 中国球王之路

5356510.desc: Fight through intense FPS operations alongside the X-Dolls. Complete objectives, upgrade your weapons and abilities, hunt secrets, eliminate powerful bosses, and survive a campaign across hostile locations filled with supernatural threats and deadly enemies.
5356510.name: X-Dolls Squad

5356830.desc: A wild 1980s crime adventure where dating, dirty jobs, drag races, shootouts, and adult fun collide. Explore the city, make money, build relationships, and cause trouble as you work your way toward the biggest score of your life.
5356830.name: GRAND TIDDY ADVENTURES 🚨

5357700.desc: Survive a dinosaur park with 3–8 players in an online game of cooperation and social deduction. Repair facilities, share supplies, and vote out suspects—or sabotage your friends as a hidden cultist. Transform into a dinosaur and turn suspicion into a chase.
5357700.name: Jurassic Paradise: No Escape

5358090.desc: Step behind the counter of a quiet little pharmacy and bring order to its shelves. Sort, stack and arrange medicines one box at a time in this cozy organizing game. No timers, no pressure, just the simple joy of a perfectly tidy shelf.
5358090.name: Tidy Pills

5358610.desc: Build a cat tree right on your desktop. Cats climb the post, leap from the top and bounce off the rides you place, earning gold with every hit. Arrange rides, meet a growing crew of cats and decorate your Cat House in a cozy idle game that plays quietly beside your work.
5358610.name: Desktop Cozy Cat Tree

5359810.desc: A turn-based card strategy game set in the Taiping Rebellion. Guided by Heaven, you become Hong Xiuquan, God's second son. Unlock characters, build a team, and exploit Five Elements matchups and formation bonuses. Complete six story chapters; unlock roguelike challenges after Chapter 2.
5359810.name: Peaceward Chronicles

5359980.desc: Chill Summoners is an idle game celebrating Grand Summoners' 10th anniversary. It features nine relaxing arrangements of Grand Summoners music plus a Pomodoro timer to assist your productivity while working or studying. Customize the settings for your own personal stroll through Raktehelm.
5359980.name: Chill Summoners

5360050.desc: Carnival: Tidy Up! is a cozy fairground restoration sim. Recycle 75,928 pieces of junk, hunt down missing parts, and repair the attractions. Bring the amusement park back to its former glory, then sit back and enjoy the rides!
5360050.name: Carnival: Tidy Up!

5360650.desc: Command a modern army against monsters in turn-based battles across Europe. Recover the wounded, study enemies to reveal their health and damage, and decide which front to hold as the invasion spreads.
5360650.name: Spellraid

5360670.desc: In this 2D platformer, through 4 different worlds. Face a gauntlet of 17 different boss fight. Beat them all and face your future. The golden crown awaits.
5360670.name: Bone Breaker

5360720.desc: An overworked accountant in a ninja suit takes on his entire company. Fight your way out of Megacorp Tower in a pixel-art action platformer, solo or with up to three friends in online co-op.
5360720.name: Escape Your Boss

5361610.desc: Command a U.S. Army Sustainment Company in a punishing military strategy campaign. Scout threats, clear routes, escort supplies, and lead armored and infantry offensives. Upgrade your fleet, develop your NCOs, and face the consequences of every loss.
5361610.name: Expeditionary Sustainment Command

5362770.desc: Dookie Clicker: The Big Pfft is a Peachy-themed incremental clicker game, set in a bubbling sewer laboratory. Click to make pffts, build ridiculous factories from the Whoopie Cushion to the Methane Volcano, snatch random power-ups and grow your stinkiest empire yet OH YEAH..keep eyes peeled for fly!
5362770.name: Dookie Clicker: The Big Pfft

5363210.desc: Jerry and Jasper is a simple RPG experience involving traditional turn based combat, mission variations based on player choices, and various unique puzzles. Filled with dozens of impactful choices, every variation of Jerry and Jaspers Journey is bound to be unique.
5363210.name: Jerry and Jaspers Jovial Journey

5363480.desc: A quiet autumn evening in a small seaside town. The soft flicker of a monitor, drizzle outside, and your favorite tracks playing in your headphones. A simple "hi" from a stranger breaks the quiet. What starts as a chat to pass the time becomes a fragile thread connecting two very different worlds...
5363480.name: Sincerely, Your Diary

5364130.desc: Restore order to a cruise ship off Benidorm. Pick up 4,300 products, complete 64 objectives across 16 shops and solve preparation tasks. Upgrade your abilities, discover hidden souvenirs and play at your own pace in this single-player organizing game.
5364130.name: Benidorm Cruiser Order

5365570.desc: MATE, This Place is a MESS! is a cozy organizing game where you sort 5,000 yerba mate packages in a messy museum. Fill the shelves, brew your mate, unlock abilities and kick packages into place. At the end of the hall, a huge curtain hides the truth about the museum. What could it be?
5365570.name: MATE, This Place is a MESS!

5365790.desc: A jigsaw puzzle game set in a print workshop. Assemble 24 archival and original prints with distinct piece cuts, free rotation, and room to build off the board. Finish each Working Proof to reveal the completed print, then file it in your Cabinet. Selected prints offer a Second Look challenge.
5365790.name: Impression Cabinet

5366290.desc: ▣ Stylish Sci-Fi Action RPG ▣ ■ Switch combat suits and classes in real time. ■ Master parries, perfect dodges, and powerful combos. ■ Battle massive enemies across vast battlefields with other Guardians.
5366290.name: ARES: THE IRON VANGUARD

5366850.desc: A short, mystery-thriller adventure game about attending to a regular Halloween party. At least, that's the goal. Right?
5366850.name: IMMISCERE

5367060.desc: This pack expands your Storage space and lets you organize items into separate tabs.
5367060.name: DPS - Storage Pack

5367070.desc: This pack is for players who want to support the development team.
5367070.name: DPS - Supporter Pack

5367320.desc: Play Spotify, YouTube or game audio through your microphone in Discord, Zoom, Teams or OBS, and talk over it. AuxPipe mixes one app's sound with your voice. The virtual cable is included.
5367320.name: AuxPipe

5367460.desc: A Windows app that reads game subtitles and interface text in a selected screen area and translates them in place. Choose from offline-capable local models covering up to 100 languages, with stable subtitle overlays and a customizable glass-style display.
5367460.name: Real-Time Screen Translator

5369020.desc: 3D isometric open-world Action/Shooter. The city, devastated by a nuclear explosion, was seized by hostile factions. The main character, together with his ranger friend, decides to restore order and free it from the chaos.
5369020.name: The Last UNION

5369070.desc: Buy lost suitcases from flights around the world, crack them open and see what is inside: socks, cameras, gold bricks or a rubber duck. Sell every find on the baggage belt and grow your dusty garage into an automated luggage business.
5369070.name: Lost Luggage

5370260.desc: What are friends for if not to build a tower out of junk together... In Junk Tower Together, take turns stacking the most ridiculous objects, balance on the brink of disaster, and build a crazy tower with a group of up to 8 players.
5370260.name: Junk Tower Together

5370360.desc: You lost your hat in the middle of a vast desert and must keep digging to find it!
5370360.name: Digging In The Desert

5371390.desc: Find and Survive the Footage of Lost VHS Tapes that have been uncovered in this adventure. Discover new Puppets and secrets in this Horror/Point and Click Game. The Puppets are up to lots of tricks so make sure you use all the tech given to you to make sure you stay... safe.
5371390.name: Finnigan's Magical Puppets

5371810.desc: Cozy Tent is a quiet, single-player ambience game. Stay inside a tent in the forest while the rain falls: make a hot drink, read, play chess, watch a sky that follows the real clock and moon, and share the tent with a ferret.
5371810.name: Cozy Tent

5371870.desc: Grandpas in wheelchairs, a pub full of games and 22 maps to race over. Bet on the chaos, throw everything you grab, beat every pub's boss in Story Mode or play with friends online in Chaos Run, 1v1 Duels, tournaments and 25+ pub games. Full controller support, Steam Deck ready.
5371870.name: Afterpub

5372560.desc: Manage a football club in a persistent online world. Build your squad, set tactics, develop facilities and compete in evolving leagues while your decisions shape the long-term future of your club. Scout talent and follow every result.
5372560.name: Zattrick Manager

5372890.desc: A medieval fantasy village builder and auto battler. Gather resources, expand your settlement, and build a force of warriors, archers, and mages to face monster waves. When your village falls, spend earned Skulls on lasting upgrades and return stronger.
5372890.name: Amberfall: Village Defense

5373210.desc: Build roads, intersections, and tram lines. The city grows on its own along the roads you lay. Ease congestion and turn a village into a metropolis.
5373210.name: Arteria

5373260.desc: Sound in liquid form. Ferro is a real-time 3D audio-reactive fluid simulation. Shape liquid, light and motion with music, MIDI, automation, or even your microphone. Infinitely customizable, place on your desktop or add to your livestream for an expressive companion to your sound.
5373260.name: Ferro - 3D Audio Visualizer

5373430.desc: ATELIER BLOCKS is a falling-block puzzle game built around customization, creation, and multiple ways to play. It features 18 single-player rule sets, nine AI battle rule sets, cute minigames, and five Creation Studios.
5373430.name: ATELIER BLOCKS

5373670.desc: Shards of Veyara is an adventure game that blends farming with 3D platformer action. Explore the sky islands of Veyara—a world warped across space and time—gather seeds and resources, cultivate crops in your hub to grow stronger, and reclaim the shattered Dimensional Shards!
5373670.name: Shards of Veyara

5374070.desc: Return to the old gas station years later, this time as a raccoon. Turn the snowbound backwoods into a winter resort with an ice rink, ski slopes, guided tours, and cozy cabins for your guests.
5374070.name: The Last Gas Station: Winter Resort

5374580.desc: A cozy anime picture puzzle. Piece together 32 hand-finished illustrations with gentle sliding and jigsaw puzzles, collect the whole alphabet from A to Z, and keep every artwork as a wallpaper. Warm music, no timers, no pressure.
5374580.name: A to Zen: Cozy Anime Puzzle

5374820.desc: Chopper, the jester executioner wielding giant shears, joins your squad! Meet a new melee damage dealer who slices through enemies by switching between combat stances.
5374820.name: DPS - Character Pack : Chopper

5374830.desc: On the final night as the moon fades away, a reaper named Geumeum joins your squad! Meet a support character who guides wandering souls and aids allies with a Spirit Bell and Censer.
5374830.name: DPS - Character Pack : Geumeum

5375170.desc: Cozy, short and relaxing: cast your net to clean up a dirty lake and bring nature back. With dogs as helpers, recycle trash and earn money to upgrade your gear. Lots of hidden treasures to find and wash, in a satisfying mini-game to decorate your house. Wildlife appreciates your work.
5375170.name: My Dirty Little Lake

5375310.desc: Low scores. High stakes. HEARTRIFT is a single-player tactical card roguelike. Reveal cards, replace high values and clear matching columns. Develop four colour paths, combine relics and choose your route through a fractured world.
5375310.name: Heartrift

5375410.desc: Link Loop is a 2D puzzle platformer built around portals and satisfying physics. Use portals to move objects, redirect lasers, and transport fluids. Levels have multiple solutions, and creativity is key.
5375410.name: Link Loop

5375770.desc: Become the last Reaper in a brutal dark fantasy action game featuring precision sword combat, reactive enemy AI, advanced gore physics, and devastating supernatural abilities. Master deadly encounters, command, and unleash carnage across endless waves of enemies.
5375770.name: Mox Nox

5375890.desc: Turn a chaotic dice shop into a satisfying collection. Pick up, inspect and sort 4,095 colorful dice into matching sets, fill wooden shelves and unlock handy upgrades in this cozy first-person organizing game.
5375890.name: Sort Them Dice

5376400.desc: Add a 16-print railway and industrial jigsaw puzzle album to Impression Cabinet. Assemble locomotives, bridges, rail yards, maps, technical drawings, and steelworks. Complete each Working Proof and file the finished print in a new album.
5376400.name: Impression Cabinet: Steam & Steel

5376720.desc: 'Still Not Dead Yet' is a suspenseful horror-thriller text story inspired by H. P. Lovecraft. In a dark mausoleum, a grieving professor performs an archaic ritual to resurrect his recently deceased wife. The ritual succeeds, setting him down an unforeseen path.
5376720.name: Still Not Dead Yet

5376970.desc: Turn a small backyard into a farm that supplies an entire town. Grow crops, make goods, deliver orders and expand your business — solo or in co-op with up to 4 players.
5376970.name: Farm Business Simulator

5377070.desc: Fell the forest, float thousands of logs down the river and turn them into firewood, planks and profit. A cosy top-down idler where every log is simulated: jams build up, raftsmen break them loose, and a single axe grows into a humming timber empire.
5377070.name: Floatwood

5377120.desc: A dead island. A town crawling with the Mindless. Something in the woods that only moves when you look away, and smiles before it kills. Scavenge, forge your weapons, hold your base against raiders and survive the night, alone or with up to 7 friends.
5377120.name: Purplestar

5377410.desc: Defend your throne against undead hordes in a pixel-art siege roguelite. Aim your attacks without leaving your seat, hunt legendary gear, and combine seven schools of power. Turn your spoils into permanent kingdom upgrades. The king will not survive the siege. His gold will.
5377410.name: King Dies Rich

5377770.desc: Rope a rooftop, swing over the street and settle it with a six-shooter. RUSTLERS is a cartoon Wild West shooter with 8-player PvP, a lasso that does it all, six modes from high-noon duels to the Black Stallion's night hunt, 20+ period guns and 11 maps.
5377770.name: Rustlers Online

5377980.desc: Raise and grow your very own Graz! Make him burp, spend your Burpo on increasingly peculiarly snacks, and feed him until he's ready to Asscend. A crude, colorful clicker with goblins, Burpo Frenzies, leeching Giovannis and 2-player online or LAN co-op.
5377980.name: Raise a Graz

5378030.desc: A Napoleonic-era Roguelite Tower Defense. Lead the defense of the Wall against the hordes of the apocalypse. Command the united armies of Europe, deploy living lines of defense, map out range cards, and halt tens of thousands of enemies. Ready! Present! Fire! Commander, win humanity one more dawn.
5378030.name: La Muraille 1806

5378110.desc: Mow lawns in first person on a beat-up riding mower, solo or online co-op up to 6 players. You're a grumpy old man who smokes, drinks cheap beer and doesn't care, but leaves perfect stripes. A picky neighbor, an abandoned golf course, an island wedding.
5378110.name: One More Lawn

5378180.desc: Free 4K pack for Dawn. It adds the whole film in 2160p and 10-bit colour, with the film grain intact. The download is optional, about 20 GB, and you pick it in the player's settings. You need the film to use it.
5378180.name: DAWN AEROWAR - Pack 4K

5378450.desc: Big mess. Little goblin. Goblins and humans are at war, and thousands of stolen treasures need sorting! Fill shelves, grow towers, and unlock magical upgrades and gadgets in a cozy, family-friendly sorting adventure that's easy to learn and fun for goblins of all ages!
5378450.name: Goblin Hoarder

5379430.desc: Take command of a steam-powered airship and battle across the storm-torn skies. Fight solo, challenge AI, compete online, experience a cinematic story, or survive the relentless waves and colossal bosses of Redwake Siege.
5379430.name: Stormtide Skies

5379520.desc: A knockout party game for 1–8 friends online. 69 minigames of reflexes, memory, aim and nerve, each explained in one line. Everyone plays the same level at the same time. Fail, or come last, and you're out. First to 100 points is the smartest in the room.
5379520.name: Smartest in the Room

5379640.desc: Aim for the head as zombies close in through darkness and fear. Earn gold, unlock permanent upgrades, and survive escalating waves of special infected and bosses in this 2D pixel survival shooter. Choose upgrades carefully, control the horde, and push for a higher score in every short run.
5379640.name: HEADSHOT: Zombie Doomsday

5380110.desc: Peekour is a 2D pixel art platformer. YOU desperately need to pee and only the final toilet counts! Run, jump and parkour through 6+ levels. Collect coins and bottles of water to get more pee, and customize your experience with 40+ skins.
5380110.name: Peekour

5380650.desc: Retro arcade action meets glowing 3D voxels in this twin-stick arena shooter. Dodge bullets, shatter enemy ships and turn wreckage into upgrades. Build your ship across five sectors, then push further in Overdrive and Endless mode.
5380650.name: VOXFRAG

5380750.desc: Fit weapons, armor and relics into your backpack as you progress through the dungeon! Neighboring items give each other bonuses and find rare Catalyst Stone to automate whatever touches it. Get stronger by unlocking a 200+ Ascendancy tree between runs, and play solo or in online co-op with a friend!
5380750.name: Backpack Ascendancy

5381000.desc: A simple management game at the bottom of your desktop. Assign dwarves to gather, craft, research, and trade. Pay gold to Snow White, a fearsome dragon, every ten years and guide your settlement through a hundred-year fairy tale.
5381000.name: Snow White and the Dwarf Slaves

5381260.desc: Terrum DeepDrill is a single-player drilling game in a 2.5D side view. Terrum Corp owns your debt and calls it a contract. Win tenders against rival firms, drill through the rock, and haul enough ore to stay ahead of the bill.
5381260.name: Terrum DeepDrill

5383190.desc: Team up with up to 3 players and tackle parkour courses in a town swallowed by water! Take on the Sunken Bloom and Drowned Wastes maps, overcome obstacles, create chaos with your cars, and choose between collision-free or collision-enabled gameplay with the Immunity feature!
5383190.name: Car Parkour 4 Together

5383550.desc: A physics-based roguelike where you pull back a marble, let go, and score every time it bounces off a wall. Combine Patches to activate multiple Synergies, upgrade them and collect Relics to make a build of your own, then climb past rule-bending bosses to the final boss.
5383550.name: CLACKPOT: Marble Bounce Roguelike

5386810.desc: Your first night shift in a police evidence archive nobody has filed in years. Pick up loose papers, photos and tapes, uncover hidden case numbers with the right tool, then press, stamp, box and shelve each case. No clock, no quota, no way to fail.
5386810.name: Evidence Vault

5386950.desc: Thread a hovering wheel of cheese through gaps that never stop tightening. A hit costs a slice; dodge clean and it grows back. Chase your best, race everyone on the Daily Seed, and beat friends and ranked rivals on the exact same course. Earn skins, shapes, trails and maps as you play.
5386950.name: Cheese Racers

5388200.desc: A 2D survivor action game. Players choose hidden heroes such as Little Mage and Wave Swordsman to survive and strengthen their skills in the constantly surging tide of enemies, challenge their limits - and fully enjoy the decompression and dopamine pleasure brought by bullet screen monster clearing.
5388200.name: 球球幸存者 · Ball Survivor

5388330.desc: Splatterworks is a physics sandbox where every experiment leaves a mark. Build contraptions, stage ragdoll battles, and unleash weapons and hazards on a detailed injury simulation. Create chaos solo or bring friends along for online co-op.
5388330.name: Splatterworks

5388370.desc: A fast-paced action game with a taste for lowbrow sexuality. No puzzles. No complicated progression. Just you, your enemies, and a little bit of strategy. Use your surroundings, outsmart your enemies, and find your own way to take them down. Simple, shameless, and unapologetically trashy.
5388370.name: Femme Fury(Pure Classic Simple Action Game)

5389200.desc: An online space-mining idle incremental game that lives in the corner of your screen. Mine alongside other pilots, unlock automatic mining, upgrade your ship, and build your own orbital station while you work or browse.
5389200.name: Asteroid Watch

5389460.desc: Pocket Furry is a relaxing and heartfelt dating simulator where your choices matter. There are no right or wrong answers. Just choose what she likes.
5389460.name: Pocket Furry

5389650.desc: EVO RNG is slot-machine god-game - draft creatures, press spin and watch your ecosystem hunt, merge and evolve on its own. Collect, chase paylines, food chains and mythic creatures. Game does not contain any real money gambling elements.
5389650.name: EVO RNG

5390220.desc: A classic-style arcade game with fast-paced sessions. Descend with your avatar into the desolate mortal world, filled with dangers and monsters, and fight to survive.
5390220.name: Vaatar

5390550.desc: A beautiful married woman moves in next door. One day, while her husband is away, she makes a bold move on you. Unable to resist her sweet temptation, you begin a secret affair filled with forbidden pleasure. A sweet and naughty relationship begins whenever her husband is away...
5390550.name: The Wife Next Door - She Drains Me While Her Husband's Away

5390630.desc: Sort scattered candles, fill the shelves, and bring order to a cozy candlelit room. Unlock upgrades through a skill tree to arrange candles faster and watch the clutter disappear in this relaxing first person organizing game.
5390630.name: Can You Candle it?

5390670.desc: "Deeper..." is a short game about an obsessed diver. Diving accumulates DEEP, which you can spend to enhance your next dive. Your wife will faithfully wait and assist you but how long will you keep her worrying?
5390670.name: Deeper...

5391250.desc: Chaos in the wizard's shop? An army of knights at the inn? Tidy Up Ltd. is on the job! Pick up wares, sweep away dust and put furniture where it belongs. Play cozy co-op for 1 to 8 players, from a little shop to a huge academy of magic.
5391250.name: Tidy Up Ltd.: A Cozy Co-op Cleanup

5391260.desc: Fish It!: Sort the Aquarium Shop is a cozy organizing simulator where you put back over 4,100 unique fish into their aquariums. Fill the tanks, unlock helpful abilities, and enjoy the satisfying loop of turning total aquatic chaos into a clean, well-organized shop at your own pace.
5391260.name: Fish It!: Sort the Aquarium Shop

5391510.desc: Learn game theory optimal (GTO) poker five minutes a day. Tea Break deals you a hand, a seat and a decision, grades your answer against solver output, and tells you which idea a mistake broke. A study tool for No Limit cash Hold'em, not a poker game: no real money, no wagering.
5391510.name: Tea Break Poker Trainer

5392220.desc: The soundtrack for Zombie Police: Midsummer Unhappy New Year. Enjoy the music from the game.
5392220.fullgame_name: Zombie Police: Midsummer Unhappy New Year
5392220.name: ゾンビポリス ～ゾンビ刑事と凍てつく真夏のお正月～ Soundtrack

5393560.desc: On the witch's request, the nun Agnès sinks deeper into the ancient ruins. An R18 pixel-art exploration action game. Caught by monsters, her clothes tear on the spot as she is defiled. Over 70 lewd scenes. Corruption drags her down, and at times she offers herself to monsters and lewd tools...
5393560.name: SisterFall

5393800.desc: Go back through time and kill Grandad. A co-op board game with absurd weapons used to hunt your Grandfather throughout the decades to create the ultimate grandfather paradox... The Grandparadox! Play solo with bot helpers, or with up to 9 other people in online multiplayer!
5393800.name: Grandparadox

5393950.desc: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!
5393950.name: Puzzle Dinosaur Skeletons

5394070.desc: A short horror cooking game. Run your dead uncle's burger cart on a foggy harbour pier in the 1970s. Cook for the locals, spot the drowned before they reach your window, and find out who really killed your uncle.
5394070.name: The Usual, Please

5394410.desc: Descend into a traditional turn-based roguelike of deadly dungeons, strange heroes, and sixteen demanding gods. Create your adventurer, recover ancient Orbs, and survive to tithe your treasures. Compete in the one-shot Daily Delve, uncover fallen players' graves, or watch and bless their adventures.
5394410.name: Titheborn

5395030.desc: Every hero summoned to this world got an amazing skill. You got [Idle]: you only get stronger while doing absolutely nothing. Your party fights the Demon Lord's armies. You nap under a tree and collect all the EXP. An idle comedy that plays better when you're not playing it.
5395030.name: I Was Reincarnated with the [Idle] Skill, and Now I Do Nothing

5395630.desc: Fight through 15 escalating defense battles in this strategy RPG expansion. Capture valuable nodes, launch daring counterattacks, recruit familiar heroes, strengthen your squads, earn army-wide bonuses between chapters, and push your army command skills to new heights.
5395630.fullgame_name: Symphony of War: The Nephilim Saga
5395630.name: Symphony of War: The Nephilim Saga - Hold the Line

5395840.desc: You are a cow. Everyone insists this is normal. MOO at anyone or anything, anytime, and watch a simple ID errand spiral into chain reactions. Go viral on Y, grow followers to unlock bigger scenes, play the stock market and drag your herd onto the field. Optional on-device AI chat.
5395840.name: MOO

5395920.desc: Bring order to a shop overflowing with collectible frogs. Pick up and sort colorful figures, fill themed shelves, unlock helpful upgrades, and search for hidden eggs. Build your collection one frog at a time.
5395920.name: Frog Collector

5396240.desc: Help the hot streamer girl to win the tournament and achieve sympathy of the sexy vampire queen.
5396240.name: EmyLiveShow Origins: Nia The Gamer Queen

5396440.desc: Poke, stretch and fling your squishy jelly! Every texture feels different. Then trap rivals with jelly bombs — pang-pang! Stages 1–15 are free; the Full Version Unlock DLC adds 16–50.
5396440.name: Pop! Jelly PangPang

5396620.desc: Lead Japan’s first external intelligence training course in eighty years as Naoki Tsukuda, an honest ex-consular officer learning the art of deception. Choose one of three complete romance routes where duty, grief, trust, and desire collide.
5396620.name: Tokyo Honey Trap for Beginners

5397370.desc: Great things grow stronger together! Backed by TRENTILA, Alliance wants to turn teamwork into triumph at The Grand Major 2026. Show your allegiance with their official team bundle!
5397370.name: THE FINALS - Alliance TGM26

5397380.desc: Ape Squad is ready to go bananas at The Grand Major 2026! Show you support them with their official team collection. VAIIYA’s backing this monkey business!
5397380.name: THE FINALS - Ape Squad TGM26

5397390.desc: Elevate is ready to raise the bar at The Grand Major 2026! And with ALFA ACTA backing them, you can bet they've got a contingency plan for every possible outcome. Show your support with their official collection!
5397390.name: THE FINALS - Elevate TGM26

5397400.desc: ENVY is heading to The Grand Major 2026, and they're planning to give the competition plenty to be jealous of! Show your support with their official team collection, backed by HYDRA-Q.
5397400.name: THE FINALS - ENVY TGM26

5397410.desc: Five Fears is ready to spread some serious fright in The Grand Major 2026! Support the team with their official collection, powered by OSPUZE. The competition has been warned.
5397410.name: THE FINALS - Five Fears TGM26

5397420.desc: Where there's smoke, there's FYR! This squad's ready to turn up the heat at The Grand Major 2026, with VOLPE fueling the flames. Show your support with their official team collection!
5397420.name: THE FINALS - FYR TGM26

5397430.desc: The Kansas City Pioneers are blazing a trail to The Grand Major 2026! With ALFA ACTA behind them, you can bet they've come properly prepared. Show your support with their official team collection!
5397430.name: THE FINALS - KCP TGM26

5397440.desc: KingZero isn't here to count the seconds in The Grand Major 2026. They're here to make every moment count! Rep them with their OSPUZE-powered collection.
5397440.name: THE FINALS - KingZero TGM26

5397450.desc: Luminon is looking to light up The Grand Major 2026. They’re backed by HOLTOW, so at least someone's insured! Show your support with their official team collection.
5397450.name: THE FINALS - Luminon TGM26

5397460.desc: Moon Theory has an interesting theory about who should take the crown at The Grand Major 2026. Rep the team with their official collection, brought to you by VAIIYA!
5397460.name: THE FINALS - Moon Theory TGM26

5397470.desc: No limits. No looking back. Nfinite is heading to The Grand Major 2026 with HYDRA-Q in their corner and their sights set on the crown. Show your support with the team's official team collection!
5397470.name: THE FINALS - Nfinite TGM26

5397480.desc: Many teams dream of winning The Grand Major 2026. NTMR is here to ruin those dreams! Get behind the squad with an official collection, brought to you by VOLPE!
5397480.name: THE FINALS - NTMR TGM26

5397490.desc: Things are about to get RAD at The Grand Major 2026! With DISSUN supplying the power, this squad is ready to turn up the heat. Show your support with their official team collection!
5397490.name: THE FINALS - RAD TGM26

5397500.desc: Fasten your seatbelts! Take Flyte is heading for The Grand Major 2026, and HOLTOW has them covered. Rep the team with their official collection!
5397500.name: THE FINALS - Take Flyte TGM26

5397520.desc: Vanguard Gaming is charging into Grand Major 2026 with their sights on the top of the bracket! Powered by DISSUN, this official team collection is ready to bring some serious competitive energy to your Arena loadout.
5397520.name: THE FINALS - Vanguard TGM26

5398160.desc: Gopher It is a cozy first-person job sim about being the newest intern in an office full of animals. When someone calls, you go and do what they want: copies, coffee, the post, a birthday card to pass round. Play solo or with up to three friends. No timers, no game over.
5398160.name: Gopher It: Office Intern Simulator

5398370.desc: A unique roguelike word fusing mutant breeding game! Fuse the monsters and the words into one creature. Form an army of mutants and battle the world! Or play with a friend and fuse parts together.
5398370.name: Battlegenics

5398560.desc: A Soviet reactor has gone silent. Enter ZHELEZO in this dark retro FPS, battle radioactive mutants and uncover a reality beyond the walls. Fight through 24 levels across four acts, wield seven weapons and face endless enemy waves in Survival mode.
5398560.name: Iron Reactor

5398720.desc: A roguelike deckbuilder where your cards are scratch tickets. Scratch to fight, push your luck for the JACKPOT and stop before you go BUST. Build a deck of tickets and climb from the Shantytown to the King's Palace.
5398720.name: The Scratcher

5398740.desc: Starwaste is a voxel space sandbox about exploration, survival and building. Dismantle wreckage, research resources and turn an abandoned scrapyard into a base — alone or with a crew.
5398740.name: Starwaste

5399320.desc: A retired ronin picking up his sword one last time, and a bamboo forest that has grown over his whole life. Cut your way through it one swing at a time, haul the pieces home, sharpen your blade and find out what's waiting at your old master's grave.
5399320.name: Bamboo Ronin: The Last Cut

5399970.desc: Air Support is a top-down arcade helicopter shooter in a world of plastic toy soldiers. Fly a Green Army gunship over backyard battlefields, blast the Tan Army, winch up cargo, and bring a friend in co-op.
5399970.name: Plastic Soldiers: Air Support

5400000.desc: An incremental tycoon about getting rich in a crooked city. Play as a thief, a dirty cop, a 9–5 worker or a suburban teen, and climb from nobody to the person Port Vesper can't function without. Every run, the city you left behind has changed.
5400000.name: Upstart Tycoon

5401070.desc: Relax with 20 free jigsaw puzzles and difficulties ranging from 24 to 500 pieces. Explore animals, nature, Japan, travel and fantasy at your own pace.
5401070.name: Kingdom of Pieces

5401230.desc: A zombie-survival game that lives on top of your desktop. By day a gas-masked rat scavenges, crafts and builds a tree house; by night it holds the ladder against the horde. The tiny island floats over your windows while you work — and never gets in the way.
5401230.name: Survivor Rat vs Zombies

5401340.desc: Tunak Wheel Launch is a goofy physics game about building a questionable machine and launching a wheel as far as humanly possible. Scavenge and trade for the parts you need, assemble your engine, mount your wheel, and get everything spinning. Once the RPM is high enough, hit the chimney!
5401340.name: Tunak Wheel Launch

5401580.desc: This game is a memory game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!
5401580.name: Memory Games Rabbits

5401590.desc: This game is a memory game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!
5401590.name: Memory Games Wolves

5401600.desc: This game is a memory game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!
5401600.name: Memory Games Ferrets

5401610.desc: This game is a memory game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!
5401610.name: Memory Games Flies

5401620.desc: This game is a memory game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!
5401620.name: Memory Games Squirrels

5401670.desc: Christmas is coming and the toy warehouse is a mess! Read the kids’ letters, find the right toys, pack them and pull the lever. But be careful! Some kids don’t deserve toys, and the coal crate is right there!
5401670.name: Toys, Please!

5401760.desc: 4,600 spells are scattered across the floor, and they're all yours to put away. Shelve each one in its element's cabinet, then fuse two elements together to create a spell no one has seen before.
5401760.name: Tidy Up the Magic Mess

5402730.desc: Awaken your power in Core Awakened, a 2D fighting game without a traditional health bar. Charge your energy, master CORE I, II and III, and unleash combos and special finishers. Play Arcade, challenge a friend locally or fight other players online through Steam.
5402730.name: Core Awakened

5403060.desc: Choose a world and explore it. Walk the volcanic plains of Venus and fly from the ground to orbit, swim and dive across an ocean planet, or ride mine carts through old tunnels alone or online with friends. Three worlds, one simulator, no limits.
5403060.name: Everything Simulator

5403100.desc: This pack reduces repetitive tasks and lets you quickly switch between Gear and Skill setups.
5403100.name: DPS - Convenience Pack

5403190.desc: Create maps and compose your own music, weaving melody and rhythm into falling-block puzzles. Share your challenges and compete on global leaderboards in a roguelite with typing, rune combos and strategic builds. Choose Oaths, raise the Heat and adapt as sanity shifts.
5403190.name: Project Babel

5403220.desc: What happens after the romance ending? Seven new epilogues for the seven men of How to Grow a Man, with 7 new CGs and a new title screen featuring all seven.
5403220.fullgame_name: How to grow a man : Turning Chumps to Hunks
5403220.name: How to grow a man · 7-Character Epilogue DLC

5403380.desc: Your little brother mashed your toy bricks into ugly lumps and left them on your desk. Pull them apart, sort every piece into the bin with its picture, then follow a booklet whose steps play like little videos and build something lovely. Just one more piece...
5403380.name: One More Piece

5403440.desc: A free online 1v1 tactics game combining chess-inspired movement with deckbuilding. Build a 24-card deck, move your pieces, and use cards to outmaneuver your opponent. Contest river chests, adapt to spreading danger zones, and defeat the enemy commander. All battle cards are unlocked.
5403440.name: Arcane Chess Realm

5403780.desc: A first-person party brawler for up to 20 players! Punch rivals out of crumbling arenas or launch them into goals with wacky weapons. Play every mode solo against AI, or invite Steam friends. Multiplayer starts with 2 human players, with AI filling empty slots.
5403780.name: Punch Riot

5403800.desc: A cozy gold panning game. Wash the creek gravel, watch the gold settle in your pan, sell your finds in the village, and turn a small empty room into a home. No timers, no failure. Just quiet, golden little days.
5403800.name: Golden Pan

5404040.desc: Sneak past the guards, use the map gimmicks, and open every locked door. 14 beauties are waiting on the other side — with an animated scene to match. 30 stages. 30 adult animations.
5404040.name: Lewd Life

5404190.desc: A touch-based puzzle simulation game. A woman has been strapped to a new type of bomb, and her heart rate is linked to its trigger. Remove the restraints and tasks across her body, make her climax, and defuse the bomb. Features animated scenes and 2 endings.
5404190.name: Bomb Disposal

5404460.desc: A cozy first-person tidying game. Thousands of board game boxes lie scattered across a charming two-storey shop. Gather stacks of copies, shelve every game in its category and watch the shop come back to life, one satisfying section at a time.
5404460.name: The Cozy Board Game Shop: Tidy Up

5404600.desc: Build a dungeon worth breaking—and a home worth protecting. Play as Nubi, a rag doll defending a tiny room: repair wreckage, revive monsters, place helpers and spring traps on treasure-hungry heroes. Send them fleeing and turn their dropped loot against the next party.
5404600.name: Please Don’t Break My Dungeon

5404780.desc: A fighting game with no fighting. When two players meet, the higher level wins. Levels are sold one at a time, one press each. Right now, someone on the board is one level above you.
5404780.name: PTW

5404940.desc: Vehicular combat survivor game. Dodge swarming enemies, evolve absurd weapons and smash huge bosses. Hot Mods change every drive and random modifiers make enemies unpredictable. Collect scrap, upgrade your garage, unlock new cars. Get wrecked. Come back louder.
5404940.name: Road Riot

5405270.desc: Słownikowa Wyspa is a Polish-language educational adventure game. Join Mizuki on a journey across a mysterious island, solve word puzzles, explore unique locations, collect missing book pages, and discover fascinating facts in an illustrated encyclopedia.
5405270.name: Słownikowa Wyspa

5405460.desc: A digital comic set in the Beholder universe, presented as a handbook for the ever-watchful landlord. Discover the fine art of minding everyone else's business through dark humor, suspicious tenants, and the absurd rules of the Great State that never stops watching.
5405460.name: Beholder: The Landlord's Handbook - Digital Comic

5405820.desc: A red-hooded archer, a silver moon bow and a horde that never runs out. Moonbow Idle is a dark fantasy auto battler: leave it on a second monitor or sit down and min-max. Hatch pets, farm boss gear, ascend, go deeper.
5405820.name: Moonbow Idle: Dark Fantasy Auto Battler

5405940.desc: Awakening from a deadly clash with a dragon, Rosaline gains terrifying powers. Set off on an epic journey through the kingdom of Artolia, slay fearsome monsters alongside allies, and confront the corrupt shadow threatening her homeland.
5405940.name: Rosaline: The Dragon Girl

5406550.desc: A first-person psychological horror game set in a cramped Korean goshiwon. You and your friend make fake ghost videos for views. But something that looks exactly like his costume gets one step closer every day.
5406550.name: Goshiwon | 고시원

5408030.desc: A slow, story-rich xianxia idle RPG about cultivation, discovery, and reincarnation. Work, train, explore, and uncover new systems across repeated lives. Progress carries forward, the world changes, and each journey reveals more than the last.
5408030.name: Cycle of the First Dawn

5408250.desc: Run a little ice cream truck by the sea. Scoop, stack and top every order by hand, earn tips from happy customers, then spend your days in town: stock up, decorate your home and spoil your pets. A cozy seaside job sim.
5408250.name: Seaside Scoops

5408350.desc: An incremental tower defense game: defend your tower against hordes attacking from every direction. Choose cards, combine powers, recruit heroes, and turn each defeat into permanent upgrades so you can return stronger.
5408350.name: Zaz Tower

5408770.desc: Walter Kessler works the night shift at a data center that is always quiet, always cold, and never quite right. Five nights of first-person psychological horror: clear the alerts, walk the halls, answer the radio, and make it to six.
5408770.name: 5 Nights at Data Center

5409100.desc: Enter twelve cursed chambers in a gothic survival game where weapons attack automatically and movement keeps you alive. Discover 100 weapons with no equipment limit, face increasingly difficult levels and bosses, and descend deeper into darkness. (Not a roguelike)
5409100.name: The 12 Chambers of Darkness

5409410.desc: Tidy up to 19,026 objects across a two-floor store with 25 departments. Pick up products, restock shelves, fold clothes and earn upgrades in this cozy first-person tidying game. Play solo or team up in online co-op with up to 4 players.
5409410.name: Mart: Tidy Up Together

5409770.desc: A social deduction party game for 4 to 12 players. Join on your phone, accuse your neighbors, and root out the witches hiding in Salem before they turn the whole town against itself. One host screen, no downloads for players, pure social chaos.
5409770.name: Salem 1692

5411310.desc: Smash crates as Tin, a tiny salvage robot with a hammer, and free the memories locked inside ten vaults. A handful of crates grows into total havoc of lightning, saw blades and drones in this 5–7 hour incremental game with a real ending.
5411310.name: Tiny Havoc

5411460.desc: Run a restaurant as inflatable cooks! Chop, stir and serve before your balloon guests swell with rage and pop. Don't overinflate, dodge the knives, patch holes with tape, and build new rooms and machines. Co-op chaos for 1–4 players, online or on one screen.
5411460.name: Overinflated

5412000.desc: Play Solitaire. Move cards, undo a move, start a new deal, or check the in-game guide at your own pace. Then Explore DLCs. العب سوليتير بنظام سحب بطاقة واحدة. يمكنك نقل البطاقات، والتراجع عن خطوة، وبدء جولة جديدة، أو الرجوع إلى دليل اللعبة وبالسرعة التي تناسبك. ثم إستكشف الألعاب الأخرى.
5412000.name: Jibtik - جبتك

5412540.desc: Dave’s starving and the chippy shuts soon. Run, dash, swing and slime your way across 16 levels of grim British streets in this fast, frantic speedrun platformer. Beat your best, race your ghost and get Dave his chips while they’re still hot.
5412540.name: Dave: Leg it

5412670.desc: A mesmerizing active incremental. It starts slow, with a few sparks. Then they're everywhere and you can barely keep up. Every reset, a perk that changes how you play. A few hours in the flow. First goal: 2.3 billion. Of what? You'll have to play to find out.
5412670.name: 2.3 Billion

5413320.desc: Silver Service is a cozy tidying game where you put 11,132 portions back where they belong aboard a cruise liner, solo or with up to 3 friends. Fill your tray, find the right display, unlock upgrades, and to unwind, grab your fishing rod and see what’s hiding under the water.
5413320.name: Silver Service: Tidy Up the Grand Buffet

5413650.desc: A roguelike deckbuilder where every fight is a duel of seduction. Play cards to fill her Arousal before she fills yours, and climb a Spire of temptresses to break its Queen. First to climax loses. Varg doesn't plan on losing.
5413650.name: Deck'em Down

5415560.desc: Eat your way through an entire supermarket! Start with snacks, earn money from everything you eat, and buy upgrades to eat faster and devour bigger things. Go from a bag of chips to entire shelves, fridges and even the checkouts. Can you eat the whole store?
5415560.name: Eat Everything in a Supermarket

5416020.desc: Mythistoria is an all-in-one creative writing and world-building application built for novelists and storytellers alike to manage their process end-to-end.
5416020.name: Mythistoria

5417020.desc: Realm of Iron is a dark fantasy pixel-art action RPG for solo or co-op with up to 8 friends. Explore a vast continent, clear dungeons and slay bosses, craft and refine your gear, then farm, fish, cook and build a town while living settlements trade, raid and go to war around you.
5417020.name: Realm of Iron

5417180.desc: Tidy up the messiest forge in nine realms. A gnome grandmaster forges legendary weapons faster than anyone can put them away, and you are his apprentice. Grab, toss and sort 4,000+ swords, axes and cursed oddities in a cozy first-person organizing game, solo or in 4-player co-op.
5417180.name: The Legendary Sortsmith

5417370.desc: Touhou Auto Chess is a single-player roguelite auto battler based on the Touhou Project. Recruit companions from Gensokyo and build diverse team compositions by combining equipment, treasures, and synergies. Discover fresh combos with your favorite characters!
5417370.name: Touhou Auto Chess

5417940.desc: Swift Cultivation is a text-based idle cultivation game. Set your action queue and let time do the rest: breakthroughs happen on their own, food gets eaten for you, and every death makes you stronger. Fight, craft — and ascend.
5417940.name: Swift Cultivation

5418360.desc: Finally, touch grass. Comb a hill of grass with your mouse, pick flowers, catch fireflies and wait for rare visitors, from a frog to a dragon at night. Or make the hill your live desktop wallpaper. Free, relaxing and impressively unproductive. The grass can wait.
5418360.name: Touch Grass, Pls!

5418410.desc: This DLC includes three additional cutting mat designs to customize your restoration workspace. Thank you for supporting Reshine and our team!
5418410.name: Reshine ‒ Supporter Cutting Mats

5418430.desc: Strip Memory Naughty Cowgirls is an addictive adult memory card game set in the Wild West. Challenge four stunning cowgirls with unique personalities, test your focus, and unlock high-definition animated rewards and spicy scenes in the gallery.
5418430.name: Strip Memory: Naughty Cowgirls

5418450.desc: Dive into the tropical summer of Sunset Bay! Solve addictive Match-3 puzzles alongside three gorgeous bikini-clad girls, unleash powerful special bomb combos, and unlock an exclusive gallery of animated reward scenes in this vibrant beach adventure.
5418450.name: MATCH'EM ALL! - Sunset Bay Bikini Adventure

5418470.desc: Start with zero followers in a tiny room. Plan each week's streams, handle live donations and on-air surprises, ride the genres on the rise, and grow an unknown streamer into a star everyone watches.
5418470.name: Streamer Manager

5418650.desc: The seas rose. One island still stands. Build a war factory from a single robot, automate your entire war economy, and hold the coast against saturation strikes of cruise missiles, drone swarms and ballistic warheads - then strike back across the sea with missiles, dropships and mechs.
5418650.name: Metal Naval Combat: Saturation Strike

5418700.desc: Yuzuki Yukari joins your calculator with new voice lines by VOCALOMAKETS, 4 themed designs, and a singing Performance Mode. Hidden reactions await in certain calculations!
5418700.name: Calculator - Desktop Mate Widgets Yuzuki Yukari DLC

5418710.desc: Kizuna Akari joins your calculator with new voice lines by VOCALOMAKETS, 4 themed designs, and a singing Performance Mode. Hidden reactions await in certain calculations!
5418710.name: Calculator - Desktop Mate Widgets Kizuna Akari DLC

5418900.desc: The echoes of a forgotten kingdom await. This is the official Thronefall soundtrack, with music from the base game and the Craaghelm DLC. Strings by day, drums by night. To hear, you only have to listen.
5418900.name: Thronefall Soundtrack

5418940.desc: Live wallpapers for Windows: scenes, videos, images, web pages and audio on your desktop. A built-in editor with particles, effects and keyframes, scheduled playlists, auto-pause in games, and Steam Workshop. A lightweight native engine that's easy on your system.
5418940.name: Morphic Wallpaper

5418970.desc: An oddly satisfying incremental roguelike: flip coins to earn money, invest it all back into skills, upgrades, coins, and more as your fortune snowballs into the trillions! Hoard relics from encounters, get rich by midnight to get game-breaking boons, and whatever you do... do NOT anger Gregory.
5418970.name: Lucremachine

5419120.desc: Santa crashed his sleigh into your garden and Christmas is buried under the snow. Call up to three friends and dig it all out: sell the snow, upgrade from bare cookie hands to absurd machines, and bury each other along the way. Cozy, chaotic co-op with proximity voice chat.
5419120.name: Snow Worries!

5419140.desc: **Ludoman** is a life simulator set in snowy Russia. Pay off a 250,000-ruble mortgage, work, gamble your money, and explore an open world. One life, complete freedom, and multiple endings. Your fate is in your hands!
5419140.name: Ludoman

5419520.desc: A tiny inkblot. Two states. Bounce across printing blocks, stick to walls, and ride moving machinery in a physics platformer set inside a misprinted book. Master your momentum through 30 handcrafted rooms of crumbling type, shifting gravity, and portals.
5419520.name: INKBLOT

5420230.desc: Notes flow in from both sides toward the center. Play solo with both hands, or team up with a friend on one screen. You never have to chase the notes themselves, so you can focus purely on the music. Build charts for your own songs with the built-in editor and share them easily as QR images.
5420230.name: DualBeats

5420510.desc: A morning jog turned Ren into a spirit. To regain his human form, he'll have to negotiate with the local spirits — each with their own conditions. A fairy-tale point-and-click puzzle game, hand-drawn.
5420510.name: When Ren Ran

5420610.desc: Black Friday night, and the shoppers turned. Drive straight into the zombie crowd: back-to-back roadkills build a RAM combo, long drifts end in a TURBO. Turn loyalty points into coupons and survive until closing time.
5420610.name: Blackest Friday

5420690.desc: This is an online RPG featuring a retro fantasy aesthetic. Starting from Talking Island, you can play as a Knight or a Wizard, exploring villages, wilderness areas, and underground dungeons. Engage in real-time combat to hunt monsters and gather loot as you gradually develop your character.
5420690.name: 天堂世族網路遊戲 (Royal Lineage Online)

5420820.desc: Tidy up thousands of manga volumes in a chaotic Japanese bookstore. Pick them up, find the right shelves, unlock new abilities, and turn total chaos into a cozy manga paradise. Play solo or with friends in online co-op.
5420820.name: Manga Shop: Tidy Up!

5421010.desc: Yut without waiting for turns. Build energy, throw the sticks, stack and capture pieces, and turn the match around with skills.
5421010.name: Physical Yut

5421150.desc: BIG CLIMB is a co-op climbing game for 1-4 players tied by a real physical rope. Climb the mountain together before the colossal spider gets the one lagging behind.
5421150.name: Big Climb

5421940.desc: A greenhouse full of tiny frogs, and every one needs a place. Collect and sort 6,000 figures across 300 designs and 30 themes. Earn coins, upgrade your basket and turn a wonderfully messy shop into a collection you can admire.
5421940.name: Sort Them Frogs

5421960.desc: Search for your missing dad in a mysterious horror adventure. Build a portal, step into the unknown, and discover what lies beyond. But be careful... you never know what might be waiting on the other side. Can you find him?
5421960.name: The Friendly Monster

5422560.desc: This game is a memory game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!
5422560.name: Memory Games Shrubs

5422570.desc: This game is a memory game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!
5422570.name: Memory Games Cacti

5422580.desc: This game is a memory game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!
5422580.name: Memory Games Food

5422960.desc: Run your own game studio in this idle management game. Develop and release games, automate the work, and turn your growing catalog into steady income. Give flops another chance, build sequels, then sell your studio for permanent bonuses and start again.
5422960.name: Idle Game Dev Studio
