5423090.desc: A cozy single-player simulation where you play as a magician bringing order to a magical mess. Search for scattered cards, sort them into their proper decks, and use your magic to tidy up. Don't forget to find your missing rabbits and doves along the way!
5423090.name: The Magician: Tidy Up the Magic Decks!

5423250.desc: A cute, chunky auto-shooter tower defense. Your rider's cannon fires on its own: pick the upgrades, grow the tower from wood to steel, send guns on carts to hunt, and blast critter hordes through day, night and storms. 18 riders, VS and co-op with friends.
5423250.name: The Turret and the Hare

5423300.desc: Azure Ruins is a hex-board merge roguelike where shape, count, and rank drive your strategy. Pair Trait Runestones, Relic rules, and special mechanics to stack chains and multipliers. Spend limited Stamina to crack an island city's mechanisms, storm the Royal Vault, and climb global leaderboards.
5423300.name: Azure Ruins

5423830.desc: The Star Voyage Departure Bundle is a starter pack for new *Trails of Starlight* adventurers. It includes essential wing cultivation materials and core currencies, helping players quickly grasp the wing system, ease early resource strain, and explore star realms smoothly.
5423830.name: Trails of Starlight - Star Voyage Departure Bundle

5423880.desc: You’re trapped in a room with a thousand fingers. Press them, gather supplies and try to survive the consequences. Experiment and find a way out solo or with friends—up to four players. In PvP, grab a weapon and fight free-for-all or two against two.
5423880.name: Don't Press This SH*T

5423890.desc: Hunt cryptids in a hostile open forest, alone or with up to four players in co-op. Scavenge supplies, hunt wildlife, craft gear and customize firearms. Survive each encounter, reach extraction and bring your hard-earned loot back to the lodge.
5423890.name: MYTHHUNT

5424210.desc: Welcome to The Last Inn — become the innkeeper! Build a refuge on the Radiated Continent. By day, serve guests, farm and raise livestock; by night, hunt, scavenge and gather ingredients. Recruit companions as helpers or lovers. Build an oasis and unravel the mystery over three great shelters…
5424210.name: The Last Inn Demo

5424270.desc: Tidy Up: Street Market is a cozy first-person organizing game. Over 6,000 items are piled up around an open-air market: fruit, fish, shoes, flowers, toys and more. Carry each one to the right stall, earn money, buy upgrades, and turn a messy street into a full, colorful market.
5424270.name: Tidy Up: Street Market

5424370.desc: A single-player action RPG blending pixel art with 3D environments. Explore varied lands, master stamina-based combat, and face altar bosses and twelve demon lords. Forge your build, hatch pet companions, and rest by the campfire on a journey through loss and memory.
5424370.name: Sun Knight and the Evil Trial

5424390.desc: A classic 9×9 Sudoku game built around logical deduction and branching hypotheses. Mark assumptions separately from deductions, manage candidates, backtrack through multiple branches, and progress through ten chapters containing 100,000 puzzles.
5424390.name: Hypothesis Sudoku

5424870.desc: Want to fuck a demon? First, you'll have to defeat the demons on the soccer field! Plan your moves carefully in this turn-based soccer game! Put your brain to work, and success is guaranteed!
5424870.name: Furious Football: Demons vs Humans

5424890.desc: This is a video game based on the Backrooms myth, but it breaks away from its lore to tell an original story. It features a variety of gameplay sections with different creatures and a narrative-driven approach that sets it apart from other games based on these locations.
5424890.name: Backrooms: 1977

5425210.desc: Explore the maze. Collect the gems. Uncover its secrets. Dungeon Escape 3 is a 2D top-down maze escape game featuring over 30 levels to explore, hidden collectibles to discover, and puzzles to solve. Navigate through a maze of interconnected rooms, unlock new paths, and see how far you can go.
5425210.name: Dungeon Escape 3

5425700.desc: Potted plants that live on your Windows desktop. They grow over days and weeks, droop when you forget them, and flower if you keep watering. Double-click a plant to water it.
5425700.name: Bouture

5426350.desc: A delivery hit the market of Elderberry Vale and went everywhere. Now thousands of fruits need a home. Carry them to the right stall and line them up in perfect rows, alone or with up to two friends in online co-op. No timers, no fail states, just one very satisfying mess.
5426350.name: Berry Busy Tidy Up!

5426410.desc: The goats are back and they have hired a bull. Grab, hurl, and outrun the herd in this updated version of Ranch Attack Classic: a fast, funny arcade runner with two farmers, a barn full of unlockables, and the original prototype as a bonus.
5426410.name: Ranch Attack: Farmer on the Run

5426860.desc: Elf World Adventure 14 continues the hentai puzzle series with beautiful anime-style elf girls. Piece together revealing illustrations, enjoy a fantasy atmosphere, and choose between two difficulty levels to suit your mood.
5426860.name: Elf World Adventure 14

5427110.desc: Lost Bitcoin is a digging and automation game set in a gigantic junkyard. Collect scrap, burn it for coins, buy upgrades and build a factory that works for you. Crack crates and safes, and check every USB stick to find your lost Bitcoin wallet.
5427110.name: Lost Bitcoin

5427130.desc: Upwardly is a colorful 3D precision platformer. Climb 10 castles across 5,000 meters, dodge deadly hazards, and race the clock. Choose from three difficulty modes, master every jump, and chase your personal best on randomized or shareable seeded courses.
5427130.name: Upwardly

5428930.desc: Even ghosts dream of freedom! Help a little ghost escape a haunted mansion, where everyday objects hide clues to secret passages. Observe, deduce, and slip through walls to reach the moonlight.
5428930.name: Ghosts Don't Need Doors

5429100.desc: Unleash 65+ monsters in a free-to-play 3D arena fighting game. Master intense 1v1 combat, unleash devastating magic, conquer challenging bosses, and fight through Tournament, Chaos, unpredictable Duels, and online battles.
5429100.name: Garvog: Monster Fight Combat

5429150.desc: An isometric zombie shooter: fight through hordes of hundreds of the dead, upgrade your guns and underbarrel modules, and burn the crimson out of a blacked-out town. Three stories, 75 chapters, bosses with their own tricks, and online co-op or PvP for up to 4 players.
5429150.name: Fallen City

5429590.desc: Stranded on Mars with a storm closing in, you need money for a rocket. Grow potatoes, sell your first batch of chips, and put your earnings into a bigger production line. Then the mutant potatoes arrive, right on schedule. What could you sell them for?
5429590.name: Potato Factory

5429830.desc: Manage a tavern as hot as its innkeepers! Cook, brew, build, and charm the royal court. Unlock 20 innkeepers with unique talents, conquer 5 difficulty levels, and discover whether you can satisfy every desire of the king…
5429830.name: Tavern of Temptation

5430860.desc: A first-person social deduction game for 4 to 12 players. At night you work around the village while the Cursed hunt. In the morning you argue it out over proximity voice chat and vote someone out. Hopefully the right person.
5430860.name: Wiggle Town

5431930.desc: In 1980, Dad left a small vintage shop and 300 yuan. You took the counter and rang the bell. Ice lollies, enamel mugs, frog sunglasses, Yanwu tape recorders filled the shelves. Seventy antiques, ten regular neighbours, a new paper each day. Running the shop means holding onto life.
5431930.name: 旧物小铺

5433150.desc: You are Brumhilde von Hummelbommel. You wake up alone in February: find a hole in the ground, gather pollen and nectar, raise your daughters and build your nest. Nine months against wasps, birds, storms and heat. In November only one thing counts: is your colony still standing?
5433150.name: For Bumble's Sake

5433240.desc: Climb down a deep, dark shaft with up to three friends. A blind worm grows out of the rock and hunts you by scent: move fast and it follows your trail. Light holds it back, but not for long. Hook, swing and rappel deeper, while your friends' voices echo down the shaft.
5433240.name: Unknown Depths

5433870.desc: Survive a night of Chinese folklore in Ghosts Before Dawn, a pixel-art survivor-like. Wield auto-casting talismans, flying swords, and spirit-banishing gongs. Combine weapons and the Five Elements, brave haunted villages and ghost markets, then face the final bosses after ten minutes of survival.
5433870.name: Ghosts Before Dawn

5434200.desc: A turn-based board game for 2! Place triangle pieces in turn and be first to connect two of your colored spots on the board's edge. Decided within 24 moves, yet no one knows if a winning strategy exists. With a reinforcement-learning AI, 40 puzzles and an editor, a real-time 3D mode and online play.
5434200.name: TRIROAD

5434520.desc: A little seed, a very big world. Ride the breeze, bounce from leaves and drift through 20 botanical landscapes in a gentle physics adventure. Find a place to put down roots. An optional breath into your microphone gives you a little lift.
5434520.name: Little Seed

5434650.desc: A short cozy building and management sim set in the sleepy waterways of Kerala, India. A once-mighty village boat club is being revived decades later. Design and build a race-worthy boat, manage the club and its funds through its comeback season.
5434650.name: Rhythm of the Backwaters

5435010.desc: Run a streaming company under a board that can fire you. Negotiate with stars, produce films, series and shows, and refresh your catalogue as audiences lose interest. Build a talent agency and choose which contracts, productions and risks are worth taking.
5435010.name: Streaming Tycoon

5435190.desc: A five-in-a-row board game with an engine that explains itself: every move comes with the shape it built, the threat it answered and the alternatives it weighed. Learn from ten lessons and 1,680 proven puzzles, review your games move by move, and play ranked online or entirely offline.
5435190.name: GomokuZero

5436360.desc: Little 3D Loafs live on your Windows desktop. They wander, react to you, hang out with each other, and find their own fun while you work. Even secret characters! With more to come with updates.
5436360.name: BitLoaf

5436520.desc: Catch a fish and you become the fish. Catch a car, become the car.
5436520.name: Fishing Up The Food Chain

5436650.desc: A satisfying cleaning incremental. Scrape years of gunk off forgotten things with your own fingernail, then take Gary's old van across town: gum that pops, soot, burnt cheese, grease that runs. Every flake lands in a jar, and every kind of gunk is its own currency.
5436650.name: Scrapecremental

5437060.desc: Your tabletop RPG, together on LAN or online. Join and play free with characters, dice, animated movement and session messages. Full Toolkit DLC unlocks campaign creation, grid and gridless maps, content editors and GM hosting. Optional accounts connect your community.
5437060.name: Game Master

5437570.desc: Create your character, pick your starting gear, and settle into a rented cabin in this immersive, relaxing life simulator. Forage, work odd jobs, sell junk at the thrift store, and keep yourself fed and clean as you save up for the cabin of your dreams.
5437570.name: Cabin Life

5437650.desc: The classic online strategy game of empires and ancient artifacts, reborn. Found cities, raise armies of thousands and race rival players across a living world to seize the legendary Artifacts. Free to play, with one account on PC, browser and phone.
5437650.name: Artifact Reforged

5438180.desc: vlaina is a cute interactive desktop pet that brings Live2D characters to your work, study & play. Watch it react as you type, click or move the mouse; switch models, resize & reposition to create your own companion that makes every keystroke more fun.
5438180.name: vlaina

5438460.desc: Cyberpunk pixel-art auto-shooter. Your weapons fire on their own: you dodge bullet curtains, freeze the battlefield with Stasis, and pick 1 of 3 new weapons every floor. Climb 50 floors across 5 worlds and take down 10 bosses.
5438460.name: STASIS PROTOCOL

5438690.desc: A cozy block-swapping puzzler with knitted blocks. Swap, match and chain yarn blocks to beat 24 hat-wearing bosses, solve 80 hand-made puzzles, chase the daily board, or battle friends in local and online VS, including cross-play.
5438690.name: Oh Baby Blocks

5438730.desc: Fishing Shop: Tidy Up is a relaxing first-person game where you bring order to a messy fishing shop. Pick up scattered items, sort them by category, color, and size, place them on the right shelves, upgrade your abilities, and choose music to match your mood!
5438730.name: Fishing Shop: Tidy Up

5439140.desc: Somewhere in a mountain of millions of clover leaves hides one four-leaf clover. Dig by hand with up to 3 friends in online co-op, sell the fiber, then build belts and machines that dig for you. Find all 24 rare species for your Botanical Album.
5439140.name: Find the Four Leaf Clover

5439180.desc: Build your stable. Chase the Golden Silks. Buy, breed and train racehorses, develop your yard and plan your Flat or Jumps campaign in this single-player management sim. Watch races unfold in 3D, become Champion Trainer and return to defend your title.
5439180.name: Stable Champs

5439420.desc: Embark on your adventure with player from all over the world! Lead your Angel team to reveal the ancient mysteries of Galaxy…… Welcome to Angel legion, a free RPG gacha game with good fun!
5439420.name: Angel Legion-DLC Starlit Veil Dance (Orange)

5439450.desc: Embark on your adventure with player from all over the world! Lead your Angel team to reveal the ancient mysteries of Galaxy…… Welcome to Angel legion, a free RPG gacha game with good fun!
5439450.name: Angel Legion-DLC Starlit Veil Dance (Pink)

5439650.desc: A 1-4 player co-op roguelite FPS. Four Guardians from different mythologies cross the realms that Oblivion is erasing, with guns, lightning, daggers and hummingbirds. Give your weapon and each ability its own element as you play, until a single shot sets off a chain reaction.
5439650.name: Mythawake

5440370.desc: Command a customizable cat in this 3D tower defense game. Build elemental cannons, research new defenses, deploy cat-piloted aircraft, and repel waves of mice. Face bosses, tackle daily sieges, and create and share maps through Steam Workshop.
5440370.name: Meowstone Siege

5441160.desc: You are the last squirrel standing. Perched on your treetop platform, draw your repeating crossbow and hold off wave after wave of wolves, bees and groundhogs. Build auto-turrets, chain power-ups, defend the tree.
5441160.name: Squirrel Defender VR

5441620.desc: Noon casts the shortest shadows. A honkaku mystery told as an interactive sound novel: every clue is in black and white, on pages you've read. Amesaka, winter 2015. A son lies dead at the foot of the stairs; by morning the housekeeper has confessed. The soup spilled on the steps is still warm.
5441620.name: Shadow at Noon

5441690.desc: A low-pressure tower defense where losing costs nothing but time. Place Cowboys, Dynamite, Flamers, Snipers, and Cannons across 10 levels and 20 waves each — gold and towers always carry through a retry, so you're guaranteed to win eventually. Just build, watch, and rebuild.
5441690.name: Bandits are Coming

5441840.desc: An ink-wash xianxia action game. You are your sect's most worthless disciple — spirit energy leaks right out of you. Then you learn the one technique only you can use: clash blades at the instant steel meets steel and take your enemy's power. Every win becomes a unique ink painting.
5441840.name: 执笔人 The Inkwright

5442160.desc: Sil-More is a tactical turn-based rogue-like role-playing game, fork of Angband and Sil. You're one of the greatest heroes of the First Age and your task is to descend into Angband, the citadel of the Greatest Enemy, and bring back the Great Jewels from the Enemy's crown.
5442160.name: Sil-Morë — Shining Darkness

5443080.desc: Lost your car keys at the beach? Or was it the woods? Grab a metal detector and a shovel, dig up junk and treasure, flog it to a shady Fence for upgrades and find those keys, with no rush, before a tsunami hits, or before the bear comes. Play solo or with up to 3 friends in online co-op.
5443080.name: Where are my keys?

5443320.desc: Your car broke down on County Road 17. The old man in the farmhouse would like to play a game first. Western trivia, just a quick one. Answer well and you get your phone call. Answer badly and Earl decides.
5443320.name: Earl's Court

5443350.desc: Chisel Me This is a 1-8 player party game where you and your friends compete to create statues of various prompts. Sculpt large marble blocks, mold clay, and sabotage competitors as you create artistic masterpieces!
5443350.name: Chisel Me This

5444340.desc: The Claw and Conjure demo is an async PvP auto-battler with fantasy RPG units. Upgrade your town to synergize with your build, then race into battle against real players. The demo offers free access to early game units, items, and abilities and allows PvP play for 8 rounds per run
5444340.name: Claw and Conjure Demo

5444410.desc: Battle enemy hordes, build powerful ability combinations, and defeat challenging bosses in this single-player bullet heaven roguelike. Choose distinct characters, unlock evolutions, and earn permanent upgrades—all with offline gameplay.
5444410.name: Dungeon Survivor

5444950.desc: Collect spinning tops, mix parts and take on rivals and tournaments! Run your own top shop, team up with friends in online co-op, or bring your custom build into a 1v1 battle.
5444950.name: Topsmith: Spinning Top Shop Simulator

5445330.desc: A relaxing ASMR puzzle with 500 hand-drawn levels. Unscrew metal pieces, enjoy satisfying sounds, and watch them fall. No timers, no pressure — just pure unscrewing satisfaction.
5445330.name: Unscrew Therapy

5445850.desc: Build squads of 10 classes for 1v1 hex-based tactics. Alternate squad moves to defeat the enemy commander. Defend, counter, tighten or spread formations, and use formation attacks. Accuracy and evasion shape damage, not random hits. Seize mana points and teleport gates to deploy hidden reserves.
5445850.name: Commander's Dilemma

5446260.desc: Immerse yourself in the nostalgic atmosphere of early 2000s Russia as you investigate the theft of a city relic. Interact with unique characters, make difficult decisions, and find your path. Save your hometown or feed it to the fiends.
5446260.name: Lestvitsa

5446440.desc: A writing commission takes you to a mansion above the sea. Uncover its secrets, listen to its inhabitants and piece together a story in which the dead still have something to say.
5446440.name: Villa Anzuelo: The Obituarist

5446840.desc: Leaf It Zen is a cozy game about clearing cherry blossom petals from a beautiful Japanese garden. Collect petals, upgrade tools, unlock new areas and discover hidden cards featuring Japanese spirits. Relax and enjoy the atmosphere!
5446840.name: Leaf It Zen

5446860.desc: Eyelord is an intense, fast-paced, heavy metal match-3 pop 'em up. It is a relentless massacre of innocent rolling eyeballs, using a mouse, touchscreen, or game controller. Get into the flow alone, or bring a friend to the slaughter!
5446860.name: Eyelord Returns

5447250.desc: Corporate Dash is a hilarious party racing game for 2–9+ players! Use your smartphones to place bets, play sneaky cards, and watch your office colleagues race through hilarious chaos. Outsmart your friends, survive unexpected disasters, and climb the corporate ladder!
5447250.name: Corporate Dash

5448310.desc: Collect charming companions, build a five-member team, and master turn-based battles in a lush fantasy world. Shape your team with runes, challenge dungeon bosses, and face player defenses in the Colosseum. A little home. A wild adventure.
5448310.name: Rune Nest

5449250.desc: A block-stacking puzzle game for friends. Drop pieces onto one shared board that grows with your group, clear lines together, draft perks and survive random events. Or battle in team duels up to 4v4 and free-for-all matches for up to 10 players. Plus a 40-level campaign.
5449250.name: Quadora

5449680.desc: A voxel fantasy idle RPG about farming loot, leveling up and refining your build. Collect weapons and armor, upgrade your gear and unlock rare spells!
5449680.name: Mini Legends Idle

5449820.desc: A short horror game. At a data recovery firm, you examine the camera of a man who vanished in 2011, for his sister. File 343 is missing. Dark records show only while you hold Develop. Meanwhile, the camera looks for a face and shoots when it locks focus. Real photos and timestamps trace his route.
5449820.name: Frame343

5449940.desc: Furry Witch Fox is a cozy Halloween furry clicker starring an adorable fox witch! Collect hearts, buy upgrades, catch ghosts, and unlock 45 colorful illustrations. Pumpkins, candles, and the comforting magic of Halloween await!
5449940.name: Furry Witch Fox

5450030.desc: Every sheep on the farm has escaped from its stand. Catch them, carry them home and put each one back in its own spot. Hats, costumes, a whole meadow of runaways and a few silly tools to help. A cosy, woolly tidy up game.
5450030.name: We Have a Sheep Problem

5450190.desc: Miko Rhythm is a four-lane arrow rhythm game with a cute-goth heart. Hit the beat on a neon 3D highway or a classic flat lane, play 55 songs on four difficulties, dress up Miko in over 90 looks, chase the daily challenge, and make your own charts.
5450190.name: Miko Rhythm

5450420.desc: Enter a deadly prison survival game where every choice and every QTE can mean life or death. Follow Lin Yu through four ruthless levels in a cinematic interactive thriller where one mistake could end everything.
5450420.name: The Top Game

5450430.desc: The yacht is a dinghy. The wheel is a hubcap. The fish are something else.
5450430.name: Hillbilly Yacht Club: Fishing

5450860.desc: Have you ever wondered, how many tickets does it take to win the lottery? Scratch tickets, match the numbers and spend your winnings on more tickets, until you are scratching millions at a time. The jackpot odds are realistic, 1 in 290,472,336, and nothing you buy changes it.
5450860.name: How Many Tickets Does It Take To Win The Lottery?

5451060.desc: Choose among 13 distinct fantasy kingdoms: appoint ministers, balance the treasury and maneuver on the world map, then command legions in turn-based battles with war-strategy cards and towering giants. Roguelike runs, branching stories and multiple endings.
5451060.name: Crowns & Colossi

5451120.desc: Recruit Three Kingdoms heroes and build a five-unit team. Combine faction synergies, merge heroes, and use equipment and stratagems to prepare for automatic battles. Every shop visit and formation choice shapes your run through an ink-painted age of conflict.
5451120.name: Three Kingdoms: Gambit of Chaos

5451260.desc: Your store. Your robot. Your code. Code Market is a relaxed management game where you don't click to sell — you program. A robot works in your supermarket, and it does exactly what your Java or C# code tells it: walk to a rack, pick up tomatoes, take a customer's order, pack the bag.
5451260.name: Code Market

5451310.desc: You're a commercial diver left under an offshore platform after an accident. The only way up is a chain of emergency refuges, and each one needs something from out in the dark. You get a bearing, six strobes and a few minutes of gas. Your supervisor, Mara, stays on the radio.
5451310.name: Point Nemo

5451410.desc: TryTakeMe is a game inside an infected computer. The virus Lilith takes 92% of your machine’s power and leaves you 8%. Six viruses, six voices, a terminal, and a constant struggle for control. Mistakes are expensive: a virus may stay forever. 🖥️🖤
5451410.name: TryTakeMe

5451420.desc: A first-person 3D online murder mystery for you and your friends. Each player takes a role, walks the same crime scene, hunts for clues, and argues their way to the truth. Start with a free case. For paid episodes, one player buys and the whole group joins.
5451420.name: Murder Mystery Online

5451610.desc: A cosy co-op tidying game. Sort + 7000 runaway things back onto the shelves of 18 shops with up to 3 friends. Grab, stack and shelve, unlock magnets, scanners and sorting robots, hunt 25 golden items, play mini games and turn the messiest mall in town into the tidiest.
5451610.name: Tidy Mall Together

5451960.desc: Demo of CHU: The Nightmare of That Day. Long after your discharge, you wake up back in the barracks: live through Day 1 and the first night with “him” still awake, then take on spin-off Chapter 1, The Silent Monastery, in 1-4 player online co-op. The full game launches January 14, 2027.
5451960.name: 추 : 그날의 악몽 Demo

5452060.desc: A cozy first-person sorting game about turning a garden centre buried in over 2,000 gnomes into beautifully organised shelves. Relax, find every little character its perfect home and enjoy the satisfying calm of bringing order to the chaos - one more shelf at a time.
5452060.name: Sort Them Gnomes

5452550.desc: The horde moves when you end your turn. Command up to three champions in a turn-based survival roguelite. Reposition, combine spells, and shatter frozen enemies with steel. Survive 100 rounds and spend earned renown on permanent upgrades.
5452550.name: Glorybound

5452870.desc: Guide a cute, drifting sunfish through an underwater cave in this 2D side-scrolling action game. Dodge rocks, rubbish, shells, anemones, fish and charging orcas. Ride powerful currents, beat your best distance, and retry instantly when one collision ends your run.
5452870.name: MANBOU / VOYAGE

5453070.desc: Tokyo, at night, in the rain. Twelve years after vanishing, Kyōsuke Narumi comes home to a yakuza war. An open-world crime saga: street fights, katana and gunfights, police chases, BASE jumps off neon towers, mountain-pass races and a whole city to live in, day and night.
5453070.name: KUROSHIO: Neon Blood

5453230.desc: Claim territory, dodge monsters, and reveal 70 illustrations in this single-player 2D game. Reach 85% to clear each stage, release the draw button to retrace your path at double speed, and test your limits in Area Challenge and Endless Dreams.
5453230.name: 幻想中_In my imagination

5453270.desc: One angel. Two guns. Thousands of demons. Manually aim and fire two weapons with separate triggers in a survival roguelite with roughly 20-minute runs. Shape powerful blessing builds, face each map's guardians, and unlock new angels and permanent upgrades for your next attempt.
5453270.name: An Angel With Too Much Ammo

5453830.desc: Investigate a conspiracy inside a corporate headquarters. Explore in first or third person, solve access-card puzzles, and fight hostile robots in this single-player action adventure. Try the free three-floor factory demo, including Lucy’s side story and a vault boss.
5453830.name: Conspiracy at Headquarters

5454060.desc: Episode 1 of Murder Mystery Online. On a full-moon night, five people gather at a mountain shrine for an all-night rite — and within an hour the shaman is dead. Nine hours until morning. 5 players, 120+ min. One purchase lets the whole group play.
5454060.name: Murder Mystery Online - 초치성

5454420.desc: A short interactive experience where you make choices about your sexual preferences and receive personalized jerk-off instructions.
5454420.name: JOI Simulator

5454430.desc: A boy with a flashlight. A house that will not let him go. Explore, solve hands-on puzzles, and survive supernatural encounters in a side-scrolling horror adventure that reaches far beyond its walls with strange worlds, sudden chases, and terrifying enemies to confront.
5454430.name: NO SUCH MONSTERS

5454550.desc: A sleeping planet. A few robots who know nothing yet. And you, who know how to write programs. Teach them, block by block, to take care of the world, until life comes back on its own, across five worlds.
5454550.name: Savebot: The Last Garden

5454640.desc: An experimental VR cooking game with liquid and soft-body physics.
5454640.name: Perfect Pancakes

5454720.desc: Combine weapon modules, collect relics and spread fire in this rogue-lite horde survivor. Choose your route, complete missions and take down giant bosses, then head back to your truck before the "Seep" engulfs you!
5454720.name: Dreadmiles

5455040.desc: Organize your Windows desktop with a customizable dock. Pin apps, drag icons into place, preview open windows and switch between them. Choose any screen edge, automatic hiding, hover magnification, and light or dark themes.
5455040.name: Dock Window

5455460.desc: Immerse yourself in Backmare, a psychological survival horror experience designed to twist your reality and test your sanity. Here, survival is not merely about running away—it is about piecing together a fractured truth forgotten by time.
5455460.name: Backmare: Return of the nightmare

5455560.desc: Ten fortresses, one river, five against five. Build your base, train an army of up to a hundred units and break the enemy HQs with your team in fast real-time strategy battles. Free to play, with cross-play between PC, iPhone and Android.
5455560.name: Command Base Assault

5455640.desc: Rock-paper-scissors meets strategic card autobattling! Collect and merge cards, build your team, and outsmart opponents through positioning, elemental matchups, unique abilities, and spells.
5455640.name: RSP Ultimate Battle

5455670.desc: Voice typing for the Steam Frame. Hold both grips, say it, let go: Gripspeak types it into Steam chat, the browser, the terminal or any desktop app. Speech recognition runs on the headset, so your voice never leaves it and it works offline. Requires a Steam Frame.
5455670.name: Gripspeak

5455960.desc: A black-and-white incremental game about one revolving door. Turn it, let people in, and spend the earnings on a bigger door and better blades, until the corner shop's little door is a human pump swallowing the whole city. The goal: admit all of humanity.
5455960.name: Round and Round Inc.

5456790.desc: The dead fill the streets of Howell, Michigan. Search houses for food, haul supplies home, and board up before dark. Build a base and keep people alive in an isometric zombie survival sandbox.
5456790.name: Livingston County

5457010.desc: 777 HERO is a pixel-art idle RPG that captures all the heart-pounding moments of pachinko! And of course! It's built so that even people who know nothing about pachinko can have plenty of fun, so don't worry! The controls are super simple too!
5457010.name: 777 HERO ~The One Who Defies Time~

5457250.desc: Kasumi, a maid café waitress in Akihabara, inherits her late father's safety-pin factory. Make pins, ship them, upgrade wacky machines, retool for global trends, and join her mom and sisters in chasing No.1 world share and a planet of safety pins. A pixel-art incremental factory comedy.
5457250.name: Minami Co.

5457920.desc: Recolor sprites and entire asset folders with multiple palettes. Preview changes, preserve selected colors, adjust shading and dithering, and export variations for your game or art workflow. Includes palette tools and command-line batch processing.
5457920.name: ColorCraft

5458630.desc: It's time to challenge the monsters of Arvelia! Become one of the world's mightiest mages, slay thousands of creatures, and claim their power. They thought this world belonged to them. Prove them wrong. They used to be the hunters. Now they're the prey. No More Monsters!
5458630.name: No More Monsters

5458820.desc: Old Gus has retired and left you his run-down two-space parking lot. Take tickets, collect every fare, keep the place spotless and deal with the town's worst drivers as you grow it, space by space, into a 135-space complex in this first-person management simulator.
5458820.name: Paid Parking Simulator

5459270.desc: A brutal top-down shooter inspired by DOS-era classics, ASCII graphics, arcade shoot 'em ups, and gloriously over-the-top '80s action movies. Fight through Campaign, Endless, and Horde modes, then create your own carnage with the built-in level editor and Steam Workshop support. NO MERCY!
5459270.name: Revenge on the 13th Floor

5460000.desc: Episode 2 of Murder Mystery Online. In a snowbound village, the head of the youth co-op is found dead in a wardrobe — dead for three days, yet everyone heard from them during those days. Why did no one open that door? 5–6 players, 120+ min. One purchase lets the whole group play.
5460000.name: Murder Mystery Online - 사흘

5460060.desc: Commander, sixteen enemy officers stand between your armoured train and the end of the war. Beat them in card battles and they join your squad. Pour the whiskey in your quarters to unlock their animated scenes, uncensored. One purchase. No microtransactions.
5460060.name: Debriefed : Frontline Command

5460910.desc: A 1-4 player co-op airline comedy. Run a tiny island airline with your friends, keep a falling-apart plane in the air, fix it mid-flight and keep a full cabin of passengers happy. Or at least alive.
5460910.name: Mayday Airways

5461060.desc: A horror game by B.Reader based on Arabian Nights.
5461060.name: IFRIT

5461360.desc: Battle through ten shifting voxel regions with 100+ weapons, breakable cover, traps and bosses. Dodge bullets, flip tables and make the most of every lucky drop. Rescue allies, unlock pets and customise your delver. Play solo or with a friend in online or shared-screen local co-op.
5461360.name: Dungeon Delvers

5461500.desc: Five a side, top down, thumbs on. Arcade football with a whole international season underneath it. 195 nations, one midfielder: you.
5461500.name: Football B-side

5461630.desc: Survive the horde, collect gold, and rework your build between waves. Pick a Warrior, Brawler, or Mage; fuse two skills, then combine fusions into ultimates. 4 regions, 21 enemy types, bosses; 15 waves, 3 difficulties, endless mode. No XP; upgrades come from the shop. ~10-minute runs.
5461630.name: PixelSurvivors

5461730.desc: An otome visual novel of romance and supernatural mystery. Disguised as a boy, you enroll at an elite all-boys academy to find out who killed your parents, and choose how close you grow to three classmates with secrets of their own.
5461730.name: Claws of Destiny: Complete Edition

5461870.desc: A first-person sci-fi social deduction game for up to 8 players. Fix the ship, watch your crewmates, then accuse and vote out the infected. Or be Patient 0: lie, sabotage and vanish. A co-op mode swaps the traitor for a hunter and a ticking clock.
5461870.name: Synthetic Quorum

5462260.desc: A 2D puzzle adventure game with hand drawn style. In the night map, you only need to press the C key on the keyboard to excavate hidden treasures on the ground, crack the mechanisms in the correct order, take a boat to reach Mist Island, and complete the exploration of five levels of night fog.
5462260.name: Dig! Dig! Dig for Treasure

5462360.desc: Made by someone with nearly 10 years in a gyudon (beef bowl) shop. A first-person shop sim where you wash rice, simmer beef, plate bowls, juggle IH burners and ring up orders like the real job. Run out of rice and the shop closes. Shout through the lunch rush solo or with up to 4 friends online.
5462360.name: 牛丼店シミュレーター

5462420.desc: Roll, balance, and find your way through a world of challenging courses in this relaxing physics-based adventure. Control balls made from different materials, each with unique physical properties, and master the art of rolling your way to the finish. Stay balanced and complete every level!
5462420.name: Ballpeak

5462450.desc: Rotate groups of three diamond-shaped tiles to restore the illusion of a colorful cube. Choose from eight puzzle sizes, ranging from 12 to 243 tiles, and race against the clock to beat your personal best. Simple rules, precise controls, endless challenges.
5462450.name: Puzzlozenge

5462560.desc: An incremental colony game in an allotment garden. Hundreds of gnomlings pick berries, merge fruit in a magic cauldron and fling it through the air. When the run slows down, make jam: jars buy lasting upgrades in the Gnome Village under the compost heap.
5462560.name: Jar of Gnomes

5462830.desc: A lighthearted RPG where Randal and Matt embark on a tabletop role-playing adventure, with Charlie as their Dungeon Master. Eager to finish the game as quickly as possible, they’ll have to deal with Charlie’s twisted challenges, facing combat, exploring dangerous dungeons and solving puzzles.
5462830.name: Randal's Weekend

5463460.desc: VELTARUM is a single-player retro FPS built around fast movement and brutal combat. Wall-run through a dark world of towers and chains, fight with guns and a sword, slow time, and face towering bosses. Spend crystals on upgrades between lives and climb again.
5463460.name: Veltarum

5463810.desc: Break through 50,000 bricks. Time to escape the walls. Punch your way to freedom! Break through walls, punch out the walls and escape prison one punch at a time! Smash through tougher walls, discover new areas, and become the ultimate wall-breaking machine in WALL PUNCH: ESCAPE THE WALLS SIMULATOR
5463810.name: Wall Punch: Escape The Walls Simulator

5463830.desc: 2D action game featuring exhilarating gameplay driven by dashes and combos. Keep an eye on the actions and reactions of Spica—a cool yet adorable boy who wields the power of the stars! With over 30 stages, the game offers plenty of replay value through features like score attacks and time trials.
5463830.name: StarsPartyNext

5463910.desc: A free messenger for friends, communities and teams. Chats, voice and video calls, voice rooms you can drop into anytime, screen sharing, community servers with roles, and a task board for your team. One account on PC and phone. Sign in with Steam.
5463910.name: Gсhat

5464560.desc: 1996, somewhere in Coyote City... the dead won’t stay dead. Blast through a blood-soaked zombie horde in this fast-paced retro FPS. Shred them limb by limb, chain brutal kills, and make sure every last one of them RIPs.
5464560.name: HordeNight 1996

5465130.desc: The Moon is up there. You're a monkey. And for some reason, you've decided that climbing a giant tree is a good idea. Climb, jump, and swing your way through this physics-based climbing adventure, solo or with friends. The plan doesn't get any better, but you can blame it.
5465130.name: Moonkey

5465350.desc: Start with empty shelves and a dream in My Bookstore! Buy books, manage your inventory, serve customers, and grow your little shop into a thriving bookstore. Stock your shelves, ring up sales, and build the bookstore every book lover dreams of!
5465350.name: My Bookstore

5465790.desc: Start with a single coin. Flip, upgrade, and automate your way to a fortune in an incremental game where flips determine power.
5465790.name: Gold Idle

5465850.desc: High-speed anti-gravity racing across 16 tracks. Take on 15 rivals, master banked corners, loops and jumps, and spend your energy on perfectly timed boosts. Unlock 12 distinct ships and compete for victory across four Grand Prix cups.
5465850.name: FLUX CIRCUIT

5465870.desc: Stack zombies, clear lines, and chase high scores! Zombie Mori! is a fast-paced falling-block puzzle game packed with quirky zombies! Clear multiple lines, combine zombie types for huge score multipliers, and unlock all 50 zombies in your collection. The higher you stack, the higher you score!
5465870.name: ゾンビ盛り！

5466110.desc: Free Issue 00 includes an exclusive special stage of the wild run & gun HIJURA SCARLET GEAR! A disk-magazine-style collection of indie studio HU-GA's work, also with the Final Re:Quest movie trailer in TRUE PIXEL, a special booklet and four Zolge Station talk specials. New issues arrive as DLC.
5466110.name: ZOLGE STATION: HUGA Waiwai Academy

5466570.desc: A single-player visual novel about bar owner Larry and the people he meets. Make choices across multiple character routes and endings, with 40 local save slots and an ending collection. Available in 8 languages.
5466570.name: 賴瑞的調酒研究室

5467080.desc: Run a first-person upgrade shop in Upking. Draw collectibles, take commissions, and chase rare traits with every hammer strike. Play it safe or pay to keep a customer’s masterpiece. One more hit could make your fortune—or shatter it.
5467080.name: Upking

5467590.desc: Neon-noir beat 'em up for 1-2 players. Includes PART I: STREETS OF VENGEANCE, PART II: OVERCLOCK and SURVIVAL MODE: two full campaigns, couch co-op, combos, throws, support strikes and 13 boss fights, told in painted comic panels.
5467590.name: IRON FURY

5467680.desc: Relax with Charmosaic, a cozy, free-to-play diamond painting game. Match colors, place thousands of tiny diamonds, and watch beautiful pictures come to life. Choose from three difficulty levels and enjoy new free paintings every month.
5467680.name: Charmosaic

5469080.desc: First-person PS1-style stealth horror. No weapons, no combat. The last bus is gone, and you’re left at a seaside inn in a Hokkaido snowstorm, with polite hosts who hear everything, even your voice if you turn on the mic. Find the proof and get out, or no one will believe you.
5469080.name: The Red Inn

5469110.desc: Work the night shift at a 24-hour drive-thru. Take orders, cook the food and hand it out the window. But some customers aren’t human. Check every face, car and order, and refuse the ones that don’t match, or they’ll come back for you before dawn. Solo or co-op for up to 4 players.
5469110.name: 3AM Drivethrough

5469310.desc: Start with an empty account and load the first cargo yourself. Hire and train workers, add wagons and expand your station and warehouse. In this railway idle game, watch the flow of goods, spot bottlenecks and decide which upgrade will make the biggest difference.
5469310.name: Haste Makes Waste

5469940.desc: Uncle Sal left you the keys to his pawn shop on Avenue A. Haggle with sellers, spot the fakes, hand out pawn loans and flip the deals of the week. Run the counter solo or with up to 3 friends in online co-op.
5469940.name: Pawn Shop Together

5470240.desc: Celebrate shocktober like never before!  Take a shot with your electric power beam to try hitting Kaya in the fewest shots possible!  Ride your golf cart to the next tee location as you work your way towards your goal of sending kaya flying, but be careful!  You wouldn't want to do her in!
5470240.name: Kaya Shock Golf

5471210.desc: Pickleball Pro is a 3D doubles pickleball game with the real rules: the kitchen, the two-bounce rule and 0-0-2 scoring. Dink, drop and drive through a 16-team Pro Tour, or take on a friend in online multiplayer. Every shot is here, from the third-shot drop to the Erne.
5471210.name: Pickleball Pro

5471970.desc: An endless pile of paperwork is waiting for your approval stamp. Reject shameless business expenses, outwork your rivals, and from New Hire to Chairman, work until the day you die!
5471970.name: Rubber Stamp Legend

5471990.desc: You watched the defragmenter as a kid. Now it's your turn. Sweep the read head across scrambled disks, hear fragments click into place, and upgrade your machine from a 1998 floppy to a 2032 archive array, recovering thirty years of one ordinary life along the way.
5471990.name: Disk Defragmenter

5472000.desc: Your grandpa is giving you his old farm! Clean it up, plant vegetables, take care of the animals, and make friends in the small village of Lindenau. Go fishing, explore caves, and help the village fight back against a big scheme from the city. Play alone or with up to 3 friends.
5472000.name: Cloverstead

5472080.desc: SHRED A BILLION is a first-person incremental game about a mountain of money! Grab bills by hand, scoop them with a bucket, level up and feed a billion dollars to the shredder. Only 3,929,120,202 bills left to go!
5472080.name: SHRED A BILLION

5472130.desc: Blast your friends off floating arenas in Rocket Punt, a chaotic rocket party brawler for up to 10 players. Grab wild weapons, dodge incoming rockets, and fight solo or in teams across seven modes. Play online with friends or practise against bots.
5472130.name: Rocket Punt

5472200.desc: A 3D aquarium game for watching bee shrimp. Zoom in to see them graze, groom and swim, or feed them and watch them gather. Choose from 12+ aquascapes, change the lighting, and customize the shrimp's patterns, colors and sizes.
5472200.name: Bee Shrimp Aquarium

5472270.desc: The most emotionally charged horror game. Find all the pictures before the entities find you.
5472270.name: Backrooms Found Hentai

5472470.desc: Drive an armored war machine through endless enemy waves. A survivors-like shooter: auto-fire, dodge, unleash ultimates, pick upgrades and set the field ablaze. Start with Eileen / Ghost, unlock two more crews, fight nine stages, and push each battlefield from Easy to Nightmare.
5472470.name: 装甲奇兵

5472530.desc: A cozy first-person family sim where your fox family doubles every night. Hunt, chop, build a den and tuck your kits into bed, then command a crowd of thousands at once, from three kits up to 65,536. Play solo or in online co-op with up to four parents.
5472530.name: Big Fox Family Time

5472580.desc: A large-scale sorting simulator set in a two-storey hypermarket: organize 65,146 products and boxes across 23 departments, stock shelves and warehouse racks, and use boosters to find, carry and place items.
5472580.name: Hypermarket: Sort & Stock

5472820.desc: This Skylines-themed book unlocks 20 additional levels for Coloring Pixels. Travel the world's cities and beyond in this new book! Iconic, famous, and fictional cities!
5472820.name: Coloring Pixels - Skylines Pack

5472830.desc: This Advent-themed book unlocks 24 additional levels for Coloring Pixels! It's Christmassssss! Celebrate again with Coloring Pixels. Play during the month of December to get the full Advent experience! 1 image will unlock every day between the 1st and the 24th, like a true Advent calendar!
5472830.name: Coloring Pixels - Advent 8 Pack

5472850.desc: Incremental factory + automation clicker + vending machines + steampunk = Vendilooper. Build a snack empire you can get lost watching. Automate refills, stack machines into towers, and feed trains and rockets to Mars. How many snacks can you vend per minute?
5472850.name: Vendilooper - original

5472880.desc: 1,800+ event cards, 164 troop cards and 151 epic figures anchor this civilization strategy roguelite. Weigh policy, construction and war; choose a starting technology, homeland and faith to shape each new run.
5472880.name: Rebirth of Empire

5472910.desc: Collect randomized loot and shape your build with skills, talents, and gear. Choose from four heroes and explore 75 stages across five continents in side-view battles.
5472910.name: Abyss Destroyer

5472990.desc: MiaoMiao Idle is a healing-style cat-themed idle game. In the peaceful "Cat Village", you live alongside adorable cats — gathering, fishing, farming, mining, raising cats, building, and crafting equipment, enjoying a laid-back countryside cat life.
5472990.name: 猫猫放置

5473160.desc: Make a face. Steal the show! Mimic wild expressions on camera in Facial Expression Variety Show. Practice across 10 solo rounds or compete online with up to 6 players. Take turns in the spotlight, compare scores, and celebrate on the podium. Your face is the main event!
5473160.name: Facial Expression Variety Show

5473910.desc: A turn-based RPG about hamster cosmonauts. Roaches hired by space pirates have stolen the Golden Sunflower. Lead five heroes through 170 levels in five worlds, beat the bosses and bring the petals home.
5473910.name: Space Hamsters

5473930.desc: A wordless hidden-object puzzle game set inside living medieval paintings. Find what the villagers need, carry it across the scene and set their troubles right, and each one you mend brings the picture into full colour. No timers, no way to fail, and the Fool to help or sometimes get in your way.
5473930.name: Follyvale

5474070.desc: Hold the gate against ground and airborne swarms in a dark-fantasy defence shooter. Upgrade your arsenal, defeat powerful lords, then take direct control of unlocked heroes—turn, hover and strike back through a 30-day campaign and endless defence.
5474070.name: SWARM GATE

5474650.desc: A minimalistic, top down, survival horror. Run, strategise and outplay The Horror accross multiple maps and modes.
5474650.name: The Horror

5474720.desc: Gym Tidy: Re-rack Your Weights is a gym-themed organizing game supporting up to 4 players online. Clean up the fitness space and get some exercise along the way. Some heavy dumbbells cannot be lifted right from the start.
5474720.name: Gym Tidy: Re-rack Your Weights

5474760.desc: A satirical clicker where the goal isn't to get rich: it's to owe as much as possible. Click your credit card, spend what you borrow, sign every loan, and climb from a broke apartment to a mortgage on the Sun and a loan against Reality itself.
5474760.name: Debt Clicker

5474910.desc: Shoot the asteroids until they're small enough to collect. If anything hits the tail of asteroids you've collected, you lose them. Don't lose so many. Lose less. *Fewer.
5474910.name: Ruthenium Smash & Grab

5475240.desc: Explore a shifting fantasy world in Riftgrove, a 3D action RPG featuring four playable classes, fast-paced combat, procedurally generated wilderness, dangerous dungeons, rare relics, and powerful Champions. Return to Haven, take guild contracts, and venture through the next portal.
5475240.name: RIFTGROVE

5475450.desc: Lia’s Rolling Club is a satisfying incremental game about rolling joints, stacking cash, and chasing jackpots. Upgrade and automate to hypnotic trap and plugg beats. Survive an increasingly chaotic arena shooter, climb the leaderboards, and uncover Lia’s mysterious story.
5475450.name: Lia’s Rolling Club

5475670.desc: Catch what moved. The moves get smaller and smaller. Test your perception.
5475670.name: Peer Into The Void

5475700.desc: Recess at a 2000s Korean elementary school, five gonggi stones on your desk. Scatter, toss, pick up and catch with the hand you move with the mouse. Play your seatmate or a Steam friend for wrist flicks, or climb Grades 1 to 6. Between rounds, touch 140+ things around school and play with friends.
5475700.name: Gonggi: Recess

5476120.desc: Build your own cruise line, from a little Rhine river boat to a 5,000-guest megaship. Design every deck, staff it, plan the voyages and keep thousands of guests happy - or set loose a kraken, a lightning storm and pirates and see if she stays afloat.
5476120.name: Cruisopolis: Cruise Line Tycoon

5476460.desc: 《Doomsday Survivor 末日幸存者》 is a shooting game with a post-apocalyptic theme. Players will face the threats of zombies and rebels. They need to defend against zombie attacks, go out to explore, collect supplies and avoid the attacks of zombies and rebels.
5476460.name: Doomsday Survivor 末日幸存者

5476500.desc: The exclusive soundtrack from Hidden Cats in Beijing is here!
5476500.name: Hidden Cats in Beijing Soundtrack

5476640.desc: FIRE CHESS is a serious strategy game that puts players in command of an emergency-response team to contain spreading wildfires. Recruit and manage units across a hex-grid map, use your limited resources to contain a spreading fire, protect residential communities, and respond to critical alerts.
5476640.name: FIRE CHESS

5476770.desc: Armed Prisoner III is a 2D casual incremental idle electronic cricket small game in which the core gameplay revolves around Bot AI characters using modern firearms to shoot and fight each other. The battles are random, chaotic, and unlimited in duration
5476770.name: Armed Prisoner III

5477010.desc: Solve block-fitting puzzles and unlock sexy character scenes as your reward. Find the perfect fit and reveal what awaits beyond each completed board.
5477010.name: Hentai Age Onsen

5477110.desc: Xianxia auto-battler: 42 cultivators, 7 elements, 14 bonds. Eight teams, 100 Embers each — lose them all and you are out. No fixed finish line: fight until you ascend or fall. Your rivals are real lineups left by other players — AI stand-ins when the player pool is thin.
5477110.name: Ascension Tournament

5477240.desc: A Western-flavored, procedurally generated top-down shooter in retro pixel art. Blast through 50 floors across 5 chapters, smash enemy spawn holes, freeze incoming bullets with your Stasis skill, and take down a boss every five floors, including a two-form final boss.
5477240.name: STASIS LAST RAIL

5477320.desc: Break the support. Drop the slab. Smash the rock below. Rockburst is an incremental mining game about setting off collapses, collecting ore and buying upgrades to dig deeper before your lamp runs out.
5477320.name: Rockburst

5477420.desc: A Hold'em table in a secret members-only club. Tonight again, beauties with hidden reasons sit down to bet. To the one who loses it all, you offer not pity but a deal. Break them, make an offer hard to refuse, and claim their secret 'reward.' At the table's end waits a dealer sure she can't lose.
5477420.name: ZX Allstar Holdem

5477640.desc: Paragra is a 2D arcade paragliding game. Climb in thermals, become an XC league hero and win competitions. Read the sky and don't land in a field too early.
5477640.name: Paragra: Paragliding Adventure

5477930.desc: Your cat borrowed eight million, built a second sun in the bathroom, and named you guarantor. An absurd comedy visual novel with dubious contracts, a bathtub republic, a turn-based solar puzzle, and three ways to survive the evening.
5477930.name: Boris & the Second Sun

5478920.desc: "Magnetaris" takes you to an unknown planet, battered by electrical storms and strongly affected by magnetic fields. You will have to stabilize it using new technologies and machinery. Alone or with friends, explore these magnetic lands, unveil their secrets, and restore balance to this planet!
5478920.name: The Planet Crafter - Magnetaris

5480010.desc: Relive your Battle Bears childhood with 3 classic skins from the Trilogy Era (Classic Oliver, Classic Riggs and Classic Huggable) designed with superfan artist AceArts, 3 classic songs for the menu and map jukebox, and 100 Gas Cans to spend in game.
5480010.name: Battle Bears Gold - Classic Skins & Jukebox Songs

5480030.desc: Go Overclock! Use 2 Overclock gauntlets with Oliver for a unique play style, including the brand new Dark OCO Gauntlet. Plus 5 Overclock skins, including 3 brand-new ones designed with superfan artist AceArts, the Overclock menu theme for the jukebox, and 150 Gas Cans to spend in-game.
5480030.name: Battle Bears Gold - Overclock Skins, Weapons & Jukebox Song

5480040.desc: THIS PACK SHALL SHOWER GOLD UPON EVERY CLASS PRESENT AND FUTURE! Never go unnoticed on the battlefield again with 11 gold skins, one for every class! It wouldn't be Battle Bears Gold without them.
5480040.name: Battle Bears Gold - Gold Skins Pack

5480060.desc: Smash the competition with Bling Pong, a close-range table tennis weapon crafted from Gold Digger materials by artist AceArts. Includes instant unlocks for 6 unreleased DLC tracks and, we're not joking, 1,000 BONUS GAS CANS!
5480060.name: Battle Bears Gold - Bling Pack: Weapon, Rare Songs & Gas

5480120.desc: Seek your perfect match in Regency London! A wealthy suitor would save your family from ruin—but what about your heart and your literary dreams? An interactive Regency romance novel, 259,000 words and hundreds of choices, without graphics or sound effects.
5480120.name: As the Lady Chooses

5480320.desc: A pixel shooter with automatic fire, random loot, and permanent upgrades. Steer your fighter left and right, combining gear, relics, and items packed with memes. Spend gold on the skill tree, chase survival records, and face a boss with three phases. Your next chest might hold a surprise!
5480320.name: ！？龙龙？！

5480840.desc: Every enemy moves on the beat. Fly one of four ships through a cyberpunk three-act run, meet 210 strange encounters, play 24 minigames, unlock a new relic with every stage you clear, fuse weapons into 1,378 fusions, and see how deep Endless goes.
5480840.name: BeatSlayer

5480940.desc: A linear adult visual novel about a quiet 19-year-old living alone with his stepmother Rinko, an elegant model and cosmetics entrepreneur. She still treats him like her son. But the way she looks at him when the house is quiet says something else entirely.
5480940.name: Lost With Mom

5481060.desc: Break through 10 million voxels to find the Prismatic Cube. A short incremental game about satisfying destruction with really bouncy balls.
5481060.name: 10 Million Cubes Demo

5481170.desc: Run a hands-on burger truck in PC VR. Take orders, grill patties, build burgers and serve your customers. Work through daily shifts to unlock a bigger menu, or cook together in online co-op. Headset required.
5481170.name: Burger Truck

5481780.desc: Tinsel the elf is on the NAUGHTY LIST, and she's in Santa's office to appeal. She swears she's innocent, but every snow globe of evidence tells a much NAUGHTIER story. A comedic real-time 3D erotic story, fully voice acted by adult superstar Mia Sloane. You play Santa: Naughty or Nice?
5481780.name: Tinsel versus the Naughty List

5481890.desc: Strap into a fully 3D starfighter and battle endless alien waves with up to 3 friends. Stack roguelite upgrades, chain class combos, fire your ultimate beam and bring down 11 colossal bosses - or turn your guns on each other in PvP dogfights.
5481890.name: Spaceship Wars Together

5482020.desc: By day you sow. By night they come for the harvest — so you make them the harvest. Kill monsters ON your crop beds, let the soil drink their blood, and watch it grow at dawn. A brutal farming defense with a shotgun, a scythe and a year of nightmares.
5482020.name: Blood Soil

5482210.desc: Carve your body out of marble, and stand as still as a statue! Hide & Chisel is a hide-and-seek game where you carve a block of stone into any shape you can think of. Hide from the Curator and his hammer!
5482210.name: Hide & Chisel

5482330.desc: Wayfarion is a 2D space action roguelite. Chart procedural sectors, fight in real time, fit weapons and drones, and trade loot at starports. A destroyed ship ends the run, while skill-tree licenses and unlocked hulls carry over. Play solo or in online co-op.
5482330.name: Wayfarion

5482350.desc: Become Rinnosuke, owner of the Kourindou curio shop, and play chess with the Gensokyo regulars who drop by. Your guests laugh, panic and grumble as the game turns. Learn the rules in a 9-chapter story, then sharpen your play with puzzles and lessons.
5482350.name: Touhou Chess

5482540.desc: Conduct an orchestra with your mouse as the baton. The catch: they're terrible. The flute can't be heard, the horn is deafening, and the choir in Beethoven's Ninth only sings "Aaah". Had enough? Throw the baton at them. Instruments break, the damage piles up, and they throw it back.
5482540.name: MISCONDUCTOR | 迷指揮者

5482710.desc: A pixel-art business tycoon. Run an electronics and car company from 1980 to today: research 45 years of tech, design desktops, laptops, phones, cars and engines part by part in 3D, build your campus and fight twelve rival companies for every market.
5482710.name: Silicon Tycoon

5483250.desc: Box Them Cats is a cozy drag-and-drop puzzle game. Grab wandering cats, sort them into the right-sized boxes, recycle the sneaky trash bags, and take on clients’ challenges to earn goddess blessings.
5483250.name: Box Them Cats

5484040.desc: Sweeter is a single-player, campaign-driven FPS set on the island paradise of Sugarland. As Sweeter01, leader of a purification squad, you will cleanse zones sealed off due to the infected creatures known as Sugis and uncover the truth hidden by headquarters.
5484040.name: Sweeter

548430.desc: Deep Rock Galactic is a 1-4 player co-op FPS featuring dwarven space miners, procedurally-generated destructible environments, and endless hordes of alien monsters. Explore cave systems, mine for minerals, and work together to survive!
548430.name: Deep Rock Galactic

5484320.desc: FOG is a role-playing game centered on combat and character progression, incorporating elements such as Minesweeper. It features mechanics like chain fog-clearing, allowing even newcomers unfamiliar with traditional Minesweeper rules to pick it up quickly.
5484320.name: FOG

5484400.desc: A relaxing first-person sim about tidying up a forgotten military underground base. Shelve ammo crates, weapons, drones and gear, unlock new sectors and level up your skills – solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players. No timers, no pressure.
5484400.name: Military Base Tidy Up

5484410.desc: Tidy up a private space company's scrapyard, collect rocket parts into sets on your racks and build your own rocket every evening. In the morning it launches – will it reach the edge of space, orbit, or help build a space station?
5484410.name: Rocket Scrapyard

5484620.desc: You are the Demon Lord, and every woman in the land wants to move into your castle. The rejected ones show up with armies for a "hostile job interview." Merge slimes, hold the gate, and pass them all. A cheeky pixel-art tower defense comedy with adult content.
5484620.name: Demon Castle Guard

5484900.desc: One long trip across America, and every stop is a new temptation.
5484900.name: Sinful States of America

5485170.desc: Be born into a random year between 1980 and 2008, weighted by real birth counts, in one of China's 34 provinces and regions and 56 ethnic groups. Then live one life year by year, from birth certificate to obituary, through the years as they really happened. No guide, just one life.
5485170.name: 十四亿分之一

5485210.desc: 'My Sister' is a casual Visual Novel JRPG. Play as 25-year-old Jung-boong, taking on jobs and adventures to heal his depressed younger sister. Complete non-combat quests, and battles to unlock multiple endings and event CGs!
5485210.name: My Sister

5485330.desc: Turn piles of plush cats into tidy shelves! So Many Cats! is a cozy first-person organizing game. Sort 4,608 plushies, unlock abilities and decorate your shop. No timers, no rush. Just one more cat!
5485330.name: So Many Cats!

5485410.desc: Get your first taste of running a bakery in space in this free introduction to Cosmic Crumbs: Bakery Simulator. Bake sweet treats, serve coffee, put your robot helper to work, and adopt a cat — solo or with friends in online co-op for up to 4 players.
5485410.name: Cosmic Crumbs: Bakery Simulator - First Bite

5485770.desc: Sort thousands of collectible toys during the night shift at a mysterious toy store. Complete collections, organize shelves, unlock upgrades, and enjoy the satisfaction of putting everything in its place. But be careful... something is watching you.
5485770.name: Meowinks Tidy or Else

5486000.desc: A couch co-op spellcaster for one to four players. Aim every spell by hand, jump what you cannot walk around, and read fifteen bespoke bosses well enough not to burn your friends. Friendly fire is always on.
5486000.name: Emberveth

5486240.desc: Become the general manager of a baseball club in this management simulation. Make decisions on player signings, trades, free-agent contracts, lineups, and team finances. Compete in a challenging league and build a legendary franchise with your own baseball philosophy.
5486240.name: DIAMOND OFFICE: BASEBALL GM

5486980.desc: A solo card game with one deck. Clubs and spades are monsters. Diamonds are weapons. Hearts are potions. Each round deals 4 cards: play 3, keep 1. Get through the deck alive. Every deck can be won. A new daily deck every day, and rogue runs of six decks.
5486980.name: Grim Deck

5487290.desc: A cozy organizing game where you sort over 4000 adorable creatures into their matching terrariums. Discover more than 400 creature variations, unlock helpful abilities, and turn a colorful mess into a collection full of life.
5487290.name: Sort the Creatures

5487470.desc: A first-person multiplayer social deduction game: investigate, craft equipment and expose the parasite, or play as the creature to hide inside other players, take control of their bodies and turn their trust against them.
5487470.name: Parasite: Among the Guests

5487820.desc: Defend your base, recruit an army, gather resources, and fight epic battles in this real-time strategy game! Play the campaign, survive waves of enemies, and challenge other players online.
5487820.name: World of Stick

5488250.desc: Hunt zombies, collect powerful loot, and grow stronger in this third-person action RPG. Find pistols, assault rifles, shotguns, and equipment with randomized stats and effects, build your character, fight through five increasingly dangerous stages, and ultimately challenge the Zomking.
5488250.name: Zomking

5488980.desc: Ravenford: The Last Raven Warden is a painterly dark fantasy beat 'em up. Fight through twelve cursed chapters as the last warden, chain sword combos and fiery spells, move between lanes, upgrade your blade and armor, and face monstrous bosses to free a land swallowed by night.
5488980.name: Ravenford: The Last Raven Warden

5489070.desc: Eight strangers. Nine ancient pillars. One oath that will cost them everything. Gather a band of travelers across a hand-built diorama world, bring foes low in deep turn-based battles, and live the tragedy that came before Echoes of Creation.
5489070.name: The Nine Oaths

5489160.desc: A turn-based RPG featuring classic Magic Tower gameplay. Climb through tower floors, collect keys and gold, fight monsters in turn-based battles, solve puzzles, and uncover the truth behind the Demon Lord and the Princess at the tower’s peak. There are three distinct endings.
5489160.name: 魔塔-织梦

5489480.desc: Just Lay It is a train survival strategy game where you lay tracks, gather resources, and fight monsters to keep a train running across the desert. Defend against waves of enemies and design efficient routes to reach your destination safely. The moment the train stops, survival ends.
5489480.name: JustLayIt

5489550.desc: Build a village in Song-era China with knowledge from the modern world. Plan homes and workshops, assign villagers, research and trade. Muster a roster of up to 24 soldiers for two three-battle campaigns, then return home to tend your growing settlement.
5489550.name: Xiqiao Chronicles

5489800.desc: Raise the fallen and build your own legion of the dead. Command the kings you defeat as elite summons, swap between 8 shot types and unleash screen-filling skills in this dark fantasy survival action game.
5489800.name: Necromancer: Revival of the Dead

5490210.desc: A mouse-only 2D physics climber. Grab on with Kurousa's long ears, swing, and climb a mountain of office supplies. No checkpoints: one fall can send you back to the start. He falls, he cries, and he reaches again. Can you get Kurousa home on time?
5490210.name: Kurousa Just Wants to Go Home

5490440.desc: SKY REAVER is a pixel-art vertical shoot 'em up with incremental progression. Dodge bullets, destroy enemies and collect resources. Return to base for permanent upgrades, unlock missiles, wingmen and lasers, and take on 25 powerful bosses with ever-growing firepower.
5490440.name: SKY REAVER

5490500.desc: Run an occult pawnshop where every bargain can become a liability. Inspect strange antiques, expose forgeries, diagnose curses and serve demanding clients. Trade, cleanse and fulfil orders while yesterday's promises return as today's consequences.
5490500.name: Occult Pawnshop Simulator

5490870.desc: Change gravity in six directions and guide crystal orbs to their goals in this single-player 3D puzzle game. Choose any of 100 stages from the start. EXTRA HARD adds XOR gates, water controls and floating platforms in larger mazes. Team up with Meguru and Bimba to earn minimum-move medals!
5490870.name: Horochi's Challenge

5490920.desc: A quiet place for Sudoku. Explore 20 variants and five difficulty levels with illustrated rules, a hands-on tutorial and hints beside the board. Save favourite puzzles, build a relay, or create and share your own puzzle files. Play solo offline with autosave.
5490920.name: Infinite Sudoku

5490940.desc: Organize a bank vault packed with 2,345 unique items! Sort cash, gold, and precious treasures, arrange every shelf, and turn chaos into order. Team up with friends in this satisfying tidying adventure!
5490940.name: Bank Vault: Tidy Up Together

5491440.desc: Clock in for inventory week and scan every box before 6:00 AM. Explore a foggy shipping yard through a store-issued phone, manage its battery, follow radio instructions, and survive five increasingly impossible night shifts.
5491440.name: FINAL COUNT

5491940.desc: A cosy digging game set in a British back garden. Shovel, pick and drill through turf, clay and rock, sell every load, upgrade your tools and build ladders, belts and lifts as you dig hundreds of metres down to unearth treasures, crystal caves, lava and a buried secrets. Dig alone or with friends.
5491940.name: Project Hole

5492180.desc: A whacky physics action game about space! In Grand Space Game, take control of a problematic planet that has attracted the attention of many across the cosmos. Smash your way through the galaxy and form objects from the dust for more chaos. Take what you earned and build a new galaxy in your image.
5492180.name: Grand Space Game

5492190.desc: Enter the long-closed St. Elora Hospital for a final technical inspection before demolition. Restore power, explore the building, and examine the records left behind. Before it Falls is a first-person psychological horror game focused on exploration and environmental puzzles.
5492190.name: Before it Falls

5492690.desc: Night shift at a tunnel car wash on the edge of town. Take the money, log the plates, keep the brushes turning until six. The attendant before you stopped coming three weeks ago. His notes are still in the drawer.
5492690.name: Night Wash: GE-418-NK

5493320.desc: Supporter pack with the Grimguard Armor, Chaos Glider and matching cape cosmetics
5493320.name: Stormforge - Supporter Pack Cosmetics

5493880.desc: A darkly funny bunker management sim. Build down, admit survivors at the gate and pray none of them is infected. Every night something new tests your layout: diggers from below, crawlers in the vents, spores in the air, screamers drawn to your generators.
5493880.name: Home Sweet Bunker: Bunker Tycoon

5493950.desc: A video player that runs on the Steam Frame itself. It opens almost any video or photo: watch on a big screen, in 3D, VR180 or VR360, with hardware decoding up to 8K, 10-bit HDR and subtitles. Play from the headset, a microSD card, a share, Jellyfin or Emby. No PC, no account, no tracking.
5493950.name: FrameCinema

5494180.desc: This is a first-person horror adventure game where you enter the mansion of Kun Kun, the richest man in Aikun City. Everything inside has been eerily controlled. Kun Kun has set up a series of puzzles to stop intruders. Can you solve these puzzles and escape Kun Kun's mansion?
5494180.name: WhoKilledKK

5494200.desc: Discover the joy of learning Chinese: connect characters into words across 30 ink-wash themes, planned to grow to 100. Every word includes pinyin, English meaning, and audio. The interface stays in Chinese for immersion - hover any button for an English tip. Zen Mode or 3-minute Challenge.
5494200.name: Hanzen: A Chinese Word Journey

5494340.desc: In Totally Not Gaming, we offer classic mini-games like Spider Solitaire, FreeCell, Klondike Solitaire, and Minesweeper—all disguised as office software! Come join us for some fun slacking off at work!
5494340.name: Totally Not Gaming

5494840.desc: “Don't Drop!!” is a challenging 3D action game that captures the essence of platformers. Control the ball using only jump commands as you aim for the top of the tower! Go through repeated trial and error, and experience the thrill of gradually clearing each level!
5494840.name: Don’t  Drop!!

5494940.desc: Turn a forgotten mountain street into a cozy yokai night bazaar. Gather ingredients, choose stalls, and let an odd little crew get to work. Keep recipes between runs, learn lasting upgrades, and prepare seven lantern-lit festivals.
5494940.name: Yokai Night Bazaar

5495060.desc: SENGOKU combines samurai action, economic management and grand strategy in feudal Japan. Lead the Tokugawa clan, build farms and trade networks, recruit warriors, forge alliances, conquer castles and rise through the Imperial Court to become Shogun.
5495060.name: Sengoku Fields of Empire

5495500.desc: The official one-track MANBOU / VOYAGE soundtrack. Includes Bubble Plunge by teihen0gc (1:00.447), in 320 kbps stereo MP3 format. Music created using Gemini generative AI.
5495500.name: MANBOU / VOYAGE Soundtrack

5495580.desc: Stand up, paddle hard and try not to fall in. Race stand-up paddle boards down wild rivers round the world, through rapids, over waterfalls and off kickers, with friends bumping you into the water. Wobble, wipe out, climb back on, win.
5495580.name: Extreme Paddle Board

5495680.desc: Be a prop and hide, but with a little twist. Play classic Hide & Seek, or jump into Generator Mode: fix generators, disguise as props, stun the hunter and escape through the gates before you end up on the electric chair. Play with friends or strangers.
5495680.name: Prophunt Slop

5496150.desc: Vending Park: Sort & Stock is a cozy organizing game where you sort over 1,000 scattered products and put them back into their correct vending machines. Unlock helpful abilities, tidy up at your own pace, and enjoy the satisfaction of restoring order to a messy vending park!
5496150.name: Vending Park: Sort & Stock

5496540.desc: Heavy punches, big bellies and scores to settle. Street Panz is a single-player 2D fighting game: choose from eight fighters, take on the neighborhood rivals and four bosses, sharpen your moves and climb the local leaderboard.
5496540.name: Street Panz

5497040.desc: Build a party of up to five heroes in this single-player Chinese fantasy idle RPG. Auto-battle for gear with random affixes and collect offline rewards. Combine formations, combat styles, and cultivation manuals to take on secret-realm bosses and climb the Endless Tower.
5497040.name: Idle Demon Slayer

5497300.desc: Squeeze fruit, earn mountains of juice, and grow your tiny fruit stand into a thriving juice empire! Buy upgrades, automate production, discover rare fruits, brew recipes, explore orchards, and prestige for permanent rewards in this colorful incremental clicker.
5497300.name: Fruit Frenzy Clicker

5497610.desc: Take charge of a ski jumping nation and build a team for seasons to come. Select your squads, plan training, develop young talent and follow your athletes in 3D competitions. Your decisions shape the future of the team.
5497610.name: SJM - Ski Jumping Manager

5497850.desc: A relaxing logic puzzle where you shade cells and draw a single loop, using arrow clues that count the shaded cells. Every puzzle has exactly one answer you can reach with logic alone, no guessing.
5497850.name: Yajilin: Line Logic

5498410.desc: New Capybara, 1933. Private investigator Sam Malone and his assistant, Tommy, take on a case to find a missing wooden leg that contains a secret ledger. A branching noir detective story infused with dark humor, where any choice could be your last.
5498410.name: Visual Novel

5498450.desc: inFADErs is a barbershop simulator where every hair on your customer's head is real. Thousands of strands grow, fall, flop when wet and stand up when dry, and every one of them is judged when the cut is done.
5498450.name: inFADErs

5498600.desc: Kill birds, get paid, then buy stuff to kill more birds, get paid more, then buy even more stuff to kill even more birds... you get the idea. Clicker / idler / incremental entertainment for the whole family (or just you, we don't judge).
5498600.name: 2 birds 1 stone

5499270.desc: Explorer, but faster and better. Foldaria is a modern Windows file manager: tabs, split panes, instant search, Quick Look previews, cloud sync status and 15 themes. One small app, no ads, no account, no tracking.
5499270.name: Foldaria

5499650.desc: 毎年8月、御鴉郷にはカサネメ様が出現する...。怪異が蔓延る集落を探索し、儀式を行うサバイバルホラー。怪異を"観測"し、安全に業務を遂行せよ。
5499650.name: カサネメ様

5499750.desc: It’s Table Time packs 30 classic board games, card tables, dice battles, and quick-pick arcades—from Chess and Ludo to Mahjong, Code Breaker, Pool, and Tank Battle! Play solo vs. smart AI, gather 2–4 friends locally or in Party Cup, or jump into Steam Online Play!
5499750.name: It’s Table Time

550.desc: Set in the zombie apocalypse, Left 4 Dead 2 is a co-operative action horror FPS takes you and your friends through the cities, swamps and cemeteries of the Deep South, from Savannah to New Orleans across five expansive campaigns.
550.name: Left 4 Dead 2

5500200.desc: The companion that turns your next battle around might still be inside an egg—hatch your team, brave dice-driven turn-based battles, and journey from sunlit shores to snowy wilds and distant star realms.
5500200.name: Dicekin: Monster Tamer

5500260.desc: A Journey to the West deckbuilder with shadow-puppet art and mahjong-powered combat. Choose your fighter, build card and relic combinations, read enemy intentions and take branching routes through a ten-chapter single-player expedition.
5500260.name: GOD OF DEFIANCE

5500470.desc: Experience realistic photography simulation. Master exposure, focus, and depth of field, and explore how cameras and lenses shape each shot. Take photo jobs, shoot, edit, and deliver your work to upgrade your gear. Meet new friends through campus life and weekend shoots.
5500470.name: Portrait Photography Master

5501280.desc: In active Early Access development: unfinished and evolving. Grow a black hole, swallow towers, freeze bullets and chase a fleeing president. Planned to launch at Steam's minimum base-price tier, with price increases as content improves.
5501280.name: Bold Hole

5501320.desc: Help a floating island restore life in VR
5501320.name: Asian Story

5501670.desc: A weather and disaster expansion for The City. Track storms on the forecast, then watch your city face lightning, hail, floods, forest fires, earthquakes and EF0 to EF5 tornadoes. Build sirens, shelters, levees and seawalls, drain flooded streets, insure your buildings and rebuild.
5501670.name: The City - Force of Nature

5501760.desc: By day, tend your flock on a bright little farm. By night, guard the gate while three strangers beg to come in. Some are sheep running for their lives. Some are wolves in wool. Ask the right questions, open the gate or don't, and trust no fleece. Watch your flock and maybe save the world.
5501760.name: Wolves In The Flock

5502460.desc: Doomfield: The Maze is a single-player horror minigame where you explore a cornfield maze to find your missing dog while evading two deadly virus entities. Venture off the main path to discover hidden areas where the digital memory grows increasingly distorted.
5502460.name: Doomfield:The Maze

5502530.desc: Build a tiny world in a jar. Layer gravel, charcoal, moss and soil, plant ferns and succulents, then add frogs, a box turtle, snails, ladybugs or a few fireflies.
