Give it its own weather: a little sun, a rain cloud, a thunderstorm, snow. Share it or sell it on the marketplace and become a tycoon!
5502530.name: Terrarium Tycoon

5502660.desc: The original soundtrack to EVERYBODY HATES YOU IN TOKYO, composed and arranged by Tayfun Tuna.
5502660.name: Everybody Hates You in TOKYO Soundtrack

5502740.desc: Mastering your skills at Chess has never been easier or more fun. Earn gold by challenging yourself in both full games of chess against 20 different NPC opponents, each with their own personalities & quirks, or in 150+ puzzles. Take your gold and wager it online or in an intense dungeon adventure!
5502740.name: Dungeons of Chesslore

5502930.desc: A cosy dog food tycoon. Cook, portion, freeze and pack fresh dinners to order before the 14:00 van (it will not wait). Grow from one hob in a flat to a warehouse, with a border terrier called Biscuit supervising. Early Access.
5502930.name: A Dog's Dinner

5503180.desc: Join Zeus and the gods of Olympus on a bouncing trip from the mountaintop down to Tartarus. Aim, fire and clear every gold peg, then ride the ball back up the board for a x5 finish.
5503180.name: Olympegs

5503580.desc: Make music videos that move with the beat. Use your own music or pick from over 100 included sample tracks. Mix effects, make the look your own, and save videos in up to 4K at 60 frames per second. A guided tutorial helps you get started.
5503580.name: Audio Motion Lab

5503640.desc: A psychological horror game set in a high-rise apartment building in Japan. You are staying in Room 3501 on the 35th floor when, one night, you encounter something inexplicable. Strange events gradually begin to unfold in what should have been a quiet apartment building...
5503640.name: Apartment 3502 | 3502号室

5503670.desc: Black Fiend Legend - Cards is a single-player dark fantasy RPG focused on card collecting, character progression, and loot hunting. Choose your class, explore forests and dungeons, battle monsters and bosses, and collect cards and gear at your own pace.
5503670.name: Black Fiend Legend - Cards

5503690.desc: Roll dice, build combos, and bend fate in a single-player turn-based dice-card duel. 30 cards, distinct AI opponents, and a heavy dose of RNG. Please note before buying: luck matters, the difficulty is high, and even good decisions can lose to the dice.
5503690.name: Dice & Fate Duel

5504190.desc: Turn massive asteroids into absolutely nothing! Mine, break, and dismantle procedurally generated space rocks from 100% to 0%. Collect valuable resources, upgrade your mining ship, deploy drones, and automate your operation in this satisfying space-mining incremental.
5504190.name: Zero Mass

5504840.desc: Experience a story of temptation, passion, and emotional discovery as Adrian navigates tangled secrets, rising jealousy, and intense romance to decide where his heart truly belongs when the night finally ends.
5504840.name: Between Two Midnights

5505310.desc: Drift, boost and battle to the finish in fast-paced arcade racing. Bend bodywork, shed panels and survive spectacular crashes. Collect and tune your cars, discover shortcuts and race online against players on PC and Android.
5505310.name: Drift Wreck: Online Racing

5505440.desc: Online party chaos for up to 8 friends: train fluffy kittens in a neon gym until their muscles break the roof. Steal gains, suplex your friends, become a kaiju and survive laser pointers, Roombas and UFO abductions. Whoever weighs the most at 11 PM wins.
5505440.name: MUKIMUKI NYANKOS

5505470.desc: The original soundtrack of Go Next, by Miguel Angell and Mcborg. 32 tracks and 96 minutes of music that swing from chiptune and EDM to drum and bass, synthwave, jazz and anime rock, written to keep you moving through the hordes.
5505470.name: Go Next! Soundtrack

5505730.desc: A top-down arcade drift game. Flick into slides, link corners into massive combos and chase medals across neon cities, snowy passes and desert canyons. Customize your car with 230+ parts, beat daily challenges, or cruise a living city in the Chill Zone.
5505730.name: Drift: Beyond Grip

5505740.desc: A feature-packed casual jigsaw puzzle game! Enjoy multiple difficulties, real-time multiplayer battles, Workshop custom images, desktop pets, rhythm mini-games, and story mode. 9 languages, 22 Steam achievements!
5505740.name: ‌Super Puzzle‌

5505970.desc: Light Gun Madness is a travelling shooting show for your PC Light Guns. Test your skills, play with friends. A great party game. Use one light gun and pass it around to see who gets the best scores or play head to head with 2~4 light guns at the same time. You can use a mouse but it's not the same.
5505970.name: Blamcon's Light Gun Madness

5506160.desc: Egg Harvest is a roguelike farming game where you try to save your farm from debt. Produce eggs with your chickens, complete contracts, choose powerful upgrades, and fill your egg catalog. Keep producing until your debt is paid off!
5506160.name: Egg Harvest

5506410.desc: Start as one hungry sheep. Eat visible trails through lush pastures, earn upgrades and grow a huge working flock with mowers. Expand your grazing business, hunt for treasures and get home before the wolf takes this outing’s earnings. A single-player incremental adventure, playable offline.
5506410.name: Only Sheep

550650.desc: Black Squad is a free-to-play military first-person-shooter. Players can master their skills and show off their strategies with a wide range of game maps, modes, and weapons to choose from. Join thousands of FPS players worldwide in one of the most played games on Steam!
550650.name: Black Squad

5506620.desc: Chop up your friends and enemies in an enclosed arena with random chaos modes driven by a slot machine.
5506620.name: Slots of Chaos: Melee Arena

5507100.desc: Clear the snow one satisfying shovelful at a time, alone or with up to three friends. Start with a single shovel in a snowy Japanese town and end up clearing airport runways. Snow piles up where you throw it and banks up in front of your plow. Your pace: no time limits, no fuel, no tool wear.
5507100.name: Yukikaki: Snow Plow Simulator

5507130.desc: A starter pack of accessories for your quagling!
5507130.name: RPG in a Box - Quagling Supporter Pack

5507320.desc: Command the siege or lead a royal escape in Ancient Moves: Hnefatafl, a Viking strategy board game. Capture the king with 24 attackers or break through with 12 defenders and their king. Play solo against four AI difficulty levels or challenge a friend on the same device or online.
5507320.name: Ancient Moves: Hnefatafl (Viking Chess)

5507430.desc: Survivors is a tower defense game mixed with roguelite elements. Place your survivors, test your strategy, lose, earn resources, upgrade your defenses and try again, stronger.
5507430.name: Survivors

5507480.desc: Drive Japan’s superconducting maglevs at up to 603 km/h. Break speed records, run timetabled passenger services, handle emergencies at speed, or head out trackside as a spotter.
5507480.name: Maglev Driver

5507590.desc: A language-learning reader for your own books. Import EPUB, PDF and TXT files, then just read: Errant Ant counts every word you meet and look up, and colors each one by how well you really know it, so new words stand out and familiar ones fade. No flashcards, no account.
5507590.name: Errant Ant

5507790.desc: A cozy cat detective set in an isometric seaside neighborhood. Mandarin, a ginger cat, has been framed by a look-alike. He has seven days to find the culprit and prove his innocence to people who only hear him say "meow."
5507790.name: Who Framed The Cat?

5507870.desc: Those are fighting words! Literally. Use a random supply of letters to create words and put them in offense or defense. May the best vocabulary win.
5507870.name: Babble Battle

5507950.desc: A cinematic medieval chess saga! Take on 12 rivals in the Campaign, play Free Battle, solve 24 checkmate puzzles and watch every capture become a brutal, piece-specific execution.
5507950.name: Chess Lords

5508060.desc: One Last Cast "is a tabletop game. Place the scenery of lakes and mountains in a corner of the screen, and let your friends accompany you to leisurely fish and collect fish species from various places. Encounter rare and exotic fish, complete local commissions, and upgrade fishing equipment
5508060.name: One Last Cast

5508260.desc: Reveal Chess: hidden pieces, logic & tactics. Flip Chess: 4×8 board, Cannon & 60 HP. Classic chess too. Online matchmaking, friend battles, 8 languages.
5508260.name: Reveal & Flip Chess

5508940.desc: Carry a lantern into a night haunted by Chinese folklore. Chain sword strikes, cast talismans, dodge and counter with a perfect guard. Explore seven cursed regions as Shen Yan, searching for Lin Jian Yue and the names lost to old pacts in this single-player action RPG.
5508940.name: The Evername Lantern

5509010.desc: Escape into a world of warmth and comfort. Paint cozy rooms, peaceful hideaways, and inviting spaces filled with the little things that make a place feel like home.
5509010.name: Charmosaic - Cozy Corners

5509730.desc: A unique virtual trading simulator mixed with mature giantess interactions. Master the virtual forex market, trade virtual UGTS stocks, and unlock high-quality FMV fetish mini-games. No real money involved. (18+ Adult Content)
5509730.name: Trading A Giantess

5509790.desc: Destroy exactly one million blocks in this minimalist black-and-white idle clicker. Click or automate, upgrade six endless branches, prestige, evolve, and climb the tier system
5509790.name: Million Blocks

5510420.desc: A comedy of terrors begins in The Fog. Dead by Daylight: Terrifier brings horror icons The Terrifier and Sienna Shaw into The Fog alongside a new original Map, Hartshorne Mall. Purchasing this add-on unlocks the Art Crispies Cereal charm and the Clown Cafe Banner.
5510420.name: Dead by Daylight: Terrifier

5510580.desc: From collecting bottles in the city park to founding the Cosmic Deposit Council: gather empties, hire helpers and grow a recycling empire that stretches from a small town to the edge of the universe. A relaxed pixel-art idle game that keeps running on the side.
5510580.name: Bottle King

5510730.desc: Battle in chaotic fantasy melee arenas! Grab weapons, block, kick and turn deadly traps against your rivals in Free For All or Team Deathmatch. Explore changing battlegrounds, play online, or sharpen your skills against bots.
5510730.name: Arena Mayhem

5510960.desc: An arena-based arcade action game where your shield is for more than defense. It’s not much of a weapon, so get creative: PUSH enemies into obstacles and off ledges, clear the arena, and move on to the next.
5510960.name: ShieldMan

5511570.desc: Golf among the planets. Every planet pulls your ball: bend shots around moons, ride solar winds, slingshot past pulsars and land on tiny worlds. 12 courses, 216 holes, 4 clubs and a lots of ball styles — alone or with your friends.
5511570.name: Space Golf - A golf game in space...

5511640.desc: Start with a tiny boat and a single gun. Sink ships, salvage their gold and turn your vessel into a gloriously over-armed floating fortress. A calm, minimalist naval roguelike with an ever-changing soundtrack, where the sea always wins in the end, but never before you look magnificent.
5511640.name: Mini Battleships

5511850.desc: Build your own sandcastles and design your own beaches. Dig channels and raise sand walls to hold back the tide across 36 campaign beaches, or see how long your castle can last in Endless.
5511850.name: Save the Sandcastle

5511870.desc: Turn familiar Minesweeper logic into an expedition. Mark hidden mines, find safe routes and uncover the Crystal Mine's secret. Explore 1,380 puzzles and 24 rule types, with hints that explain the reasoning behind your next move.
5511870.name: Minesweeper Quest

5512040.desc: Seven months ago, Glassy Sky threw them out. Tonight Kira and Mark are coming back: in a stolen car, armed, with a plan that was never supposed to work. A standalone four-act story campaign for Directors Cut: Train.
5512040.name: Directors Cut: Train – Bonnie & Clyde

5512840.desc: A free Cold War real-time strategy game in full 3D. Build a base, mine ore and lead the Allies or the Soviets across 16 maps. Fight the computer, battle friends with up to eight players, or climb the ranked 1v1 and 2v2 ladders.
5512840.name: Code Red RTS

5513420.desc: A Brazilian top-down crime sandbox inspired by GTA 1, GTA 2 and Chinatown Wars. Steal cars, turn intersections into police pileups and switch between two protagonists. Take jobs, race illegally or grab a helicopter and explore a freshly generated island.
5513420.name: C.L.T.

5513550.desc: A coin-flip incremental. Hover over coins and they flip on their own. Buy more coins, a bigger ring and chain reactions until the whole stone is exploding in gold. Pay off Hell's bills before they're due, or lose it all.
5513550.name: Obol

5513610.desc: A top-down survivors-like where your ship's neon trail is your only attack. Circle a swarm, close the loop, and everything inside bursts at once. Bigger loops hit harder but keep you exposed for longer. A run takes about ten minutes.
5513610.name: LOOPLINE

5513980.desc: One night, you casually start a livestream to show viewers around your room. From that night on, your peaceful everyday life begins to fall apart...
5513980.name: Haishin

5514130.desc: Tired of traditional Minesweeper? Try Loop Minesweeper! Familiar rules, but the board never ends. Had enough of flat boards? Rotate a sphere and sweep mines in 3D. Want something stranger? Try negatively curved space on a Poincaré disk. Super cool.
5514130.name: Loop Minesweeper

5514200.desc: Newborn is a 3D online fantasy RPG for Windows where every journey begwins at the very start of a life. Create a character, step into the medieval town of Rokento, and set out across a living continent of desert dunes, frozen glaciers, misty marshlands, open seas and far-off islands.
5514200.name: Newborn

5514250.desc: Break through solid rock with your bare hands. Smash blocks, upgrade your power at the Workbench, unlock stronger gloves, fight enemies, and uncover what lies beyond the walls.
5514250.name: DeepBreaker

5514700.desc: Flick weapons into your backpack and take on the horde! In this action roguelite, your weapons attack automatically. Swap out overheated weapons and stack matching gear to merge it. Before each run, fit skill pieces together and spend your gold on permanent upgrades to shape your build.
5514700.name: PanicOperator

5514810.desc: Look closely, then answer from memory! Challenge friends in 2–8 player tournaments full of cute animal scenes. Import your own pictures, write multiple-choice questions, and share custom packs for a challenge only your group could create.
5514810.name: Memory King

5515050.desc: Welcome to a secret members-only billiards club where 20 beautiful heroines await! Face them in thrilling three-cushion matches and enjoy their intimate service as your prize. Adult videos, a story and a free practice mode! A sweet, breathtaking time for special members only begins.
5515050.name: Secret 3-Cushion Club

5515070.desc: Beneath the City lies the Pit — a bottomless chasm full of monsters, artifacts and secrets. Assemble a squad of four heroes, combine six elements, descend into random dungeons and fight for your place in the leagues against other explorers of the deep.
5515070.name: Heroes of the Void

5516180.desc: Maze tower defense for up to eight players. Hold one lane of a ring round a castle: build the longest maze you can, catch what leaks from your teammates and see how many endless waves your team can hold. Or go PvP: two teams, mercenary sends, and ranked ladders from 1v1 to 4v4.
5516180.name: Ringfall TD

5516980.desc: Thousands of toy bricks are tipped across a cozy toy shop floor. Sort each one onto the shelf for its shape and into the bin for its color, alone or in online co-op for up to 4. Play the 14-room Campaign, or put all 114 shapes on the floor at once in Cozy Mode.
5516980.name: Tidy Up: Bricks n Blocks

5517840.desc: Defend a growing network against real-world cyberattacks - from a freelancer's home laptop to the quantum era. Place firewalls and 2FA, research new defenses, catch phishing emails, read the logs and decide what to save when everything is under attack.
5517840.name: Breachwall: Network Defense

5517900.desc: Yeat is a minimalist clicker game where every click counts. Choose between TONKA and YEAT, build up your individual and combined click totals, and watch your numbers grow. Your progress is saved locally, so you can continue clicking whenever you return.
5517900.name: Yeat

5518020.desc: Build a global airline from a single prop-plane. Your planes fly real routes on a living globe and keep earning while you're away. Grow hubs, unlock new regions, then sell your airline and start a holding company of subsidiaries. A relaxing idle tycoon that lives on your desktop.
5518020.name: Red Eye Empire

5518050.desc: With your team of 4, there are no rules in this chaotic battle: Don't fall for fake CDs, throw objects at your opponents, and defeat them at any cost. The first to find the real CD and reach the police wins. It's time to put your friendship to the test! The real ZTA VI CD will be in your hands!
5518050.name: Find The ZTA VI CD

5518570.desc: TrapRush is an online party platformer for 2 to 12 players. Each round, everyone places one item on the same course: a bridge, a spring, or a saw hidden under it. Then you all race to the flag at once. Make it while your friends don't, and you score.
5518570.name: TrapRush

5518650.desc: Pilot a customizable spacecraft in WHUCK Protocol, a top-down voxel sci-fi roguelite. Survive waves of hostile machines, evolve powerful weapons, defeat massive bosses, and choose when to extract or descend deeper to uncover the legend of WHUCK.
5518650.name: WHUCK Protocol

5518960.desc: Survive a shared battlefield in this online PvPvE action RPG. Combine skills, enhance equipment and form alliances of up to four. Risk your progress for treasure, prepare your next life, and challenge the Vermilion Bird to become the one who ends the season.
5518960.name: SURVIVORS SURVIVE

5518990.desc: Fill the cube with no gaps. 100 hand-made 3D polycube challenges from the Cubetoria Series 1 puzzle book, from your first 2×2×2 to expert Pro builds. Turn, tilt and snap colourful pieces into place, find every answer, keep a daily streak and build your own puzzles.
5518990.name: Cubetoria: Build. Think. Solve.

5519340.desc: A cooperative puzzle platformer for 1 to 4 players who share the controls of a single cow. Split the keys, time synced jumps, clear wacky obstacles, and find meme dances hidden behind secret NPCs!
5519340.name: Jumping Cow

5519390.desc: Chess in 2D and 3D that plays just as well with a controller as with a mouse, and also from any browser. Six AI levels with titles to earn, game reviews that explain every mistake, puzzles, an interactive tutorial and online play.
5519390.name: Salva's Chess

5519480.desc: Wreck and Repeat captures that bite-sized GTA chaos of city mayhem distilled into an incremental driving roguelite about wrecking everything in sight, one short run at a time. Explore a vibrant procedurally generated Cyberpunk city where every building, car, and street prop can break apart.
5519480.name: Wreck and Repeat

5519610.desc: Run a late-night cafe in Tokyo, serve meals tailored to your regulars, and investigate the secrets behind their requests. Balance supplies, cooking and income with clues, conversations and relationships in this 2D single-player narrative adventure and management game.
5519610.name: The Midnight Client

5519840.desc: Bring a friend. Make a rival. Dig through rock, steal their ore and put out their Furnace in a real-time 1v1 or 2v2 digging shooter. Thirty guns, destructible tunnels and fights worth settling in a rematch. Play online or split screen.
5519840.name: Claimbreaker

5520280.desc: Run a creator company with your own studio and production team. Combine production cards, design workflows, and furnish your workspace with equipment and housing items in this management sim. Develop your staff, grow channels, and expand through sponsorships and creator contracts.
5520280.name: Creator Tycoon

5520310.desc: A city-building simulation where you freely create your own city on the water. Surrounded by Baroque music, watch merchants stroll through the streets and horse-drawn carriages pass by as you admire the cityscape and its architecture. We invite you to experience **A Moment of Tranquility**.
5520310.name: バロック商人 ～ バッハの残響

5520650.desc: Play solo or in 2-player online co-op in this PSX style extraction roguelite based on the Backrooms. Explore procedural levels, scavenge for loot, and extract alive to upgrade your gear.
5520650.name: Clip Out: Backrooms

5521040.desc: Found your village on the real map of Istanbul. Send caravans over real bridges and ferry lines, raise walls, train soldiers and grow from a humble village into a beylik in a free online strategy game where every street and landmark is the real city.
5521040.name: Koyland

5521470.desc: 5,000,000 games on VAPOR, and all but one are clones. From your bedroom PC, screen procedurally generated store pages, stamp each fake on the detail that gives it away, put bots to work, and dig through the haystack for the one original. An incremental hidden object parody.
5521470.name: Needle in a Haystack Simulator in a Haystack of Needle in a Haystack Simulators

5521500.desc: 9 classic board games in one collection: Chess, Backgammon, Connect titles, Checkers, Dominoes, sink the fleet, Monopolization, Parchis and Snakes and Ladders. Play against the machine, hot-seat locally or online with friends over Steam.
5521500.name: Board Game Collection: Family Classics

5521810.desc: You don't need to be a hero to protect someone's tomorrow. Set out as just a villager in this 8-bit MMORPG. Cross paths with other players, help each other, and uncover the world's secrets to the end. Play with strangers, friends, or solo. Then the Trial Tower awaits. Buy once, no subscription.
5521810.name: Just a Villager MMORPG

5522490.desc: Supporter pack for No Blink Allowed
5522490.name: No Blink Allowed - Supporter Pack

5523300.desc: Physics study app: 65 topics, 5,616 practice items, lessons, flashcards and mock exams. Limelight: A Physics puzzle game in a theatre of illusions.
5523300.name: Total Physics

5523540.desc: Lead your species from the Atomic Age to Transcendence: explore a random galaxy, colonize worlds, design ships, forge alliances and command real-time space battles – a turn-based 4X space strategy game.
5523540.name: MischkaSpace

5523630.desc: The most old-school football manager you'll find. Start in the 10th division, build your squad, pick your XI, adjust at half-time and climb to the top flight: 200 clubs, 10 divisions, 7,000+ players. No microtransactions, no loot boxes. Play solo or with up to 3 managers on one PC.
5523630.name: Eleven FC Manager

5524160.desc: A cosy idle fishing game on a Scottish island. Fish from a stone pier while the bites come on their own, level eight skills, hire four hands, then mend an old creel boat and take her out to new grounds. Eight Summers with a proper ending, 257 catches to log, and no timers or ways to fail.
5524160.name: The Wee Pier

5524170.desc: Return to the flower shop for a Christmas tidy-up. Sort 16 festive flower varieties, stock gifts, decorate the tree, and discover the notes left behind.
5524170.name: Tidy Up the Flower Shop: Christmas

5525500.desc: Collect, sort, and organize hundreds of unique stamps across beautiful themed albums. Play alone or online with friends, create your own collections from photos, and enjoy the simple pleasure of putting everything in its place.
5525500.name: A Thousand Stamps

5526200.desc: Automate your factory while building deep relationships with the heroines.
5526200.name: Let's Build a Naughty Toy Factory!

5526720.desc: Answer 911 calls with your own voice. Every caller hears what you say and answers back: panicked, confused, sometimes barely able to speak. Pull out the details that matter, find them on the map, and send police, fire, and EMS. Work the shift solo or with up to six dispatchers.
5526720.name: Dispatch Simulator

5526860.desc: Descend with 1-4 wizard cats through every-pixel-simulated caverns! Craft chaotic modular wands, swat volatile potions off shelves, trigger chain-reaction falling-sand alchemy, and share one pool of 9 Lives in online co-op or solo roguelike runs.
5526860.name: Nine Lives Below

5527800.desc: An asteroid will hit Earth in 90 days. The government held a tender, and one miner came with his own pickaxe. He asked for no money and said the asteroid would pay for itself. Dig 5,000,000 m³ in first person, solo or in online co-op for up to 8. Sell the ore and buy ship guns that fire as you dig.
5527800.name: No Asteroids

5527840.desc: 经营一座破落宗门：安排弟子种田炼丹、静修冲境，给他们赐婚、看他们生子、也看他们记仇。布阵迎战同样在过日子的敌宗，熬过每五十年一次的大劫。二十个建造位，九品仙宗，六处秘境——飞升，或者被灭门。
5527840.name: 洞府修仙录

5528190.desc: Meet Zephyr, a curious little bird powered by AI running locally on your computer. Leave him notes, explore his town, and watch him discover hobbies, make friends, build games, and create videos. A cozy companion game about a little bird with a life of his own.
5528190.name: Zephyr's World

5528200.desc: Welcome to IcerKid! Dive into a chilly, fast-paced puzzle-action adventure where your goal is to survive and conquer dynamic levels. Strategy, control, and thinking skills are required to advance to higher levels and compete on global leaderboards.
5528200.name: IcerKid

5528450.desc: Strike down relentless waves of enemies and test your reflexes! How long can you survive as the speed keeps rising in this fast-paced retro 8-bit arena?
5528450.name: Ninja Kaeru

5528590.desc: Race as kemonomimi yokai girls through 24 courses of Japanese folklore, from fox shrines to Raijin's thunderclouds. Drift, boost and hurl yokai mischief at your rivals to take the lead.
5528590.name: Kitsune Kart

5528680.desc: A game night made for two adults on one PC. Choose Casual, Flirty, or Spicy and explore four couples games: Truth, Dare or Drink, Never Have I Ever, Know Your Partner, and Quiz Night. Share stories, test your connection, and take turns in the spotlight.
5528680.name: Two Can Play

5529020.desc: The Madness of Michael DLC adds new versions of all characters, as well as hundreds of new items and new challenges. It's a gigantic addition that will ensure lovers of Cursed Words can lose themselves in the game all over again!
5529020.fullgame_name: Cursed Words: The Word Game That Isn't
5529020.name: Cursed Words: The Madness Of Michael

5529210.desc: Tidy up the auto repair shop! Sort the tools and spare parts, put everything in its place, clean off the dirt, and build a car piece by piece!
5529210.name: Auto Mechanic Tidy Up

5529550.desc: Survive escalating zombie waves in a top-down shooter, solo or with a friend in online co-op. Earn cash, collect loot and blueprints, and turn each purchase into a better chance of survival. Complete achievements to unlock cosmetics and rescue cats along the way.
5529550.name: XtreaM Zombies

552990.desc: Immerse yourself in thrilling naval battles and assemble an armada of over 800 ships from the first half of the 20th century — from stealthy destroyers to gigantic battleships. Change the look of your ship, choose upgrades to suit your play style, and go into battle with other players!
552990.name: World of Warships

5530980.desc: The sun has fallen asleep. Carry the last ember of daylight in a single torch and lead a column of four east to the Tower of the Sleeping Sun. A fairy-tale, turn-based party RPG where your marching order is your formation — and whoever holds the torch decides what you see.
5530980.name: Torchline

5531040.desc: This supporter pack contains themes and the Nuberry handset. The Standard membership card for Goodwin Mutual is unlocked. Purchase this pack to support the development teams ongoing work on Touchline.
5531040.name: Touchline Standard

5531300.desc: The elves pulled an all nighter and the workshop is buried under a mountain of toys! Grab up to 7 friends, climb the pile and put thousands of teddies, trains and presents back where they belong before Santa's inspection. Cozy, chaotic, satisfying co-op.
5531300.name: Christmas Workshop: Tidy Up Together

5531610.desc: The maid asks if you have an appointment. It's your house. Take it back in GBald, a third-person arcade shooter. Dodge flying pots, fight through 30 waves of furious staff and roosters, and hit the gym between waves.
5531610.name: GBald

5531790.desc: Tidy up the oasis! Scoop the desert into your backpack, turn sand into gold and upgrade from a cotton glove to a full-blown sandstorm. Uncover a green oasis, hidden treasure and helpful robots, alone or with up to 3 friends in online co-op.
5531790.name: Desert Cleaner

5532190.desc: A tactical 1v1 board duel on a 6×6 grid where every piece you place shoves its neighbours. Line up three or deploy all eight to win. Quick online matches against players on PC and mobile, or play the AI offline. Outwit. Oust. Win.
5532190.name: Oustwit

5532230.desc: AMOS Studio is a modern macOS development environment for creating genuine Amiga software using the AMOS Pro language. Write and edit code, import and export original AMOS files, and work with compatible memory banks. Currently in Early Access, with native compilation and ADF support planned.
5532230.name: AMOS Studio

5532770.desc: Pick a job at a real airport, watch your plane fly it in real time, and get paid when it lands. A relaxed flight career over the real world, with live weather, thousands of airports and pilots from everywhere sharing one sky.
5532770.name: Pocket Pilots

5532830.desc: A first-person shooter where every bullet is a real projectile with its own speed and drop. Build your weapon from 34 guns, then fight online in lobbies of up to 32 players or against bots across a Mexican valley town, Brazilian Favela, the Ukrainian steppe and an open sea of jets.
5532830.name: New Age War: Online

5533560.desc: Nailong Battle is a lighthearted 2D survival shooter. Your round Nailong auto-fires at endless waves while you dodge, growing stronger with gold and XP. Pick two of five active skills, then take on bosses and Steam leaderboards.
5533560.name: NAILONG BATTLE

5533720.desc: Give your desktop a bold new look with this exclusive wallpaper pack for Fuck Everything 👉👌💦. Explore a collection of high-quality artworks inspired by the game’s characters, cheeky atmosphere, and unforgettable moments.
5533720.name: Fuck Everything 👉👌💦 - WALLPAPERS🔞

5533800.desc: Free Lances is a medieval autobattler. You lead a company of mercenaries in a war between two lords. Accept contracts from either lord, place your units, give them orders and watch the battle play out. Your objective is to win a castle of your own and retire there in peace.
5533800.name: FreeLances: Blood for Profit

5533990.desc: The feast is over and Grandma’s farmhouse is a gravy-splattered disaster. Pick up, sort and put away up to 2,831 plates, pies, pumpkins and forks with up to 7 friends, while golden hour fades into a cozy, fire-lit night.
5533990.name: Thanksgiving: Tidy Up Together

5534070.desc: Give Bloom a magical new transformation with the exclusive Cardix skin, inspired by the Winx Club collectible cards from Kayou!
5534070.name: Winx Club - Moonlight Quest: Bloom Cardix Transformation Skin

5534310.desc: Dig a haystack of one million straws, sell the hay, then build belts and robotic arms to take the stack apart. Ten hidden needles give permanent bonuses. A cozy first-person factory game.
5534310.name: Find The Needle: Haystack Hunt

5534440.desc: This Laboratory-themed world unlocks 16 additional levels for Coloring Voxels. Science, experiments and maybe even a little sci-fi await you inside. You can feel like something of a scientist yourself with this world!
5534440.name: Coloring Voxels - Laboratory Pack

5534460.desc: Up to six friends pilot cheap drill pods straight down to Hell. Dig a new hex-column world every contract, haul ore to a shared crew bank, build Lift stations at depth, break the Seals, beat the devil waiting at the bottom, then escape the flood.
5534460.name: Motherloader

5534910.desc: Real No-Limit Texas Hold’em with your friends — live webcam and voice chat right at the table. Seat up to 7 friends online, or play solo against Easy, Medium and Hard bots anytime.
5534910.name: Poker Night Live

5535320.desc: 5,434 Christmas items are scattered across the shop. Put them back where they belong and enjoy the wonderful order. No timer, no stress. Upgrade your skills with the candy you earn and arrange colourful, twinkling Christmas items on the shelves of a huge two-storey shop as you like. Merry Christmas!
5535320.name: Tidy Up Christmas Shop

5535690.desc: Meet Kebbo, a sleepy dragon and master coinmaker, running a tiny mint in the corner of your desktop. He strikes coins and earns marks while you get on with your day. Check in when you like to answer letters, travel the kingdoms and help him fill his book.
5535690.name: The Dragon's Mint

5535750.desc: A WW2 tank in a medieval world, fighting armies of several hundred soldiers at a time and knocking down their castles. There is an open-world campaign, a Gauntlet roguelike mode, and online co-op and PvP with friends for up to four players.
5535750.name: Tanks & Trebuchets

5536060.desc: SUMMER 1812, WITH EUROPE UNDER HIS HEAL AND BRITAIN NOT ACCEPTING ANY PEACE. NAPOLEON LEADS THE LARGEST ARMY EVER ASSEMBLED IN EUROPE. TO FINALY INVADE RUSSIA, CAN YOU QUICKLY CONQUER RUSSIA. WHILE MAKING SURE YOUR TROOPS KEEP UP THE PACE AND ARE SUPPLIED! BEFORE THE RUSSIAN WINTER?
5536060.name: War Tiles: Napoleons Invasion of Russia

5536190.desc: Shellcrushers is a stylized horde tower defense game: tens of thousands of roaches pour in at once, and you meet them with six turrets, RPG-deep upgrade trees and procedurally generated maps, so no two fights play the same.
5536190.name: Shellcrushers

5537480.desc: Fly a modern strike fighter low over a real, 1:1 map of Israel. Thread the Tel Aviv towers, explore 120+ real places in Free Flight, fly six sorties from training to historic 1967 and 1981 strikes, and land it back home. Easy to learn, with a live coach.
5537480.name: SUFA: Strike Fighter

5537490.desc: The most immersive darts career simulation ever made. Build your player, design your darts and rise from pub opens to the World Championship. Handle the press, win over sponsors and take on more than 2,000 players in a living world of tours, rankings and rivalries.
5537490.name: Darts Player Simulator

5537900.desc: Night is a top-down action shooter with a security-camera look. Fight through dark, ever-changing floors, shoot, dash and execute enemies in melee, face a boss every 10 floors, and team up with up to three AI-controlled allies.
5537900.name: Night

5537920.desc: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 dogs in Kuala Lumpur 🐾 in the hand-crafted landscape. 🏆 Earn tons of achievements. How many 🐶 can you find? 🔎 Be quick! ⏱️
5537920.name: 101 Dogs Hidden in Kuala Lumpur

5538010.desc: Zombie Train is a roguelite survival defense game. Fight endless zombie hordes, defend your base camp, and cooperate or compete with other survivors. Combine weapons and cards to build your ultimate armored train. Every choice matters!
5538010.name: ZombieTrain Demo

553850.desc: The Galaxy’s Last Line of Offence. Enlist in the Helldivers and join the fight for freedom across a hostile galaxy in a fast, frantic, and ferocious third-person shooter.
553850.name: HELLDIVERS™ 2

5538790.desc: A turn-based hex strategy game of total conquest. Command combined land, sea, and air forces across procedurally generated worlds, outmaneuver up to four independent AI rivals, and capture every city to win it all.
5538790.name: War Master: World Conquest

5539600.desc: Unit 47, re-cut as the prestige TV series nobody asked for. Episode title cards, a sponsor break, production notes on how the game was really made, character cards, gold clipboards, and credits where every name is Amir Dayyef. Free.
5539600.name: PROPERTY INSPECTION: DIRECTOR'S CUT

5539980.desc: A tactical siege board game of chained jumps and castle assaults. Command ten pawns and four knights, wipe out your rival or storm both castle gates. Play the AI, pass-and-play with friends, or go online, including 4-player team battles.
5539980.name: Knights & Squires

5540060.desc: Breakdance Simulator is a wild party game that brings breakdancing to your living room. Every move is danced with real physics, so a perfect headspin and a spectacular faceplant are never far apart. Think you can build the ultimate routine?
5540060.name: Breakdance Simulator

5541080.desc: Own a failing racetrack and keep the gates open for 36 months. Choices matter. Pull the policy levers, keep the people who can shut you down on your side, then watch each month's stakes race with a full voiced broadcast. An influence web that meets the racetrack owner's dream. Fully offline.
5541080.name: My Dusty Downs

5541800.desc: A short incremental baseball game: hit the ball, collect cheers, reach the ending.
5541800.name: Summer, Youth, and Baseball

5541850.desc: Two riders. Four dragons. One sky to rule. Pick the Orc King or the Sorceress Queen, saddle up a fire, ice, poison, or magic dragon, and joust your rivals out of the clouds. Raid villages, summon storms, call a Titan, or just fly for high scores, solo, online or tournament with 8 players .
5541850.name: Dragon Joust

5542190.desc: Click on 'Start Game', the image will be grayed out, and the colored parts will be randomly scrambled into 16 small fragments, scattered randomly on the screen.Players click on the small image, drag it to its original position to restore it, until all the small fragments move to the correct position
5542190.name: Wuxiang Lake

5542420.desc: A clicker incremental game where every swing fuels your growth. Hold to attack, cut through monsters, and turn your earnings into lasting power. Go from struggling against a single foe to sweeping through crowds. How far will you get this time?
5542420.name: 杀个痛快

5542430.desc: Fire a line at a building, swing to the top, let go, and fly! Tear through neon cities, a clockwork town and a 600 m megatower at over 300 km/h, throw items as volcanoes erupt and rockets lift off, and race up to 4 players online as a runner, a chicken or a hamster.
5542430.name: Swoopla: Swing Racing

5542640.desc: One bus. Four wheels. A whole lot of bad decisions. Share control of an uncooperative bus, rescue flying passengers and cross cities, canyons, ice and swamps on the way to a megatower roof. Play solo or argue your way to the finish with up to three friends.
5542640.name: WeirdBus

5542670.desc: Support Safari-TV and give your next questionable expedition a new look. Includes the Reptile Skin, Monkey Costume, Alien Goggles and Hypnotic Glasses. Cosmetic items only.
5542670.name: Safari-TV - Supporter Pack

5542680.desc: Bring a little more nonsense to your next safari with the Lion Costume, Black Robber Mask and Pixel Glasses. Three cosmetic items for the friends who always end up in the footage.
5542680.name: Safari-TV - Community Pack

5543980.desc: A desktop pet for Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity: every prompt sends your mascot to the stage to dance while customers throw bills worth its API cost.
5543980.name: Token Club: AI Desktop Pet

5544230.desc: Steer a ray-traced glass marble along floating roads of ice, mirrors and spinning floors. Race the clock through five worlds, hunt hidden sun crystals to earn a sixth, then build your own courses in an editor that traces every change as you make it.
5544230.name: Gorse Roll

5544560.desc: A psychological horror game set in a yakiniku restaurant in Japan. As the owner, you open the restaurant and welcome customers as usual. But that night, orders begin arriving from Table 7—a table that shouldn't exist...
5544560.name: Midnight Yakiniku | 深夜焼肉

5544590.desc: Masha falls asleep over a deadline in Moscow and wakes up as Vasilisa, a young woman promised to Koshchei. Learn the rules of the living forest, protect your true name, and choose an ally in a dark fantasy visual novel inspired by Slavic folklore.
5544590.name: Bride of Koshchei

5545050.desc: You are Xxx, a security guard forced to work the night shift. Unfortunately for you, boredom is the least of your worries at CLT SUPERMARKET. Survive, fight back, and uncover the truth behind what’s happening in this fast-paced action-horror adventure as you face the horrors of both the workplace.
5545050.name: CLT Supermarket

5545400.desc: Build a fantasy trading empire in a single-player idle crafting game. Hire gatherers and crafters, turn raw materials into valuable goods, and outtrade rival merchants. Set your prices, collect your sales and grow your warband between visits.
5545400.name: Auction House 2

5546350.desc: Duck Billiards is a bullet heaven where your attacks are determined by billiard balls and runs are lightning quick. Play as cool duck wizards and unlock lots of items and levels!
5546350.name: Duck Billiards

5546640.desc: Run your own Christmas tree lot in a snowy Montana town. Sell every tree, cut it fresh, net it and strap it to the car. Take on a new job each day, hire a crew, grow from a corner lot to a second lot across town, keep Santa happy and make it to Christmas Eve.
5546640.name: Christmas Lot Simulator

5546670.desc: Drop one card onto another and watch a 13th-century kingdom grow. Gather, build and raise your people, survive the seasons and hostile neighbors, then win by conquering their capitals or completing a grand cathedral.
5546670.name: StackProsper

5547250.desc: Action packed 3D cat fighting indie game. It's not an AAA game, probably not even -A. But it's full of adventure, leveling and customization. Also funny.
5547250.name: Pufu

5547370.desc: A history-driven merge puzzler. Water meets fire and becomes steam; steam pushes the first machine — 223 elements, 10 Chinese dynasties, 74 levels, from a Stone Age campfire to a Qing-era firearms workshop. Every invention cites a real source.
5547370.name: 文明融合

5547610.desc: Survivor Town blends colony management, autonomous survivor simulation, and tower defense in a post-apocalyptic world. Recruit unique survivors, build production chains, research technology, craft equipment, explore dangerous lands, and defend your settlement against daily raids and powerful Bosses.
5547610.name: Survivor Town

5547640.desc: Start an investment company with JPY 100 million in 1956. Study financial reports, invest in shares, and acquire businesses. Reinvest dividends and sale proceeds, face changing economic conditions, and build your own conglomerate.
5547640.name: Investor Life

5547990.desc: RETROPULSE Christmas is a relaxing neon puzzle game with festive retrowave and retro-anime art. Connect matching colored dots with glowing lines, fill the grid, and reveal Christmas illustrations across 50 levels. Enjoy cozy holiday vibes, colorful puzzles, and atmospheric electronic music.
5547990.name: RETROPULSE Christmas

5548320.desc: Clean up after the party in this cozy first-person co-op game! Put every item back where it belongs, scrub away the stains, toss the trash and play satisfying mini-games – solo or with a friend, online or split-screen – before Mom gets home.
5548320.name: Party Home: Tidy Up Together

5548450.desc: Gear up like an elite operator with the Tom Clancy’s Ghost Recon Crimebond, featuring two new weapons, a new mine, three outfit sets, and more.
5548450.name: PAYDAY 3: Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon Crimebond

5549660.desc: Build a driver's career from karting to the top of fictional championships. Train, choose contracts and direct race pace, tyres and pit stops. Balance ambition, funding, academy support and fan reactions in a pixel-art motorsport world.
5549660.name: Kartelith: Racing Career

5549700.desc: Return to an abandoned psychiatric hospital where your mother vanished twenty years ago. Explore dark corridors, solve environmental puzzles, and survive terrifying encounters in this 25–30 minute first-person psychological horror demo. Room 307 is waiting.
5549700.name: ROOM 307 Demo

5549760.desc: Demand runs ahead of supply, growers are being recruited. You are one of them: you pick a planet, take over a plot of land, and run it remotely through a tracked robot called the Farmoton. You make money (nibs) by growing crops and selling them to the traders who dock at your farm's market each day.
5549760.name: Interplanetary Farmer

5550010.desc: A dark fantasy roguelike auto-battler where massive armies clash as rival gods shape your campaign with blessings, curses, and impossible demands.
5550010.name: Bring Me More! Demo

5550020.desc: A Three Kingdoms strategy roguelike. Battles are match-3, decisions are strategy. Build a different army every run from 50 generals and 6 formations, and march on Luoyang, where Dong Zhuo has made a pact with a demon.
5550020.name: Chains of Three Kingdoms

5550200.desc: If you'd like to support the development of Meow Star Archives, or contribute to helping stray cats, we and the little kitties would like to give something back to you
5550200.name: Meow Star Archives - Supporter Pack

5550890.desc: A text adventure inspired by the Sierra classics. A pirate with a hat and no ship, a sarcastic parrot and a map torn in three: type your way across the Caribbean, dig up chests, forge papers, bribe a skeleton with a fish and out-fence your old captain to a legendary hoard.
5550890.name: The Perfect Quest: The Drowned King's Hoard

5551040.desc: This is a top-down platformer where your goal is to complete the levels. Destination & Acceleration is a truly hardcore, stylish, and fair game. What a shame you won't even make it past ten levels here.
5551040.name: Destination & Acceleration

5552070.desc: Command one of four sci-fi armies on a hex board where every tile fires at once. Place, move and rotate your tiles, aim their guns and shields, and be the last one standing. Play against the computer, with friends on the same PC, or online with 2 to 4 players.
5552070.name: HexStermination

5552220.desc: Experience the world of Melvor Idle 2 through its official soundtrack, composed by Matteo Palmer. From peaceful skilling to epic battles, enjoy an atmospheric collection of music that brings the world of Melvor to life.
5552220.name: Melvor Idle 2: A RuneScape Adventure Soundtrack

5552910.desc: Pilot an auto-firing weapons platform through swarms of machines in this top-down action roguelite. Level up and evolve weapons, trigger chain collapses, and cut the power to industrial districts across nine maps.
5552910.name: 暴走拆城 (Rampage Demolition)

5552940.desc: Fire, take control of your bullet, and catch your friends off guard. Show: No Mercy is a competitive FPS party game for 2–8 players. Battle across pirate islands, adapt to different game modes, and fight for trophies. Steer your shot. Beat your rivals. Win the show.
5552940.name: Show: No Mercy

5553070.desc: A farm boy inherits a crest that was never meant for him. Lead a growing band of companions through a kingdom at war, in a grid-based tactics RPG with the look of the handheld classics.
5553070.name: The Radiant Crest

5553810.desc: This is a demo. And you're just an intern training to become a Game World Maintenance Worker. Figure out how to gather ingredients and brew potions to send to the heroes. Along the way, clean up the mess left behind by your work. Make it spotless and fill all the slots with full potions.
5553810.name: Bunny Bring Bits Demo

5555150.desc: This game is a collectible card battle game centered around monster summoning, magical traps and chain strategies. Collect cards, build decks, predict opponents, and create your own winning chains in the battles.
5555150.name: Duel Era

5555440.desc: Be the queen's scent: lead a living swarm of hundreds of honeybees to the flowers with your mouse and carry the honey home to a straw skep. Cook hornets in a heat ball, scatter from diving swallows and keep the colony fed through 12 summer days.
5555440.name: Kovan-G

5555790.desc: Become D.U.B.B.I.O, a counter-terror AI deployed to the city of Sowrat. Juggle simultaneous hacking tasks to interfere with terrorists, gather the clues they leave behind, and deduce where they will strike and how they are armed. But this mission is only the surface of the operation.
5555790.name: D.U.B.B.I.O

5556770.desc: There’s a place for you at Mallow’s picnic. Search ten painted woodland scenes for little lost treasures, from the rainy bakehouse to the lantern-lit stream, in a hidden-object story read by a gentle British narrator.
5556770.name: Moonberry Hollow

5556940.desc: Twelve pieces. One perfect fit. Build all twelve pentominoes from real 3D cubes and fill the build plate, matching every lettered anchor. 220 computer-checked challenges on five plates, a Daily Challenge, Free Build and the Cubetoria crew to cheer you on.
5556940.name: Cubetoria Pentomino Challenge

5557390.desc: After the busiest night at Winter Wonderland, everything has ended up in one giant pile. Team up with up to 8 friends to sort nearly 3,000+ festive treasures back where they belong, hang the baubles and switch the magical Winter Wonderland lights back on, one cosy armful at a time.
5557390.name: Winter Wonderland: Tidy Up Together

5557520.desc: A 90's horror inspired first-person game about working the midnight shift at a video rental store.
5557520.name: Midnight Shift 2: Last Rental

5559520.desc: Fish, flee, and gamble your way to quota in this 1-4 player roguelike. Fight every catch, haul it aboard, avoid demonic beasts, and make it back to the ship with just enough time to bet it all at the casino. Miss quota and the sea takes every coin. One wrong cast could cost everything.
5559520.name: Fished Out

5559930.desc: You are a cat, in a robot, in a car you built yourself. Bolt a gun on the front and a gun on the back, then race up to three friends through seven city-planets. Wreck, and you wake up in the pit, one life down. You get nine. Spend them.
5559930.name: Catnip Wars : Nine Lives Racing

5561120.desc: A pixel-art auto-battler. You get one save file. If your party wipes, it's deleted and you start over. Not quite from zero though cause the Scrolls you earned stay, and they make every new file stronger. Grow a party of six. Use their abilities. Fight against 36 bosses.
5561120.name: Single File

5562220.desc: Learn analog electronics by building circuits. Solve 55 puzzles, from your first LED to filters, amplifiers and oscillators, with a live circuit simulator, oscilloscope and multimeter. Lessons and hints help you along the way. Experiment freely in the sandbox.
5562220.name: Analog Bench

5563870.desc: Forward! Ed's Massage Parlor! is an adult RPG with male same-sex themes. Down on his luck in the big city, Ed returns home to take over his late father's massage parlor and gets to know all kinds of customers. Run the shop, decorate it your way, fight monsters and build your own combat style!
5563870.name: EMP_Forward! Ed's Massage Parlor!

5564710.desc: HOT HALLOWEEN - is a simple 2D game for adults in which you have to uncover hot images of beautiful ladies.
5564710.name: HOT HALLOWEEN

5565800.desc: Hide the milk in the back. Put your own store brand at eye level. Get inside every shopper's head. Build your supermarket from scratch, survive chaotic dinner rushes, and bankrupt six rival chains until you own the whole city.
5565800.name: Retail Empire

5566040.desc: Your story. Your stage. Your rise to stardom. Step into the spotlight and experience the excitement of life in the entertainment industry! Train as an idol or audition as an actor. Design concerts, star in films across four genres, and live the celebrity life in Evermont, a glamorous new city.
5566040.name: inZOI: Spotlight

5567200.desc: Essen, 1807: Grow your family business into an industrial conglomerate. Trade, manufacture, and invest in new technology. In this turn-based business and family simulation, you’ll guide your dynasty through wars and crises until 1933—and decide who will carry on your life’s work.
5567200.name: 1000 Milliarden Dollar - Kohle und Stahl

5567360.desc: Compete with other players for the top spot on the leaderboards! Summon 80 unique heroes, build powerful teams, and conquer endless worlds in this fantasy idle RPG. Fuse champions, evolve skills, collect legendary equipment, and keep progressing even while offline!
5567360.name: Summonforge: Idle RPG

5568040.desc: A co-op horror comedy for up to 4 players. You're a crew of space janitors: scrub stations after "incidents" and find out what roams the halls and how to survive it. There are no instructions: try everything, log your discoveries in the glossary and piece together the truth.
5568040.name: Deep Clean

5568660.desc: Hatch a new companion from a Rare Egg, raise it with Experience Bread, and choose five Rare 3★ charms with Charm Tickets.
5568660.name: Traymon World - Tamer Set I

5568670.desc: Prepare for your next adventure with an Epic Egg, plenty of Experience Bread, and five Epic 5★ charms of your choice.
5568670.name: Traymon World - Tamer Set II

5568680.desc: Take the music of Traymon World beyond your taskbar. Listen to the game’s original soundtrack whenever you like.
5568680.name: 트레이몬 월드: 태스크바 몬스터 RPG Soundtrack

5568830.desc: Awake or Sleep: Anomaly is a first-person psychological horror game where your home becomes a nightmare. Spot strange changes, blink to distinguish reality from dreams, and decide whether to sleep or escape. Survive terrifying encounters and uncover buried memories.
5568830.name: Awake or Sleep: Anomaly

5571360.desc: Take late-night cleaning jobs in a first-person horror game. Load up your van, mop floors, vacuum rugs, and take out the rubbish. When a cupboard opens by itself or an unplugged washer starts knocking, decide how much of the checklist is worth finishing.
5571360.name: Paranormal Cleaner

5571890.desc: Start at the help desk and climb to the corner office: close tickets, fix servers, survive outages, office politics, and performance reviews on the way to CTO. Or skip the ladder, stay in your parents' basement, and bet it all on Stonks.
5571890.name: plebCTO

5571940.fullgame_name: Sir, We Have a Pit Problem
5571940.name: Sir, We Have a Pit Problem! Demo

5572050.desc: Wake in a sterile white cube. Solve strange puzzles, unlock doors, and push deeper through a dreamlike maze of locked rooms. Escape… if you can.
5572050.name: Cube Escape

5572500.desc: Touhou Sukusuku Racing is a cute, casual racer set in Gensokyo and beyond. Speed through Touhou-inspired tracks, outplay rivals with varied items, and chase the championship. Between races, play with your Sukusuku friends at home and take photos together!
5572500.name: Touhou Sukusuku Racing

5572530.desc: A cozy Christmas falling-block puzzle game that looks like a felt stop-motion special and plays like an arcade classic. Drop elves beside presents, set off chain reactions, and bury up to three rivals in coal on one screen.
5572530.name: Tinsel Tumble

5577110.desc: BOWLO is a 3D bowling roguelike where every throw is an attack. Your ball carries a gun that fires down the lane on its own, the pins answer with bullet-hell patterns, and you steer the rolling ball through the fire while it's on its way to the pocket.
5577110.name: Bowlo

5577160.desc: Every cable in the world lies in one huge pile on the floor of a data center. Pull cables out, carry each plug to its port and watch the cable snap into a neat run. Restore the internet alone or in online co-op with up to 5 friends.
5577160.name: Untangle The Internet

5577260.desc: A dark fantasy action RPG. Four heroes, six acts of open world, endless Nightmare Dungeons, loot, a bestiary and up to four players online. Take the Cinders from the Wardens and relight the Hearth. Play solo or with friends.
5577260.name: Soulkindle

5577330.desc: When the lights go out, the monsters come out of the closet. Line up the toys across the bedroom floor and stop every nightmare before it reaches the bed. A cozy lane-defense game with a 240-night story, Hard Mode for every night, and co-op and versus with friends.
5577330.name: Bedtime vs. Nightmares

5577430.desc: The Moon Clock stopped at 11:59, and only the toys are awake to stop the nightmares. Your toy buddies follow you and do the fighting while you weave through the crowd and evolve your favorites. Win back the house solo, or team up with up to three friends online or on one couch.
5577430.name: Bedtime Survivors

5578420.desc: A text-based horror interactive fiction about a cursed grindhouse actress returning to the studio lot that ruined her. Make choices through seven genre-bending wings, survive the damage, resist the corruption, and chase one of eight endings.
5578420.name: FINAL CUT

5578650.desc: A free fantasy RPG of hooded heroes and 350+ magical creatures. Play on your own whenever you want, or join a live stream's caravan from Steam or the Twitch chat. Build your heroes, tame creatures and forge your gear.
5578650.name: Lumanto

5578660.desc: You run a manufacturing company. Customers send you offers, and every one of them ties up a production site for a number of rounds. Accept the wrong ones and your plants sit full of poor margins. Accept the right ones and you earn the capital to expand. It sounds simple. It isn’t.
5578660.name: Margin Matters

5579450.desc: Kanae Yamada, a reporter for an occult magazine, visits a vast Japanese mansion abandoned for over 20 years and now notorious as a haunted location. Trapped inside, she must solve mysterious puzzles, uncover the intentions of an unseen presence, and find a way to escape.
5579450.name: Escape from the abandoned mansion haunted by spirits!!

5580320.desc: Tidy up Uncle Tony's toy store by day, then grab the vacuum when night falls and the ghosts escape their snow globes! A free 20-minute taste of Uncle Tony's Spooky Toyland: cozy organizing meets cute ghost-vacuuming.
5580320.name: Uncle Tony's Spooky Toyland Demo

5581700.desc: Survive with your allies with up to 4-Player Online Co-Op survival and try to resist death in classic round-based zombies. Can you survive the zombie outbreak?
5581700.name: Zombie Outbreak - Co-Op Edition

5582050.desc: The official soundtrack for Zombie Outbreak, composed by Flagman Jeremy Network.  Featuring 4 easter-egg songs featured across each zombie map, along with four perk jingle songs.
5582050.name: Zombie Outbreak - Co-Op Edition Soundtrack

5583500.desc: Play When Chests Rain Tons of Loot your way. The Sandbox opens every level, skill, card and legendary item and lets you set the rules: up to a million times the gold, triple speed, endless runs. Looks adds new chests, gem and candy loot, and a colour set for every hero line.
5583500.fullgame_name: When Chests Rain Tons of Loot
5583500.name: When Chests Rain Tons of Loot - Sandbox & Looks

5583810.desc: What happens when 20 skeletons face a dragon? Or an army of goblins challenges a colossal demon? Try the free demo of Dark Ages Battle Simulator! Create your own dark-fantasy matchups, build your armies, and watch monsters, warriors, and legendary beasts clash in epic battles.
5583810.name: Dark Ages Battle Simulator Demo

5584120.desc: A psychological visual novel about a girl who’s in love with a teddy bear who’s in love with her. And a secret they both share.
5584120.name: Tell Me How I Can Hurt You

5584170.desc: Unlock Phase 1: Leaf Crown and continue your journey beyond the free content. Explore deeper into the Worldtree, face new challenges, gather materials, craft Sigil Shards, and strengthen your party as you uncover the secrets of the Worldtree.
5584170.fullgame_name: The Worldtree and the Omamori Promise
5584170.name: 世界樹と護符の約束 - Phase 1：葉冠編

5584920.desc: Collect cards, place buildings, and forge your own army in this roguelite auto-battler. Combine units, spells, and relics from different factions. Make the most of limited space and gold, and discover new combinations to overcome each battle.
5584920.name: TILELIA

5586550.desc: The delivery truck just tipped a whole building into one giant heap. Dig out bricks, logs, steel beams and Sash Windows, check the plan and fit every part into its glowing blueprint slot. Then bin the rubbish, return the tools and watch the lights come on, solo or with your crew.
5586550.name: Construction Site: Tidy Up Together

5587250.desc: Explore a cursed labyrinth filled with deadly monsters and hidden treasures. Defeat enemies, level up, master skills, and collect gear. Recruit NPCs as companions, fight powerful foes, overcome countless dangers, and reach the deepest depths!
5587250.name: Deepest Maze

5588810.desc: Challenge Death in a dark fantasy poker roguelike deckbuilder. Build powerful hands, combine supernatural Jokers and Soul Cards, bargain in the Black Market, and survive seven deadly contracts against cursed dealers. Risk everything, master your multipliers, and face Death itself.
5588810.name: IDEAL DEATH GAMBLING

5591320.desc: The free demo of The Cardkov. Play the opening of this single-player, top-down extraction shooter where poker hands become weapons. Collect discarded cards in the cold back alleys, build a hand, and make it back alive with your new weapon.
5591320.name: The Cardkov Demo

5594400.desc: After returning to your cabin after a while, you discover it has been completely covered in snow. Luckily you got a shovel.
5594400.name: Shovel That Snow Demo

5596460.desc: A pixel-art action RPG for 1 to 4 players. Choose one of five classes, master real-time combat, shape your build with glyphs, runes and 50 gear sets, and descend through 21 dungeons with their own deadly rules to face 21 bosses, solo or in online co-op.
5596460.name: The Old Circle: Ecos da Masmorra

5596770.desc: Support Idle Demon Slayer with exclusive cosmetics: a supporter title, avatar frame and profile card, weapon and spirit-pet appearances, plus a developer letter and digital commemorative album. This optional pack grants no combat stats.
5596770.name: 挂机伏魔录 - 伏魔传承·开发者支持包

5599530.desc: Thirty days to save your late Nana's cottage in Honeywood, a lakeside town where bears and people live side by side. Date six very different bears (one of them is technically a human), outwit a resort developer, and decide who you'd really rather meet in the woods.
5599530.name: I'd Choose the Bear

5601610.desc: Embark on your adventure with player from all over the world! Lead your Angel team to reveal the ancient mysteries of Galaxy…… Welcome to Angel legion, a free RPG gacha game with good fun!

5620270.desc: A free local translation model for RealSub, available in every region, including the EU, the UK and South Korea. Translation runs right on your own PC, so translations appear almost the moment the words do. No more waiting, and it can run fully offline.
5620270.name: RealSub Local Translation Model – Also Available in EU, UK & Korea

5625590.desc: Try Gravelix for free: blocks shatter into gravel on landing, and same-colored gravel that reaches from one side of the board to the other explodes. The demo includes the interactive tutorial and Classic mode with 5-minute sessions limitation.
5625590.name: Gravelix Demo

5658850.desc: Explore the art of Kame City in this digital artbook, featuring Aya, Miu, Mari, the supporting cast, and artwork from the game’s dates, cutscenes, locations, items, interface, and cover illustrations. This DLC contains only the digital artbook. It does not add gameplay content.
5658850.name: Kameko Artbook

570.desc: Every day, millions of players worldwide enter battle as one of over a hundred Dota heroes. And no matter if it's their 10th hour of play or 1,000th, there's always something new to discover. With regular updates that ensure a constant evolution of gameplay, features, and heroes, Dota 2 has taken on a life of its own.
570.name: Dota 2

578080.desc: PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS, the high-stakes winner-take-all shooter that started the Battle Royale craze, is free-to-play! Drop into diverse maps, loot unique weapons and supplies, and survive in an ever-shrinking zone where every turn could be your last.
578080.name: PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS

582010.desc: Welcome to a new world! In Monster Hunter: World, the latest installment in the series, you can enjoy the ultimate hunting experience, using everything at your disposal to hunt monsters in a new world teeming with surprises and excitement.
582010.name: Monster Hunter: World

588430.desc: Fallout Shelter puts you in control of a state-of-the-art underground Vault from Vault-Tec. Build the perfect Vault, keep your Dwellers happy, and protect them from the dangers of the Wasteland.
588430.name: Fallout Shelter

594650.desc: Hunt: Showdown 1896 is the brutally rewarding extraction shooter. Track twisted monsters and overcome ruthless PvP. Take bounties in corrupted backwaters lost to history. With a team, you might survive. Die with nothing or get out with everything.
594650.name: Hunt: Showdown 1896

596070.desc: Take the ice in first-person VR hockey. Handle the puck, pass, defend, and shoot with two-handed controls in DSHL matches. Play goalie, sharpen your skills, and chase wild Trick Shots and arcade challenges. Ringette is included as an extra mode.
596070.name: Dr Snipes Hockey VR

60.desc: A futuristic action game that challenges your agility as well as your aim, Ricochet features one-on-one and team matches played in a variety of futuristic battle arenas.

6100.desc: Eets may have a cute outer-shell, but its Lemmings meets The Incredible Machine gameplay, crazy characters and over 100 increasingly tricky puzzles quickly sucks in even the most seasoned player.

632360.desc: Escape a chaotic alien planet by fighting through hordes of frenzied monsters – with your friends, or on your own. Combine loot in surprising ways and master each character until you become the havoc you feared upon your first crash landing.

70.desc: Named Game of the Year by over 50 publications, Valve's debut title blends action and adventure with award-winning technology to create a frighteningly realistic world where players must think to survive. Also includes an exciting multiplayer mode that allows you to play against friends and enemies around the world.

700330.desc: Deep within a secure underground facility, a sudden containment breach allows many of the secured anomalies to escape from their chambers. Assist the Foundation in re-securing the facility, help the Insurgency in their goal to capture it, or wreak havoc as an SCP in a frantic bid to escape.

714010.desc: Aimlabs is the aim trainer of choice for over 50 Million players, from beginners to esports pros. Our unique aim analysis optimizes your gameplay, targets your weaknesses & builds key skills for any FPS game! Time to warm up with our unlimited scenarios & rank up in-game!

72850.desc: EPIC FANTASY REBORN The next chapter in the highly anticipated Elder Scrolls saga arrives from the makers of the 2006 and 2008 Games of the Year, Bethesda Game Studios. Skyrim reimagines and revolutionizes the open-world fantasy epic, bringing to life a complete virtual world open for you to explore any way you choose.

7940.desc: The new action-thriller from the award-winning team at Infinity Ward, the creators of the Call of Duty® series, delivers the most intense and cinematic action experience ever. Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare arms gamers with an arsenal of advanced and powerful modern day firepower and transports them to the most treacherous hotspots...

813780.desc: 42 Civilizations, 229 Campaign Missions, Singleplayer, Co-Op, Multiplayer, In-Game Editor, Mods, Cross-play...It is good to be the king.

8870.desc: Indebted to the wrong people, with his life on the line, veteran of the U.S. Cavalry and now hired gun, Booker DeWitt has only one opportunity to wipe his slate clean. He must rescue Elizabeth, a mysterious girl imprisoned since childhood and locked up in the flying city of Columbia.

892970.desc: A collaborative exploration and survival game for 1-10 players, set in a procedurally generated afterlife inspired by Viking culture. Battle, build, and conquer your way to a saga worthy of Odin’s patronage!

With its addictive action, frantic first-person shooter combat, massive arsenal of weaponry, RPG elements and four-player co-op, Borderlands is a breakthrough experience that challenges all the...

899770.desc: Uncover the Past, Reforge the Future. Ascend into one of 15 mastery classes and explore dangerous dungeons, hunt epic loot, craft legendary weapons, and wield the power of over a hundred transformative skill trees. Last Epoch is being developed by a team of passionate Action RPG enthusiasts.

This standalone retail title spans three distinct stories, interwoven to create one of the most unique and engaging single-player experiences of this...

Two years after the Infinite War the once great warring nations now lie in ruins, and humanity’s hope for a brighter future is nothing but a bitter memory.
